tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 2 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis he ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/dpe thum gsol/dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/ dhenye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉 zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang /da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang /'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/nang don rig pa dang /gso ba rig pa/tshad ma rig pa/sgra rig pa/bzo rig pa/lo rgyus/rtsis rig ༈gas bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yan/ —1—

'ad 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las kya go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun /bang la thob pa na shan tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brjid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lce gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal /bab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i ma/bas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gas snyel dang skung yig mang zhing bris chugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang ma/bas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gas snyel bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'chug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu guzhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'gyung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhud lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu spungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / har wid lta bu yo rob dang / a— rdo rdogs su grags wo gyi slob grwa chen mo

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod wo po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi bee ro ska cog zhung / /ni nubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ shangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhud lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/—2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang chabs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'gyung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyam/sa pa rnams gsos/ 'khru/gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/—3—

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhyen mkhyen/ / zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu'i las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs tog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4—

bsdu sgrag gsal bshad/bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi bandi dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod — —

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras sbungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btang ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2—

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon tan bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras skrungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3 —

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni spo dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bshes mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4—

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi chul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras skrungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'gyung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈khyu 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di/ 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5 —

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song hrin krin sogs kyi rgya'i sbyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'gyung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—6—

khong ni slob dpon chen tshu du 7 5 pa / se tre 1 6 3 'di byung gnas dang / paṇḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs te mes pos padma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang sbyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid 'khrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis — 1 —

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gas yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang /'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dzwa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mjad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gtugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mai tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug smri ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/ rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang / ni gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang / rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ārya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhung bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhung drug ྅ hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lanta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591 )la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —hūṃ—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/ dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bzhes gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab bshus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla bskos ༵ chi lnga ༵ brang 'ag rnyi~X rnyi/da rdo shā da sgi dhi ༵ ༵/ spya rdo ༵༷ ༵ rdo /bas /spyu ༵༵ ༵ngo bo mtshamang slob da rjo / ༵bla~Xsna pa ༵ kyā ༵༵ sdig rnar ༵ s+ho ṭā rjid ༵ ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge khu shes bgres song gi rnam par lhastsi sna ༵ḍā sung pa dang / /bod ༵ /rno ༵rnyi /bgres ༵dzong je/ ༵sdo rdo ༵ nghru bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/ dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de kau sa/ phyi ༵ / /rdzu/nab rni ༵༵ sna dugs po dang gornga rdo sa lta rdo nyam sa su pyi ba'i ba ji ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta pu'o nanda dang pra yā mā nanda gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig thama~X ༵/la shin ༵ lgi dī~X dā rjo ༵ ༵ sa dog sa gcod ma/ / du ༵༵ ༵ shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod chen po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni ba ṇa shrī dang puṇḍa badzra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du shambha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo jo sas lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa rnams kyang g.yin la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi bcu shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsum mang po gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel chen pod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhan yang dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang ngo byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras sbungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khor bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnye/na bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635)la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i spyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/— 1()—

rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas bdag nyid kyi rnam thar nges par brjod pa'i rtogs brjod ces bya ba bzhugs/ 1gsang ba'i rnam thar sogs rnam thar 'ga' zhig bzhugs/ 249sangs rgyas rjes dran dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi man ngag zung du khukhujus ga pa bzhu/gas/ 291rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i zhal gdams mgur 'bum gyi skor bzhugs/ 297

brjod pa'i deb gter shin tu zhib mo ma bcos lhug pa'i rtogs brjod ces bya ba'i smad cha bzhugs/oṃ a tha/ legs lam ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gzhi las brtsams te cung zad brjod par bya'o/ /de la shing mo yos kyi lo shar ba na/dge mtshan gyi ltas du ma dang bcas hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig nyi ma me bzhi'i 'grub sbyor 'dzom pa la gnas gzhi gsar 'debs byed par 'dod pas/bla brang dam chos gling nas yongs dus/ sgo drung du mtshams len brgyad chu bum pa khengs pa thogs nas dga' ba la dga' ba la zer ba sogs lam la phrad pa rnams kyang tshig bkra dang lam bkra shin tu legs pa dang bcas/ nyi ma shar ba na rdzong mdo'i mdun gyi sa gzhi khri stegs lta bu 'dir sleb/ sa chog gi sa brtag bslang sbyang bzung rgyas par byas/ sa bzung ba'i skabs/ nam mkha' gang ba sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' mngon sum du bzhugs nges snyam pa yang byung /gtor ma rgya cher gtong ba'i skabs/ da lta'i mgon khang u tsa la'i mtho dman 'di tsam gyi tshad du/ chos skyong mgon po lcam dral gzhi bdag dang bcas pa rnams 'khor a tsa ra dang / mon pa rta lug g.yag khyi mang po dang bcas rol mo'i sgra 'ur 'ur chem chem byon pa'i rnam pa gsal byung / de nas re zhig zla smad —1—

de la rdo gsog ces byas/ rang re de bar du rgyal rtse bla ma'i drung dang / chos rje ye shes rgya mtsho ba dang / dkon mchog legs 'dzin pa sogs la chos sna 'ga' re yang bshad/ yang hor zla gsum pa'i tshes brgyad gza' tshes dga' ba la/ gtsug lag khang gi thig 'debs shing 'gram 'dru ba'i phyir/ slar sa chog dngos gzhi rgyas pa de/ dpal 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa'i bzhed pa dkyil chog rdo rje 'phreng ba las ji skad 'byung ba bzhin du bsgrubs/ sngar sa bslang ba'i dus dang 'di gnyis kar du nam mkha' la 'ja' 'od dkyus ma rma/ yin pa dang / me tog gi myong 'bab pa dang / shar phyogs nas glo bur du grwa pa mang dag re sleb pa byung / 'di gnyis ka la dga' ston gyi tshul du/ rang re'i grwa pa thams cad kyis kyang byon te/ mang ja tsha ra spyi 'bul gyi rnam grangs re byas/snga sor rang bzhin la yul ljongs phu mda' 'di kun grog ma mang ba zhig yin/sa chog gi nyin mo 'di skabs kyang grog ma sogs srogs chags mang ba 'dug kyang / mi ring ba nas dgon pa'i sa gzhi nye skor dang bcas pa thams cad la/da lta'i bar du grog ma ye med cing / srog chags gzhan yang nyung ngu song / gzhi bdag la sogs pas sa byin pa'i rtags mngon sum lags mod/ sngar gyi sa cha'i ming de bsgyur te/ rtag brtan dam pa'i chos kyi gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal du thog ma nyid nas ming btags/ snga sor hor zla gnyis pa'i nang du/chos rje gnyis sogs rang re'i grwa pa sum brgya skor la ri khrod chen po'i 'du khang du/ rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang bskur ba zhag nyer brgyad pa zhin byas/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor rdul tshon dang / gzhan rnams ras bris yin/ nag pa'i zla —2—

ba la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub mchod gsar pa btsugs shing / chos rje ye shes rgya mtsho bas shar sgo slob dpon mdzad/ sto sgo'i slob dpon ni rgyal rtse bla ma'i drung gis mdzad pa yin na'ang / shin tu sku khams ltems te dngos gzhi la phebs ma thug sgrub mchod kyi mthar/ tshogs mchod nyer mkho gsar pa sgrigs pa de'i steng nas tshogs 'khor yang byas/ dus 'khor gyi tshogs mchod mdzad pa'i srol bar skabs nas 'chad 'dug nag pa'i bco lnga sgrub mchod dngos gzhi'i nyin/ sde pa gzhung gi sa nas/ shing bzo rdo bzo gtos che ba rdzong bar mdzad pa tsho yang 'byor/ ri bo che nas rje 'gyur med sku gshegs pa'i bsngo rten thugs dam gsal 'debs skyel mkhan yang skabs 'dir sleb/ de rjes mi ring bar phyogs kyi chos zhu mkhan kun yang phyogs phyogs su thegs song / nged kyi rtag brtan la skabs skabs su blta ba la yang 'gro dgos pa dang / g.yas g.yon gyi ri rtse sa gnad che sa rnams su zla phyed zla phyed la gtor ma gtong bar phyin/gzhan dpyid la dbyar btags te phal cher skyid phug tu mtshams bsdams te bsdad/ zla ba bzhi pa'i gnam gang la nyi ma gza' 'dzin zhig byung skabs/ da lta'i 'bras sbungs kyi thad kyi brag rtse 'di nas gtor ma chen po zhig btang bas/chos skyong gi rnam 'phrul mi mang po dang bya rog ches che ba mang po nged rnams yar lung dang / chu sgo gzhung na las ka chen po mang po sgrub rgyu yod zer nas/ shar phyogs kyi nam mkha' la yol gyis song / phyis de ngor dang ras chung phug pa lta bar 'dug 'di lo byang ngam ring du ni zhabs drung rang gi bka' bkod bsgyur ba la/ chu 'og pa sogs chos sde 'gas da nas rje kun dga' grol mchog gi bstod

pa'i rigs rnams tshogs su ma 'don zhig ces dril sgrog par mdzad gda'o/seng seng la gsang 'dus 'phags skor gyi sgrub dkyil dang 'khor lo bde mchog lu dril nag gsum gyi sgrub dkyil rnams brtsams/ de yang 'phags skor 'di la sngar chog rgyas pa gtso bor ston pa'i yig cha kho na mang bar 'dug pa las 'dir don tshang zhing 'byer bde bar byas/ hi lha pa'i sgrub thabs la rgya bod gnyis char du rtsa rkyang gi lugs dang 'grel ba'i lugs zhes so sor grags shing / rtsa rkyang la yang kha skong can gyi lugs dang / kha skong med pa gnyis yod/ kha skong med pa'i srol 'dzin pa nyung / kha skong can la'ang mi 'dra ba shin tu mang bar 'dug 'grel pa'i lugs 'di la pradzñā rakṣi ta'i lugs su grags/ grags pa de la brten nas 'di tshogs bshad yin pa dang / 'di la mi 'thad pa dang mi legs pa yod tshul byed mkhan bar skabs su yang cung zad byung zhing / phyis ngor pa'i srol 'dzin rnams kyis rgya cher sgrags so/ /de ni khungs mchod pa'i thal song chen po yin te/pradzñā rakṣi ta'i chos bzhi zhes bya ba ni/ khong nyid kyis brtsams pa ma yin te/grub thob chen po lwa ba pas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa na/ myongs cig tu yod pa de pradzñā rakṣi tas sde tshan bzhir bcad de so sor byas pas de ltar grags pa tsam ma gtogs/ tshig don la phri bsnan cung zad kyang med na pradzñā ra sti ta 'gog par 'dod pas/ grub pa'i dbang phyug lwa ba pa la sdig sogs par zad do/ /de bas na nā ro pa'i man ngag yin min la rag ma lus kyi/ nā ro pa bas kyang chas che zhing / ches snga rol du byon par pū hi pa nyid kyi rjes mi ring ba kho nar byung ba lwa ba pa'i lugs 'di nyid ngo mtshar che bas de dang mthun par byas/ dkyil chog ni —4—

dā ri ka chung ba'i lugs 'di dang bla ma gong ma rnams kyi 'di yang mthun par 'dug pas de'i lugs dang / dril bu las dkyil gyi dbang chog la yang / kha bskong rgyas bsdus gnyis 'dug pas/ bsdus pa'i lugs 'di legs par shes nas de bzhin sbyar/ nag po lugs kyi sgrub thabs la yang gzhung dang mthun par gcos dgos pa cung zad snang la/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la sngar gzhung don ji lta ba bzhin du longs pa ched ma byung bar snang bas/ grub chen nag po spyod pa'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du gnas pa 'di sbyar ro/ /'di bris zin pa'i nub mo rmi lam du/ spang ljongs nyams dga' ba me tog du mas brgyan pa cig na phar phyin pas/ ji zhig ltar nas dur khrod chen po 'jigs su rung ba cig tu sleb/de'i dbus na lha khang cig 'dug pa der zhugs de phyin pas/ rgya gar gyi ā tsarya mang po re re bzhin pu ti 'dzings pa re thogs nas sgrig gin 'dug so sor 'grig tsa na po ti gcig tu song / kha phye nas bltas pas 'khor lo sdom pa'i dbang chog rgyas pa yin zer gcig 'dug de nas a tsa ra de rnam/sa kyis maṇḍal ljang khu chen po zhig byas/ tshes bcu'i cho ga byed rgyu yin zer bud med mang pos tshogs rdzas khyer nas byung / khong rnams cho ga byed kyi 'dug maṇḍal gyi dkyil du 'od sngon po khyil le ba zhig byung / de la brtags pas de'i dkyil na 'khor lo sdom pa zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ zhal thams cad shin tu khro nyams che zhing /yas kyi mche ba yas la log pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs de ral pa kham ser/ a tsa ra 'ga' zhig gi ral cog ltar/ sgor sgor po la rdo rje'i 'phreng ba rgya mdud ris su bcings ba gcig 'dug sku de je che je cher song nas mi tshad tsam du song —5—

ba la gnyid sad do/ /de la po ti 'dzings pa bsgrigs pas 'grig pa ni/dkyil chog gi go rim sngar gyi bla mas mdzad pa rnams 'khrugs pa la 'dir dgongs don dang mthun par 'grig zer ba'i brda ru 'dug / spang ljongs dang dur khrod du phyin pa ni/ ri bo tshang tshing sman ljongs dang / zhes dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i gnas bstan par 'dug pas/ dbang bskur gyis shig pa'i brda don yin pa 'dra snyam pa shar/ skabs der snga sor gnyer ba kun dga' bkra shis la gtam smras pa de 'dzam thang du sleb 'dug pas/ 'dzam thang spyi sa dang bla ma ka bzhi pa'i yi ge 'byor zhing / re zhing sku skye'i gnas tshul 'dri bar byung ba yin/de'i don spyi babs sngar bzhin dang / sgos su yang nga ni dgung lo yang bgres shing bon la bag chags brtas pas/ de phyogs su phan thogs rang zhig dka' ba'i tshul bsrings kyang / nged la 'dod don sgrub rgyu cig yong ngam snyam pa'i dogs pa skyes nas mi nyan pa snang/ 'di skabs rtag brtan gyi lcags ri 'khor yug tu 'brel pa thog so do tsam dang / nyer mkhe'i khang pa gnyis gsum dang gtso bor gtsug lag khang chen mo'i 'og thog khel ba yin/ skabs der 'du khang chen mo'i ka ba 'dzugs pa'i nyin/ nged rang gcig pu skyid phug na yod pa'i skabs/ mi nag po 'ga' dang / gyad stobs po che yin zer ba 'ga' re de ring las ka khag che ba yod/ sang nyin gtor ma cig kyang ster dgos zer nas song / dgongs mo kun dga' dpal bzang sogs khong tsho sleb byung ba la/ ka ba slong mkhan mang po song yod byas/ ga tsam tshugs dris dus seng g.yabs kyi ka ba gnyis ma lags pa'i/ ka ba sum cu so bzhi po thams cad tsha bzhes grol nas nyi ma phyed zur yan —6—

la tshugs 'dug hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu gsum gyi nyin mo yin/ sang gtor ma bzang pa zhig kyang btang / de'i phyi nyin tshes bco lnga la 'du khang gi gdung thams cad snga dro nas nyi phyed yan la khel nas/ mtha'i lcam yul 'ga' shas la rgyug kyang thongs pa byung / thog lha'i tshul du grwa pa thams cad byon pa'i mang ja gdan bzhes sogs dga' ston dang / bzo bo rnams hol ston mo'i skabs/ rma bya nas slob gnyer ba snga ma rnams kyang sleb pa sogs legs lam du byung / sgo khang gi gdung mdun ma chen mo de 'gel ba'i skabs/ sne phyogs gcig mar lhungs 'dug kyang / skyon gang yang ma byung zhing de 'phral mi gnyis kyis 'then thub/'di skabs tho rangs snga mo nas mi su yang ma langs pa la/ rdo rtsig pa 'dra ba'i phrog sgra chen po dang / shing gshog pa lta bu'i sgra sogs thams cad las ka la langs 'dug snyam pa la/ blta bar phyin du gang yang mi mthong ba de 'dra nub gcig nub gnyis min pa rgyun du byung / rdo ches che ba mang po byis pa bu mo chung chung 'dras skyel ba dang / cho 'phrul che ba la rdo chen mo mi gnyis gsum gyi 'degs dgos yang rdo'i spe'u mi gcig pa dang las khung mi gcig pa phan tshun du brjes pa yang mang du byung / thog ma 'ga' re la brkus pa yin nam snyam pa'i yid mi ches byung yang / phyis thams cad kyis cho 'phrul du nges shes rnyed/lcags ri'i rgya sgo rnams bcug pa nas gzung ste/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel zhig yin pa 'dug de lta bu gsal bar ma byung / de skabs glo bur du sprul dkar po gnyis shig da lta'i lho gling gi thang 'dir byung 'dug pas/ las rgyab pa gcig gis chu rong du bskyal 'dug de bzhag na gling khong du chu gcig rdol yong rgyur —7—

gda'/ de nas ston ser kha mkha' spyod bde ldan du mtshams zhag bdun tsam zhig byas/ rgyab ri sngon 'bor skyong gi rtse mor gtor ma gtong ba la phyin dus yar lam khams shin tu ma bde ba'i ngang nas sleb tsam byung / nang par gtor ma btang bas shin tu bzlogs che ba'i ltas shar/ rang re lo bco lnga pa'i dus kyi rkang lag gi rjes yin gyu'i khungs sa la sbas pa zhig yod pa'ang las byed tshos sa drus pas thon/ brag la'ang rjes yin snyam pa zhig byung ste ya mtshan pa dang bar chad gang yang min lags/ dam chos gling du rigs ldan lha khang gi logs bris rnams kyang grub cing dkyil thang drug bdun cig dang / gzhan zhing khams ma bdun tsam bzhengs pa yang mthar phyin/ don gnyer 'ga' zhig la rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi chos than thun bshad/ yi dam dang mkha' 'gro la gsol ba yang yang btab pas/ gnang ba'i mtshan ma byung nas dpyid kyi thig le'i khyi ka de brtsams/ rtag brtan du yang ston de gtsang khang gi thog kyang khel zhing / rung khang gi 'og thog kyang legs par grub/ lcags ri nang gi mtha'i khang pa bcu lhag zhig gi 'og thog khel ba dang / lcags ri'i kha gso'i yang ci rigs pa/lcog rnams la'ang mi sdod nyan pa dang / 'bras sbung gi ma khang 'di yang rags rim grub pa sogs mdor na las byed pa nyung yang grub shin tu che ba zhig byung /'di lo sde pa gzhung nas 'u lag brgya skor re zla ba gsum tsam gyi bar la gnang /de nas mi ring ba'i dus zhig la dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel chen 'di phyi mtsham me ba'i khog nas brtsams pas zhag po dgu la grub byung / snga sor gnang bzhu ba'i don du gsol ba btab pa la yang ltas bzang ba cig byung / des na deng —8—

sang mang po zhig kha cig dpe bris bzhus kha cig blo bzo tsam gyi sngags don 'chad pa las rang grag tsam yin par go /de rjes khra bo gling gi nang der spyin bsreg che ba zhig kyang phul/ 'di skabs bsam 'grub rtse nas 'bod mi gnang don la/ kam tshang sgang pa dmangs 'di spyan 'dren zhabs tog rgya che ba mi mdzad pa'i thabs med pa la 'tshub 'gyur yang che bar yod 'dug pas rkyen sel gyi dbang sogs la 'phral du yong dgos pheb byung ba de mthun grwa pa rnams dang lhan cig rtag brtan du phyin/ da bzod las ka ma ran par grwa pa rnams der sdod par byas/ nged kyis rten 'brel du nges don rgya mtsho'i lung gi 'go tshugs tsam byas yongs dus/ lung nag rdzong zhol du srod gdong nag la sleb/ nang so thog gis gzhi len byung / de nas bsam rtser sleb dus sku mtsham pa tsam gnang 'dugasleb nyin nas gzung ste/ rkyen sel gyi dbang rjes gnang rnam grangs mang ba 'bul bzhin pa dang / lo gsar mdor bsdus zhig gnang ba'i dus dang thug pa'i dga' ston rgya che ba dang gzhan yang sku rim bgyis pa rnams dmigs su 'gro zhing legs par byung / de skabs chos rje shangs pa shākya bstan 'dzin pa'i drung paṇa chen shākya'i mtshan can gyi khri thog tu myur du 'byon rgyu'i thugs dges pa dang spro ba sags sags rang dang bcas/ de mthun gyi chos zhu yang nor lha'i rjes gnang mang po dgos gsung pa ltar byas/ khong pa dang brag dmar mkhan chen dang slob dpon bkra shis phun tshogs sogs dge bshes 'ga' shas la/ rdo rje bdag med ma'i byin rlabs byas pas/ de nub nas zhag gsum bzhi zhig shin tu na ba'i 'tshub tu mngon par byung / tshogs gtor dang bshags pa 'dra phul bas —9—

grag khong rang bla ma slob dpon pa de rnams thugs nang shin tu ma dag par 'dug pas lan nam/ gang yin cha mi 'tshal/ gser mdog can grwa myong chen mo'i slob dpon chos rje thog pa ba la gshed dmar gyi chos 'ga' re bshad/ li ma lha khang rags rim 'grig pa la bgegs sprod sogs kyang bsgrubs/ sku rim pa rnams 'tshogs sa'i 'du khang gsar bzhengs la rab gnas byas/ sde srid la mnal ltas 'tshub tsam cig byung 'dug pa/ ji ltar yin rtogs shig gsung bas/sku dog yod pa'i ltas rang ni min pa 'dug gzhan gyis cho 'phrul ltas ngan 'dra bsgrubs pa'i rnam char 'dug pas/ de mthun gyi sku rim phul/ de rjes 'bod mi byung ba ltar/ nged kyis tshong 'dus su theg gsum pa zhig bsdad/ la rgan rgyud 'dol byung du phyin zhun shas bsdad/ rkyen sel gyi chos bka' 'dra byas/ phyogs de sngar lugs kyi 'dzom cha chen po bag dro ba de ni mi gda'/ sku skye bcu bzhi'i zhal thang gsar bzhengs bzang po mdzad 'dug pa la rab gnas rgyas pa byas de nas bsam sdings su zhag po gsum pa zhig bsdad de/ tshud lam rgyan gong gi lha mo dpal ldan ma la zhu don zhig yod pas mjal/ mchod gtor bzab ma phul tshur yongs bas sngar thab 'dzin 'ong ba'i shul de kar snar thang pas thab 'dzin zhig byung / der mi 'tshogs che zhing / gang nas yongs cha med pa'i bud med gzi byin che ba gos dkar po gyon pa zhig kyang byung / mthong ni thams cad kyis mthong gin 'dug ste/ gang yin ngo shes pa ni gzhan mi 'dug go /byang chen du'ang zhag gsum bsdad/ sde pa bstan rgyal drung dang / sde pa ka bzhi'i drung gi sku skye rin po che dang bdag cag lhan cig gnas kyi klu sdings der zhag gcig bsdad/—10—

rgya gan nas kyi yar lam rdzong la 'bod rtsis kyi bzhed yod pa la/ de skabs grabs ma grub par zhol gyi klu sdings der tsha bzhes cig byung / snga sor rdzong rtser phyin skabs dang / kha sing de'i mar lam gnyis kar la yang 'tshub tu mngon des shes pa byung zhing / de res ni stong pa nyid kyis zil gyis mnan pas cang ma byung /'di skabs gong dkar du rje ngag dbang bzang po gshegs pa'i zhe dgu'i sgang gi rlung 'tshub chen mo'i ring yin/ nged dang chos 'brel ni med zhal 'dris kyang chen po med de/ bka' rgyud pa 'di ba mdzad sgo legs pas/ nged la'ang thugs dam gsal 'debs phran bu bskyal byung / sa skya pa'i zhal ngo 'di rnams rang gis rang la ka bsngo rten 'bul ba ma gtogs mi mdzad pa'i srol cig gda'o/ /de rjes 'gyangs chen med par rje 'jam grags pa zhu ba'i 'brug pa'i dbu che zhig yong 'dug pa'ang / gza' gdong thug gi rnam pas thegs 'dug pa'i gsal 'debs bsngo rten yang byung / khong de gnyis kar grongs pa'i rgyu rkyen de mgar ba rang gi mtsho ni chas bsad pa'i dpe ltar rgyu rkyen gcig pa cig yin par 'dug ste/ slob brgyud tshos go ni da dung ma go bar gda'/ snga sor dbyar dus de/ dar lung phyogs su klu gtor mang du btang ba dang / sprul phyir bskyal ba de'i rten 'brel gyis/ da lta'i sgrub chu chu mig chen po 'di/ skabs 'di tsam brdol ba yin/ de nas rgyal gyi zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi la jo nang gi dgun khrid kyang tshugs par byas/rang re'i glob rigs gsang phur pa smad pa'i slob dpon rgyal mtshan 'od zer ba yang slong mo la skabs 'dir byung / smon thang mkhan chen pas se rib kyi grwa rgyun lnga ba zhig rdzong bar mdzad pa skabs 'dir sleb/ mchog dbang gong ma'i snga dro — 11 —

snar thang nas lcam drung yang 'khrid la 'byor ba yin/ dam po grol nas skra bcad mdzad/ dam po ma thebs kyi ring khrid kyi sngon 'gro'i skabs la rtag brtan dang jo nang gnyis su mtshan bsdod re mos byas/ gcig tu snga chos grol nas gcig tu da/gongs chos 'dzugs par sogs/ nyin re bzhin gnyis kar du chos thun ma chag pa lcogs shing zor yang ba zhig byung / 'di'i sgang dang nag nya yan la grwa pa rnams la snying po'i mdo lnga'i bshad pa dang / dbang mdor bstan gyi bshad pa yongs rdzogs song / 'khrid gtor skabs/ yar rgyab nas lcam drung yang phebs shing de rjes mi ring ba na chos sgor zhugs/ khrid gtor grol ba'i nyin mo rang sde srid kyi bka' bkod dang bstun nas/ chos sde brag dmar ba'i grwa rgyun nyi shu rtsa bgrang pa zhig 'byor/ slar yang zla ba gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i mtshams nas/ rtag brtan gyis las ka btsugs shing / grwa pa rnams ri khrod chen por chos bar la byon/ nag nya grol nas rang res bsgrigs pa'i sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas kyi steng nas/ dbang rjes gnang byin rlabs kyi bka' rnams btsugs/ so so'i lag len ma 'chugs par byed dgos pas zla ba gnyis tsam thogs/ zhag po bcu bcu la shing bu len pa sogs bar seng nyi ma re re dgos par byung / lung ni yongs su rdzogs pa rang bklags chos skyong gi skor rnams ma gtogs/ byin rlabs rjes gnang gi bka' thams cad song zhing /chos skyong skor nas kyang bdun brgyad gcig gi bka' byas/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs sgrub sde rnams la yang byas shing / de skabs rten 'brel ci yin rung /rdo rje phag mo'i rigs dang / ku ru kulle dmar chung skor gsum sogs mkha' —12—

'gro ma'i chos skor gyi skabs thams cad du lag pa la shu ba'i rnam pa 'byung ba sogs cung zad 'tshub pa'i ltas byung / khro bo chos skyong sogs gang la yang 'tshub cha med de grol nas tshogs chen la gshed dmar lha lnga dang / bde mchog dril bu lus dkyil gyi dbang dang / rang res gsar du bsgrigs pa'i yi ge'i steng nas/dpal 'khor lo sdom pa slob dpon chen po ka sna pa skyod 'chang dbang po'i lugs kyi dbang bskur ba de legs par bsgrubs shing / slob mas shom mkhan mi 'dug ste/ rang gi lag nas bton pa'i mchod pa gtor ma tshogs sogs rgya bal gyi lugs bzhin du bzab rgyas rang byas/ sgrub pa mo grags pa rnams kyi kyang cho ga 'dzugs pa'i don la/ thog cig la dbang bskur byas/ skabs shig 'doms pa'i ri rtser gtor ma gtong thengs gcig la/ rdo sngon ma phyogs nas chu glang zhig tshur la byung chur zhugs pa dang / lan rting ma gcig la smon skyid kyi ltag tsam 'dir/ nya shin tu che ba 'dom bcu tsam yod pa zhig byang nas lhor bcad pa'ang /nged dang kun dga' dpal bzang gnyis kar gyis mthong / phyogs gzhan gyi klu 'ga' zhig 'dir 'ongs pa'i rtags su ni gda'/ de rjes sku 'bum gyi chos khri chen po'i steng nas/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim rgyas pa zhig dang / bde ba can gyi zhing bkod dang / mngon dga'i zhing bkod gyi mdo gnyis rgyab rten du bshad cing / lam rim gyi grub 'bras byangs lugs kyi sems bskyed chen po de mdzad pa snga srol du 'dug pa bzhin byas/ 'di skabs lha 'dongs pa'i chos rje bgres pa khong ra'i yum gyis bsngo zhus la khor tsam byung / dbyar smad chos rje phywa bka' bcu pa dang / bla ma dam pa ye shes dbang po'i nye gnas rig dpal ba gzhan — 13—

'ga' re dang bcas pa la blo sbyong cha tshang zhig bshad/ de dag dang grwa pa bsnyen rdzogs pa rnams la/ so so thar pa'i mdo'i bshad pa yongs su rdzogs par grub/ chos rje phywa pa sogs 'ga' shas la/ grub chen zhi ba sbas pa'i bzhed dgongs dgyes rdor nye rgyud lugs kyi dbang bka' rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te bsgrubs/ lag len phra mo tshun chod rgya gar ba'i lugs bzhin byas pa/ glo bur du char 'babs pas dkyil 'khor gyi steng du chu 'bab pa sogs byung yang / dmigs pa brtad pas chu de yud tsam thub/ de 'phral snod bzed pas dkyil 'khor la gnod ma thub/ 'di skabs ka bzhi'i dbon po rnams kyi u tshugs chen pos bskul bas/ bla ma kun dga' bzang ldan dpon slob rnams khams phyogs 'gro don la brdzangs pa yin/ de nas btsas ma ran pa tsam la/'khyog po'i mkha' spyod bde ldan du phyin/ seng cig la rgyab ri sngon por skyong gi rtse mor zhag gcig bsdad/ gtor ma rgya cher btang / rang gzhan la phan pa rgya chen po 'grub pa'i ltas zhig kyang byung / byang stag lung du zhabs drung ma chen ngag dbang rnam par rgyal ba'i zhal snga nas kun spang gnang ba dang / zhabs drung dpon rin po che khri thog tu phebs pa la zhal dkar ja zhus bzab par phul/ de ka ma gtogs mtshams bsdams nas bsdad de/ zhag po nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam song /lo 'di la dus 'khor sgrub dkyil sogs rang res bsgrigs pa'i yig sna 'ga' shas/ mnga' ris rdzongs dkar du spar rko ba zhu ba dang / gong ma la ja zhus pa zab rgyas 'bul ba dang / spar gyi do dam la dkon mchog legs 'dzin pa brdzangs pa/ skabs 'dir 'khor byung zhing / de tsho'i lta rtog sogs la mtshams —14—

grol te/ dam chos gling rang du yongs/ 'di skabs gcung ri bo che pa'i dpon drung byung nas ri bo che rtse ba rnams nged la blo btod kyi tshul yang zhus shing / sde srid du phyag dam zhu dgos tsho yang zhu rigs byas shing byung ba'ang yin/ skabs mtshams cig la/ skyid phug tu mtshams dam pa zhig byas/ da lo rtag brtan du gtsang khang 'du khang rnams kyi steng thog khel dpal chen lha khang yang rags pa 'grub/ lha khang gzhan phal cher gyi rmangs tsam bting / lcags ri'i kha gso yongs rdzogs/ lcog rnams dang bcas pa po ta la'i thog 'og ma gnyis dang /steng thog kyang spyi skya rags pa grub/ lho'i phyogs kyis mtshams gcod pa'i lcags ri btags so thams cad dang / dpal ri dang so ra : ra ming btags pa'i sgo spe'u 'di rnams rags rim dang / lho gling gi spyil po 'di rnams 'og thog phal cher grub/ gzhan yang sngar gyi 'phros la mang po grub ste/ lo 'di la sde pa gzhung nas kyang 'ug lag lo snga ma las mang nges shes pa zhig zla ba phyed dang lnga tsam zhig byung / ston gzhug nas grwa pa thams cad kyang rtag brtan nyid du byon te/ thog ma'i rten 'brel la 'du khang steng gi 'khor g.yabs 'dir/ snga dro'i dus su mdo sde skal bzang gi lung yang klags shing / kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung bden gnyis rnam par dbye ba'i bshad pa dang / thugs rje chen po'i smar 'khrid yig rnying gi lung dang bcas pa sogs chos sna sad sud rnam grangs mang ba rang bshad/ 'khor g.yabs kyi ming bkod pa mtha' yas su btags/ sde pa snar thang pa yang gshegs pa'i 'di skabs bsngo zhus la mgon po gri gug gi gser sku sogs byung ba rten 'brel legs par go /de rjes ri bo che nas/ rgya — 15—

dpe po ti bcu tsam sogs dpe cha 'ga' shas 'byor byung ba/ dus 'khor 'grel chen yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngos ma nyis pod zhig 'dug pa'i rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas nged kyi lag tu snga mo zhig nas 'byor ba yin/'grel pa de kha'i gras de 'di skabs 'byor pa/ yid la ya mtshan skyes shing re mang klogs pas/ zung sbyor la yang blo skyed re ka thon byung / dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus gnyis ka'i rgya dpe 'dug ste/ snga ma la mdzad byang nā ro pa'i mtshan 'byar ba de ka 'dug phyi ma la sngar bod du 'gyur ba na/ kha che'i yul du skyes pa yi/ /dge slong snyan grags bzang pos byas/ /zer ba 'dug kyang rgya dpe 'di na snyan grags bzang po'i skad dod la ya sho bha dra zhes pa med par/ byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes pa snang bas/ kha che byang chub bzang po'i yin zer rgyur 'dug sngar dpyal chos bzang gis bsgyur ba'i dus kyi kha che paṇa chen gyi rgya dpe la snyan grags bzang pos mdzad zer ba yod par 'dug der ma zad chag lo dang dā na shī la yang nā ros mdzad par bzhed/ dpang los 'gyur bcos mdzad pa la yang de bzhin du 'dug kyang / rgya dpe gzhan las byang chub bzang po 'dug pa mngon sum du mthong / mkhas pa chen po gzhan rnams thams cad nā ros mdzad par 'dod kyang / sa skya paṇḍi ta ni nā ros ma mdzad par bzhed skad la/ gong ltar dpyad gzhi 'byung ba bden par snang ngo / /de nas mi ring bar ri khrod chen por lo dus kyi dgun khrid btsugs shing / yul nas a ma lags dang /dbon po yang nged 'phrad par 'byor byon/ 'di skabs rtag brtan du yang chos —16—

btsugs shing / gnyis kar du chos la yar mar du bgrod tshul re mos byas/ ri khrod du rgyab chos la ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo lung bklags/ rtag brtan du ni 'di skabs thun mong gi khrid zhen pa bzhi bral/ blo sbyong thun gcig ma dang /tshig rkang brgya dam snying po don gsum/ sum pa lo tsā ba'i blo sbyong / skyid sdug lam 'byer gyi 'khrid/ sgrol dkar gyi 'khrid/ tshe dpag med grub rgyal lugs kyi 'khrid/ sems nyid ngal gso'i 'khrid/ de nyid rgya gzhung 'brel ba dang bcas pa'i lung / thun mong ma yin pa ku ru kulbe'i khrid sogs 'khrid thung rnam grangs mang ba zhig bshad/ 'di res dus 'khrid kyi 'khrid lo legs par byung /gshed dmar mngon rtogs kyi bshad pa yang 'di dus brtsams te nyi ma gsum la grub pa yin/ snar thar nas dpon sa yum sras kyang sa skyar bzhugs ma nus par skrag pas 'di phyogs su phebs byung zhing / sde pa rgyal bu'i drung yang chos skor 'jug pa mdzad/ khrid grol mtshams su yang gtsang sa nas 'bod mi gnang zhing / lnga sor sgar chen bsam 'grub rtse'i rdzong nang la spyan 'dren gnang ba'i dus/ spyir gong 'og thams cad du 'tshub cha dang / de nas gzung nas rjes su yang zla ba gnyis tsam cung zad 'tshub pa'i ngang dang / sde srid rang ser ma la brten pa'i sku khams lan cig long po rang yang byung / cung zad zi ba yang yang yong ba cig byung 'dug spyir ni myong bar nges pa'i las kyi 'bras bu dang / bya ba byas zin/ 'bras bu grub zin du thal ba'i rigs la bcos thes med/ de min chags che nyams nga than thun rnams rim gro chang chung gis kyang bzlog na chen pos lta ci smos/ des na zhing gi mchog bla ma/ de'i nang nas kyang gzhan su dang mi — 17—

'dra ba'i lung med 'di lta bu la/ zhabs tog dang mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni/ gzhan dge 'dun gyi sde kun dang / bla ma dge bshes gzhan kun la tshe gang du zhabs tog mdzad rgyu'i dngos po tsam/ 'dir nyin re'am zla re la'ang gtong dgos na/ sku dog chang chung yang bzlog mi thub pa'i khar/ bar chad gsar pa skyes yong ba 'di 'dra rang yang ci yin snyam/ yong btangs kyi sbyabs la blo skyog ge ba zhig zhag shas blo yul du byung / gang ltar 'phral myur du 'gro ba shar/ lam stabs bde zhing sa gtsang ba'i stabs chu byang brgyud nas phyin/g.yag po ru bzhir sleb dus rtse nas lo gsar gyi skal pa skyel mkhan gnang ba yang 'byor/ rtser sleb 'phral nas gzung / thog mar tshe dbang grub rgyal ma brgya tshar/ lha dgu brgya tshar sogs dbang rjes gnang rkyen sel gyi rigs rnams gtso bor phul/ bgegs bskrod dang khrus gsol gyi rigs mang du byas pas/ nged sleb nas shin tu 'jam par byung / re zhig gi rkyen sel de tsam gyis lcogs par 'dug yun ring rab sdod dgos phyin/ chos rnam par dag pa de snyan du gsol dgos snyam nged ra'i blo la yang byung / sde srid rang gi dgongs pa la yang de kho na bzhin 'dug pa rtse mthun du byung nas/ chos kyi rtsa ba skyabs 'gro dang / skyabs 'gro'i rtsa ba dad pa yin zhing / dad pa'i rtsa ba ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi rnam thar go ba la rag las pas/ ston pa'i rnam thar rgyas pa 'dul ba las 'byung ba rnams kyi nang nas/ lo rgyus sde tshan che ba re tsam gnyis tsam re la chos than thun re byas pa dang / 'jig rten bstan bzhag gi go ba zhib cing gsal la 'gril ba rim can du phul ba'i go ba yongs rdzogs dang / bshes pa'i 'phrin yig la thun —18—

mong ma yin pa'i legs bshad gsar pa du mas brgyan pa'i bshad tshoms rgya che ba dang bcas te bshad/ bshes 'phrin dang 'jig rten bstan bzhag gnyis ka la 'dzin chos rgyas pa gnang ba'i thugs rtsol bla na med pa mdzad zin bris yi ger 'god pa mdzad pa yang shin tu dag pa gzhan pas ches phun sum tshogs pa byung / sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal 'di tshig 'dzin sprus gtsang zhing / don la yang go babs shin tu bzang ba'i thugs rab khyad par can rang yin par 'dugabashes 'phrin gyi po gad pa 'go btsugs pa'i nyin/ ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod chung zhig bskur byung ba/ de'i nang na bzhes 'phrin yongs rdzogs kyang 'dug mgo zhabs na sgyu/ ka re re lhag po zhig kyang snang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang spyod pa yi/ /zhes sogs kyi bshad pa'i skabs su/ bcu gcig zhal la klu sgrub kyi sku mang pos bskor ba'i thang ga ster mkhan zhig kyang byung bas/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel ngo mtshar can du yid ches/ sngar gyi 'grel pa thams cad ni bsdus don sna zing spu zing las lam rim rkang tshugs mi 'dug pa la/ bsdus don gyi rkang sgrig tshul khyad par can cig blo la shar ba 'di/ 'phags pa nyid kyi byin sas yin no zhes pa'i brda don yin par mngon no/ /g.yi 'di'i don rnams shin tu thugs la 'phrod par yang byung / 'di skabs sdod sa li ma lha khang dang thag nye bas/ phyag mchod smon lam yang yang thub pas shin tu dga' bar byung / chos bzang nyi mas se rib kyi grwa rgyun gsar pa 'dra yang khrid nas sleb/khong tsho la ma dā na pu ra nas/ tsant+ra shing rgyal pos dung bzang po gcig nged la bskur gda'/ 'di skabs shig rgya gar yul gyi bi mā na 'dra ba'i gur zhig 'tsho — 19—

ba gnang 'dug pa'i rab gnas dang bstun gser mdog can pa'i tshogs pa rnams mtshan brjod la yod pa la/ chos 'brel rjes gnang gsum pa cig dang /mkhan slob rnams la kyai rdor nag po lugs kyi dbang cig byas/ brag dmar mkhan chen la yang rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i chos skor ci rigs pa zhig bshad skabs shig la yar 'brog bsam sdings kyi rje btsun ma o mtsho pa dpon slob rnams kyang mnga' ris gung thang phyogs la thegs pa'i zhor lam sde pa mjal bar phebs/ thal rlung wo pos rgya gling cha pa sogs/ khong rang dpon slob kyi won las la bar chad kyi ltas du ma mthong sel thabs byas na bar chad de sel ba dka' las mi 'dug ste/ khong dpon slob tsho rang dgos don med pa'i 'gran zla'i khungs rang 'dug pas/ bcol gtogs med pa de bzhag pa rang legs pa 'dug 'bras sbungs thams cad mkhyen pa'i sprul pa'i sku la lha sar dar 'dzugs pa'i dus de lta bur nged kyi rten 'brel sgrigs na/ gang spyir phan pa'i thabs shig yod pa yin te/ lho kha la thegs pas stabs ma 'grig 'di skabs sku yal ba'i thugs dam gsal 'debs kyi rten bzab par byung / skabs der 'dar gdong bde gling pa gsum la/ bka' bkyon dbyings che ba byung ba la yang / zhu ngo gang drag rang zhus pas/ mdar du mkhar bzhag tsam byas pas gzhan bde bar byung ba dang / gdong dga' nas kyang gser mdog can du bzhugs dgos tsam las/rdzong gzhis sa cha gsar gnang rnams la skyon ma byung ba dang / bde gling pa yang bde bar bsdad chog pa byung / sngon ma 'dar ba'i snying khungs kyi steng nas 'brog rigs rnams ma byung ba la zhu ngo bskyar chags zhus nas slar gnang ba yin/—20—

lar mi 'di rnams la phan thogs byung tshad de 'phral brjed 'gro bar 'dug yang brjed pa'i 'phro la mi bde ba re byung na khu long g.yab gda' yo rang dgos pa gcig kyang gda'/ de nas hor zla gsum pa'i nyer gsum la yar bteg nas 'ongs/ bkra shis lhun po'i mdun der drung chen dang / lhun grub sgang pas ja 'dren zhig byung / yangs par thab bsu'i sar 'brug sgra shin tu che ba bstud mar yong ba dang / gangs char chen pos lung ba dkar por song ba zhig byung ste/ nged rang la ni rten 'brel legs par go /snar thang du chos sde'i bsu ba ser bsgrengs dang bcas sleb/ snar thang sde pa'i shul gyi thang ka ci rigs sde srid rang gi phyag tu gzhes pa'i lhag ma phal che ba rnams dang / dpe cha rnams las ji ltar mkho che ba rnams rtag brtan gyi chos sde gsar 'dings la mkho che bar yongs 'dug pas/ khyer thong gsung ba'i bka' lung yod pa ltar/ de tsho blta rtog la zhag po gsum bsdad/ rgyal rtse mngon dga' nas yin pa'i rgya dpe 'ga' re lag tu 'byor/ rgya dpe 'di tsho dang po rang thar pa nas spyan drangs par 'dug 'dir byung ba'i tshe mdo'i rgya dpe gcig la gzugs sngags o gnyis ma kho na yin par 'dug o gsum ma'i rgya dpe yang sngar nas nged kyi lag na yod/ des na ngor chen gyi gsung bgros dpal gyi rgya mtshan pa'i zin bris sogs tshe mdo'i bshad pa gsum bzhi gcig na/ o gnyis ma ma dag lo paṇa yon la ma mgu bar sngags kyi gung nas bcad pa yin zer ba kho na 'dug pa yang / rna gtam rgad po la yid brtan bcas pa'i cal col kho nar bas/ rgya dpe rang la o gnyis ma yod pas so/ /de nas byang chen du yang phyin/ 'di skabs rgyal chen rtse'i phyogs —21—

kyi nang la babs te/ phug mo chos rdzong gi mda' byams gling sogs dang /shab kyi mda' dang rog tsho sogs brgyud pa'i gtsang po lho kha yin pa la'i byang kho na brgyud nas yongs/ rtag brtan du hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes gsum la sleb/'di'i res la brel pa de tsho'i stabs kyis/ nag pa'i nya la rang res ma sleb pa dang / rtag brtan du dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub mchod tshugs pa'i thog ma yin pas/cho ga'i 'go la rang re yod pa rang zhig dgos par byung nas/ snga gong ri khrod du nag nya lan gnyis song ba de yin kyang / rtag brtan du 'dzugs pa'i thog ma de sa ga la byung ba/ de phyin chad kyang sa ga nyid la byas so/ /'di skabs sgrub mchod sngar 'byud ltar las/ grwa rigs dus 'khor gyi dbang bskur ma thob pa re mang 'dug pa rnams la/ dbang bcu gcig po yongs rdzogs zhig byas/ chos sde nang gi bla ma slob dpon dang grwa rigs gal che ba gnyis gsum dang / 'jag pa bla ma dang / slob dpon bkra shis phun tshogs dang bcas pa yongs dril bco brgyad la rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i dbang dang / bdag po wo po'i dbang yongs su rdzogs par bsgrubs/ zla ba de ka'i nyi shu bdun la/ chos sde rnams chos lung byang rtser chos bar la byon/ rtag brtan gyis las ka rnams kyang tshugs/nged kyis ri khrod nyid du bsdad/ chos rje ye shes rgya mtsho ba la gsang 'dus skor gyi chos mang po dang / sbyor drug gsar ma'i 'khrid lag len bshad bka' dang bcas pa sogs chos mang rab bshad cing / gang bshad pa de rna mchog gi gong kha la ma song ba'i nges tig can ngag sgros rnams la yang zin bris thebs pa'i bshad pa la/ rjes yod par byung / rje bzhi nā tha de lho ra ṭa ṭa na bzhugs kyi —22—

sdi— snyem / pre da 'dug grwa rigs dzo gi pho mo gnyis bod la byung / lto phyogs kyi dpe cha sgrol ma'i rgyud 'grel cig byin byung / slob dpon bkra shis phun tshogs pa khams la 'byon pa'i 'dod chos dbang rjes gnang khrid sogs rnam grangs mang ba nyin re bzhin dang / bden mchog rtse pa gzhi grwa thams cad dang bcas pa la kun rig gi dbang zhig kyang byas/ 'di skabs rgya gar yul dbus wā rā ṇa sī nas/bram ze paṇḍi ta kriṣṭha zhes bya ba sgra sogs phyi rol gyi rigs gnas la shin tu byang ba/ bye brag pa dang / rig pa can pa dang / rig byed mtha' pa'i gzhung gsum la shin tu sbyangs pa che ba zhig khyad par sgra la ches mkhas pa'i grub 'bras sa skri ta'i skad la byang ba'i mthar thug pa rang cig bram ze'i bu lon ma khyer ba'i slong mo la byung bas/ khong la dbyangs can ma'i sgra mdo nas cung zad nyan/ dgos pa rang mi 'dug kyang rtsed mo tshul du lha kris ri gsung legs ldan gyi glu nas le'u gnyis dang / khyab 'jug chen po'i mtshan stong gi 'go rgyangs phan yon de bsgyur/de rjes dbyangs can byā ka ra ṇa'i 'go nas mtshams sbyor bud tsam bsgyur cing /khyad par du don che ba la/ ri bo che nas byung ba'i rgya dpe'i seb na/ dpal ldan ka lā par sgrod thabs kyi gzhung bal po'i dpe zhig byung ba/ kha yig la ka lwa pā ba ta ra zhes 'dug pas sgra mdo ka lā pa'i bshad pa zhig yin nam snyam nas sgra'i gseb kyi rgya dpe'i sdebs la bcug 'dug gang ltar de yongs su rdzogs par bsgyur bas ngo mtshar che bar byung / spyir sngon gyi lo rgyus la shambha la'i lam yig dang po ta la'i lam yig sogs rdo rje gdan kyi sgo'i rdo khang na yod ces ཿnga ba'i shambha la'i lam yig de 'di yin par 'dug 'di 'phags pa don yon —23—

——lcags kyus gsungs pa yin/ po ta la'i lam yig de sngar 'gyur nas bstan 'gyur du chug pa 'di yin te/ rje btsun ma sgrol mas gsungs pa yin/ 'di gnyis kar rgyud kyi rigs su gtogs par byed dgos tshul 'di mthong nas sngar gnas skor ba gcig gis shambha lar phyin no skad pa skye bo mi nag pa rnams kyi lag tu 'khyams yod pa'i rdzun gtam de tshes rdzun par go nus so/ /dpal lha mo'i mtshan stong gi rgya dpe lag na yod cing / 'di dngos nang pa'i gzhung rang ni min pa 'dug na'ang / bod kyi lha mo'i bstod rnying kun na/ mi gcig ma la ming dgu ma/ mtshan brgya ma la mtshan stong ma/ /mtshan brgya dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ /gang nas bos kyang khyod kyi ming / /bya ba la sogs pa 'dug pa la/ gzhan rnams la rgya gar lugs dang mthun mi mthun ji ltar yang / bod rang la ngos 'dzin rgyu re 'dun pa byin rlabs dang yang ldan par grags la/ mtshan stong ni bod pa la ngos 'dzin rgyu mi 'dug cing / 'di kho na yin par snang bas bsgyur 'dod de bshad pa tshar gcig nyan bod skad du 'bebs par brtsams na/ gnyan cha cho 'phrul che ba rang gis de res 'jog dgos pa byung / paṇḍi ta'i bu lon sbyang ba'i phyir/ rang res kyang bum gdan kha gang ma gcig dang gser sogs gang drag phul/ shis brjod slo ka gnyis khong rang gis brtsams/ de nged kyi bsgyur ba'i skad gnyis shan sbyar gyi dpe dang bcas te/ sde srid sku gzhogs su brdzangs pa/ zhabs drung yab sras dga' ba tshal nas tshur phebs/ 'tsho mos chen du bzhugs gral zhal dkar bzhes rgyu zhab/sa drung rgyal bu bzhugs gral chen mo la phebs pa'i thog ma de dang 'dzom/ khong gis shis brjod kyang phul gda'/ rten —24—

'brel yang legs po yin shes 'dug shin tu dgyes pa byung ba'i gser srang gcig sogs gnang spyin yang bzang bar byung / khong rang yang mgu bas rgya gar du thegs/ chos lung tshogs kyi mkhan chen rnying pa ngam ring mkhan po lhun rab pa yang nged 'phrad par phebs/ chos bka' than thun dgos gsung ba la de mthun byas/ slar gsang 'dus rim lnga zhu ba la yongs gsung gin 'dug phyis phebs ni ma thub/ dbyar gung gcig chos rje ye shes rgya mtsho ba dang / rang de'i dbon po sogs dam tshig gtsang ba nyung bsdus gcig la/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i gsang ba'i rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa rang re'i pha chos de yang byas/sa skyar bdag chen rgyan pa gshegs/ sku mched phyis thugs nye ring yong khun yin kyang / dang po'i brnag pa cig thugs la yod pa los yin/ zhabs drung khri chen dgyes grags nas zhabs bro mdzad pa'i grags pa yang byung / gdong rgyud bgres gzhon gnyis kyi dang po rtsa ba'i bla ma khri chen rang yin kyang bar skabs gzigs phyogs mi gcig pa'i skabs 'dir dngos su thugs 'gal/ gdung brgyud a mis drung la mdzad bka' gtsang sar zhu sgugs la phebs dgos byung / nged la ngo chen dgos phebs pa sde srid du nan bcags zhus pas yon mchod du yang 'brel/lcang gseb ber chen sogs sku skal ma pham tsam byung ba yin/ phyis drin sems par mi mdzad do/ /dbyar smad rang re'i lag g.yog sgrub pa byas pa/ kun dga' rin chen pa dpon slob tsho yang khams phyogs la thegs/ sbyor drug gi bshad pa bar skabs su g.yeng bas 'bri 'phro la lus pa de ston ser kha 'dir ched gtad bris/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdzogs rim gyi rnam bshad 'di yig sna

mgos che ba la the ba tsam byung / dbyar gzhug 'di la snga phyi rim can du sde srid kyi rdzong ltar gnang ste dbus chu shul khog dang / kyi shod phyogs dang / gra dol gzhung gsum 'phrang po rnams nas grwa gsar brgya lhag pa yang 'byor/ lo 'di'i nang du rtag brtan du ni gtsang khang gi steng / 'og min lha khang du dus 'khor rgyal ba rigs lnga rgyal ba rigs drug gnas gtsang ma'i steng gi 'og min bkod pa sogs logs bris legs pa grub pa dang / gtsug lag khang chen mo gtsang khang sgo khang dang bcas pa'i shing rtsi dang / gas yang shing rtsi dgos pa'i rigs than thun mang du grub cing / chos bzang du ming bzhag pa'i sde yangs chen mo dang / nub kyi lha khang gsum/ shar gyi lha khang gsum/ gzhal yas khang du ming bzhag pa'i gtsang khang ka bzhi kha che lugs dang 'khyams ka ba bcu drug pa dang / lha khang gzhan rnams kyi yang 'og thog phal cher khel/ byang gling gi khang pa thams cad kyi 'og thog khel zhing / cha phyed tsam steng thog kyang khel ba dang /'bras sbungs zhol gyi 'og thog dang / po ta la'i steng khang sogs ji snyed cig grub/ u tsa lar mtshan gsol ba'i mgon khang 'di/ thog 'og ma gnyis lo snga ma dang steng thog lo 'di la phub/ de skabs mgon lug gcig yod pa de/mgon khang byed rgyu de'i sgo 'og kho nar nyal ba dang / 'u lag pa re gnyis las ka mi byed par yib cing nyal ba la/ lug des ched gtad 'tshol du phyin nas brdungs/ shing las la bskul ba sogs chos skyong 'khor ba'i ltas mang du byung cing / de dus rten bcas pa med kyang / mgon po'i bzhugs sa byed rgyu yin byas pa tsam gyi bdag byed par 'dug lo 'di la'ang sde pa gzhung nas 'u lag —26—

sngar khyud ltar gnang zhing / las rjes shin tu che ba de yin/ 'di rjes nas sde pas zug mi rang rdzong ltar gnang ba med/ mchod gzhis pa kho nas byas pa yin/lo snga ma gsum gzhung dang mchod bzhis gnyis kar log nas byas pa dang grub che chung rang khyad chen ma byung / 'di'i ston gzhug nas chos sde'i grwa pa rnams kyang rtag brtan rang du gzhi phab pa yin/ khams phyogs nas brda du sku skye sogs 'ga' shas la sbyor drug cha tshang zhig bshad/ sa skya zhabs drung khri chen gyi bka' skyon byung dogs pa'i 'jigs bros la jo nang du bsdad pa'i rab 'byams pa te ba sogs 'ga' shas la/ gcod khrid zhib pa zhig kyang byas/ rtsas chod skor la dkon legs pa la 'dod chos 'dra bshad kyin yod skabs/ ri bo tsho che pa'i rje drung ngag dbang pa khu mtshan gnyis kyang 'byor/ rje drung skal bzang pa'i sras po de skra bcad par mdzad/ khong gi bzhed pa chos chung brgya rtsa'i lung zhig kyang bklags/de nas rtag brtan du tshogs chen la sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang rgya gzhung gi lung dang bcas pa yang byas/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim bsdus tsam zhig kyang bshad/ skabs 'dir sog po'i rgyal po che chen das chin 'das pa'i mang ja bsngo rten sogs byung zhing / mi sna mi rgan sa 'byin zer ba de/ snga sor stag lo dgun ka jo nang du byung ba dgon gnas gsar 'dings byed rgyu yin zer ba'i gling brjod cig yod pas / de brdzun ma yin par bden par 'dug ngo mtshar che zer/de rjes gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi/ gshin rje gshed dmar po bcu gsum ma nag po bcu gsum ma rwa lugs/ ma rgyud sgyu thod gdan gsum sogs kyi dbang bskur byas/ dkon legs pas ched kyis zhus nas tshogs chen la —27—

gshin rje gshed nag po zhang lugs kyi dbang de yang byas/ khams nas yar re shing pa'i sku skye spyan 'dren la arke sku skye dang / 'dzam thang gnyer ba rgya'/ ba dpal sogs mang po zhig byung ba/ skabs 'dir 'di phyogs su sleb/ thams cad la mchog dbang sogs chos 'brel 'ga' zhig dang / arke sku skye la dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang yang byas/ rje drung ngag dbang pa sogs la 'khrid brgya'ang bshad/ de nas dus 'khrid kyang sngar khyud ltar bcugs/ khams ci pa khrom tshugs sku skye/ sgang pa dbon po sdom tsa dbon po ste bla tshugs 'dzin pa gsum po de sogs khams pa nyi shu rtsa 'dren zhig sbyor drug la zhugs dam po rgyab pa yin/ 'di skabs lco rong na 'khrug pa ra lung ba la brten pa'i dus 'khrug dang / byang rgyab smad na sog po'i 'du 'tshog gi skabs de yin/ gting skyes nas bde skyid lags kyang dam po 'debs par phebs/ dam po grol nas chos mdzad pa yin/ skabs der o la pa ti'i rim bzhi'i khyi ka de yang brtsams sangs rgyas thod pa dang / ye shes dbang phyug ma'i sgrub dkyil sogs kyang bris pa yin/drang srong pa sogs byang gi dpon ris mang dag zhig dbus la 'gro dgos byung ba'i dus de yin pa drang srong pa mar lam yongs dus nged la bshags pa 'bul zer/ 'dir skor tsam byung / zug gas pa yang blangs/ hor zla gnyis pa'i skabs shig la nang cig gnod sbyin slo dra pā la dang / las kyi gshin rje yin snyam pas mi nag po gnyis kyis/ nag hril ba cig sdir sgra dang bcas te mdun du bskyur dam nyams kyi mgo 'di re zer/ bltas pas rtsibs ri bsam gling gi mkhan po rgya mtsho pad dkar ba'i mgo bor 'dug de nas mi ring bar khong 'das/—28—

nged kyis rbad bskul byas kyang ma byas dgos kyang dgos pa med/ khong rang bla ma dam pa bde bar gshegs pa de la sgo gcig ma yin pa thams cad nas dam nyams pa des yin par gad/'o/ /rtag brtan du dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor zhang lugs zhe dgu ma/ skyo lugs gshin rje mo brgyad kyis bskor ba/ mal lugs ro langs brgyad bskor/ rwa lugs bcu gsum ma rnams/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor dang / rwa lugs ro langs brgyad skor la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor mchod pa rgyas pa dang bcas pa sgrubs te/ grwa pa thams cad la dbang bskur/ tshogs kyi khri gsar pa'i byin rlabs la/ phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po'i dbang bskur dang / lha khang gzhal yas khang gi khyams su sngar ma thob pa'i rigs rnams la mi 'khrugs pa/ tshe dpag med/ bde mchog nag po pa/ dril bu pa/ gshed mar lha lnga sogs kyi dbang bskur byas/de bzhin du gshin rje gshed dmar po'i khrid spros med dang / rnal 'byor bzhi rim gnyis nag po zhang lugs kyi 'khrid rnal 'byor bzhi pa dang / 'jigs byed skyo lugs kyi 'khrid rwa rtse sems 'dzin dang / gshed dmar lugs gnyis la brten pa'i byin rlabs kyi bka' bcu gsum tsam ste/ de thams cad tshogs chen rang la byas pa yin/ 'di skabs sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi sku bzhengs pa'i mgo tshugs pa yin pa la/ rang re'i grwa pa cig gis rgya gar rdo rje gdan 'khor ba'i byang chub shing gi yal ga lag ngar tsam cig dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs rjes kyi spar 'ga' re byang chub shing lo mang po dang bcas pa 'byor byung ba/gzungs bzhugs kyi rten 'brel 'grig par 'dug smon 'gro ba'i rgyal bu tshe —29—

dbang lhun grub pa yang lugs legs byed nges par mjal kha dgos zer nas phrad tsam byas/ ri bo che nas slob gnyer grwa rgyun gsar pa thog ma rnams kyang skabs 'dir 'byor/ sa ga'i sgrub mchod kyang sngar lugs bzhin byas pa las/ grwa pa gsar pa dus 'khor gyi dbang ma thob pa shin tu mang ba nas/dkyil 'khor de ka'i steng nas slob ma'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa tshar gcig byas/ de rjes kyang nged kyis sngon 'bor skyong gi rtse mo la gtor ma wo po sgrub pa'i phyir sang 'gro rgyu'i de ring de/ gro khud pa sde srid nas yar gnang ba 'byor/spyir sku rim rgya che ba gnang 'dug khong sgos su sgrub sde dang rtag brtan la mang ja 'gyed sogs sku rim rgya cher mdzad pa dang / sde srid sog po'i steng du dpung 'degs gnang rgyu'i bsrung 'khor sogs kyis gsung ba'i gsal 'debs su 'dug gtor ma chen po yang stabs 'grig pa sbyin bdag chen po'i bar chad sel ba la ni dmigs/ 'di skabs pha rol po zhwa gser thogs yin kyang / nged ni rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po la lhag par mos/ dge phyogs pa 'di pa dang / lhag par 'bras sbungs kyi chos grwa la nye sems bag chags mthug pa zhig yod/gnod sems ga la zhig chos grwa de dag tu chos dar bar smon pa dang / rtsod pa 'jam po'i phyogs su zhi bar smon lam btab pa yin kyang / de'i dbang du 'gro ba zhig mi 'dug phan tshun gnyis ka las ngan gyis bdas pa la thabs ci byar yod/ dbyar stod de grwa pa thams cad la/ gsang 'dus rim lnga mar lugs mgos lugs gnyis/ ye shes zhabs kyi zab gsal dang grol ba'i thig le/ de dag gi rgyab rten rgya bod kyi gzhung dang bcas pa thams cad bshad/ rgyud kyi skor —30—

la rtsa rgyud kyi lung tsam ma gtogs/ 'grel pa sogs gzhan ma song / man ngag mtha' rgyas rang du song ba yin te/ grwa gzhon thams cad rtsed mo la yengs/ rgan pa thams cad kyi rna ba'i gong kha la song ba'i blo la bcags rgyu dang blo skyed thon pa lta ci smos/ chos ga 'dra cig thob bshad rgyu yang med pa'i byis pa mdo med cig ka byung / lo 'di'i sos ka dang dbyar gyi ring sdod sa po ta lar byas/ khams dwangs shing shin tu skyid/ sbyin sreg nub 'ga' shas byas/ shin tu zil che ba dang / sbyin sreg gi tha mar drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtong ma gtor res kyi gtor ma'i khar sdig pa rwa can re dngos su yong pa sogs shin tu rtsub par mngon kyang /'di skor la brten pa'i yon bdag gi sku dog thams cad sel/ rang re'i bar chad kyang mang po sel 'dug 'di skabs re shing nas sku skye yang phebs 'dzam thang phyogs la phebs 'dod stabs/ dge bsnyen dge tshul dge slong gi bar du chos sgor 'jug pa dang / dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs rdzogs/ sbyor drug gi mgyogs 'khrid/ blo sbyong / nai gu/ kun rig gi dbang / nyer mkho'i rjes gnang / tshe dbang sogs ci rigs gsan te thegs song / arke sku skyes rjes su yang sbyor drug gi khrid zhim mor nyan/ bde mchog la sogs pa'i chos bka' gzhan yang mang du zhus song / dbyar gung nas gzung / chos bzang gi chos khri'i kha 'bebs la/ theg mchog rab tu rgyas pa'i dbu ma chen po rnam par nges pa de brtsams shing / brtsams grub rim nas bshad pa 'tshams pa re bshad/ theg nyi shu rtsa gnyis tsam la cha tshang bar 'gril/ 'di rtsom pa'i blo shar ba'i dus/ tho rangs kha cig gnyid du song ba ni min/ da lta'i snang ba 'di nub nas sa gzhi ri —31—

bo nags tshal thams cad rin po che dang 'dra ba dang / mtsho rdzing me tog du mas brgyan pa sogs dang gzhal med khang dpag tu med pa na/ sangs rgyas re re la 'khor byang chub sems dpa' mang po mang pos bskor ba yod snyam pa dang /khyad par dbus kyi phyogs na ljon shing rgyas pa mtha' med pa gcig gi rtsa ba na/sku tshad nags rgyal gyi ri 'di bas kyang ldab kyi mtho ba'i sangs rgyas sa gnon gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa cig 'dug pa de/ 'o skol gyi ston pa yin snyam pa byed cing /sku'i g.yas na byang chub sems dpa' dkar po gangs ri tsam pa cig 'duga'ajam dbyangs yin snyam pa byed/ g.yon na de tsam dmar po zhig 'dug spyan ras gzigs yin snyam pa byed/ /dkar po de'i yang g.yas na ser po zhig 'dug byams pa yin snyam/ g.yon rang na sngon po zhig 'dug pa de/ phyag rdor yin nam nam mkha'i snying po yin nam snyam pa las ha cang nges gsal ma byung /nga 'phags pa kun tu bzang po ga na bzhugs snyam tsa na/ ljon shing de bas kyang sku gzugs ring ba/ sku mdog ma nges pa sku'i nang thams cad na me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar bkod pa mtha' yas pa yod pa cig 'dug gzhan 'khor tshad gzung med pas bskor/ thams cad kyang bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po las brtsams chos gsung ba'i snang ba byung / zhing khams 'di gang na yod zhus pas/ khyod rang gi snying gi dkyil na yod gsung / dum cig nas snang ba de yang 'gags/ de'i rgyun las theg mang po'i bar du rig pa gsal zhing dwangs pa/'char sgo mtha' yas pa shar yang thams cad spros bral du gnas pa/ dga' bde'i cha shas kyis brgyan pa nyin mtshan kun tu byung / gnyid kyang ngos gzung —32—
