med pa'i ting nge 'dzin de kha la gnas/ gdams ngag rnams nas rnam gsum rigs dbye bshad pa de/ las dang po pa re dogs can la dogs pa yin/ re dogs dang dga' sdug med na rnam gsum rigs dbyes ci byed/ de dgos pa byungatsam nyid nas cher kha shor/ sangs rgyas mthong yang zhen rgyu med/ sdig sbrul mthong yang sun rgyu med/ bdud nag mthong yang stong nyid snying rje'i ngang / yi dam mthong yang nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon gyi tshul du 'dug ro mnyam gcig la khyad par ta gang yang mi 'dug kyang / rten 'brel ma 'gags pa'i 'char tshul de 'dra cig byung / lar dus kyang shin tu tha mar sleb nga/'i ltas los yin yod/ lo 'di la lha sa'i mi bsad chen mo dang / ser dang 'bras sprungs sogs stong la khang pa'i dge ldan pa'i gya nyes chen mo de yang byung / de rjes ston gyi ring la/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis/ ltung bshags/ dkon mchog rjes dran/ byams smon/ sgrol ma/ tshe mdo/ phyag rgya lnga'i mdor grags pa sde/ tshigs bcad gcig pa/ gnyis pa/ bzhi pa/ sgo drug pa/ bzang spyod rnam sa la 'grel pa re brtsams pa yang shin tu rtsom 'bab pa zhig byung / 'di skabs mdog smon gro nas lha rtse rdzong du rgyugs pa'i gzings gzhi mang po byas/ rdzong nas spe'u ba tshe dbang rdo rje bas nged kyi mchod gzhis 'dra'i sar bcom rgyag byed zer nas dmag bskul byas/ khong rang rta thog tu 'khyon ma thag gnam gzer byung nas sa la lhung / de nas mi ring bar rdzong dpon yang shor ba yin/ de rjes nas dus gzings kyang zhi ba'i skabs/ du ba mjug rings gnyis shar ba de byung / ston gzhug gi chos dang dgun chos kyi tshul du rang res brtsams pa'i 'grel ba de kha'i —33—

steng nas/ ltung bshags/ byams smon/ dkon mchog rjes dran sogs kyi bshad pa re yang byas/ lo 'di'i dpyid ka nas de yan chad kyi bar la mkhar las kyi rigs lho byang gi lha khang sngar steng thog ma khel ba thams cad khel/ lha khang rnams kyi logs zhal mthil zhal sogs zhib cha rnams dang / gzhal yasakhang gi steng dang / lho gling gi spyil po thams cad kyi steng thog khar nub byang gsum gyi gling la yang steng thog ma khel ba rnams kyang khel/ rtse dang zhol gnyis kar du spyil po gsar pa yang mang du grub/ mkhar las sngar las kyang grub che ba tsam byung / sbus khyim pa dpon slob 'ga' shas dang / gtso bor gzhi pa'i lha ris pa rnams kyis gtsug lag khang chen mo'i logs ris rim gyis grub/ lha khang bde ba can gyi logs bris kyang grub cing / 'jam dpal lha khang gi logs bris kyang cha phyed grub/ sgo khang gi rgyal chen bzhi yang lo 'di la ka bris pa yin/gtso che shos bal po bzo bo nyi shus sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun gyi sku bzhengs pa la/ gtso bo ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya'i rgyal po dang /'khor gyi tshul du gzhan drug yin pa las/ gtso bo dang bcom ldan 'das rnam gzigs dang rin chen gtsug tor can de gsum po de/ hor zla bzhi pa'i 'go nas gzung / brgyad pa'i tshes bcu gsum tshun la gzungs bzhugs yan chad legs par grub/ rigs ldan gyi thang sku sum cu so bdun dang / sngags sku thang mo che 'ga' re yang 'di yan chad la legs par zin/ tshes bcu bzhi gza' skar bzang ba nas brtsams de/ zla ba'i 'phros de ka la/ gsang 'dus 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor lo bde mchog pū hi pa/ gshin rje gshed nag po rdo rje —34—

'jigs byed/ mi g.yo bla med/ phyag na rdo rje gtum mo/ phag mo lha so bdun ma rdo rje bdag med ma rnams kyi dkyil 'khor ras bris la brten nas/ rab gnas tshar re byas pas/ tshar brgyad dang / zla ba dgu pa'i yar tshes gsum pa gza' skar bzang ba la/ rab gnas chen mo/ dga' ston can de byas pa yin te/gnam gang gi nyin mo sa chog byas/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor thugs dkyil rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa'i steng nas yin pas rab gnas tshar dgu song / nyin re bzhin sku'i gzi byin rgyas pa sogs byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan mtha' med pa dang / bum pa'i nang du yungs dkar lhungs pa la/myu gu sdong bu me tog shar ba'i bar du byung / dge 'dun rnams dang phu nas sgrub sde yongs rdzogs phebs pa rnams la mang ja gsum sbrel/ tsha ra nas 'gyed/ skye bo mang po rang shugs kyis 'dus pa la/ nas 'gyed sogs zhal dro bying chags par byung / skya ser thams cad la rten mjal yang legs par btang / de ltar na thub pa'i dbang po sogs sangs rgyas gsum po de'i sku gzugs la/ rgyu zangs khal nyis brgya nyi shu tsam/ skud gser zho stong phrag gsum tsam/ tha na rtsi la yang sha dkar zho drug cu/ ti tsha nya ga lnga bcu tsam/ dngul zho brgya dang sum cu skor song zhing / dga' ston chen mo 'di'i gnas skabs su/ bal po lha bzo ba rnams la yon/ bkra shis kha btags bco brgyad/ gser spyi legs pa/gser sil ma srang bzhi/ g.yu legs pa drug g.yu rna rna rgyangs lnga/ yang g.yu rna chig 'dogs gcig dbum phor bcu/ gan dkar legs pa rgya shubs can/ kha thi sogs gos yug sne tshad bcu/ rgya gos gcig dar sman tshe dang byar dar yug —35—

nyi shu/ bkra shis kha btags kyi yol ba gcig sman tshe'i yol ba gnyis/ ja sig sum cu/ bur tang lnga/ g.yas shag gser shog ma nyi shu/ dong pa gser rbe(ga ma cha tshang gsum/ stag sgam cha/ gzig sgam cha/ stag khom cha/dom khom cha/ dbu pa sga gcig gzhan yang dung chas/ mdo ba mas/ pa ri sogs phran bu rnam grangs mang po dang / ka yug sne tshang bcu/ sbun mdab/ gon ma/ ras yug dkyus ma sne tshad rnams nyi shu nyi shu rta bzang ba sga 'khor dang bcas pa/ mo gos legs pa/ bzo bo nyi shu ngo thams cad la gos lham ske rags tshun chad cha tshang ba re rnams sprad/ 'brel can rnams sngon du 'gro ba'i mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub myur du thob pa dang / gnas skabs su yang 'jig rten bde zhing / bstan pa spyi dang / khyad par du yang phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i gtam dang ldan pa'i bstan pa rgyas par smon lam btab po/ /dga' ston gyi gral 'di la/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis la bshad tshoms rgya che bar byas/ de rjes dgun la nye ba na/ chos rje bla brang 'gag pa byams pa kun dga' ba grwa btsun sum cu skor dang bcas pa chos zhu bar byung / tshogs chen la blo sbyong zhig bshad pa'i gzhug tsam la sleb pa yin/ rgyal chen bzhi'i logs bris kyi rab gnas/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor la brten nas byas pa de kha'i steng nas/ khong dpon slob rnams la dbang zhig kyang bskur/'di skabs jo nang dbu mdzad pa'i jo jo 'das pa dang / khong tsho dpon slob tsho'i bsngo zhus gshin don mang po dbang yon dang gu chu rug byas pa'i gshin bsngo byed dgos dang / rlung drag po langs pa sogs rab gnas de rten 'brel legs rgyu —36—

ma byung / nai gu chos drug gi dmigs pa nges po zhig kyang bshad/ de rjes dgun khrid rim pas sngar lugs bzhin btsugs/ 'gag pa dpon slob thams cad kyis dam po yang rgyab/ shangs chos lhag ma rnams kyang cha tshang tsam byas/ 'di skabs gsang ba'i de kho na nyid kyi ṭīkka de brtsams pa yin te/ cung zad mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bka' ma grol ba'i rmi ltas zhig kyang byung / brel bas g.yengs nas tshogs gtor bshags pa sogs byed pa'ang ma byung / dam po grol nas bla ma byams pa kun dga' rang la sbyor drug gi yan lag phyi ma rnams kyi lag len 'dzug btsugs dang / ngo sprod rnams kyi go don khi mor yed dgos pa byung ste/phyis blo la 'jags pa ni ma byung 'dug sngar gsang ba'i de kho na nyid kyi 'grel pa brtsams pa de'i gnyan cha dang khong la'ang sbyor drug gi lag len ston dgos byung ba'i gnyan cha sdoms pa 'dra ba cig gis rkyen byas te/ srog gegs kyi rnam pa shin tu na ba zhag bdun tsam byung / yongs gril ba nad gzhug de zla gcig lhag pa bsdad/ thur sel gsus par log pas dang kha 'gribs/ da dung yang de'i sred skabs re langs yong ba 'dug spyir yan lag phyi ma rnams kyi lag len 'di shin tu bka' gnyan par 'dug khyad par khong ba dang po sbyor drug gi chos la dad pa chen po mi 'dug pas/ de sel du song nas lan pa 'dra'o/ /de rjes dam rdzas ril bu zhig bsgrubs/ dam tshig gtsang ba rnams dang lhan cig tshogs dang gtor ma 'ga' re byas pas nad gzhug lhag ma de yang de skabs sangs pa 'dra ba zhig byung / 'di skabs dus khrid dkyus las zla gcig gi snga ba yod pas legs par byung / gzhan du na ba de chos sgang rang la yod pa 'dug cing / brel ba mang

po dang yang thug pa cig ka yong ba 'dug rgyal ba seng ge'i sku skye ri shing pa yang / khams phyogs la 'byon pa'i blo rtse byas 'dug kyang / 'bri gung tsam nas shin tu bsnyung ba'i tshur logs skyid shong brag dkar sker du gshegs 'dug dang po nged kyi brtag pa de bden par byung/ de rjes lug lo gsar ba hor zla dang po'i tshes bco lnga yan la/ sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi nang nas bcom ldan 'das thams cad skyob dang / log par dad sel dang / gser thub dang/ 'od srung gi sku brnyan rnams kyang gzungs bzhugs phyin chad mtha' dag ma tshang ba med par grub/ dpal sangs rgyas thod pa dang / ye shes dbang phyug ma dang phyag rdor stod 'grel lugs kyi bde mchog ste/ dkyil 'khor gsum po de rim can du zhal phyi nas rab gnas tshar re byas/ 'di skabs sde srid dbus nas bsam 'grub rtser phebs de rgyang tsam song skabs yin/ rab gnas 'di tsam la yong ba yod zhu bar btang na/ rab ston gsher bar song dogs 'phrod ye ma phul na'ang /ma gi nas thugs tshod gnang ba dang 'grig ste/ rab ston mang ja sbrel ma/ tshar bzang pa/ dar 'gyed ja 'gyed/ nged la'ang g.yangs khre'u'i dam kha gcig sogs bzab ma dang / kun dga' dpal bzang la yang tsan dan dmar po'i rgya rtags gnang ba sogs dang / brda ma btang ba la skye bo mang po rang 'dus par tsam pa dang nged rang gi lag nas skya btsun thams cad la nas 'bo rgyag sogs mdor na/ thog ma'i rtsis la skabs 'dir rab gnas gsangs se byas/ dga' ston dang bcas pa'i rab gnas phyis byed snyam na'ang / 'di skabs rang du dga' ston bzab rgyas rang shugs la byung / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs phyis —38—

bzhengs pa bzhi po 'di la/ zangs khal nyis brgya bdun cu skor/ gser zhog sum stong du nye ba/ rtsi rang la ti tsha khal gnyis tsam/ dngul zho dgu bcu lhag tsam/ sha dkar zho brgyad cu tsam dang bcas pa song / dga' ston thog yon rdzongs su/ bzo bo sngar gyi rnams la/ bkra shis kha btags kha bzhi bcu/gser srang bzhi/ g.yu rna gnyis/ pho skor bzhi/ g.yu nyi shu/ dngul spyi gnyis/dngul phor gnyis/ rten khebs bcu/ ma ṇi ma'i mthongs yod pa'i bla bre gcigabyus ser po yug sman tshe yug bco lnga/ gzhan dar yug bco lnga/ sman che'i yol ba gnyis/ sman tshe kha 'khyar brgya tham pa/ dar gzhan kha 'khyar sum brgya/ ja sig bzhi bcu/ bse sgam cha/ ka ci'i yol ba/ g.yas shag dang 'jong dar ma bu 'dres pa bco lnga/ gtsang snam dbu snam/ stod ras yug rnams bcu bcu/ kha sha spun 'dab/ ka yug gon chen/ gon chung rnams nyi shu nyi shu/ ras yug sum cu/ rta gcig dre'u gnyis/ sder spyad/ dkar yol ba ri la sogs pa nor sna phran bu sna tshogs dang bcas pa spyin/ dga' ston snga phyi gnyis kar la/ bzo bo nyi shu po re re bzhin sman tshe tshon rdzogs ma kha mdud re yang legs dar gyi tshul du sprad/ sngar bzhin sku gzugs bzhengs pa la bya ba byas pa'i dge ba thams cad rang shar spros bral du ngo shes pa'i sgo nas bsngo bas 'phral du rgyas thebs par yang byas/ smon lam de dag 'grub par 'dug snyam pa'i nges shes kyang skye bar byung ngo / /rab gnas kyi sgang la nged la snga mo zhig chos du ma re thob zer ba'i rtogs ldan zhig rgya gar du phyin pa'i rdo rje gdan nas kyang rgyang tsam lhor phyin/nged kyi bla ma gang ba'i rdo rjes bskur ba yin zer/ de bzhin gshegs pa mnyam —39—

bzhag mdzad pa'i rdo sku/ sngon rdo rje gdan gyi 'khyams kyi lha yin pa skyon med zhig khur nas nged la gtad/ nub phyogs nas ye shes sems dpa' dngos su byon pa'i rnam par 'dug gtsang khang chen mor ding phon bum gdan ma gser ma gsum gyis gtsos pa'i bum gdan ma bcu dgu'i bla bre dang / 'du khang chen mo'i ka ba sum cu so drug gi sa la khebs pa'i bla bre bzang sgrigs chen mo nyi shu rtsa bdun/ 'og min lha khang la dgu dang / rgya gar lha khang la kha thi dang byus yug sgrigs pa'i bla bre sogs kyang 'bul thub/ de nas lug lo'i hor zla gnyis pa'i nang du gtsang du sde srid rgyal bu'i drung khri thog tu phebs rgyu'i thog la/ nged la'ang 'bod mi phebs pa ltar tshes gnyis la rtag brtan nas bteg ste/ 'jad kyi ne sing du zhag gcig bsdad pa'i skabs/ nye skor de tsho nas 'phrad mkhan shin tu mang ba zhig byung / gser sdings su bsdad pa'i nub mo/ rgyal po gnas rnying pa'i cho 'phrul btsun gzhon bong ring shin tu mdzes pa/ 'khor ban de dang skyes pa bud med bzab chas can lnga bcu drug cus skor ba zhig byas de/ nged la phyag cig phul/ ja zhal cig drangs/ da res khyed yongs pa de nged la bkra shis/sngar gyod kha che ba zhig yod pa nged rang sang 'gro ba 'dug gzhan thabs kyis phar yol tshur yol byas pa yin zer ba cig byung / tshes lnga'i nyin mo bsam rtser sleb/ de nyin sngar gyi rtogs ldan smyon pa des/ nged kyi rta gdong nas phar skyid la zer 'drab kyin rgyugs/ rten 'brel 'tshub tsam du 'dug ste mngon 'gyur ni cang ma byung / 'gong po dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur du yong ba 'dug sleb 'phral nas zhag gsum gyi ring de la sku khrus dang / drag dbang tshe dbang sogs ci rigs pa —40—

phul/ tshes brgyad kyi snga thog gza' skar bzang ba la/ rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i tshogs/ khri thog tu 'jog pa'i mnga' gsol de phul/ sde srid rang yang snga gong stobs kyi rgyal po yin pas/ khri 'don ka dpe ma ma gnang bas/ dgongs bzhed ltar lhan du phul ba yin/ spyi babs bod kyi sde dpon phal cher rang 'tshams kyi rgyal srid 'dzin pa de srol yin pa 'dug 'ga' zhig la che 'don byed pa'i srol 'dug kyang / shis brjod re tsam ma gtogs/ cho ga 'di byed kyi nges pa mi 'dug na'ang / 'phags yul na rgyal rigs dra ma rgyal srid du bsko ba la/ rig byed las 'byung ba'i cho ga 'dug pa de/ de dang rig pa mtshungs pa la/ cho ga nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lugs su sbyar nas skabs 'dir byas pa lags/ de nas zhag mang po'i bar dga' ston rgya chen pos khyab par mdzad/ sgyu ma lta bu'i rtsed sna yang mang du mthong / mi 'tshogs dang grags pa ches pas 'dre mi ma yin mang po 'dus sam snyam pa 'dug /de 'dras nad yams la sogs pa byung dogs 'dug pa nas/ 'byung po spyi gtor dang / bgegs gtor mang tsam btang bas/ so sor gyes pa'i rnam pa yang shar/ gzhan yang phyi nang gi rten 'brel yin 'dug pas/ rgyal srid kyi bya ba byed pa'i mi ma yin snga phyi las tshan brje ba'i rnam pas gsar pa mang po sleb/ rnying pa skrag mdangs gzi brjid can mang po log 'gro ba'i rnam pa 'dug bud med zil can gcig sngar skyid po rang byung / da 'gro zer 'khor mang po dang bcas phyogs byang shar la song ba'i snang ba gsal bar byung / nyin mo mi 'tshogs che zhing / rtsed sna zang zing mang po dang / mtshan mo 'byung po'i zang zing mang pos dus 'das kyang / de —41—

thams cad 'dus byas mi rtag zag bcas sdug bsngal/ chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa'i tshul la nges shes skyed pa'i brda don kho nar byung bas/ ri khrod du bsdad pa las kyang nyams myong la bogs che ba tsam shar/ dga' ston gyi ring der/ sa chu dros pa rang zhig byung ba las/ de rjes cung zad bsil du song /zla ba de kha'i zla gzhug nas drag po'i gtor dbang 'dra yang phul/ zla ba dkar nas tshe dbang sogs thog mar rkyen sel la phul rjes/ dbang ngam rjes gnang sogs dbang chos rnam grangs re 'chag med dang / sde srid nyid kyi dgongs bzhed ltar/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi bshad pa'i chos thun re yang 'chag med du byas de/ 'dzin chos skyong ba dang / zin bris 'debs pa yang 'di skabs thugs brel shin tu rang che ba'i skabs su 'dug kyang / 'dzin chos dang /zin bris dang / mtha' gcod kyi bshad pa gsan pa sogs thugs rtsol shin tu che ba mdzad/ btsun pa kun la 'di 'dra'i 'dun pa byung na 'tshed pa gda' ste/zhogs rgyugs re yang 'dzin mi nus/ spyi chos thun re yang nyan mi nus pa 'dis phung gda'/ sngon bstan pa dar bya ba yang/ btsun pa rnams 'dun pa che ba'i ming yin/ deng sang chos nub bya ba yang / chos pa rnams slob gnyer sgom sgrub gang la yang 'dun pa mi byed pa 'di la zer ba yin/ bod na btsan btsun mang nyung rang ta da lta yang lcogs tsam gda' ste/ grul btub de ye mi gda'/ sngon chas par spyod pa'i rab byung du ma zad/ dge bsnyen dang sngags pa dang / khyim btsun tshun chod kyang / dpe 'dri ba dang / lta rtog dang / sgo sgor spyang dang / chosazhu ba dang / nyan shad sogs la rtsol ba can mang du byung zhing / sgom sgrub la yang —42—

rtsol ba che bar byung / bstan pa gnas pa bya ba de 'dra la zer ba yin par gda'/thugs brel ches pas nyin mo chos gsan long mi yong 'dug pa/ chos bka' rnams mtshan mo'i ring kho na la mdzad de/ res 'ga' 'dzin chos grol ba na nam phyed yol la khad song ba yang yong gin 'dug zin bris phyag bris de'i rjes su mdzad pas/ tho rangs tsam du 'gro ba lan mang / 'di skabs byang zhabs drung nor khyung klu sdings nas yar ngam ring la phebs song ba'i skad cha tshor te/ ltas ni shin tu 'tshub par 'dug khong rang la ni zhu mkhan ma btang / gzhan rnams la ni smras/ tshangs chug byung nas 'di yan chad du/ nged dang 'phrad dgos pa 'dug gsung ba zhig yang yang byung kyang / bzang brdzu'i zom zom de ka min pa/bshags pa byed gsung pa lta bu'i kha gsal can gang yang mi 'dug pas/ nged kyis kyang zem 'gros la bzhag pa yin/ yang bar skabs su sangs rgyas thod pa dang / kyai rdor mtshon cha can dang / ye shes dbang phyug ma dang / bde mchog mi tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang sogs byas/ klu sdings gsar ba la sngar chu thags shar zer ba/ bkra shis dge 'phel du ming spos pa yin/ da yang dge ba 'phel ba de mi dga' bsam ming 'dra min cig 'dug gzims khang gi rab gnas sogs la nged yon mchod lhan du phebs zhag gnyis bzhugs/ de rjes phyag tu 'byor pa'i thags sku'i rigs dang / se'u sogs tshem sku'i rigs/ si thang gsar rnying /g.yin yang thang ka'i rigs shin tu mang ba dang / bka' 'gyur hor par ma/grub thob brgyad cu'i zhal thang gsar bzhengs/ 'bur sku yang rgya bod sna tshogs pa mang po dang bcas pa la/ sa ga'i zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin rab gnas rgyas —43—

par byas/ zhag bdun gyi bar du mchod pa rgya chen po gnang ba sogs bshad tshod dang mthun par mdzad/ 'bras sbungs dga' ldan pho brang ba'i nang zan 'ga' zhig dang rgya le ba'i bud med rnams la'ang btson dong du 'jug pa sogs bka' skyon par byung yang ngo chen zhus pas bde bar khrol/ g.yor por sil ma dang 'da' 'u nang nas sde pa gzhung gi phyag tu gang byung rnams nged la mchod gzhis su sbyor 'jags gnang / blon chen bde skyid par bka' skyon 'gangs che ba rang byung na'ang / zhu ngo gang drag zhus pas/ gnyer kha bzhes pa min pa de res la nyes skyon gzhan ma byung ba yin/ zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bzhi la yar bteg chu byang rgyud byas de lam 'gol zhing skyid pa'i ngang nas/ tshe brgyad kyi snga thog rtag brtan du sleb/ bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun gyi rab gnas zhal dro chen mo de/ zla ba de ka la byas na phyogs nas yong mkhan rnams dus thug ste mi 'choms par 'dug pas/ hor zla drug pa'i yar tshe dge ba cig la byed par byas de bar du chos than thun 'dra bshad/ byang nas zhabs drung shin tu sku bsnyel ba'i sku rim la dgon yar mar du mang ja dang / nged la'ang da res bshags pa 'bul ba yin pas/ ngam ring du yong dgos gsung ba byung ba na'ang / bshags pa ni len par spro yang yar phyogs 'gro ni ma thub/ sku rim de la'ang sel gyi rnam pa yod nges shes pa'i 'u lag pa mi gsum la skyon par byung / sger pa rje drung rtogs ldan pa 'byor pa la yang / khong gis sngar ma thob pa'i shangs chos kyi 'phro 'dra rim pas bshad/ ri khrod chen por sgrub sde la/ thugs rje chen po'i smar khrid dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang gi rigs mang tsam byas/ gting skyes —44—

nas sde pa rgyal bu'i drung dang chos rje ye shes rgya mtsho ba dpon sa yum sogs kyang rab gnas kyi dga' ston dang legs ja gnang bar phebs/ tshes brgyad kyi nyin gza' skar sogs 'grub sbyor bzang ba la/ dpal he ru ka 'khor lo sdom pa ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas rab gnas dngos gzhi sgrubs/ de'i nang par rab gnas rjes kyi bya ba rnams byas/ 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char 'bab pa nyi ma bstud mar byung ba sogs phyi ltas nang ltas thams cad legs par byung / rang re'i lag nas btang ba dang / phyogs kyi zur 'dren sogs dga' ston nyin zhag mang po 'brel ba la/ rtag brtan rang gi tshogs pa dngos rnams 'du khang chen mo khengs pa dang / sgrub sde rnams gzhal yas khang gi khyams su 'tshog sa mdzad/ de min rang re la gtogs pa'i dgon tha dad pa'i grwa btsun sna tshogs pa rnams chos bzang gi rdo bcal du 'tshogs/ de la su 'dod yongs chog pa'i tshogs yangs par byas/ yongs gril ba la ha rgyag tsam ma yin par re re nas bgrangs pa la/ ser mo ba'i khul du stong phrag gsum lhag bcas la/ nyin re bzhin mang ja gang thongs thongs dang / tsha gro mar thud/'khur ba sogs dang dga' ston dngos gzhi'i nyin bur bsgar mtho gru bzhi/rtsam nas khal 'gyed/ dngos po'i phyag 'gyed bzab pa dang / gzhan gting skyes nas zhal ngo re res mang ja 'gyed bcas te/ gzhan yang grwa rigs mchod gzhis kyi khul nas zur 'dren dga' ston gyi 'bul ba sogs rnam grangs mang ba dang / mchod gzhis pas gtsos pa'i stod smad thams cad nas 'dus pa'i skye bo'i tshogs dga' ston len pa dang / rten mjal bar 'ongs pa ches tshogs che —45—

bar 'dus pa rnams la gro bzhes/ myong gang 'thung / bu ram 'khyid gru bzhi nas 'bo sogs dga' ston rgya khyon che zhing byings chags pa 'thab rtsod sogs nyes skyon ye med pa'i 'jam pa rang cig byung / de mtshams ye shes sems dpa' dngos su byon pa'i phyi rtags sku'i byin phebs pa'i rten 'brel du/ chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi thugs dam thub pa'i rdo sku 'di/ bla ma sman chu bas spyan drangs te 'dir byon/ phyis kyi ma phyi sogs dgon pa'i spyi thes su dgongs nas sde srid kyis bka' 'gyur yongs rdzogs zhig gnang ba yang dga' ston thog ma'i nyin 'byor ba/ gsung chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rten 'brel 'grig cing / gsung rdo rje'i ye shes phebs par nges shes skyes/ bar skabs der sher snying gi 'grel ba chung ba dang / che ba de yang sum gnyis tsam zhig bris thub/ 'di skabs byang zhabs drung yang zla ba drug pa'i tshes bdun la sku gshegs pa'i skabs 'dir bsngo rten dang / sku byang cig kyang gcog dgos bar byung ba lugs gnyis kar nas 'brel ba shin tu che bas sku sgrib sbyangs thabs de skyo shas dang 'brel ba cig gi ngang nas/ dmigs su gang 'gro snying thag par byas/ cung zad phan thogs par mngon pa cig byung / 'di skabs kyang gtsang sde srid nas g.yu rtse sa ri sa skor thams cad thog ma mdzod pa kun dga' dpal bzang la gnang ba yin na'ang /rtag brtan du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub mchod thes bstan pa nam gnas sbyor ba gnang / de rjes rtag brtan gyi dbyar chos la dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha hi pa'i lugs kyi rdzogs rim rnal 'byor chen po dril bu pa'i khrid rim pa lnga pa/nag po rim bzhi lam slong chen mo/ dpyal lugs kyi phag mo sgom drug gi 'khrid/—46—

rtsa dbu ma'i khrid/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khrid/ bde mchog dkar po'i byang chub sgrub lam gyi 'khrid dang tshe khrid gnyis/ bde mchog lhan skyes kyi khrid/ ma hā mā ya'i khrid/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i khrid/ rdo rje gdan bzhi'i khrid de ma rgyud kyi khrid rnam grangs mi 'dra ba khungs dang ldan pa bcu gcig dang / o la pa ti'i 'grel pa rang nyid kyis sbyar ba de ka'i steng nas/ lung dang bshad pa rgyas pa tshar gcig tshe mdo'i 'grel pa'i bshad pa dang lung rnams byas/ de nas hor zla dgu pa'i stod la gting skyes nas sde pa ma chen yang gnas mjal dang nged 'phrad par phebs/ sgrub sde chos sde gnyis char du/ mang ja 'gyed bcas rnam gzhag bsngo rten sogs khyad par can sgrub par mdzad/ tshe dbang rigs gnyis brgya rtsa dang / rkyen sel gyi rjes gnang ci rigs pa dang 'khor lo bde mchog nag po lugs kyi dbang dang / rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs sogs gsan/ dus ston gzhung yin kyang dgun chos dang sbrags pa la/ bde mchog 'khrul spong dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / sdom pa 'byung ba dang / 'khor lo sgyur drug dang / sbyangs pa'i yon tan ma dang / dril bu lha lnga dang / 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang / bong zhal can dang / phyag rdor stod 'grel lugs kyi rtsa dkyil dang phag mo lha so bdun ma ste bde mchog yab yum du gtogs pa'i dbang bka' bcu po de rnams tshogs pa thams cad la bskur/ gting skyes nas sde pa'i drung gis kyang de thams cad zhor la gsan/ de nas bar skabs der ri khrod chen mor mtshams zhag bcu skor zhig byas/ rang re bsam 'grub rtse nas 'khor ba nas gzung 'di bar du/ sgo khang gi logs bris chos skyong bco lnga 'khor dang bcas pa

dang / gtsang khang gi logs bris dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dang dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dang / rdo rje 'jigs mdzad la sogs pa sngags sku gtso che ba'i logs bris yongs rdzogs dang / 'jam dbyangs lha khang gi logs bris 'phros dang /o rgyan mkha' spyod lha khang gi logs bris phyed tsam dang / sman bla lha khang gi skya ris tsam gzhi sdod kyi lha ris pa rnams kyis grub pa yin/ dbon po bsod nams sogs kyis phyag rdor lha khang gi gyang ris grub cing / gnod sbyin nor lha'i lha khang gi skya ris tsam thebs so/ /ngang pa'i rgyal po'i rnam pa can gyi gru shan bzang po cig kyang 'gro ba rnams 'khor ba'i chu bo las sgrol ba mtshon byed du legs par btsugs/ bal po bzo bo bdun tsam gyis lugs sku than thun mang rab dang / gtso bo bcom ldan 'das kyi rgyab yol 'od skor/ rgyu gser zangs dngul gsum las grub pa sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs bcu gcig gis mdzes par byas pa/ 'phra rgyan khyad par can du mas yongs su spras pa 'di bzhengs thub/ mchod rdzas kyi khyad par mchod rkong chen mo dang / rting chen mo'i rigs 'ga' re yang bcos/ ri logs kyi spyil bu rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i spyil po bzhi bcu skor thebs/ gzhan yang las ka grub che bar byung / las mi nyung yang las mi mang po'i dus dang 'dra ba rang byung ngo / /'di skabs gcig la lung nag shel dkar du tshur gyi mthu bzlog dang phar la drag las gnyis kar yin rgyu'i khungs kyis sgram sgram sil sil mang po zhig byas pa'i grub 'bras la/dpon mo de gza' gdong thug byung nas glo bur du 'das/ bsngo rten skyel mkhan byung bas/ nged kyis kyang ma legs skyel bzab pa zhig byas/ de nas sngar khyud —48—

ltar dgun gyi 'khrid kyang btsugs/ rta lo lug lo'i dgun khrid 'di gnyis la/rtag brtan dang ri khrod kyi chos mnyam por tshugs pa de ni ma thub/ 'di lo sde pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis dam po mdzad pa yin zhing / skyes rgyal grwa rigs dam po byed mkhan shin tu mang bar byung / chos rje ye shes rgya mtsho ba la 'di ras snga phyir lam 'bras kyi gdams ngag yongs su rdzogs pa dang / nai gu'i khrid dang byin rlabs cha tshang ba zhig dang / ma hā mā ya'i rgyud kyi bshad pa zhib mo smon lam rnam gsum la rang re'i khyi ka'i steng nas bshad pa 'dzug khrid/ bka' babs bdun ldan gyi gzhung gi bshad pa phyed tsam dang / man ngag yang de tsam bshad/rgyud sde lnga dang kun rig la sogs pa'i dbang bskur yang byas/ skabs 'dir sher snying ṭīka chen gyi 'phros kyang rdzogs par bris pa yin/ dus khrid grol nas mtshams dam po rgyang tsam cig kyang byas/ smon thang mkhan chen brag dkar chos rje yang glo bo dang se rib phyogs kyi grwa rgyun gsar pa dang bcas legs par 'byor/ mkhan chen lhun rab pas dgos med la dge rgan tsho la ngan slob zhal ta dngos su bcug 'dir yong mkhan grwa pa lnga tsam gzhan la skyogs 'dug de nas glo bo ba tshos mang ja 'gyed bcas bsngo rten rnam gzhag sogs bzab rgyas su byung / yang 'di skabs mchod gtor bshams shing gsol ba btab pas legs pa'i mtshan ma yang byung zhing / khyad par 'phags ba 'jam dpal gyis gnang ba bstsal ba'i rmi ltas cig kyang byung nas/ gsang 'dus rim lnga la ṭīkka zhib pa 'di brtsams pa yin/ 'di 'bri ba la nyi ma nyi shu rtsa lnga song / skabs 'dir mdog smon 'gro ba'i rgyal bu tshe dbang lhun grub pa yang / bsam 'grub —49—

rtse'i zhol du rkyen drag po thog babs kyis glo bur du 'das 'dug pas/ bsngo rten du yi dam chos skyong gi sku 'ga' zhig byung / a phas bu la dug btang ba yin zer ba'i gtam ni 'dug gal te min na bka' chad rang yin/ de rjes byang nas dpon sa'i drung la gting skyes nas yab yum rnams kyis kyang ngo chen mdzad pa sogs nas/ bshags pa kha gsal mdzad de phebs/ sde gnyis su mang ja rnyed bkur sogs mdzad/ cung zad 'tshub cha yod pa gcig ka ni byung / sun 'byin ba'i stobs dang / slar bzlog pa'i stobs ni yod yod mi 'dra/ phyi ltar mdzes cha'i dbang du gda'o/ /de mtshams rgyal rtse bla ma'i zhabs drung dang mdog chos 'khor sgang gi slob dpon dang / gzhan dge bshes 'ga' shas dang / khyad par skabs 'dir/ smon thang nas mkhan chen brag dkar chos rje'i drung yang dbus 'khor nas phebs pa sogs don gnyer mang dag gcig la/ phyag rgya chen po gzhus dmigs pa gang nges nges dang / gzhan yang lam khyer 'chi med/ mkha' spyod sogs shangs chos phran tshegs rnams dang / bla ma'i drung dang smon thang mkhan chen gnyis la/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i phyi sgrub nang sgrub kyi lung khrid rnams yongs su rdzogs par byas/ 'di skabs lung nag shel dkar ba gsar pa nang so rgya gan pa rnams dbang thang khas drag dpung pa yod 'phro rang de/ ja sbyor gcig gi sgang la thams cad sdib cing zhig pa'i rmi lam rmi 'phro la gnyid sad pa 'dra ba de byung ba'i skabs yin/ rkyen 'dis spyir stod smad kyi mang po zhig la sdib stong dang / khyad par snga sor byang gi mnga' zhabs su gtogs pa shas che ba'i khul nas/ bla ma slob dpon dgon sde rigs dpon skya che chung mang po zhig —50—

la/ re ba 'bras med dang byas pa mdo med byung / cha gcig nas blo brtad pas chog sar mi gtod/ log min gyi mgo brtod dang / ci min gyi rgyu 'grul rim po khog ngan blo nyes de tshol mkho yang mkho bar gda'/ de rjes gzhan yang smon thang mkhan chen sogs la chos sna than thun mang dag bshad/ dbang ldan lha khang /'bar 'dzin lha khang gzhal yas khang rnams kyi logs bris tshugs shing / bka' 'gyur bzheng ba'i yig mkhan phal cher sleb/ yig gra yang tshugs/ snga sor dgun nas brtsams te nam dus dga' lod la ma ltos par/ zab chen gyi sku bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod lha lnga lha mgron 'od dpag med/bcom ldan 'das sman pa'i rgyal po dpangs su thog so bcu gcig gi rtsis chu zhing gab cing / kha thi dang byus sogs shas che ba'i rgyu tshogs bzang por bcas pa 'di yang skabs der legs par grub/ thog mar gtsug lag khang du zhal phye nas rab gnas bgyis shing / de rjes zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bco lnga la gtsug lag khang gi shar phyogs la bkram ste phyag mchod bzab pa zhig byas/ cho se sde/sgrub sde skye bo'i tshogs shin tu mang ba dang bcas pa la rten mjal btang / de nub gang che ba babs/ rgyal khams dkar por gyur pa'i rten 'brel dang / chos bdag mo mnyes pa'i cho 'phrul du'ang gda'/ de'ang dam tshig gsum bkod 'di bya rgyud kyi rtsa ba lta bu yin na'ang / tha na 'di'i bris thang tsam yang dkon par 'dug pas/ sku bzhengs pa sogs kyi mig ltos la phan nam snyam pa dang / rang yang lhag par 'di la mos shing / gzhan yang 'di ni sems bskyed kyi sdom pa thob/ sngags kyi dbang bskur ma thob pa rnams kyis kyang bzlas brjod byar rung —51—

zhing / gtsang sbra ma byas kyang gtsang sbrar 'gyur ba dang / tshul khrims dang mi ldan yang / tshul khrims dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa'ang dkyil 'khor du zhugs par 'gyur ba sogs phyi ma'i dus kyi sems can la shin tu phan thogs che ba zhig yin par gsung pas de'i dbang du byas pa lags/de la nged kyis sogs 'grul dang / 'bul sdung gtong ba dang / tshong pa gtong ba sogs ni ye ma byas/ sde srid gtso bor gyur pa'i g.yin thams cad nas ci rigs ci rigs byung ba'i dar zab kyi rigs bung bas me tog gi tshogs las sbrang rtsi thob pa ltar byung ba rnams la bzhengs pa yin/ ma byin par blangs pa dang / g.yo sgyu khram gsum rku 'phrog skyis gsum sogs mi 'os pa'i rdzas gang dang yang ma 'dres pas dge ba gtsang dag kho na yin zhing / de kas byin rlabs kyang che bar bdog go /de rjes lha khang so sor 'jim bzo ci rigs pa yang 'go tshugs shing / gtsang sa nas sde srid yar dgas phyogs la dpung 'degs su nye ba'i skabs/ sde srid zhabs drung nas khor tsam yong dgos gsung ba'i 'bod mi gnang byung ba/ tshes gcig la btegs/ lam thams cad du kha ba chen bo 'bab pa dang / khyad par bo dong bkra shis sgang nas gsing ma'i bar la nyin zang gis kha ba chen po babs/ 'di skabs lung nag gi rdzong bskyel tshugs 'dug sgang dgu skyong dgu'i smad der rgya gan pa'i nang so bsam 'grub byon/ sde srid du ngo chen dgos tshul du 'dug tshes gsum la gzhis ka rtser 'byor zhing / bsu ba la sde srid bkra shis dge 'phel du phebs 'dug rta dar dang rol mo sogs kyis sna drangs te pho brang du 'byor/ de nyin nas ka chos bka'i 'go btsugs dpung thog

tu phebs rgyu'i thugs brel gyi nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu 'brel 'gro ba 'dug kyang / bar chad sel phyogs kyi dbang rjes gnang rnams gsan pa la/ thugs rtsol ni cher gnang / kha char chen po 'bab pa dang / rlung cher g.yo ba sogs cho 'phrul du yang mngon pa dang / phyi rtags nang rtags legs nyes 'dres ma dang bcas tshes bcu gsum la dpung thog tu phebs song / nged (pa sde srid rgyal bu'i drung du dbang bka' sogs 'bul ba dang / gang ci'i khyad tsam 'dug pas/'gyangs tsam sdod dgos phebs pa ltar zla 'phro de bsdad/ smon thang mkhan po dang / gzhan yang rab 'byams pa 'ga' re sogs phyag phyir dkris pa'i sde srid rgyal bu'i drung du gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs kyi dbang / sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang / rgya gzhung gi lung dang bcas pa sogs chos kyi rnam grangs 'ga' re phul/ de dus rten 'brel legs mdog kha mo yod/ lar 'go ma rten 'brel legs kyang / rkyen gyis log 'gro ba la tshegs mi gda'/ yang zhol na thor pa cung zad 'dug pas dpon sa a lce'i drung la phyil bsangs na rang legs zhus na'ang / zhabs drung dpa' bo dang bla ma sogs bzlog pa'i 'brum srung la gdeng mdzad nas gseng ba ni ma mdzad/ 'di skabs ngur smrig gi sgrol ma rdzong 'dzin 'di na phebs 'dug pas spyan 'dren zhus/ mchod pa phul/ gsol ba mang du btab/ bar chad mang po sel ba dang / byin gyis brlabs pa'i ltas kyang cung zad byung / lan cig rmi lam du 'phags ma nyid yin snyam pa'i mi'i tshul can gzhon nu ma rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhig nam mkhar byung / phyis lo shas rmi lam du dpal ldan sham bha la yin snyam pa yang yang byung bas/ sngar gyi las 'gyur —53—

nas/ der skye ba len pa yin nam snyam tsa na/ de min brtsams ces rnams sham bha la'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gsung dang mthun bar byung bas/de'i rten 'brel gyi yin gsung ba cig byung / hor zla lnga pa'i tshes bdun la byang chen du sleb tsam byas/ 'jam dbyangs tshul bzang ba grib kyi rnam pas khams ngan par 'dug cing / phya bka' bcu pa yang bsnyung gzhi ba ji bar 'dug pa/nged kyis sbyang ba dang rnam 'joms kyi byabs bkrus tsam bgyis pas khong pa gnyis po'ang myur du khams dwangs/ de nas yar lam 'gor med du 'ongs/brag ram du yang khor tsam phyin pa'i gnod sbyin la gtor ma bzab pa cig phul/tshes bcu gnyis la rtag brtan du sleb/ zhag shas ni brel g.yengs 'dra la song /nyer bzhi nas brtsams te dbyar kha spyi chos la/ shangs chos yongs rdzogs kyi dbang du byas te dpal rgyud sde lnga chab gcig tu sgrubs pa'i dbang bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang sogs chos drug bka' bcu/ phyag chen bka' lnga/ mkha' spyod bka' lnga/ phag mo gsang sgrub/ spyan ras gzigs skyer sgang lugs kyi bka' gsum/ rnam 'joms/ phyag rdor mi g.yo ba'i bka' sogs dbang bka' rags rim phal che ba dang / chos drug phyag chen lam 'byer 'chi med/ su kha'i skor gyi 'khrid/ thugs rje chen po skyer sgang lugs kyi 'khrid/ rjes su yi rang gi bar du 'khrid kyi skor dang / nai gu su kha ra hu la/ rdo rje gdan pa rnams kyi man ngag so so dang / thugs rje wo po'i skor dang / gcod rin rṣa phreng ba sogs dpe lung rnams kyang cha tshang bar song / khams pa rab 'byams pa blo gros bstan 'dzin dang / kong rab pa dkon mchog dpal bzang sogs kyi gsol ba btab —54—

———sgopa 0hūṃ ngor/ g.yin don gnyer bzhi bcu tsam/ rgyal rtse bla ma zhabs drung dang bcas pa rnams la lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag cha lag dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa dang / lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi bklags lung dang bcas pa bshad/ lar dbus nas 'khor ba'i stag lo de nas gzung / phyogs nas yongs pa shas che ba'i don gnyer nyung bsdus nyung bsdus la/ lam 'bras cha tshang re lo re bzhin bshad dgos pa byung / dbyar gung yan chad la de bzhin gshegs ba drug po rnams kyi sku'i rgyab yol gser zangs dngul gsum las byas shing / phra rgyan du mas spras pa rnams kyang grub/ rgyab yol bdun po rnams la zangs khal brgya drug cu tsam/ byugs gser zho bzhi brgya/ dbul zho sum brgya tsam song / rtsi'i chas la sogs pa yang des dpag par nus so/ /rgyab yol rnams kyi 'phra'i rgyu la'ang / brdar shel rdog po che ba nyi shu rtsa gcig chung ba drug brgya skor/ g.yu che chung 'dres pa lnga brgya dang brgyad bcu/ phug skor sog sna me tog rdo rje sogs che chung 'dres pa bzhi bcu zhe bzhi la sogs pa dang /rin po che'i khyad par ci rigs pa'ang song / yang sngar gyi zab sku'i 'phros las 'o skol gyi ston pa'i sku brnyan 'khor rgyal po zla ba bzang po'i sprul gzhi phyag na rdo rje dang / rigs ldan grags pa'i sprul gzhi 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam sprul kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po sogs kyis bskor ba/dpangs phal thog bdun gyi rtsis su byas pa 'di yang / hor zla bdun pa'i zla stod kyi nang du legs par grub/ rtag brtan nyid du rab gnas byas shing skya ser thams cad la rten mjal yang btang / de bzhin du kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po —55—

dus gsum sangs rgyas dol po pa'i sku brnyan mda' gang ma gnyis bzheng zig/ pa'i sku re re la zangs khal gnyis re dang / gnyis kar sdoms pa'i phyug gser la/ gser sho bzhi bcu zhe lnga tsam song ba/ gnyis kar shin tu mtshar ba rab gnas byas pa tsam gyis byings chags par byung / hor zla bdun pa'i nyer gsum gza' skar dge ba la/ byang chub chen po'i zab sku dang / kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i sku 'dra gcig ri khrod chen por bsu pa'i bkod ba dang bcas ste spyan drangs pas/ me tog gi char shin tu che ba 'bab pa dang / phyogs thams cad dri bzang gis khyab pa sogs phyi rtags dang / sgom chen rnams la ye shes lhag par phebs pa sogs byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan shin tu che ba byung / de skabs dbus nas sde srid kyi bka' shog don la/ zhabs drung rgyal bu'i drung du 'brum pa byung dogs sogs 'dug kyang / zhu lan du dang lo'i res la mi yong ba 'dra zhus/sgrub sde rnams la sum pa lo tstsha ba'i blo sbyong zhig bshad/ rtag brtan du mi ngan lag len nyes pa'i gdung chen gas pa dang / logs ris kyi sra rtsi sdib pa sogs ci rigs byung / yon bdag la lta bar 'dug sgam po sku skye ba'i drung yang chos ci rigs gsan par phebs pa tshogs chos de yang gsan/ zur du bya rgod shongs nas sku skye rin po che'i drung dang / gzhan rab 'byams pa gnyis gsum dang lhan cig tu sgrol ma nyer gcig nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi rjes gnang dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dbang sogs gsan song / de rjes mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug rwa lo chen po'i thugs dam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi thang sku yang lag tu byung /lo 'di la 'jigs mdzad kyi sku ster mkhan gzhan yang mang du byung ngo / /dbyar —56—

ston sbrags pa de la rang re'i chos gzhis tshor dpon sa a lce'i drung gis zer gsog yang yang mdzad/ mi sna tshos sde srid kyi bka' shog la yang rtsi rgyu med/a lce drung gi bka' shog ston dgos zer ba sha stag byung / rten 'brel log pa'i rtags su gda'o/ /yang sgrub thabs kun las btus pa'i grangs bsha/da pa zhes bya ba/ paṇḍi ta dpal 'dzin sdes mdzad ces pa cig gi rgya dpe 'khyams po zhig snga mo nas lag tu 'byor pa de sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i dkar chag tu 'dug de'i rim pa dang bstun na/ yar klung lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi bsgyur bar mjad pa 'di la bar bar na rgya dpe khol 'don du song ba'i ma tshang ba mang tu yod ces sngar grags 'dug pa ltar don la gnas par 'dug cing lo grags nyid kyi bsgyur ba'i skabs la yod pa la yang / bod dpe nyid la zegs pa ci rigs pa'ang byung ste/ dper na stobs po che'i sgrub thabs gnyis bya ba las/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs 'gyur gsar 'thor bas/ sngar gyi 'gyur rnying bcug pa lta bas mo tshon/ da lta yang de dpe kha cig la yod/ la la la med do/ /des na dkar chag dang bstun na sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rgya gzhung deng sang yod pa 'di na sgrub thabs shin tu mang ba zhig ma chug 'dug pas rang res sngar nas yang yang rtsol ba byas te brtags shing btsal ba na/ sngar bod du 'gyur zin pa yang med du snang la/ 'ga' zhig sgrub thabs rgya mtsho na yod pa de dang mdzad pa po gcig mi gcig mi shes pa re re gnyis gnyis la/ don gcig pa rnams tshad mar bzhag thar pa nas sgrub thabs sngar ma 'gyur ba'i rgya dpe mang du rnyed byung ba/de dag rgya dpe'i steng nas bsgyur/ ston de dag rnams phyogs gcig tu sgrigs pa

grub par byas/ bka' rgyun med kyang glegs bam bzhugs tshul la gal che bar 'ong / yang dngul las grub pa'i thor tshugs dpog zhu dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs mtshon pa'i lha bcu dgu'i sku gzugs can rin po che'i rigs sna tshogs dang / mtha' gnas mu tig mang po sogs phra rgyan du mas brgyan pa shin tu legs ba gcig kyang bzhengs/ de nas hor zla dgu pa'i tshes nyi shu gsum gza' skar bzang ba la bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi glegs bam ma lus pa glegs ci shing dang bcas pa tshangs 'grig tu bzhengs tshar/ rtsi gras kyang grub pa'i dga' ston yon rdzongs su/ yig mkhan lnga bcu nga lnga la/ bkra shis kha btags bcu/bzang dar kha nyis brgya/ kha btags sum cu/ ja sig bcu/ bur btang bcu/dong pa gser shog ma drug rta cham bzhi/ rta sga legs pa lnga/ rag shas/ dung mas/ mdob mas sdoms pa bdun/ tim pi sbal pa sogs nor sna phran bu rnam grangs mang ba/ g.yas shag gser shog ma bcu/ gon chen gon chung sbun 'dab ras yug snam bu cob ras yug tshangs rnams so sor brgya dang bcu bcu/ bal mang po dang / rta na gzhon bzang ba gnyis/ bong bu sga gdan dang bcas pa bcu gsum/ ba lang bcu/ sbu nag brgyad cu gya brgyad so sor sman tshe'i kha mdud re dang bcas pa yod/ rje btsun 'phags pa nga la ser po'i sku brnyan/ rgyu gser zangs dngul gsum las grub pa phra rgyan rin po che sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/bzo bkod 'phags yul gyi lugs su byas pa 'di la/ sku rgyu la zangs khal bdun tsam/ gser zho lnga bcu mi 'chad tsam/ rtsi sogs dgos cha de dang 'tshams par song / 'phra'i rgyu la g.yu'i rdo rje gnyis/ lo 'dab gnyis gzhan —58—

g.yu 'phra legs pa brgya dang bcu gcig me to ge drug pad 'dab gnyis/ rin po che su kanti che ba gcig ha kki bdun/ tsu ni bzhi bcu g.yin mu men byu ru mu tig sogs mang po dang bcas pa yod/ nyer bdun nyer brgyad la gzungs bzhugs dang thog ma'i rab gnas bgyis/ de rjes gser zhal gsol/ spyan 'byed phul nas/ hor zla bcu pa'i tshes gnyis lhag pa lag sor gyi 'grub sbyor bzang ba la slar yang rab gnas byas/ shing thog gsar ba 'bul ba sogs dang / longs spyod khyad par can 'phel ba'i rten 'brel gzhan yang mang du byung / bal po bzo bo bdun gyis rgyab yol bdun/ kun mkhyen chen po'i sku 'dra gnyis/ dzam bha la sogs phyis bzhengs pa rnams la/ bkra shis kha btags bdun bcu/gser srang gang/ bzang ja sig bcu/ shal pa dkar dmar phring phra/ yang shal pa dkar po che ba/ sman tshe/ tshon rdzogs kha brgya lnga bcu/ sman tshe dkyus ma kha drug cu/ tshon si kha brgya dang sum cu/ dar yug bzang ba brgyad/ gos mtshal kha yug sne tshang / spun 'dab lnga bcu/ gon ma brgya dang bcu/ ras yug sum cu/ka yug nyi shu/ snam bu bcu/ gos lham cha tshang bdun/ 'bras btang bur btang / 'jong dar sogs phran bu mang bo dang bcas pa'i yon rdzongs byas/yon rdzongs dang sku rgyu'i rags rim bris pa 'di nga ser sna langs pa min/ nga rgyal skyes pa'ang min/ yus 'tshong ba'ang min/ phyis rten bzhengs mkhan rnams kyis 'di bzhin byed dgos bya ba'i don yin/ dbang che ltag khur gyi rten bzhengs de don med do zer rgyu yin/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud la gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes rnam zugad mdzad pa'i lugs kyi sgrub thabs zhig —59—

kyang bris/ sngar sgrub thabs 'phreng du sgrigs pa'i nang du chud par byas/ 'di yan chad la nor lha lha khang / dbang ldan lha khang / 'bar 'dzin lha khang /mkha' spyod lha khang / pad ma bkod pa'i lha khang / gzhal yas khang gi khyams chen mo rnams kyi logs bris grub par byas/ theg mchog lha khang du grub thob brgyad cu'i logs ris bris/ kun gzigs lha khang du 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na dang / bde ba can du 'od dpag med dang / lcang lo can du gsang bdag dang /o rgyan mkha' spyod du rdo rje rnal 'byar ma dang / theg mchog tu dpal he ru ka dang / dga' ldan du byams pa dang / 'bar 'jin du mi g.yo ba dang / drang srong me lha/ dbang ldan du gzhan rje gshed nag po/ dpal chen du dpal 'khor lo bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa rnams 'bul skur bzhengs thub cing /mngon spyod drag po'i lha khang du dpal nag po wo po gur gyi mgon po dang / ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa dang / phyag bzhi pa'i sku brnyan rnams bzhengs/ so sor rab gnas kyang 'phral 'phral bgyes/ phyi ma gnyis min pa thams cad la tsho na yang btang grub pa'i skabs yin/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i sku 'dra khru tshad tsam dang / mda' tshad tsam pa nyi shu rtsa lnga/ de las cung zad chung ba nyi shu tsam dang bcas pa sngar rim can du bzhengs pa rnams la tshon rtsi gzungs bzhugs/ rab gnas kyi bar du grub/ lo 'di la mkhar las ni/ dpyid sos ka lho gling gi g.yas cung zad ngoms che sa gcig 'dug pa 'dir/ 'og nas ri 'gros kyang mang po bsdur/ dka' las mang po byas te/ zab sku 'grems sa cig rtsigs pa yin te/ nged gnyis po bsam 'grub rtser 'gro dgos byung ba —60—

des/ 'dir rngam po ba sogs 'go mi rnams kyang zhen mos gus sha tsha 'dod pa gang yang med pas nag chang la yengs nas las ka grub chung zhing / rtsig pa'i phyi'i mdzes cha legs legs tsam min pa/ nang hrem rtsigs su song chu 'gros sogs gang yang lhus ma things 'dug nged mar phyogs zla gcig gi ring 'a gtor ma'ang 'gyangs pas lan nam/ dbyar stod de ser drag chen po zhig babs pa'i tho la rmangs nas 'gyel ba'i byas pa las ror song ba zhig byung / de mar bcad pa'i phyin chad shin tu grub che ste/ zab yangs kyi spe'u dang / phyi'i pang stegs lcags ri sogs legs par grub pa yin no/ /de la kho bo bsam pa bzang ba'i rten 'brel gyis/ dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams byams par byung ste/mkhar las 'di'i dus kun tu sa rdo shing chu rnams gang 'dod du byung / rten sku bzhengs pa'i cha rkyen rnams kyang shin tu 'grub bla ba lags/ de la spyi rtag brtan gyi sa phyogs 'di rdo rang ta mod pa'i rigs su 'dug kyang / rnam grangs mang po nas tshol ba dang / gcog pa sogs mi dgos par rdo'i khung bu 'khris nas 'khris su thon pa dang / yos lo dang 'brug lo'i nga/byar gung sgrub pa cho rnams kyis kyang rdo cung zad bsags pa'i dus/ rdo khung rnying nga/ gcig phal cher zad/gsar ba gcig 'tshol dgos snyam pa'i skabs nub mo brag cig zhig nas rdo zad pa med pa de 'dra lan gnyis byung / sngar phyogs thams cad bye mas khyab pa'i rtsig 'dam dang gyangs sogs shin tu dkon dkon 'dra ba la phyogs gang dang gang du nam dgos dgos su/ 'khris de dang de nas sa spyin po gang 'dod du 'byung ba dang / gtsug lag khang gi zhal sa sbyor ma dgos par legs par sbyar —61 —

sbyar ba 'dra ba kho na gang 'dod du thon zhing / gtsug lag khang re grub pa na/de yang rdzogs 'gro ba dang / snga phyir las ka 'di tsam du rgya che ba la yang / gong du smos pa ltar dam sel dang gtor ma 'gyangs pa'i nyes skyon phran bu de tsam ma gtogs las ka la brten nas mi shi ba lta ci smos/ yan lag la rmas yar tsam yang ye ma byung ba 'di yang ngo mtshar che shos cig yin/ gong du smos pa ltar chu mig gsar pa lu ma'i rigs can brdol pas/ dgun grang dus su mi 'byag cing / shing btab pa thams cad la ci 'dod du drangs pas chog pa/ zhing sogs gang la'ang gnod pa med pa dang / phyogs 'di kun mkhar las byed pa la shing shin tu dkon pas/ dka' spyad kho na dgos pa yin yang / stod smad rnams nas 'bad rtsol med par sab seb skyabs skyibs du ma nas/ shing ci 'dod du nyos pas chog pa byung zhing / skabs skabs su sde srid nas kyang mang du gnang mod/phal cher rin bcal te nyos pa shas che ba la thams cad nyo bla zhing 'tshol bla ba sha stag byung / shing stong shin tu sbam pa sgul skyod thongs dka' ba kun yang / sa thag ring po nas 'dren pa la dka' ba med cing nyes skyon ye ma byung ba yin/ de bzhin du gser zangs kun yang / snga sor jo nang gi byams pa bzhengs pa yan chad du thams cad zad par byas pa yin yang / de phyin sde pa nas gser zho brgya phrag brgya phrag tu bcad pa lan drug tsam dang / gzhan yang snga phyir gsil ma mang du gnang mod/ spyi babs deng sang dus ngan de mi rnams 'byor pa chung bas/gser dkon zhing ster ba nyung yang / lho stod smad 'di rnams su/ chos gzhis kyi yong sgo rnams las bsgrubs pa yin yang / gser zangs gnyis ci 'dod du sgrub —62—

shin tu bla bar byung / spyi babs da lta las lo brgya tsam gyi sngon rol lta bu'am/rong byams chen dang / ngam ring gi byams pa bzhengs pa sogs kyi skabs la cha bzhug na/ de dus kyi zho stong dang / da lta'i zho brgya yang zho brgya sgrub rtsol dka' nges shes pa yin 'dug kho bos dran pa nas da lta'i bar du yang ches dkon par song snang / de bzhin du dngul chu shin tu dkon pa yin yang / yos 'brug sbrul gyi lo gsum la dngul chu shin tu mang ba sgo skyel gyi tshul du byung bas/ gser zangs kyi las ka 'di tsam byed pa la yang / slar dka' bas 'tshol dgos pa sogs ye ma byung ngo / /sngar yan chad sku gzugs bzhengs pa la dngul chu zho grangs su btab na khri tsho lngar nye ba song / lha khang gi sgo'i shan sogs rtag brtan gyi skor 'di la lcags rang yang lcags skyed phyed dang nyis brgya tsam/ sla nga nyis brgya lhag tsam/ thong lcags bdun brgya skong de snga yan chad la song bas mtshon/rgya gar shar phyogs nas tshong pa rnams kyis/ snga phyir li khri mi rgyab mi rgyab tu longs pa shin tu mang ba khyer byung ba dang / sde pa'i khral dang sgos dpon gyi khral sogs kyi sgo nas mtshal shin tu dkon yang / nged la mtshal mang po sgo nyal gyi tshul du byung ba dang / spang ma dang mthing ni sde srid nas phal cher byung ba yin te/mi rgyab bcu pa gcig dang / lnga bcu pa gcig dang / brgya pa gcig sogs mang du byung / de yang spang mthing rko mkhan rnams kyis/ spang mthing shin tu mthon che ba byung bas stabs kha shin tu legs pa dang thug go /yang 'dir sa rdo'i las ka'am/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzheng pa sogs ci yin yang rung ste/ las byed pa po thams cad nyin zang zang las byed pa la/ gzhan gyis tsha 'dzun mi dgos —63—

par shin tu spro bas 'jug cing / 'du khang dang gtsang khang gi logs bris la sogs pa'i skabs su pir dang / tshon kong mi ma yin gyis phan tshun bsnol ba dang / rang rang gi sa khul gyi tshon 'gyed pa na/ 'di ltar tshon btang ngo mi dran zhing mi shes ba la/ rgya chen por sleb pa'i rigs dang / gtsang khang gi 'jigs byed chen po'i sku la/ sbyar mthing tshon kong chung chung gcig gi sum cha gang tsam zhig gis khyed pa sogs ro mtshar shin tu mang ste/ snga sor sangs rgyas bdun gyi sku bzhengs skabs/ bzo bo rnams kyang lo mang po 'thogs kyi dogs pa byed kyang / zla brgyad kyi khongs su mtha' dag grub pa dang / gtso bo'i sku'i byugs gser gser zho stong tsam bzhu zhing / btso sbyangs byas pa'i skabs/ 'chad ye med par ma zad gser zho nyis brgya lhag tsam 'phel lo/ /des na bar skabs zhig dge sems chung zhing phrag dog che ba'i skya ser mang po zhig nged la kha zer bar byed kyang / dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams byams par yod do/ /yang shing bzo/ rdo bzo/ tshem bu pa/ yig mkhan/ rkos mkhan/ par mkhan/ khyad par ri mo ba shin tu mang po dang bcas pa 'di rnams la/ lo re bzhi so so'i yon rdzong mang po zhig bsgrubs pa yin mod kyang/ 'dir yi ger 'god ma lang la/ bzo rigs pa mang ba'i dus nyis brgya sum brgya la sogs pa dang / ji tsam nyung yang / brgyar longs pa rtag tu bsten dgos shing dge 'dun mang dus su stong du nye ba dang / shin tu nyung ba'i dus kyang lnga brgya mi 'chad pa la phogs 'khor yug gi sgo nas rtag tu 'tsho ba'i brel ba med pa dang / sgrub sde na yang rang res phogs 'khor mor sbyong dgos mang du yod cing / gong du smos pa ltar zla re —64—

bzhin dang / lo dus kyi mchod thes kyang mang du sbyar ba yin/ de bzhin du sgrub sder bsam gtan gling pa rnams la dpal rdo rje phag mo'i tshes bcu'i mchod pa zla ba ngo re bzhin btsugs/ rtag brtan du yang cho 'phrul chen po'i dus kyi smon lam dang / tshes bcu byung ngo cog la dge 'dun phyed langs rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshes bcu'i cho ga gtong bar byas shing de dag so so'i gzhi skyen legs par sbyar grub pa'i skabs su yong / gzhan yang bzo bo spyi dang bal po sogs kyi nar ma'i chas dang / dus dus kyi dgos cha mang po rnams kyang bzang bar gtogs pa steng 'grus med pa dang / tshon dang dngul chu 'tshong bar 'ongs pas mtshon pa'i sgo drung du zung khyer nas 'ongs pa rnams la yang rin pham kha ye med cing / cung zad khe dang bcas par sbyin nas mdor na sdig dang ma 'dres par byas so/ /yang snga ma gcig tsa na dgon pa'i lcags ri bskor ba la/ kha cig rdzong yin par 'dug ces btsun pa ko long can rnams kyis sna drangs nas col sgrogs spir gyis byung dus/ nged kyis gtam lan gnyis smras so/ /dang po chasang/nga 'brel pa'i lan ni/ rdzong cis kyang yin/ dgon pa dam pa'i chos kyi rdzong dang / nged theg pa chen po'i chos kyi rgyal po'i tshul du yod pa yin/ da dung yon to gyi rdzong mang po 'phel yong ba yin/ rdzong btab pa 'dod thog rang lags so byas/ gnyis pa 'jig rten dang 'brel ba'i lan ni/ lha yul rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang dang /pho brang lcang lo can yang rdzong ka yin/ chos bzang lha'i bdun sa yang brag rdzong ka yin/ 'dod khams dbang phyug ma yang rdzong gi lha mo zer rdzong la ga bzhugs pa yin/ rgya gar bi kra ma shī la dang / o tan ta pu ri zer ba'i chos 'khor chen —65—

po de kun yang rdzong ka yin/ nyan go gang yang ma non pa snying re rje/ bod rang gi bla ma chos pa'i khul du gtogs pa la'ang / sngon sa skya pa dar rgyas che dus sa skya pa rang la rdzong mang / phyis rgud nas phal cher shor ba yin/ phyis rang 'bras sbungs dga' ldan pho brang ba yang kho rang tsho dar rgyas yod dus rdzong mang da lta dar rgyas med pa dang rdzong yang med/ des mtshon pa'i 'bri stag kar gsum sogs dar rgyas yod pa rnams na da lta'ang rdzong gda' ba/ mi drag pa kun la rdzong yang yod/ g.yog kyang yong ba yin/ ma bro glu gsum dang mu lto ba kun la rdzong byung ba'i rnam grangs med/ rdzong 'debs rgyu yong ba dang rdzong du sdod rgyu yong ba la bsod nams zer ba de yang cung zad dgos/ blo gros zer ba de yang cung zad dgos/ bya byed ma nor ba cig kyang dgos pa yin/ de tsho med na sngar yod yod po rnams kyang rta sbangs gtong ba bzhin du rim can du bskyur dgos yong gin 'dug pa ma mthong ba e yin/ khyed rang rnams kyang so so nas/ dmag dang dus zing byed 'dod dang / phrag dog 'gran sems ni tshugs rgyu med pa tsam 'dug pho rgod po yod na rang rang so so'i yul sde dang / dgon sde'i sar rdzong rgyob shoganged kyi rdzong la mig tsha rgyu ci yod pa/ nged ni dar rgyas yod pa'i rtags yin pas rdzong rgyag gin yod pa ces kyang 'dod/ yin pa ta sdig pa'i rdzong min dge ba'i rdzong yin te/ de 'dra'i go rgyu khyed tshol med/ khyed la bcol rtogs kyang med/khyed la re che yang mi byed do byas/ chos kyi sgo nas lan btab na mi nyan par 'dug 'jig rten gyi lan btab dus nag spob spob kha rog bsdod par 'dugaspyir khong rnams de skad zer ba la rgyu gnyis 'dug ste/ gcig ni rang rang so so —66—

na rang bzang po dpe med yin par 'dod pa la dge las gang yang ma grub/ nged rnams khong rang tsho las ches ngan rgyu'i khungs byed rgyu la kho ra tshos gang yang ma byung / rnam dkar dge ba rlabs po che 'di nged kyis grub pas tshig pa za ba der 'dug rgyu gnyis pa ni/ nged la byang pa'i phyogs dang / lung nag sogs nasaganod pa mang po zhig e yong na/ byung na dga' ste snyam pa dang / de'i phyir du rdzong rgyag pa yin yong snyam pa kho ra tsho la bsam pa ngan pa'i re go khog na yod pa de'i me tog kha nas shar ba der 'dug go /yang na nang snga rol lo shas gcig nged kyi chos grwa la chos spel ba'i bar chad byed dgos bsam pa stod smad na mang po 'dug pa de rnams kho bos ni yun ring mi gnas par dus tshod mi ring mi 'gyang ba kho na la khang rul zhig pa bzhin du stongs 'gro ba ni dang po nas go snga mo nas shes/ de khas khong tsho'i sems 'dzin pa la ma phyin pa de yin/ lar 'jigs pa yod nas sa btsan 'dzin pa min/ yin na da kha snga bang mgyogs rgyug pa re nged kyis kyang los shes/ lam la 'gro na'ang skya ser gzhan thams cad zon can du 'gro/ kho bo zon med du 'gro/ ri khrod du yang nga zon med bag skyong /gzhan tsho mtha' phyi thams cad bskor nas sdod kyin 'dug pa/ rgyu mtshan nga la mnong med pas yin/ yang phyis gtsug lag khang rnam grangs ches mang ba sku gsung thugs kyi rten gyis phyur bur gang zhing / chos kyi gzhi chen po sbed par mi nus pa 'di lta bu grub tsa na/ khrel med kyi kha skyag rdzun 'dra brjod mkhan tshol zhal skyengs cig rang byung song ngo'ang / yang kho bos mdo sngags thams cad du gzhan stong dbu ma chen po'i lugs 'di bskyangs pas/ rta lo tsam nas gzung /—67—

dpal ldan ka lā pa'i zhing gi bkod pa dang / sa bcu'i dbang phyug gi sprul pa'i sku rnams kyi sku dang gsung gi snang ba yang nas yang du byung ba dang / yang lan cig pa da ra'i gling na/ ind+ra bhu ti'i sprul pa'i sku bzhugs pa'i sku dang gsung gi snang ba byung ba dang / yang lan cig stong gzugs kyi snang ba la brten nas/ drag po'i gling gsal bar mthong nas/ byang chub sems dpa' drag po dbang phyug gi tshul 'dzin pa lnga brgya chos ston pa'i tshul mthong ba dang / sher snying gi 'grel chen tshar ba'i nyin mo/ sprin gseb nas stong gzugs kyi rang bzhin rgyal ba mi pham pa la lha rnams mchod pa byed tshul sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas mang du byung / lug lo'i ston ka cig rtag brtan gyi 'bras sbungs na yod dus/ skyes bu dkar po gzi brjid can la phur zhabs can zhig 'khor mang dag dang bcas de nub phyogs nas byung / gang nas yin dris pas/ nub phyogs ba da ra'i gling nas yin/ dpag tshad khri phrag brgyad kyi pha rol nas yong ste nyi ma phyed la sleb/'di na sangs rgyas kyi lha khang bzhengs/ bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po'i chos la mos pa thob pa zhig yod do/ /zhes pa'i gtam/ sde brgyad gag nas gag tu brgyud pa las thos nas lta bar 'ongs pa yin zer/ lha khang la mchod pa byed pa'i rnam pa tsam 'dug da gar 'gro dris pas/ ri bo rtse lngar 'gro/ kyai rdor gyi rtsa sngags tshar gcig 'don pa'i tshad la sleb zer/ de nas gang du 'gro/ shar phyogs kyi rgya mtsho'i dkyil gcig na rin po che'i ri bo dpag tshad nyi shu pa cig yod/ de'i rtse na 'dab chags dang / phug pa na phyugs kyi gzugs can/ byang chub sems dpa' mang pos sems can gyi don byed pa yod/ de la lta ba yin/—68—

lar de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i gtam ston pa la lhag par mos pa thob pa zhig yin/ lha mo chu srin gdong can gyi ming po yin yang zer ba snyam byung /bdag dang mtshungs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong nub phyogs kyi rgya mtsho la gnas nas/de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i mdo la mchod cing / chos 'di smra ba la grogs byed pa yin no zer ste/ de nas mi snang bar gyur/ 'di la'ang mchod gtor byin na/ rang re'i lte chas rgyud la gtong grogs byed pa zhig yin par 'dug go /yang nged kyi sangs rgyas byang sems la mchod pa dang / lha 'dre 'khyams po mtha' yas pa la/ dngos su 'tsho ba'i sgo nas phan cing / 'dre'i kha phyogs pas mi phyugs kun gyi srog dang longs spyod la phan par 'dug sgos su dge ba'i las rgya chen po rnams kyi bar chad zhi ba dang / byin rlabs kyi sgo khyad par can bsgrub pa'i phyir shing yos nas brtsam ste/ zla ba phyed re bzhin rtsam pa mi rgyab gsum re la gtor rtsam byas/ dkar rgyan sogs dgos cha de dang mthun pa/ myong tshong re re gnyis gnyis tsam re'i gtor chang dang bcas pa'i gtor ma 'chag med du phul/skabs gang dgos su mchod gtor ka to ra gnyis gsum khengs pa tsam phul ba la rtsis btab med/ rgyab ri'i rtse mor gtor ma gtong thengs 'di yin la lan bzhi song ba la/ re re bzhin du rtsam khal brgya nas nyis brgya bar re yong bar byas/ de ltar byed pa la zla bo kun dga' dpal bzang ma gtogs/ thog ma rang re'i lag g.yog thams cad kyis kyang blor ma chud/ zan 'di tsam rang grog po la bskur ba zer/ smyo zhugs pa yin nam snyam pa byed kyin 'dug deng sang phal cher zhig lha la mchod pa phul yang mi 'bul/ phul nas kyang tshur sdud par —69—

gda'/ mchod ro tshur mi sdud par dengs su 'jug pa de nga'i khyad chos yin/de yang da lta dge ba la dkar ba kun/ dge 'dun gyi zhabs togo gam/ skye bo'i sbyin gtong lta bu la cung zad blos thongs par gda' ste za mkhan dngos su 'dug pa la yid ches pas phan yon la bsam pa yang 'dug yang de dang de la grags pa yang 'byung snyam pa dang / za mkhan de rnams kyis grags pa sgrog go snyam pa dang /mi la phyin pa la yus dang ngo so yong ba dang / kha lan gcig kyang yong ba dang /kha cig rang phyogs 'dzin par 'gyur snyam pa'am sngar ma dang pha'am dgra byed mkhan yin na rab tu tshur e khugs/ de min dgra mi byed la re ba sogs su 'dug sangs rgyas sogs lha la mchod par 'bul mi nus pa de/ longs spyod mkhan e yod mi shes snyam pa'i/ mdor na sangs rgyas dang lha yod pa tsam du yid tshes kyang med pa dang / de med pas grags pa dang / ngo so dang / rang re'i phyogs 'dzin pa sogs mi yod snyam pa der gda'/ 'di log lta'i zhad chen po yin par 'dug log lta'i gnyen por rjes su dran pa drug sgom dgos pa yin/sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dag /kun tu thogs med gzigs par ldan//zhes pa'i don 'di la bdag ni nges shes snying thag pa nas skyes bdog zhing gi dam pa bla ma yi dam chos skyong rnams la mchod pa phul ba'i phan yon 'di la yid ches chen po cig kyang byung / lha mthu bo che rnams rang re la rtag tu blta bzhin yang yod/ mi la re ba ma che lha la gsol ba thob ces pa 'di bden gtam chen po cig tu yang go lags/ yang rang res dgon pa'i rgyan du 'gyur ram snyam/'brug lo dgon pa'i nub kyi phyogs rgyal byed tshal du ming bzhag pa 'di dang /—70—

rta lug la byang phyogs dang / spre'u lo la shar phyogs kyi bar du ljon shing btsugs pa rnams bdag med lta bur bskyur bzhag kyang legs par skyes shing / sngar ne'u sing cung zad tsam las med pa/ 'brug lo kho na la ne'u sing shin tu rgya che bar mched pa sogs kyang / lha klu rnams dga' ba'i rten 'brel du 'dug cing / yang gangs can 'di na bla chen mang bo zhig da lta yang yod de/ sngon nas bsags pa'i bang mdzod mtha' yas pa yang mnga'/ nged lta bu'i lag tu tshe gang la 'byung ba'i rgyu nor yang / skabs re nyi ma re re dang / zla ba re rer 'byung ba dang / dbus gtsang khams gsum gyis cha na mnga' zhabs rdzong gzhis ji snyed cig yod cing /phyogs 'dzin zhen mthen gyi ban skya pho mo mtha' yas pa yod pa rnams kyang /mthar gshugs na bsod nams rnam pa gsum dang / thos bsam sgom gsum dang / rang gzhan smin grol gyi mdzad pa ni/ ston dus kyi 'brug sgra bzhin du sgra 'ur kho nar 'dug na/ bdag cag lta bu bang mdzod la mngon par dga' ba yang ma yin no/ /yang rang gi dge ba cung zad re byed zer nas de la bsnyad pa'i g.yog rigs la khral dang / zhal dkar len pa dang / grwa rigs yon bdag sogs rgyal khams kyi skye bo 'brel can 'brel med che phra skya ser sna tshogs pa'i sar 'bul sdud dang slong mo'am/ dge bskul sogs kyi ming btags pa'i gzhogs slong kha gsag rnyed pas rnyed pa tshol ba/ thob kyis 'jal ba la sogs pa thabs sna tshogs kyis gzhan nor bsdu ba'i mkhos byed pa kho na mang bar snang yang / kho bos ni de lta bu sna gcig kyang ma byas shing shugs 'byung la longs spyod gang byung tshad dge ba la sbyar ba ma gtogs/ gsog pa'i 'dun pa med pas/—71—

nged lta bu gnangs chung kho na yin yang lag rjes mi chung tsam grub pa 'di yin/'di la yang nga rgyal ma byas des dka' las dka' dgu 'di tsam byas snyam pa'i yus pa yang med/ da 'di gzhan la gtong mi thub snyam pa'i shi 'ju ro 'changs su gab nas sdod snyam pa yang med/ gzhan la 'gran pa'i zur rnon ta ga la zhig ste/rang ngam 'brel can rnams la dge ba'i 'brel ba phran bu gzhog thub na/ cung zad legs sam snyam pa tsam lags/ lar bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i dge ba brgya thams pa las/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pas thos bsam gyi dge ba gcig bzang ba yin/ de 'dra brgya tham pa las/ bden bzhi stong nyid byang chub sems kyi don yid la byed pa'i dge ba gcig dga' ba yin/ don 'di la nges pa rnyed pas nged la rlom sems mi yong ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de lags/ 'on kyang deng sang tshul khrims dag pa dang sgom yid byed de nyin mo'i skar ma las kyang dkon no/ /des na bya ba las kyi ge nar lo gtso bor byas pa'i rgyu mawo yang de na bdog /sangs rgyas byang sems kyi dgongs pa sems can rnams gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba la 'god pa kho nar gda' yang / sems can la phan pa la phan 'dogs lugs cig dgos/ rab byung chos pa'i khungs kyis skye bo mi nag la sgur ba dang / dad rdzas kyi nor rnams rngan par ster ba dang / nag chang longs spyod kyi thes la sbyor ba la 'gro don zer ba min/ gzhan don zer ba yang min/ sems can la phan pa zer ba yang min/ rang dang spyin pa byin pa'i yul gnyis kar ngan song gi g.yang sar lag sbrel byas nas/ mchong ba zer ba de yin/ chos pa shes ldan 'dra yod na yang go las che/ 'jig rten skye bo shes ldan —72—

'dra yod na yang go las che/ da ni bskal pa rnying pas shes ldan tsam yod yong de mi 'dra/ phyogs thams cad rne mchog chen po'i gling du swāhā/ tshul de bzhin go nas nged kyis ni lag len du btang kyang btab/ khel yang khel/ dad pa can bslur mi rung zhes grags te/ dad pa can yin nges shes pa de yid bzhin nor bu las kyang dkon par gda'/ rang dang 'brel pa can ma bslus pa gcig dgos so// da ni rang gi blo 'dod 'tsho ba'i lhag ma ji tsam yod pa 'di/ yang dag pa'i don la mnyam par 'jog pas dus 'da' bar byas na ci ma/ rung snyam pa 'di kho na yid la bcags pa ni lags/ 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi 'dam du bying bas 'grub par ni dka' ba 'dug na'ang / tshe rabs rgyud ma nas rgyud ma/bskal pa nas bskal pa 'byams klas par theg pa mchog gi chos la mos pa dang /'jug pa phun sum 'tshogs pa mi 'bral bar spyod pa'i go cha la gnas pa tsam 'di brtad so yin/ da ni dkyus kyi 'phros de las cung zad tsam brjod par bya ste/ de rjes kyang rtsom pa thang thung 'dra dang / ston ka de skyid phug bde ldan du mtshams cung zad cig kyang byas/ de skabs 'tshub cha rnam 'gyur cung zad che ba 'ga' zhig byung zhing / mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i don yang yang bsams shing / rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sgom pa'i lugs byas/ tho rangs cig stong gzugs kyi snang ba ka yin pa 'dra/ rigs drug gi sngags 'khor rnams sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i lugs dang mthun pa gcig shin tu gsal ba yun ring du gnas shing 'od 'phro ba cig byung / snga sor sde srid sku gzhogs su pho nya btang zhing / rab tu hor zla bdun pa dang / de min yang brgyad pa dgu pa'i khongs su yar phebs thub nges —73—

shes pa cig dgos pa dang / de min sku dog che ba 'dug tshul sogs zhur btang ba la/ de ltar gnang ba'i dgongs brtad dang / de mthun gyi gsung lan 'byor byung na'ang / skyes chen du rdzu ba 'ga' zhig gis dgongs don gyi gegs kho na byed pa nga la phyi nang bar gsum nas mang pos zhor bteg pa'i ar 'khyams nas phebs ma thub/ 'di skabs g.ye gor chos rdzong na bzhugs dus/ mi cig yar gnang byung nas/ cung zad sku ltems kyang ma lod tsam yod/ slar rim gro sogs ji ltar gsung ba zhig byung ba la/ da lam bsnyung ba de grib dang gdon gnyis kar che/ mi ngan gcig mjal bas nyin bslangs 'dug da lam gyi 'di rang skyon med na ang / slar ro ma langs nyen che ba yod pa 'dra/ dmigs gsal sku rim 'dra / gnang dgos tshul zhus/ skabs 'di dag tu sog po'i dmag chen rting ma'ang sleb skabs yin/ de rjes zla ba bcu pa'i nang du rtag brtan na yod dus/ gzhal yas khang gi logs bris kyi mngon byung mgon po gnyis la rab gnas byas dus/ skad cig la rlud nag mi bzad pa rang langs/shing shag thams cad 'phangs pa sogs rtsub 'gyur che zhing / rtog dpyad du mngon tsam zhig byung / de rjes hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin/bsam 'grub rtse nas dpon sa a lce'i drung gi sku rim mang ja zhig byung ba la/tshes bcu tsam nas sku ltems pa da dgos thor ba yin pa 'dug cing / rin po che sog bzlog drung nas lha 'brum dkar po yang yin gsung ba 'dug pa sogs yang po'i rigs yin par 'dug skyon che ba rang mi 'dug na'ang / rim gro gnad du gang 'gro dgos tshul tsam 'dug de nas tshes bcu bdun la ri khrod chen por dus —74—

khrid btsugs/ nyer gcig gi srod 'jings yol la pa snam grong stod pa gzhon pa 'bod mir byung ba'i/ dpon sa a lce'i drung zhud kha'i rkyen gyis thor pa nang du log pa sogs shin tu ltem pas yong dgos tshul dang / sde srid rgyal bu'i drung yang shangs la phebs rgyu yin gsung ba sogs 'dug lan la rtse rang du bzhugs pas khyab/ shangs la mi legs zer ba phul na'ang/ zhu lan ma sleb gong du pa snam tshor phebs grub 'dug ste de skabs shangs la ma phebs pa de kas 'tshengs gda'/ yang spyir chos pa'i rigs kyis chos kho na la phye thang byed dgos rgyur 'dug cing / chos spangs nas 'jig rten pa'i khye phogs chen po dang / gnyen tshan yon mchod sogs kyi 'jig rten gyi bya ba gal po che gang yod kyang / til 'bru cig kyang mi phan pas/ chos bcag nas bya ba gal chen zen dgos zer nas rgyug pa de/ sna lo pa'i khyu nas bud pa yin par 'dug /snor mangs pa sangs rgyas bzang po dang / o rgyan pa'i gtam rgyud bzhin yin/ chag lo tstsha ba/dpang lo chen po/ kun mkhyen chen po/ bu ston rin po che/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams pa sogs la/ rgya nag rgyal pos gdan 'dren byung yang ye ma phebs/dus phyis rang bo dong bya gshongs kyi 'chad nyan pa rje sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan pa de/ chos sgang la mi chen bsnyung ba dang 'das grongs kyi rigs sam dga' ston sogs gal che gang 'dra cig la spyan 'dren pa byung yang mi 'byon pa'i thag chod po cig yod zer/ de bden na chos brgyad chung zhing chos la gnas pa'i rnam thar du 'dug snyam pa byung deng sang de 'dra'i rigs la mi chos mi shes pa/ dgos dus mi phan pa zer nas thams cad kha gtong bar 'dug chos de med khungs med du —75—

btang nas 'jig rten gyi khye phogs la/ che bzhag chung bshel gyi phan thogs rdzus ma res mgo bo bskor du phyin na/ mi nag pa tsho dga' bar ma zad/ chos pa tsho yang de kha rang dga' ba'i khungs kyis bstod ra dir byed par 'dug mi chen skya ser shes ldan yin pa'i khungs tsho yang de kha rang dge bshes bzang bar 'dzin par 'dug 'jig rten pa rnams de skad smra ba ni shin tu blun mod de/ skye bo mi nag pa chos ma go tsa na thabs med/ dgag pa'i yul du ma byung / chos pa rnams kyi kha nas de bzhin smra/ yid nas de ltar sems pa ni kho rang bdud kyi dbang du song ba der 'dug thabs med kyang chos sam bstan pa rang de rtsa ba nas nub pa yin par 'dug snyam yid skyo ba'i rgyu kho nar gda'/ khyad par jo nang gi dus khrid 'di shin tu bka' gnyan par byed/ sngon rje btsun grol mchog thugs gtum pas/ chos gsung 'phro bzhag nas phebs pa mang / ngor du slob ma sta gon cig gnang grub kyang / thugs 'ur nas dngos gzhi ma gnang bar thegs pa'i lo rgyus yod/ gzhan yang lam 'bras gsung 'phro la bor nas thegs pa sogs mang bo byung yang / jo nang dus 'khrid snga res gnang ba cig la/ blo bde nas dpon drung rab brtan pa shin tu bsnyung nas spyan 'dren dos drag byung kyang ma thegs/ de la skyon mi yong gsung ba'i zhal bzhes kyang mdzad/ de skabs skyon yang ma byung 'dug yang phyi res cig rgyal rtse nas bdag po nam mkha' lhun grub shin tu bsnyung ba la spyan 'dren dos drag byung ba la'ang / sbyor drug 'di chos gzhan dang mi 'dra bas bag med byas na 'phral du nyen cha che zhing / phugs rnam smin brji gsungs nas 'khrid ma grol bar du phebs ma thub/ rgyal rtse bdag —76—

po'ang de rjes sku 'das nas ma mjal bar gda'/ dgongs rdzogs la ni phebs 'dug des mtshon yang sgos su yang 'di skabs ltas shin tu ngan pa'i phan thogs cig mi yong ba 'dug pa dang / lar nas kyang sku gshegs de phyi ltar gus la snying nas ma dad pa'i rnam 'gyur cig kyang 'dug pas mi 'gro bar thag bcad/ khrid kyi 'phros de kha bskyangs/ de nas nyer gsum gyi nub mo a lce drung gshegs zer nas/ nyer drug gi snga dro mgyogs bsngo skyel mkhan sleb/ pa snam du sde srid rgyal bu'i drung du/ sku srung dang byin rlabs rten 'bul du rta rdzi don yod dpal bzang kho btang bas/ jo nang ri khrod nas zhogs phyed la thon pa la/ sa hrab phril la pa snam rdzong du 'byor ba'i de 'phral zhu yig rten sogs 'bul thub pas ngo mtshar ba'ang byung / khrid kyi 'go mjug 'di kun tu/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon spyod pa pas mdzad pa'i rgya gzhung gi ṭīka chen de brtsoms grub par byung / khrid gsar ba mang shos med kyang 'khrid lo shin tu legs/ 'di skabs sde srid nas bka' shog phebs pa la/ cung zad sku ltem byung bas/ thor pa rang ni min las che'am skyabs 'jug dang / rim gro ji ltar dgos phebs byung ba/ mchod shoms kyi mar me glo bur du zad pa sogs bkra shin tu ngan pa cig byung / de mthun zur tsam phul/ 'khrid ma grol tsam la sde srid nas bkas khyab pa'i a lce'i drung gi byang chog sogs byung / 'khrid gtor gyi zor 'phen skabs/phyi nang gi rlung ltas shin tu 'tshub pa dang / khrom thams cad kyis tshor ba sku 'bum thang du sgra chen po mi bzad pa cig byung / de nas 'bod mi yang yang gnang ba'i stabs/ byi lo hor zla dang po'i tshes lnga tsam la khrid grol/ bdun la rtag

brtan du sleb tsam byas nas/ zhag bzhi'i ring la 'grib rlung kha yug shin tu che/ tshes bcu gcig la rtag brtan nas myos 'ongs dus/ khams rings pa'i gshin bsngo cig dang / bkra shis sgang shar pa'i nang nas 'ongs dus kyang /gnas sgo slob dpon rgya ma chos mdzad pa dang phrad pa'i gshin bsngo rnam grangs mang ba rang cig dgos par byung ba la/ rten 'brel mi legs pa'i dpyad du go ba cig shar/ de skabs zla ba snga ma'i mar ngo'i bcu bzhi pa/ sa skya nas bdag chen bsod nams dbang po sku gshegs pa zhag shas shin tu gsang / de skabs tshes bcu la gsang brdol ba'i rigs yin par 'dug de dus nged kyis lung nag gi ltag tsam der skad cha go nged rang shab chu thon/ khal ma rnams rjes la yong gin yod pas/ bdag chen sku gzhon pa a mis drung dgyes shing spro bas/ dung rgya gling dar 'phyar sogs bzab shoms du ma dang bcas nas dge sdings su phebs pa mthong 'dug tshes bco lnga la spa mnam rdzong du 'byor/ de'i nang par nas ka sde srid rgyal bu'i drung du/ dbang bka' rnams 'bul ba'i 'go brtsams/yid yul ma bde ba cig la zhag gsum bzhi tsam song skabs/ dbus nas sde srid snga sor thor pas bsnyung ba da dgos dga' rab yong ba 'dra gsum ba cig phebs byung / de rjes gzhung lam de kun la dmag mi dam dum 'gro mkhan dang /rings rings 'dra ba'i mi 'dra mthong ba la yang / yid yul du the tshom 'char ba'i mdangs yod pa cig ka byung / de nas rong pa bkras dar zer ba kho nged dbus la 'bod mir gnang ba/ pa snam du nyer gsum la 'byor pa las ni ma byung / bla gnyan 'khris pa lta bu'i sku khams legs/ sa mi 'phrod pa'i thugs dogs shar —78—

bas/ sde srid rang yar phebs pa'i dgongs gtad dang / gang mjal mjal du 'phrad yong dgos tshul phebs par 'dug de'i sang nyin gtor ma rgyas pa cig btang ba la ni/ phyi ltas 'ja' tshon sogs legs legs 'dra ba cig byung /de'i yang sang nyin lam du zhugs yongs pas/ sman chu lung gi pha tshad de khar nam mkha' 'brug dang phrad byung / yi ge phyi ltar rnams gtad/ chu gnyan thub phyin/der sde srid de nyid sku gshegs tshul mgyogs bsngo dang bcas pa/ blon chen rnams kyi gros steng nas yin zer ba cig sprad byung zhing / dus mi bde ba'i stabs re zhig shin tu gsang rgyu yin pa dang / sde srid rgyal bu'i drung du'ang re zhig snyan du mi 'bul zhing / slar khong rang tsho byon nas snyan 'bul byed dgos yin zer ba sogs 'dug sku gshegs yul ni bzang yul mon pa gdong du sgar thog tu gshegs gda'/ de rjes dol mda' rdzong du bzhugs yod tshul gyi gsang thabs byas/ de kha thal nas/ phyis kyang bka' blon rgyus yod tsho yang dol la phebs pa la ni thugs rtog cig kyang yong 'dug zer ba cig 'dug nga'i sems la ni dol du gshegs pa min pa la/ lar skye bo mi nag pa'i gtam phal pa la 'brel ta ci yong ste/ khong tsho gtan tshigs che che mo rang byed 'dug pa de yin/'jungs la a bsam pa cig byung / de nas slar pa snam rdzong du ka phyin/ hor zla gnyis pa'i mgo sgang de khar bsdad/ nyin re bzhin dbang chos rnam grangs gnyis gsum re mi chag pa phul zhing / bstan 'dzin rin po che sprul pa'i sku dpon slob kyang chos zhu bar phebs/ nai gu chos drug sogs shangs chos cha tshang dang / gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs sogs dbang bka' 'ga' re —79—

yang byas/ dpon sa nam mkha' mdzod ma dang / bkras sgang ba'i dge slong ma'i ming can stabs cig tu 'das pa'i bsngo rten yang 'byor/ khong dpon g.yog bcu lhag cig sdebs su 'das 'dug ste/ dug lings byung ba yin par 'dug de nas zla ba gsum pa'i 'go la/ 'dol byung du 'bod mi nan chen byung ba ltar phyin/ thal rlud chen pos lam ye mi mthong ba byung / theg bdun bsdad/ zhal ngo rnams la 'dod chos sngar rgyun ltar sgrubs/ tshogs pa mkhan chen kun dga' lung rig pa yang phrad par phebs shing / bde mchog dril bu pa kha che paṇa chen lugs kyi dbang bskur zhig kyang thugs bzhed ltar byas/ de nas bsam sdings su phyin/ sa mtho bas zhag gnyis rlung khams kyi shin tu na bar byung / da lta'i sde srid zhabs drung gi dgongs gtad kyis mgon po'i bris sku cig rtag brtan du bris pa snga dro gcig 'byor byung ba/ bya rog mang po dus gcig tu sleb pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i ltas tsam byung / gser mdog can mkhan chen shākya bstan 'dzin drung yang phebs/ thugs bzhed ltar lam dbang cig byas/ mgon po brag nag gzhan pa drug pa'i rjes gnang la chos mtshams byung / nyin cig jo mo'i ri rtser phyir nas yon bdag gi sku rim du gtor ma rgya che ba zhig btang dus/ byang shar nas rlud shugs can rang 'dug phyi ltas 'tshub par mngon pa tsam byung / slar yang pa snam rdzong du sleb/ rdzong rang gi nye skor na 'brum bags mang po rang 'dug cing / la la phyir gseng ba'i khungs byed 'dug ste/ spre'u yos rku'i rnam pa las mi 'dug kyang / de res skor sku 'brum ye ma byung ba de yin/ de skabs rtag brtan gyi dpal chen lha khang du/ logs bris la a bhe dha na nas 'byung ba'i —80—

dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo phal che ba dang / zhing skyong nyer bzhi mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho nas 'byung ba ltar dang / gtsang khang nang du bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi lha tshogs 'bri ba'i bkod pa dang / sngar mtsho ni rtsi ma gsol ba rnams la mtshon rtsi gsol ba'i bkod pa yang byas/ nged la 'bod mkhan yang med/ sde srid la spyan 'dren yang med de/ zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes brgyad la yon mchod lhan du bsam grub rtser 'byor/ lam zhor la dud mtsho'i 'khris kyi skyed tshal der phyin dus/ g.yabs ring la mi la'i rnam thar bkod pa'i khungs zhig bris 'dug pa/ rten 'brel log pa rang zhig byung 'dug snga sor sde srid du gsang brtol 'bul rgyu de/ pa snam du bar chad kyi rgyur 'gyur bas mi legs pa dang / bsam rtser legs pa dang /dus tshod de kha tsam nas sde srid zhabs drung rang bzhugs yul yang / pa snam cung mi legs pa'i mtshan ma shar ba nas rtse la phebs pa yin/ de khas gang ci nas pho brang ma mor phebs thub pas/ rdzong gzhis rang la'ang blo brling ba dang /mtha' bzhi kun tu zil che ba'i legs lam dang / rtse phyogs sa yang gtsang zhing /yar phyogs de rjes thor pa sogs nang bags kyang cher song ba zhig byung bas/ltas kyang don dang mthun pa de yin/ de skabs gzhan blon chen bka' gros pa'am/ rdzong dpon sogs gang gis kyang rtse la phebs na legs pa'i snyan bskul spyan 'dren sogs su yang med/ khong rang tshol rang 'dod kyi gnad phran tshegs rtsi rgyu yang 'dug pas/ rtser ma byon pa la dngos dga' ba'i rigs yin par yang 'dug phebs pa'i gnangs nyin ka thog mar mdzod pa gnas tshul zhu bar btang / de 'phral dngos kyis kyang zhib rgyas phul/ thugs khog che bar byung —81 —

bas sngar gyi sems khur gyis 'tsher pa sangs sku'i bar chad sel byed kyi dbang bka' 'chag med re phul zhing / bstan 'dzin rin po che dang g.yin yang ci rigs la/ dbang lung rjes gnang rnam grangs mang ba tsam byas/ de nas gsang brtol snyan du phul grub tshul/ dbus phyogs su blon chen rnams la'ang bsrings/ sngar mgon khang cig yod pa bar skabs su bdag rkyen chung ba'i skyon la thugs rtog kyang cung zad 'dug mgon khang rgya bkyed pa'i dgongs brtad shar bas/ 'gol skyid zer ba'i gzim khang de'i phu mda' la bcos ci rigs pa'ang gan pa/ bsas khang pas mgon po 'khor mangs kyi zhal thang cig kyang bris/ gnas rnying pa'i lha bzos mgon po lcam dral gyi sman sku yang bzhengs shing / de dag la rab gnas kyang legs par byung / mgon khang rten rdzas dang bcas pa cha tshang sgrig rtsom grub/ de'i gong tsam du 'phyong rgyas kyi 'go byas pa'i rdzong gzhis 'ga' zhig yar stod pa la phar shor ba dang/ dbus kyi dpon rigs che ba 'ga' zhig kyang / kham 'gros de go rig byung ba la brten pa'i gang la 'chus 'gro mi shes pa'i g.yengs pa'i skabs yin/ de dus sde srid rang la'ang dkon mchog gis mi bslu ba'i yid ches thugs 'gel chen po thugs la 'dug kyang 'dug bla ma dkon mchog chos skyong dang bcas pa'i thugs rgyud bskul zhing gsol ba 'debs pa la thugs rtsol chen po mdzad kyang mdzad/ rang res kyang dmigs pa'i rgyab skyor gang yod byas/ mgon khang btsugs pa nas gzung dge ba'i rtags mtshan yang shar/ de dus sde pa'i phyag na chibs pa 'os rigs med pas mgon po lcam dral gyi zungs 'dzugs pa la/ mgon rta bde legs kun —82—

———smon dang / lha mo la dre'u zhig btsugs rta dres gnyis po sde srid rang gi phyag tu phu pa/ lar de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po glo bur gyi dri mas g.yogs pa'i dpe dang 'dra bar pa snam nas rtser phebs skabs/ nam bza' tshun chod mda' thung ba dang phyag g.yog dpon rigs kyi bu 'ga' zhig kyang 'gro 'tshams byas nas mi sdod pa sogs nged kyi ni blo la mi ran pa cig rang byung / mgon gsol bskang gso ba bzhi sde 'dzugs pa'i dgongs pa yang thog ma rang nas sde srid rang la thun ro/ngas ma yin pa shar ba yin/ mi gzhan 'ga' res bsam pa la/ nged kyis rang ri dad kyi snyan 'bul phul ba la/ sde srid sku na gshone pas mno ma mkhyen par gsan pa yin snyam pa dang / kha nas kyang smra bar 'dug ste/ mgon khang 'dzugs pa dang / mgon gsol ba 'dzugs pa/ thugs dam gtor bsngo bskang gso la brtson pa 'di kun/ sde pa rang gi dgongs gtad thun mong ma yin pa shar ba kho na yin/ nged kyis ta phyag g.yog rnams ma mgu yi dogs nas/ da bzod tsam rim pas gnang na khyab bam zhus te/ snga khyad che ba'i dgongs pas 'phral du gnang ba yin/ lar dkon mchog la blo gtod cing dge ba la rtsol ba de mdzad pa dga' lod ji ltar yin/ byed lugs nor ram ma nor shes ldan yongs la dris shig de skabs thugs rtsol mdzad pa dkas legs/ de min nag phyogs snying la zhugs pa'i 'gal rkyen byed mkhan mang bas phyis phyag thog tu khel ba dka' ba 'dug der ma zad chos skyong 'dis de dus srog rtsa nas bzung de min byus mtha' nas bsdus 'gro bar 'dug de dus dbus nas gros byed pa tshos zhu yig phul ba tsho'i gzhug na'ang / dkar phyogs kyi lha la mchod 'phrin dgos —83—
