zer ba re 'dug pa de'i dkar phyogs ngos 'dzin/ pe kar kho na yin pa 'duga'adi phyogs dang mar phyogs na yod pa thams cad ye shes kyi mgon po la shin tu mi dga'/ 'tshub chen po yod zer/ pe dkar la blo snying brang gsum gtong /bde skyid thams cad yong ba yin zer/ nyams ci yang med pa'i blun po shes ldan du re ba a re sdug a re sdug snying re rje snying re rje/ ji skad du/ kye ma bsod nams zad pa'i mi/ /lha skal chad nas 'byung po sgrub/ khres dang / bka' dam glegs bam las/ mthu chen 'dod pas pe kar sgrub/ grub ma thag tu srog kyang bcad/ tshe nas ngan song 'grim pa mthong / /zhes gsungs pa de go yang /mgo thog tu ni babs 'dug go /'di rgyal po pe ha ra kho na'i skyon gyi lugs min/ 'jig rten phal pa drag shul can kun gyi lugs yin/ sngar mi bsten pa cig gis 'dre chen po re gsar du bsten dgos na/ kho rang gi dam tshig bsre lugs dang / kho dbang du bsdu lugs dang / rten 'brel bsgyur phyogs mang po dang / sngar gyi lha dang 'khon sel dang / phyi 'brang gi bgegs sel tshul thabs mang po cig bla ma nus pa cung zad yod pa cig gis byed dgos/ de min 'dre drag shas kho rang dang mu ma 'byor ba'i sngon la/ 'khor gdug pa can rnams kyis gong kha'i sgo nyal gtong ba yin/ lha rnying pa yang dang 'gras 'gro ba yin/ dang po'i grub thob yin zer ba de 'dras kyang / gtsang btsan sogs 'jig rten rang rgyud pa min/ ye shes pa'i sprul pa yin zer te/ gnas tshul la 'jig rten 'das pa'ang yin srid/ sangs rgyas min pa sus shes/ 'phral 'jig rten pa'i tshul bstan pa rang gis/ ye shes pa'i khyu nas bud/ lam sna 'dren mkhan yin —84—

na 'jig rten pa'i tshul sten don rang med/ sangs rgyas byang sems cig bshan pa'i tshul bstan yod na/ khong bshan pa dngos kyi bya ba byed kyi/ legs par rab tu nyon la yid la bzung shig dang zer chos bshad mi yong / 'o 'jig rten pa'i tshul bzung ba de ka kho 'jig rten pa'i tshul 'dzin dgos tsa na/ gso/da gcong brdung 'phrog rdzun gtong / ma rungs pa'i las byed kyi/ zhing khams bde ba can du 'khrid rogs mi byed/ de ru dngos su 'khrid rogs byed pa la/ tshul yang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i tshul cig ka ston dgos pa lags mod/ des na rang rgyud pa yin yang 'dra/ sprul pa yin yang 'dra/ tshul de 'jig rten pa rang du 'dug na/ 'jig rten pa rang gi 'grogs lugs dang / bsten lugs byed dgos/ de yang 'jam po la 'jam po'i 'grogs lugs dang / ma drangs pa la ma rungs pa'i bsten lugs byed dgos pa yin/ des na 'jig rten 'das pa rang dang / 'jig rten pa yin kyang dbang phyug khyab 'jug sogs lha'i rgyal po chen po dang / mi yul na yod pa'i sde brgyad drag rtsal can te/ sde gsum po 'di la khyad chen po rang yod lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal mthong ma mthong sogs la'ang shin tu khyad che ba go dgos/ skabs 'dir 'di nga/ tsho'i bsam nga/ la pe dkar 'di nged la mi dkar ba'am/ jo nang pa la mi dad rnga/ cig yin nam/gzhan sa dge bka' gsum la dad pa cig yin pa 'dra/ de la kho bos sdang shugs byas pa 'dra snyam pa'i dogs pa mi dgos sar blun dpyad kyi dogs pa cig shar bar 'dug dpal 'dzam thang sogs jo nang pa'i dgon chos gzhis la rgyal po'i dkor bdag yod pa ming nas med/ nang gtor rang la mi 'jug ste/ nged —85—

kyi pha mes gong ma nas rgyal po la las 'chol/ ngas kyang da lta 'chol du rung /sa dge bka' gsum yang phyis 'byung 'di tsho rgyal 'gong la blo brtad byed kyin 'dug pa ma gtogs/ sngon dus nang gtor la mi 'jug blo brtad 'cha' sa rang mi byed lags/ chos nyams kyang med/ snga phyi'i cha rgyus ci yang med pa tsho cig g.yin las smra mkhas pa gda' ba ang / rgyal gnye byung zer rnam rtog langs rim gro sad sud 'dra byed kyin 'dug pa de ci yin pa 'dug pa 'a yi 'a yi pe ha ra chen po drag shul can ta los yin/ de yin pas ka mi dang 'dra ba yin/ lar rgyal pos chos pa drag drag bzang bzang thams cad la bar chad btang ba'i lo rgyus ni thams cad la kha zad zad shod rgyu cig ni 'dug chos la bar chad rang yong mkhan de dkar phyogs rang 'ba' zhig e yin ltos mno bsam thong nged la ni khyad med do/ /pe ha ra mtho na nga yang dga' ba yin no/ /sde pa rang la ni phan mi 'dogs par gda' lags/ nga la sde brgyad su la'ang nye ring dgos pa med do /ang 1/ snga sor nas kyang rdzun po che 'ga' re'i snyan sgron gsan pa'i sde srid gshegs pa des kyang brten khang yang yang spo ba mdzad pa yang / cung zad mi shes pa'i rgyur song 'dug cing / brten khang du pe dkar gyi gtor bzhi rten rdzas sogs bca' ba mdzad 'dug nyin cig de la'ang gtor ma dang / rten rdzasagasar pa mang po dang bcas te/ rgyal khang rang la spos/ de nub rmi lam du/ a tsar gnyis mas kha mthil la phab nas/ da dung rtse la lan cig yong dgos yong zer ba cig byung / de skabs char ba shin tu dkon/ bkra shis lhun po'i lha myong yang ma byung / nged kyis rdzong gi thog rtser gtor tshogs che tsam btang bas/ de —86—

————nub char che ba rang babs de nas mgon gsol bzhi sde ba rnams nang bar sleb rgyu'i tho rangs ka gsal snang gi nyams la/ ri mtho ne po nags tshal rgyas pa cig gi ldan na/ spe'u stod smad gnyis 'dug pa'i 'og ma de na nga rang 'dug steng ma de nas bud med bongs che zhing gzi brjid che ba rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhig thog rtse nas nyengs kyis thon nas/ bkra shis so/ /don grub bo/ /sta sti snya sti zer ba cig byung / rten 'brel shin tu legs par go nang par khong rnams sleb/ hor zla drug pa nyis rtsegs kyi rting ma'i mgon po'i dus chen gyi tshes bzang ba yar ngo ba'i bcu bzhi la/ dpal legs ldan nag po chen po ye shes kyi mgon po dra kad chen po'i bskangs gso rgyun mi 'chad pa'i dbu tshugs/ thun gtor dang gtor 'bul thams cad mgon khang gi steng gi yang rtse der phul/ de nas brtsams te zla 'phro de la/ 'phyong rgyas sogs rdzong par shor ba thams cad tshur slogs pa dang / gzhan yang stod smad du byus legs kyi rnam pa yang yang byung ba'i dar 'phyar rgyun mi 'chad pa kho na'i bkra shis pa'i legs lam de kha rang byung / sngar gyi rmi ltas dang mthun nyin cig phyag mdzod rnams la'ang bgegs skrod rab gnas byas/ nor phyir 'brangs pa'i rgyal 'gong rnams bskrad pa'i ltas kyang gsal bar byung / de yan chad la bar skabs der/ da lta'i zhabs drung 'di khar sgo du ma nas rten 'brel legs tshogs khyad par can du ma 'grig pa'i dge mtshan kho na yod pa'i skabs yin/ 'dir gsang brtol phul grub tshul ma btang bar la/ shar nas tsho 'dzin pa su yang sleb ma byung / skabs der gsang sgo'i tshul gyi sde srid de nyid phebs kyin yod par rdzu bag byas/ mgron gnyer dpon bod gong —87—

— —ba dang / bla ma sogs bzlog pa sogs rim pas 'byor ba'i brag dmar skros sde pa'i gla 'tshal der sleb pa'i dgongs mo nam 'jigs shin tu rgod pa rang cig byung / sang tho rangs rdzong du phebs pa'i rdzu bag tsam byas/ de dus mgron gnyer dpon gros pa kha gtso shos rang yin/ mgon khang btsugs pa la khong shin tu ma mgu bar 'dug tshogs bdag yang steng du bzhugs yul mdzad par rdzu dgos pa'i stabs yin zer nas gtor 'bul byed sa yang mar phabs nas kun gzigs steng gi thog khar byas/ dus mtshams de ka nas dar phyar gyi rigs kyang rgyun chad pa 'dra ba cig byung / dge 'dun ser tshogs sogs sku rim byus rim gyi rigs mang po btsugs shing / bdun pa'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin mo gtor zor 'phen mkhan mang du byung / snga sor spre'u lo rtag brtan du thog babs pa cig byung ba sogs kyang sde srid de nyid kyi kham 'gros la lta bar 'dug 'di skabs tshes brgyad la dings su shwa skyon chen po byung ba'ang dmag byus la blta bar 'dugagatsang gi rgyal srid kyi bla de dgon 'dir / chags 'dug ste/ smras na bden snyam pa su la'ang mi yong ba 'dug nyams snang yang mi 'dug ste bla rdo nyar ma byung bar mi lag tu shor ba'i nyams cig yong nyen gda'o/ /de skabs ni gtor ltas kyi rdzi rnams mi legs pa kho na dang / tshes bcu'i nyin mo rdzong gi rtser rgyal gsol rgyas pa yang btang / bcu gcig gi nyi shar la jo gdan pa tshos rnam sras bskang gso'i gtor 'bul te/ shar steng gi rtse rang nas byed kyin 'dug lha stobs che chung dang / chos skyong mchog dman gyi dbye ba ma shes pas/ gtso bo ye shes kyi mgon po'i gtor stegs mar phab/ 'khor gnod sbyin gyi gtor stegs —88—

rtse la bton pas rten 'brel 'chugs/ tshes bcu gcig gi snga dro'i dus de kha rang la/ dbus su pho brang dmar lcags kyi 'khris der/ dpung chen gyi thog la sog po rgyugs pa'i nyin byus nyes par ma zad/ de rjes kyang sgar skong nga/nga bcas pa de byung ba yin/ de dag la sogs pa sngar rten 'brel legs lam gyi sgo dpag tu med pa yod pa la/ khong rang sleb pa nas gzung nas/ lo de nang du rang rten 'brel mang po log snga sor zhabs drung gong ma de'i dgongs brtad du 'dug pa nged kyis bris yig kyang byas/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar zhing bkod rgyas pa/ thang ka drug cu skor yod pa yang skabs der grub song / gong gsham zhal khebs sogs cha 'grig dang bcas legs par tshar ba la rab gnas rgyas par yang byas/ sde srid de nyid kyi mtshan byang gcog pa snga sor nas bsam sdings su byas pa'i byang yon rnams kyang de dus sprad byung ba la/ sngon bad rngam pa lha khang gi rten gtso nor skyong 'dul mdzad thub pa chen po'i sku 'dra de yang byung / de dang thub pa chen po'i zab sku 'di/ zhabs drung de nyid sku bzhugs dus rtag brtan du gnang ba'i dgongs brtad dang bka' bkod gnang ba yin 'dugadab rngam pa'i jo bo thub pa 'di sne gdong rtse na bzhugs pa la/ bla chen 'ga' zhig gis kyang nyams kyi mchod par bod mi yin pa'i lugs su byas nas ma 'dod par 'dug lar bod ma yin pa tsam gyis ngan par ta mi 'gro/ chos kyang rgya 'grel 'bring man chad las bod 'grel bzang shos rnams bzang bar mngon gsum gyis grub/ rgya lha 'bring man chad las bod chos rgyal gyi dus kyi rnams bzo sgros dang byin rlabs gnyis kar bzang / 'on kyang 'di rdo rje gdan nas —89—

byon par gnang zhing / dbus nas spyan 'dren dus dka' mo byung zer/bsam 'grub rtse nas rtag brtan gyi bar la dka' tshegs gang yang ma byung / glang chen smyon pa btul ba'i sku brnyan yin pas/ jo bo phyogs las rnam rgyal du mtshan gsol nas/ gtsang khang chen mor bzhugs su gsol ba yin/ de skabs bon gong nas sogs/ gleng brjod byed dus/ ston pa'i rnam thar 'di 'tshi po rang byung zer/ 'jigs 'jigs byed pa skad 'dug chos nyams ni med/ rnam rtog ni rgod 'o re brgyal/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar bzhengs pa la 'tshub yong na/sangs rgyas kyi sku 'dra bzhengs pa la'ang 'tshub ci'i phyir mi 'ong / de la'ang yong na/ 'tshub mi yong pa'i lha sku mi srid par thal/ kla klo tu ru ka'i grub mtha' de ka rang du gda'/ lha sku yin snyam nas mi gzugs rdab rdob/ rgyal 'gong gi sdod sa 'dra la blo btod la/ phar ḍā tshur ḍā gi 'di phyi gnyis med de khyed rang tsho la yong ba yin snyam pa byung / snga sor phebs mtshams nas nga'i yid la da lta dka' las byas kyang / phugs rtig po rang yang med/ de bas rang gi dgon par phyin pa dga' snyam pa byung yang / phyag g.yog rnams ma sleb par la dgongs pa zhu ma nus/ mgron gnyer dpon slob mtshams nas yang yang dgongs pa bzhus kyang / dus gzengs 'khrugs ches pa dang / bya bral de rnams la rgyang tsam 'gor/'bring 'tshams lho rtsa khog la ltos pa'i dge 'dun tshogs shin tu che zhing /skye bo'i spyin gtong gi bar du mtha' rgyas rang mdzad song / dngos gzhi teb ra'i sa khul yangs sa der/ dge 'dun stong phrag gnyis tsam 'dus pa'i steng du/nged kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba sgrib gnyis byang ba dang byang chub tu bsngo ba rgyas par —90—

byas/ de nub dga' ldan rtser sleb zhag gnyis bsdad/ de nas rje bla chen ye shes drung dang / sde pa rang dang bcas nged yon mchod thams cad kyis zar skya rang phebs/ sngar gyi skyar chos sde ni lhag lus phran bu tsam las dengs 'dug pas/ der da lta'i chos 'khor bde chen gyi gnas gzhi gtsug lag khang dang bcas pa 'di bzheng ba'i dgongs brtad mdzad/ gtor chog rgyas pa dang bcas pas sa blang ba dang / mchod yon gyi cho ga sngon du 'gro bas sa chog rgyas pa cig byas/ byang phug gi jo bo la mos pa chen po yod pas/ de res kyang nyin skor cig mjal du phyin/ byang phug pa rje kun dga' legs pa de/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi bu chen phyag tshar ma yin/ khong gis bzhengs pa'i lha khang na/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'khyud yum zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa bris 'dug pa'ang rgyud dang mthun/ dgyes rdor gyi rigs tsho yang bkram gdan kho nar bzhengs 'dugadapal dus kyi 'khor lo dbus kyi cha la bzhugs pa sogs/ blo gros phur khung thug pa ma yin pa'i rnam 'gyur tshor 'dug pas/ phyis kyi 'ga' zhig la rgong bro ba cig kyang byung / de nas slar yang mkhar chen du phyin/ gshed dam ra gyi dbang cig kyang byas/ tshe dbang sogs rkyen sel rnams kyang phul/ la stod lho phyogs kyi dgon grwa rigs rnams kyis yong dgos dgos tshul byung rung / slar bsam 'grub rtser gsangs brdol yongs khyab dang bstun nas dgongs rdzogs kyi mgo la 'gro dgos yong ba'i stabs/ yar phyogs 'gro ba bgol/ gsang sngags ri bo brgyu nas dge grod thub phyin/ rtag brtan chos 'phel gyi dgon pa 'debs pa'i sa chog dang bkod pa rnams kyang byas/ de rjes lcim lung gi byams gling du —91—

phyin/ lcim lung rdzong dpon gnyis pos kyang mthun rkyen cha 'grig tsam byung /byams gling dang dge dpal cha lag dang bcas pa rang res bdag rkyen byas zhag gnyis bsdad/ sde srid snga ma'i dus nas gnang ba'i dgongs brtad tsam yod kyang phyir 'gyangs/ da lta'i sde srid 'di nyid kyis bsko 'ja' sgrags/ tshur lam yang mang mkhar sogs brgyud nas dgon pa 'bras skrungs su phyin/ zhag gnyis bsdad/ khros dbang zhig kyang byas/ de dus rtse nas 'bod mi'i tshul du gting skyes nas brtsams te a sding bskor mang yod/ slar rtag brtan du 'byor de 'phral shar phyogs la phyin pas chog pa yod kyang/ de skabs bka' gros pa tsho dgongs rdzogs chog grwa sogs la myong ba chung zhing lhus mi things pa zhig 'dug pa nas/ sde srid kyi gsung shog byung bar/ snga sor nas zla ba bcu gcig bar dus khrid byed rgyun 'dug pa thog mar dus chos byas nas/ grol mtshams gdud chog byed dgos 'dug gsung ba byung bas/ de 'phral dus 'khrid btsugs pa yin/ khrid tshugs nas zhag bcu lhag song skabs la/ gdung chog bsnyur dgos pa 'dug pas/ khrid ma tshugs gong du yong dgos gsung ba cig byung / bka' gros pa tsho yang gra ma 'grig cing / rtsis pa tsho yang smyon pa'i rtul zhugs 'dzin pa der 'dug 'on kyang dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi'i dus thog de la 'khrol 'dug pa dang / chog grwa gzhan tsho 'dzugs pa dang mnyam por/ rtag brtan gyi grwa pa rags bsdus sum brgya tsam sngon la byon/ 'di khar dam po bdun phrag gnyis sogs bla ma gong ma'i phyag rgyun rnams nyams su mi rung bar 'dug gzhan rnams mdor bsdus su byas/ 'khrid gtor gyi spros pa rnams kyang —92—

———grwa rags rnams ma bsdad pas/ grwa gzhon btsun chung rnams kyis byas pas ngo mtshar bar byung / khrid grol 'phral shar phyogs la bskyod/ 'dra 'dre'i ltag tsam nas rlung nag langs te/ snar thang du sleb kyi bar nyi ma gnyis la rlung 'tshub shin tu che bar byung / bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyer gsum la bsam 'grub rtser sleb/ cho ga re yang btang / de dus lo mchod kyi dbang du btang bar 'dug kyang / zla gcig snga bsnur ba'i khungs su 'dug nyer lnga la gdung chog grol ba yin/ gdung chog pa thams cad sko lhan cig tu 'tshog pa ni ma byung /'tshom chen du rtag brtan pa rnams dang / ngor rnga/'i chog grwa pa rnams kyi nga kyal der yas gtam dang bsngo smon rgyas par byas/ rgya nag tu hong dus spar bzhengs pa'i bka' 'gyur mtshal spar ma kha thig tshang ba de bsngo tsho yon gyi skabs su byung /bsngo ba grol 'phral snur smad de kha la yongs/ snar thang bkras rab tu sleb tsam byas/ rlung 'tshub shin tu che/ gshin don 'di 'dra'i rigs la rlung gis mtshams bcad pa rten 'brel legs po yin zer kyin ni 'dug de nas byang chen du zhag po bdun bsdad/ zhwa dmar cod paṇa 'dzin pa sprul pa'i skur zhu yig ja zhus bzab tsam cig phul / tshur lan gnang ba la jo nang pa'i grub mtha' rtag brtan ther zug tu 'dod pa 'di 'khor lo dang por bden yod dang /bar par bden med dang / gsum par bden yod bstan na glang chen khrus kyi dper 'gro gsung ba dang / rang re la bstan pa ris med rang gis gsung ba zhig 'dug de'i lan du 'khor lo rnam gsum dgongs pa gcig par jo nang pa bzhed kyi phyi ma phyi mas snga ma snga ma la skyon 'gel bar mi bzhed bya ba dang /—93 —

lugs gnyis kar la stobs chen po nyid lta bu yang bstan pa phyogs re kho na skyong bar mdzad na/ nged bya bral gcig gis bstan pa ris med ji ltar spel thub zer ba zhus/ g.yag chen la bgo bsha' byed rin mi chog na/ byi ba'i ro la bgo bsha' sus thub snyam pa byung / rtser zhag po lnga sdod ring dang de'i ring la rkang pa g.yas pa shin tu na bar byung / de rjes bcos ma byas pa la sangs song /slar yang phag lo zla ba dang po'i tshes gsum la bsam 'grub rtser sleb/ bod dbus gtsang gi bdag po yin yang / dbu skra 'khru mkhan skabs bab cig gra ma 'grig par/ skra bkru'i rim pa tsho yang nged kyis phul/ sa skyong phun tshogs rnam rgyal de nyid/ spyir mkhyen rab dang / blo gros dang/ bsod nams las shugs ni smos ma dgos/ thugs zhen rang 'then sa dang thugs nad gtsang ba'i rigs dang 'brel zab zab rang gi bla ma'i rigs ni mang nas med/ gcig kho nar mi gda'/ rang re'i cha la'ang thugs nad shin tu dag par mdzad/ bskal dus 'di rtsod ldan yin pa'i dbang gis/ bla ma'am shin tu nye ba'i grogs la'ang phyi ma nang dang g.yo sgyu phran tshegs re yong ba 'di kun gyi lugs su 'dug pas ma bkag gzhan rang re la thugs ga rta rko pa rang yod/ de las kyang khyad par du dpal jo nang pa'i lta ba la thugs mos che zhing / bstan pa 'phel bskyed cung zad byung ba 'di khong gi phyag rjes yin pas sku bzhugs dus kyang sku rim snyan spron sogs phul/ de la thugs mi ga rta di pa min yang / rnam g.yeng gi bar chad dbang gis phyag thog tu ma khel/ bsrung dmigs sogs la ta brtson pa rang yin te/ sems can las kyi dbang du 'gro ba'i rang bzhin du 'dug pas/ ya —94—

gi sa/ngas rgyas su brdzu ba nas/ ma gi'i g.yog po'i bar du rdzus pa'i bar chad byed mkhan rgya che la dpangs mtho ba/ chags sgo blo btags grangs mang po'i kha nas thar pa'i rigs su ma byung / de skabs bar chad kyi dbang du ma song na/dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe lnga skor thub pa'i mtshan rtags yod pa yin/ don la dgra byed pa po pha rol po'i bla ma dang sde dpon gros steng nas thor pa'i bags tsho yang sku gzhogs bskyal bar 'dug thor pa rags rim gdangs rma/tshams su de'i skad cha go ba dang / thor pas mi 'grongs par 'dug snyam nas/ dug sbyor byung ba nges can du 'dug sku rkyang la ma thongs par de'i skyogs de dpon sa rgya dga' dpon g.yog tsho la yang song bar 'dug dngos su dug sbyor byed mkhan yang dgra phyogs kyi 'tsho byed 'brum bcos mkhas pa yin zer ba cig gis byas des su 'dug cing / dug sbyor thongs mtshams nas/ bla ma ba de bas mthu skad kyang mang du byas 'dug sku bsnyung ba'i skabs kyang / dang po phar yang bka' skyon mdzad/ khong tshos kyang dgra ngos blangs pa mngon 'gyur byed myong ba'i mkhan po kun blo spyan drangs/ tshe dbang phul/ lar de 'dras yong ba ta ga la srid de/ sku 'khor dpon g.yog thams cad 'khrul pa zhig pa los yin dgra phyogs kyi bla ma gzhan cig kyang spyan drangs nas byug sman sogs bcos ka yang byas gda'/phyag g.yog 'dras kun blo dang 'tsho byed la grub mtha'i srid phyogs gcig pa'i zhen byas 'dug ste/ de lo srid phyogs nad zhig byung tsa na/ sngar srid gcig pas ga la phan/ lar mi chen gnangs che shos 'di tsho/ phyag g.yog bka' gros pa rnams kyis gcig gis gcig la 'tshong pa'i re mos rang byed dgos pa —95 —

cig gi dpon po ni blon po spyi'i tshong zong du 'dug sde dpon rṣa po btsongs tsa na los kyang yod/ rin de yang kham po che cig rang yod gin 'dug go /rang rang gi mchod gnas dang bla ma la mos gus dad zhen yod na/ rang gi nor dang sa cha nas gtong dgos pa yin/ rang gi lag nas mi 'chor ba gzor bzhag gingo so 'phyar ba la btad ra ci yod/ ma dag pa'i spyin pa sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi nang na/ gzhan gyi long kha/ spyod ster ba zhes pa cig yod do/ /de lo yang sku rim ta mang po mdzad gda'/ 'gangs che ba la zangs ri rdzong gzhis dang bcas pa tsam ldeg (ldog 1ste chos gzhis la sbyar/ gzhan yang phyogs ris su chad de ba'i skyon yod pa cig gi bla 'bring sogs dgon pa chung chung mang po la chos gzhis khar khor mang po sbyor ba mdzad 'dug ste/ slob dpon dpa' bo'i zhal nas/ spyin bdag stobs ldan khyab 'jug slong ba po/ /rta yi mchog spyin dus su sa chen byin/ 'bras bu bcings pa nyid ni thob par 'gyur/ rgyu 'bras 'tshol pa 'di la su zhig smon/ zhes pa der gda'/ rim gro dang 'bul ba sbyin gtong sogs kyang gnad ma shes na rgyu song yang phan yon med pa cig 'dugagand shes na nyung ngus kyang rkyen bsgyur thub pa cig 'ong ste/ de lo'i sku rim dmigs gsal can/ tsho yang gnad du 'gro po ma byung yod par 'dug lar 'khor ba thams cad sdug bsngal mi brtan pa'i rang bzhin can yin pas snying po ta ga la yod de/ sdug bsngal gyi chu 'bab de la ka bzhag na yong ba la phu dkrugs mda' dkrugs rang ka byed pa mang bar 'dug go /de dus phyag g.yog la yod pa drag pa'i khungs rnams ni/ rang gis go ma chod pa de mi 'dod/—96—

dpang po med pa gzhir bzhag gis/ khor rang tshos snyan spron yag par phul tshul dang / sde pas de la ma gsan/ gnang sgo ma legs tshul mang ngo/ gleng bar 'dug mi legs pa yod shas che na'ang / khong tshos sgrog pa'i bab thob de e yong / yang zer rigs 'di la dpags na ga 'dra yin yang mi shes pa 'dug bsam pa'ang byung / yang mdzad pa legs pa zer ba de dge ba yin/ mi legs pa zer ba de sdig pa la 'jog na/ mi phal cher sdig pa rang byed pa mi legs pa 'ba' zhig yin/ bskal pa rtsod ldan gyi rgyal po dang blon po rnams mi dge ba bcu'i bem po rang yin mod/ chos mngon pa sogs las rgyal po dang blon po sdom min rgyud ldan du bshad pa ma lags sam/ sngon gyi rgyal po gsal rgyal 'dra ba'i dpyod ldan gyis kyang / mi 'os pa'i thub tshod ci yang byas pa'i gtam rgyud yod/ dus deng sang smos ma dgos/ da lta'i bla ma dge bzhes kyi khungs 'gangs chen la'ang byed pa mi legs pa mang nas med na/ skye bo sde dpon rang la ci zhig gtam/ sde pa las ta g.yog rigs tsho rang ka bzab dgos/ sgos su gros pa blon po tsho rang de las kyang gzobs/ yang 'jig rten pa'i dgra 'dul gnyen skyong gi bya ba rtsing zhib tsam la mdzad pa dga' lod kyi dbye ba byed na ni khyed tshos yod pa be ra ba shes nga/ cig rang ta sde pas kyang yod tsam yod de yong / la las lkog ngan zos/ la las rang 'dod kho na byas/ la las rang gi sgos dgra 'dul/ la las rang gi nye phyogs rang skyangs/ gzhung sa'i don gal che chung nye ring thams cad rlung la bskur ba de byed pa bzang po yin lags so/ /spyir g.yog po dpon po la thes med byed/ dpon pos kyang g.yog la thes med —97—

byed/ grwa pa nang zan gyis bla brang la thes med byed/ btsun pa tshos chos la thes med byed/ mi sdod mkhan tshos sdong yul la thes med byed pa 'di tshe lo bcu pa hab rgyugs byed mkhan kun gyi spyi lugs su 'dug khyed rnams sgos su blo skyog mi dgos pa 'dug snyam pa'ang shar/ de dus kyi tsho phal cig da lta dengs grub ste/ da lta yod pa dang / da yod rgyu tsho rang yang sum pa rgya shod 'phrang gi rna ba'i sha len pa'i dpe de kar 'dug yang sde srid de rang gis mi gzugs bcos shin tu sku drin bskyangs pa'i mi tsho ni/ longs spyod dang kha drag po ni nga rang la yod/da ni mgo thog gi g.yam pa bsal snyam pa rang gi glu bro dang spyod rtsing gis lung pa bkang nas 'dug sems 'phral 'khur mkhan su yang mi gda'/ 'jig rten phal pa la phan btags pa la 'bras bu de kar 'dug sku gshe/gas pa nas gzung de bar nged kyis ni sku sgrib sbyang ba'i thabs/ bum chog bzlas brjod sogs bar ma chad par byas/ ji zhig nas ltas kyang bzang rab byung / sku sgrib kyang che ste dge stobs kyang che/ khyad par du zab mo'i chos la mos pa yod pas gnad nas zin par yong ba lags/ 'di skabs kyang sde srid 'di par rkyen bzlog gi dbang rjes gnang grangs mang bar phul/ dpal 'khor chos sde'i gos sku byams chen gyi tshad blangs pa'i gos sku chen mo rgyu phun sum tshogs pa dang /ling kho na las bzhengs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku yang bzhengs pa mdzad 'dug pa/'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng nas rab gnas kyang bgyis/ skye bo'i tshogs la'ang rten mjal tsam mdzad song / rab ston ni dge 'dun la mang ja 'gyed bcas tsam ma gtogs skye bo la spyin gtong ni mi 'dug bzhugs yul —98—

yang rtse phyogs rang du bzhugs nas skabs skabs 'grems pa sogs byung na legs zhugs kyang / grib chodi snga phyi'i khyad yod pa tsam byas nas dpal 'khor chos sder spyan drangs song / grwa sar yar mar na ni 'dug rtse rang na gos sku mi bzhugs/ rgyal rtse phyogs gos sku mod sar gda' ste bsam pa ni byung / dang po byang du'ang zhabs drung la nged kyis zhus nas phyag rtags gnang ba'i thog ma rang cig dpon sa chen mo dang rdzong dpon 'dras bden med la btang pas rten 'brel thams cad 'chugs pa 'di yin/ 'di skabs kyang sde srid 'di nyid kyis sbyor 'jags phyag rtags thog ma dang gnang ba cis yod pa'ang blon po'i blo gros dang / sde srid rang nas kyang bden med la gtong ba ni gnang song / nged la 'di dus don dag ni ma grub pa der 'dug phyis yong rgyu cang med/ sde pa rang la ni phugs kyi rten 'brel chen po rang cig 'chugs song / gnyen tshan gyis phud pa'ang lags/ de rjes dgongs pa yang yang zhus kyang / zla ba bzhi tsam sdod dgos byung / hor zla gnyis pa'i 'jug tu ser gsog cig kyang mdzad/ de 'phral yar bteg nas thar pa gling du phyin/ gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i sa chog byas dus/ mchod yon gyi cho ga'i skabs chu chen po glo bur du babs pa dang / chu mig rgyas shing sbal pa dkar po thon pa sogs dge mtshan du mngon pa byung / grwa rigs thog ma rnams la gshed dmar gyi dbang dang / dpal mgon po stag zhon gyi rjes gnang sogs sgrubs/ 'bod mi yod pa ltar 'dol byung du phyin/ slar tshur lam yang thar par yang zhag gcig bsdad/ khrom dbang gi lugs cig kyang byas/ yang bsam 'grub rtser sleb/ zla gcig lhag tsam sdod —99—

dgos byung / mkhan chen 'jam mgon lhun 'grub kyi sku skye'ang / nyang stod stag tsal gyi thad smad pa tsho'i mi ngo la gsal por byung 'dug pas/ ngos 'dzin mdzad pa'i skra phud kyang blangs/ zhabs drung shun nas snga sor sa glang gi lo la mjal skabs zhabs drung rang gi gsung gleng gnang ba la rang mi brgyud med pa nas snga sor gong dkar dang phyogs gcig pa'i lugs byas kyang da dgos de ni ma 'grig g.yog rigs rnams yar stod la blo gtong 'dod mang ba 'dug kyang rang re gtsang du rang blo gtong zhu bsam pa yin pas/ de mthun yar lam khyer kyis zhu grogs kyis/ 'phrang stod smad kyi sa cha rnams nas ji ltar 'os pa dge rgyun la gang 'gro sbyor tshul sogs gleng brjod rgya shoms mang rab gnang gin 'dug de mthun yar lam nged kyis gtsang du zhus kyang / de rjes bar skabs su thugs gtong sa cung zad 'gyur ba'i cha shas cig byung yod 'dug pas par shun gtsang du 'bul dgos byung ba der 'dug spre'u lo 'dir nged la 'bod mkhan gnang / gtsang kur 'dzings pa 'di tsho la gtso bor zhwa dmar nag bzhugs 'dug ste khyed kyis kyang phan 'dogs byed dgos rgyur 'dug de min yang mar phyo gas la yong dgos gsung ba byung / de nas sprel bya'i mtshams su sne 'ur sku la dam 'jur byung / bya lo'i dbyar gtsang du phebs/ nged tshos sngar shul du phebs chog pa'i ngo chen nan bskyed bskyar chags su zhus/ sngar shul rang dka' ba 'dug ste/ thog mar sde srid rang nas dga' tshad gnang ba'i dngos brtad yod de/ bka' gros pa tshos sgo sna tshogs kyi bkag 'jig rten pa dgra gnyen blta dgos pas cha cig nas de ka yin pa'ang ni srid/ bya lo'i nang du zhal — 100—

gsal ma byung / skabs 'dir sku skal du rog tsho ngo chen la gnang ba phugs rtag brtan gyi chos gzhis su bstan pa nam gnas sbyor ba'i bka' shog kyang gnang /zhabs drung rang ni dang po rang thugs sna chos la bsgyur mkhan byung na lan re 'gyur bla ba cig 'dug kyang / rgyun du bskul ma/span byung na min pa brtan po med par yang 'jig rten rang la log 'gro ba'i thugs sna ring ba rang cig gis/da lta'i bar du yang nyi ma shar yang mgo phur bas nam ma langs par re ba'i dpe der 'dug spyi dus kyi ma khyogs pas stod smad thams cad la 'dug sgos su dbus phyogs kyi dpon ris dang / bla slob kyi rigs la mang bar 'dug ste rgyal 'gong gi bar chad kyi rnam pas blo sna mang ba/ 'gyur rkyen pa/ ngo tsha 'tsher bag chung ba/ phyi thag thung ba/ bya byed mang ba/ sdig pa myong chung tshun cho de la'ang 'dzem mi thub pa/ 'chol pa'i mtshan nyid cig yong gin 'dug pas/ lar mi chen gyi rigs tsho rim gro dkar phyogs bsrung 'khor la rtsol 'don dgos pa'i rigs su 'dug go /mi chen 'ga' zhig gzhon dus dad pa che zhing chos la dkar ba de/ dar ma tsa na dad pa yal nas sol ba'i phye ma ltar nag thibs kyi 'gro/ yang la la dar bab tsa na rnam dpyod dang ldan zhing gar sla 'tsham pa cig yod pa de/ na tshod cung zad smin nas 'brel meng cal col 'ba' zhig tu 'gro ba cig kyang 'dug dang po nyang stod du bla ma urla ba na re/ rgan 'chal snga shos de lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis tsam nas yong zer ba'i dpe dar gda'/ dang po rang bzhin ngan pa cig yod pa de 'gyur na legs de mi 'gyur/ dang po rang bzhin bzang ba cig yod pa de ma 'gyur na dga' sde 'gyur 'gro ba cig 'dug lar mi — 101 —

'gyur ba rang de sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa de rang yin par gda' lags/ de skabs 'khrum nad mched rkyen cang mang bas rtag brtan du'ang 'khrum pas na ba mang zhing / zhud kha yang mang bar 'dug zer bas rang res sleb na phan par sems te/ yang yang dgongs grol zhus kyang bka' nan ches pas hor zla bzhi pa rdzogs rdzogs 'gor/ sde srid gong ma'i dus mchod thes la phyogs yo che se ba cig ni byung 'dug su'i skyon yin nam/ lar dgon so sor mchod thes mang po rang gnang song / 'di tshor yang lha dbang rtse'i skor rnams sbyor 'jags gnang / de nas yar chas te 'ongs/ brag ram du gnod spyin la gtor ma bzab pa cig byas/ las than thun bcol ba rnams 'grub par byung /rtag brtan du zla ba lnga pa'i tshes gsum la sleb/ de gong du 'brum nad kyis grwa ba shi chad 'ga' re byung 'dug nged kyis sleb nas zhud kha dang shi chad ye ma byung / 'bras sbungs su bdun phrag gnyis tsam mtshams zhig byas pa la nub cig rmi lam na/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs slob ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa gsal bar rmi nas/ mi shigs pa'i thig le'i nges don 'di dang 'di yin gsung ba cig byung / chos lung byang rtse'i brag gi rtse shar ma la gzims khang bde mchog pho brang 'di 'debs pa'i bkod pa la rang res dngos su ma phyin/ mdzod pas bkod pa la phyin pa yin/ dbyar stong de dpal gyi jo nang du bsdad/ rgya ba ri sngon 'bor skyong gi rtser zhag cig bsdad nas gtor ma rgya che ba cig btang / de mtshams nas 'bras sbungs kyi khang pa rgya bkyed cing ze sbyon pa'ang byas/ 'di skabs mkhan chen lhun rab pa gshegs pa'i bsngo rten byung —102—

zhing / ston ka thub bstan yangs can du chos rje nag tshang rang 'gre ba yang gshegs pa'i bsngo rten byung / 'di'i kha sed dpyid ka de nged bsam 'grub rtse na yod dus/ mkhan chen lhun rab pa la dpal 'khor chos sde'i mkhan po dang /chos rje rang 'grel ba yangs pa can gyi mkhan por brtag pa thon pa yin zer blon chen rnams gleng gin 'dug rang 'dod kyi khag brtag pa la bskur na 'di'i rigs rang yod bsam pa cig shar/ brtag pa chug pa'i sbus de 'dra ang /bkra shis kha btags gtso bor gyur pa la sgrol dkar gyi zab sku cig kyang bzhengs/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar 'dul ba lung gtso bor gyur pa'i 'bor lo dang po las btus pa/ rgyas bsdus 'tshams pa 'di yang dbyar thog de la sgrigs pa yin/ 'jug phran tshegs cig lo 'di'i dgun ka bris/ zla ba drug pa'i nang du a ma lags kyang dbus nas yar spyan drangs te/ sku gshegs kyi bar 'di khar bzhugs pa yin/ de nas ser kha de rtag brtan du tshogs chos la bstan rim gyi 'khrid dmigs pa dang bshad pa gnyis kar zhib mor byas pa/ zla cig theg po bcu tsam gyi ring bshad/ byams chos sde lnga/ theg bsdus/ bslab bsdus/ spyod 'jug sogs gzhung che chung mang po'i lung yang byas/ snga sor sangs rgyas rab bdun gyi sku gzugs bzhengs pa'i rab gnas dga' ston rgya cher song / de rjes bzhengs pa thams cad kyi zhal gro chen mo'am/ gson dge sbrags ma la dga' ston chen po byas te/ chos sde sgrub sde yongs rdzogs dang / ston dus su song bas phyogs kyi dge 'dun yang shin tu rnam grangs mang bar 'dug chos gzhis kyi dgon lag rnams dang / gtsang —103—

mdog 'jang po dong gi skye bo ji snyed 'dus pa khri khrag rgal nges pa la dga' ston rgya cher sgubs/ skye bo mi nag pa thams cad la yang nas khal re bkye/ tsam pa 'bo dang / rkam 'byed bal 'gyed sogs kyang yod/ zab sku dam tshig gsum bkod dang / thub pa dang / sgrol dkar gsum po zhal phye 'dir zab sku bkram pa'i thog ma yin/ me tog gi char chen po yang babs/ shun zhabs drung yang phebs yong bas nas 'gyed bal 'gyed sogs la thugs ha las shing / lha sa smon lam chen mo'i mi tshogs che dus las kyang da res mang ba 'dug gsung /gnas rnying pa'i lha bzos mgon khang chen mor dpal mgon po lcam dral gyi sku brnyan sku tshad che ba 'di yang dus yun thung ngu la bzhengs grub/ lcam dral gyi 'tsham sku chen mo yang bzhengs/ mgon sku bzheng pa'i las ka bcugs pa'i nyin/ mgon po'i gzungs su 'dzugs rgyu'i dom nag cig kyang 'byor ba/ rten 'brel legs par byung / de rjes 'bras sbungs su rgyang tsam mtshams byas/'jad kyi phu la sogs po'i jag rgyugs thang thung cig kyang byung / sgang gzug gnyis kyi rdzong gnyer rnams sde pa gzhung gi phyag tu bzhes pa sogs la mi rnams dus gzings langs yod snyam pa'i zir bun cher byed kyin 'dug spyod pa rnam 'gyur rgod bro mo byed mkhan mang po rang 'dug ste/ sgos dpon re btsal/lkog rngan re rgyab pas thams cad kha 'phangs mtho ye re yus che che ltar byas pas chog pa rkyang pa 'dug rtag brtan gyi sman bla'i sku brnyan yang lo 'di la bzhengs pa yin/ de rjes dgun la phyogs pa na 'jam dpal gsang ldan gyi dkyil chog de yang brtsams/ de nas dus khrid kyi thog tu bab pa na/ 'phan yul snye thang —104—

sogs dbus phyogs pa'i grwa rigs dang / chos sde sgrub sde dgon lag gi grwa rigs sogs yo sdom pa la/ 'khrid gsar pa nga/ma po 'debs mkhan rang phyed dang lnga brgyar nye ba tsam byung / 'khrid gsar ba de lo rang mang zhabs drung shun pa'ang chos la'ang phebs yod de/ dam po ni mi mdzad pa de spyan ltos phyag srol la gnod kyang / mi chen 'di tsho la dbang che spyod kyi khungs re yong gin 'dug bstan 'dzin sprul pa'i sku dang / gnas sgo slob dpon/ bya gshongs gdan sa pa chos 'khor sgang ba yin pa de'ang 'khrid zhu la byon/ nyang stod nas bzang ra ba'i sku khog yongs/ 'khrid gtor gyi skabs su kho babs pa'i lung bstan than thun dang zor 'phen sogs byed pa cig byung / de nas phag lor sleb cing /'khrid grol nas skyid phug tu mtsham mi bsdad/ dge sbyor gang 'phel tsam ma gtogs/ mtshams dam po rang ni med/ hor zla gnyis pa'i smad la sde srid nas lhun grub sgang pa rab brtan pa rdzong pa gnang ba'i sog pos 'bri khung go gnyis bcom pa sogs la brten dbus la dpung 'degs dang dpung thog tu ring sde srid phebs rgyu yin pas/ cis kyang yong dgos tshul nan che che 'dra ba la/yang yong ma thub na brtag pa sogs zhu rgya'i skor yang byed rgyu yin zer/ dpung thog tu phebs des shes pa yin nam yang yang dri mal byas dus yin zer bas/'o na sku gal che tsa na yong dgos byas te/ mi ring bar lam du chug pa byas de phyin/ ma gir sleb dus bon gong nas sogs gros pa 'ga' re de dus nged sleb pa la mi dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur byed sleb mi yong ba gzhir bzhag gis 'bod mkhan btang ba yin 'dug na'ang / yongs btang ba nges snying tshim par byung /— sdi05—

sde srid rang gis dngos su gsung ba la/ dbus la dmag thog phyin na nyes skyon yod dam med phebs pa la/ brtag pa'i 'char sgo la nyes skyon ye med cing legs par 'dug nas/ de kha ltar snyan tu ni phul/ de ma thag bka' gros pa rnams byung nas/ brtag pa zhu ba gnang yod 'dug pas dbus la phebs pa ma chug tshul zhu dgos zer ba la brtag pa'i gnas tshul zhus grub tshul labs/lar yang brtag pa la khag btang ba'i rdzun byas pas ga nas 'ong ste/ khong rang yon mchod tsho la de rang yong 'dug pas yin nam/ slar yang dbus 'brog na 'brum pa sogs sa mi gtsang ba yod tshul dang / dbus phyogs phebs kyang sku na gzhon pas dpung thog rang ni mi pher/ dpung 'byer 'khrid la mi phan pa'i khar gnod pa las mi long bas/ bshol 'debs nan chags byed dgos zer yang yang lab kyin 'dug rang re'i sems la ni/ brtag pa gyis gsung ba la ni 'char sgo gang shar ba de rdzun med du zhus pa yin/ rdzun zhus pas ga la yong /rdzun byed rgyu yin na brtag pa byed don yang mi 'dug go /thigs mi thigs ni sus shes/ 'di ltar mdzod 'di ltar ma mdzad zer pa la ni/ nged gnang chung yin tsa na lar gyi yang gsan pa kog sgos su khyed rang rnams kyis nged kyis zhus pa'i rigs la gsan dgongs mdzad na ye mi yong tshul rgyun mi 'chad phul nas/ yang da res bshol 'debs nged la re don rang med pa 'dra/ ya ru skye lam ma ru skyel kyang dbang ni khyed rang tsho che snyam pa cig byung / 'on kyang khong tsho'i zer tshul tsam ni zhus/ gzhan spra lag pa mkhas 'jug mkhan mang po yang de na sleb 'dug der theg drug gi ring la rkyen sel dbang chos gang 'grub phul/—106—

de mtshams dbus phyogs thegs mi thegs the tshom lding de ba'i ngang nas dpon g.yog rnams phebs song / yol thang la rab gnas kyis gsung ba ltar nged kyi de rjes zhag po bzhi bsdad/ yol thang la rab gnas nyin gnyis ma cig grub/gser mdog can pa'i mkhan slob tshogs pa thams cad sku rim la bzhugs pa la/ kyi rdzi steng du chos 'brel la sems bskyed cig byas/ snang thang gi rten mjal ma byas par yun rings lon pas yar lam snar thang gi rten mjal byas/rten sgrig tshul rnams bar skabs su sngar dang mi 'dra bar bcol 'dug pa/byams khang sogs sngar gyi mthangs gsal zhing bag dro ba de ma yin par/ mun mun stong chang chang cig byung 'dug de nas yar yo nge rtag brtan gyi 'bras sbungs su mtshams thung tsam byas/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i zab sku bzhengs pa'i 'go brtsams/ ri khrod chen por yang mtshams rgyang tsam byas/ dge sbyong yang 'phel bar byung / dbyar stod tshun la 'bras sbungs rtse'i mkhar las 'phros skyongs rnams dang / sngar gyi zab sku 'grems sa byed rgyu'i khungs 'gyel ba'i shul der/lha khang khyams mgon khang dang bcas pa bzhengs nas/ khro rgyal lha khang du mtshan gsol ba dang / chos lung byang rtser bde mchog pho brang gi las ka'i 'phros rnams kyang grub par byas/ hor zla lnga pa'i nyer dgu gnam gang la rgyab ri'i rtse mor zhag sdod byas shing / gtor ma yang rgya cher bto / sngon skyer sgang ba'i rnam thar na/ phyug po rdor 'bum gyi yon bdag byas nas/ tsam khal brgya la brul gtor lan cig mdzad gsung ba yod/ ‘sna di res kyang tsam khal brgya lhag tsam song / gdong dga' ba'i dpon sa g.yang lags kyi gsol skal ster — 107—

rgyus zangs dkar gnyis mchod gzhis su phul khong pa rang slar chos sgor zhugs pa sogs mjad pa yin/ gzhan yang lo 'di'i nang du rtag brtan gyi lha khang shar ma gsum gyi steng gi logs bris dang / jo bo phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi rgyab yol/ phye phur dang / gong bu sogs mchod rdzas mang po'ang grub/ skor rṣa pa'ang mang pa zhig byung / hor zla bdun pa'i chos brgyad la rigs lnga'i zab sku grub pa'i rab gnas byas shing / dge 'dun dang skye bo'i tshogs la dga' ston dang / rten mjal yang legs par btang / deng sang phal cig rab gnas byed zer nas/ bsnyen sgrub gang yang ma song ba'i 'chol nga/ 'ga' zhig 'tshogs/cho ga ma dag pa cig la gsang sgrogs gang yod yod byas/ dga' ston yin zer mi 'ga' zhig gis lkog zas grub pa dang / rten bzhengs mkhan rang la 'bul ba 'dra yong la re 'ing / rten mjal gtong na'ang mi rnams kha stong grong stong la thal ba phyu re gtong mkhan du mang ba 'dug ste/ nged kyis ni de 'dra ye ma byas/rten bzhengs che tsam re byas pa la/ der 'tshogs kyi dge 'dun dang skye bo la dga' ston ma byas pa med/ bsnyen sgrub ma byas pa cho ga la mi 'jug rab gnas dngos de gsang sgrogs su ma song ba rang byas/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i zab sku lnga ngo/ 'di dag la/ zhag nyer lnga tsam dang / nyi shu tsam dang / zla phyed tsam la re re grub pa sogs zla ba gsum lhag tsam gyi khongs su thams cad grub/mgyogs la legs pa bkra shis par byung / lo 'di nang cung ri bo che zhol pa skor thams cad kyang rang re'i 'og tu byung / sngar mi grog po rang tshos ya ri ma ri ci byed 'di byed med pa byas pa la don 'dor te thu stongs song / ston ser /spa de bla — 108—

ma 'gag pa grwa btsun lnga bcu skor dang bcas pa chos zhur byung / 'khrid gyi rkang sbyor ba yan lag drug pa btsugs te/ thog mar dge ba yan chad dbang khrid mtshams sogs cha tshang song ba yin na'ang jo nang pa rang gi phyag len gyi rgyun bzang po'i dam po 'jur la thebs pa de khong tshos byed mi nus de'i rdzu sob la 'khrid gnyer dgon yas mar gang ris kyi lag len rgyus dang myong ba yod pa rnams la ma bcol bar/ khong rang tsho'i sdebs kyi rgan pa 'ga' res byed zer mi nyan par 'dug swa lag zer dus mar phyogs su slar dam po byed pa la 'khrid gnyer lag len rgyu yod pa cig dgos par 'dug zer ba la snyad byed kyin 'dug ste/ lar rgyus yod par dgos na ka sngar myong yod pa cig la brten dgos pa yin te/ mi nyan pa la kha ta'i dper 'dug pas/ ngas kyang khong rang tsho'i 'dod thog tu bzhag pas/ khong tsho'i sbyor drug de zo gyo le ba cig las ma byung / yin ni rang gis rang la bslus gtong ba der 'dug gzhan 'dod chos than thun 'dra yang byas/ rtag brtan du yang sa lugs kyai rdor bka' babs bzhi/rdo rje gur rigs bsdus/ rngog lugs kyai rdor yab bka' yum bka' gur rigs bsdus sogs kyai rdor gyi dbang bka'i rigs phal cher dang / bsam mi khyab la sogs pa'i lam sgor 'dun gyi 'khrid dang bshad pa ngag thos nas byed pa dang / brgyad char gyi yig lung dang rngog lugs bsre 'pho dang / lam dgu skor gyi 'khrid deng sang lung rgyun shin tu dkon pa dgyes rdor gyi gzhung 'gre' chos sna sum cu rtsa dgur grags pa de rnams kyi lung yang byas/ de dag gi snga phyir chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams kyi 'bur sku khru tshang ma dang / lha khang sham bha tsho— 109—

la phu mda'i logs bris la sogs pa'ang tshar/ pad ma bkod dang bde ba can gyi mda'/ o rgyan mkha' spyod kyi mdo'i logs bris sogs kyang rim can du grub pa yin/ 'di dus kyang bzang ra ba'i lha babs te byung / lung bstan gyi khungs don tshan gsum byed kyin 'dug pa ni 'brug lo 'di yan la things po byung song / lar rang de 'dra'i rigs la nges nges ci 'tshal/ de bzhin du mgon khang chen mo'i logs bris/ mgon po 'khor mang 'di nyin zhag gsum la grub/nyin mo bas kyang mtshan mo srod la mdangs gsal bar byung 'dug spyir nged kyi mkhar las rten bzhengs byas pa 'di kun la las mi thams cad dwangs spro ba rang zhig 'ong / de res mgon khang gi logs bris 'di skabs kyang / ri mo ba rnams ngal dub kyang med cing / sdod nyin mi 'dod par 'phral du las ka la 'jug 'dod pa rang byung 'dug rtag brtan tshogs chen phyed langs kyis zla ba ngo re bzhin rnam rgyal 'joms kyi cho ga gtong ba la gzhi rkyen sogs kyang sbyor thub pa dang / mgon khang chen mo'i steng gi mgon khang la dpal ye shes kyi mgon po dra kad rigs mi 'dra ba du ma dang / dpal lha mo rigs mi 'dra ba du ma bzhengs shing / sngon ma yi dam khro bo'i rigs cig 'bri dgos snyam pa yod na'ang / 'phags pa bhu ga ma'i sku bzhengs na legs pa'i ltas cig byung nas/jo bo bhu gang gtso 'khor lnga pa bris/ de lo'i dus khrid hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i 'go la ka btsugs shing / de lo'ang 'khrid gsar pa gnyis brgya lhag nges shes pa byung / 'khrid lo'ang shin tu legs/ 'di dus rgam po sprul skus kyang dam po mdzad/ chos mang du gsan/ 'khrid grol mtshams la thog mar bsam grub — 110—

rtser yod dgos phebs pa cig byung na'ang / spyir lo de la sde pa rang gzhan mi chen dang mjal 'phrad mang po dgos pa'i dog cha sogs sel ba la gnas rten byin rlabs can mjal ba sogs sde srid rang 'di phyogs phebs na legs pa'i dge mtshan shar ba la brten nas/ de bzhin phul ba ltar hor zla gnyis pa'i nyer lnga la/ sde srid dpon g.yog bzab rgyas dang bcas pa rtag brtan du phebs/ snga ma theg lnga tsam las mi bzhugs pa'i rtsis su 'dug kyang / gnas mjal rten mjal rnam grangs mang ba dang / dbang dka' gsan dgos sogs kyis zhag bcu tsam bzhugs dgos byung / gzhan 'di 'dra'i rigs la rang 'dod kyi zhu don mang po dbu tshugs mu tshugs byed pa cig yod par 'dug ste/thugs sun par 'gro bsams/ zhu don cig kyang ma zhus dgon yas mar du rnyed bkur sogs kyang bzang rab gnang zhing / rtsang skor gyi sa ris thams cad bstan pa nam gnas bar sbyor 'jags su gnang ba yin/ dpon g.yog rnams yar phebs dus/ brag ram dang nye ba'i thad tsam la nam mkha' la 'ja' sprin rgya bya'i gzugs kyi rnam pa gsal po byung 'dug de yang chos bdag nags rgyal dgyes pa'i ltas su ni gsal/ snga sor bar skabs rten 'brel mang du 'chugs pa la de res 'dir phebs pa des la la sor chud 'dug des lo shas kyi sku dog kyang sel gda'/ mi chen 'gangs chen 'di lta bu phebs pa la mi 'khams byas pas mi rung bsams/ phebs gro dang 'bul gnad gang bzab rang byas/ sgro la gang yod mda' la skyon/ gzhan 'di na yon bdag rang la gzhogs slong byas nas/ yon bdag rang la 'dren pa skad byed mkhan tsho dang cung mi 'dra/ sde —111 —

bla mdzode kyi bdag po rgyal khams kha la 'debs pa tsho dang yang mi 'dra/ nged bya btang la yod do byas kyang ci yod/ med pa de kha mchog yin/ nor che yin skyug bro/ g.yog bu rta mang gin zhe myang / kha drag dbang che yin mgo gzhug log grwa rigs yon bdag mang gin yo tshad dmyal ba'i rgyu/ 'gro don 'phrin las yin zer thams cad sdug la gtod/ a re re a re re/ paṇḍita kriṣṭha bhanta yang bu lon byang skyid po byung ba'i drin dran nas yongs pa yin gsung lo snga ma'i nang du byung / swa ra su sti'i 'phros rgyang tsam dang / sdebs sbyor nyer bsdus dang /dbyangs can ma'i bstod pa cig bskur/ lha sa mjal/ zhwa dmar nag dang sde srid sar slong mo la byon/ nged kyis rnyed pa gang drag byas skabs 'dir li ti thub skyel ma btang nas rgya gar la thegs song / dpon g.yog rnams thugs rjes mi ring ba cig na/ rje paṇa chen dben rtsa nas kyang byang kha la phebs song ba la ja zhus 'bul mkhan btang / bar skabs der ngan song sbyong rgyud rang thang spyod rgyud lugs dang / yang rnal 'byor rgyud du bkral ba'i lugs kyi yig sna gsum po de brtsams/ dpal 'khor chos sde nas mkhan chen kun dga' lung rig pa yang phebs/ khong dpon slob rtag brtan tshogs par bcas pa la/rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dam tshig gsum bkod kyi dbang dang gzhan yang rigs gsum spyi dang / a ra pa tsa lha lnga sogs dbang bka' che chung ci rigs pa'ang byas/ khong rnams phyir phebs pa'i rjes su/ rang res sgrigs pa'i ston pa'i rnam thar chen mo de'i steng nas lung dang / ngag thog nas gtam rgyud rgyas pa/ lha so rbe'i rjes gnang mang rab dang bcas pa bshad/ gtsug lag khang — 112—

chen mo'i sgo khang gi sgo sgrigs kyi nang la/ sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan bkra shis rdzas brgyad 'bul mkhan gyi bkod pa dang klu'i rgyal po brgyad dang bcas pa bris/ khro rgyal lha khang gi gtsang khang du dgra gdonge 'jigs gsum gyi lha tshogs bka' srungs dang bcas pa dang / 'khyams su sgyu 'phrul dra ba las 'byung ba'i khro bo bcu/ gshed dmar la sogs pa dang / sgo khang du gdong brnyan bcu drugamagon khang du ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa dang / chos rgyal las gshin dmar nag 'khor bcas gzhan yang mgon po lcam dral gyi rigs mang rab dang bcas pa rnams kyang logs bris su grub/ g.yu lo'i lha khang dang / so ra ni'i steng spron pa sogs kyang snga phyir rim gyis byas/ sngar sman chu lus la 'phrod par yong gin yod pa/ 'phrod du re nas dings su phyin phu lu'i sman chu de zhag gsum tsam 'thungs te/ lus yang ba sogs kyi phan yon cung zad byung yang / rlung khams la shin tu gnod par byung / hor zla lnga pa'i nang du chos lung byang rtser 'gro rtsis yin pa/ 'gro bar myos pa rang la ltas shin tu 'chub pa zhig byung nas/ 'gro ba bshol dgos byung / de 'phral rmi ltas dang bstun/ bde mchog pho brang du mgon po'i bskangs gso byed mkhan btang / phyogs der 'gro ba la bar du gcod pa'i gdug pa can 'ga' re thul 'gro ba'i ltas kyang byung / de nas zla ba bdun pa la yang jo nang du mtshams me bar bsngad/ mchod gzhis khog gi khyu 'dzin thams cad dang / sha yong mang po zhig gtsug lag khang so so'i dkar me'i thes su bstan pa nam gnas sbyar sdig rgyun dge bar bsgyur/ brgyad pa'i 'go nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs kyi bshad pa chen po rtsom pa'i — 113 —

dbu tshugs/ zla ba de kha'i nang du phal cher grub/ de'i 'phros de ka la zla ba dgu pa'i nang du dkyil chog gi rnam bshad kyang rdzogs par bris/ spyir nged kyi srol la rtsom pa che ba re byed 'dod yod na/ snga srol nas dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ khyad par sngags phyogs la chos skor de kha dang 'brel pa'i lhag pa'i lha la mchod pa rgyas pa phul zhing gsol ba btab nas gnang ba zhu/snang ba'i mtshan ma dngos byung ba'ang yod/ gang ltar ltas bzang nges pa byung na rtsom pa de la 'jug pa cig byed kyin yod/ 'di res kyang de skabs snang ba thob pa ni yin kyang / sngon med pa'i legs bshad gsar pa'ang spro rgyu yod cing /log rtog du ma'ang 'joms rgyu yod pa'i stabs dang / chos rang yang gzhan thams cad pas bka' gnyan pa'i stabs yin par 'dug rtsom pa'i ring la cho 'phrul 'tshub cha che bar byung / bar skabs cig tshig don rnam grangs mang po blo la khra gsal le bsngogs nas yod 'phro la/ khebs bkab pa bzhin du yud re gang yang mi dran pa'i rnam par 'gro ba yang lan 'ga' re byung / srung 'khor gyi pre zhad pa song mtshams kyi skabs shig dam chos gling gi 'og gi rmig chung de na yi ge 'bri yin yod pa'i snga dro cig phyi logs nas bud med shin tu che ba/gdong gi dpangs la'ang khru gsum tsam yod pa/ skra kham pa gyen du brdze sa pa cig nged la cher gyi blta ba dang / he he lags zhes gad mo rgod pa'i tshul byed pa cig mngon gsum du byung / dkyil chog gi bshad pa'i phyed tsam song ba na/cho 'phrul 'tshub 'gyur rnams sangs shing / rig pa gsal la bde ba byung /lar 'di'i skabs su thog ma lus la gnyan lhog gi 'bu ru thebs shing / de —114—

sangs nas shu ba rgya chen po dang / pags pa'i cha rnams las chu ser kha dog shin tu nag pa 'dzag pa'i lus mi bde ba'i rnam pa byung zhing / de'i 'phros dus 'khrid ran ran bar du ma grag 'khrid 'dzugs khar nyin cig la grag song / lo 'di'i ston g.yu lo so so ra ni dang bcas pa'i sa rdo'i mkhar las rnam grub pa yin/ de mtshams cig sde srid gong ma de'i gdung zhus 'bul dgos pa 'dug pas/ bsam 'grub rtse la yong dgos tshul phebs pa ltar mi ring bar rtse phyogs su phyin/ zla ba gnyis lhag tsam sdod dgos byung / 'di skabs rje chos dbyings rdo rjes sde srid la mu tig srubs ma'i phyag 'phreng zhig gnang 'dug pa la byin rlabs gyis shig gsung ba ltar byin rlabs byed kyin yod tsa na/ 'dul lung na lha spyin gyi lho phyogs pa'i skyogs mkhan la mu tig gi do shal srang brgya stong re ba byin ces pa de yang 'di 'dra cig yin pa 'dug pa snyam pa cig wal wal byung /yin yang yin pa 'dug hong zla bcu pa'i tshes bdun la sku gdung zhus 'bul byas pa yin/ de skabs me rang 'bar lta bu dang / nam mkha' 'ja' sprin legs pos khebs shing / steng thad rang la 'ja' 'od sgor mo sogs kun gyis mthong ba de yin/ 'ga' zhig me tog gi char 'dug kyang zer/ gang ltar na'ang phyi nang gi ltas thams cad legs par 'dug lha'am mi mchog gi skye ba brnyes par thag chod/ skrur ston la'ang dge 'dun gyi zhabs tog ni rgya che rab gnang song / brag dmar mkhan po sogs rang re'i slob ma 'ga' la chos thor tsam bshad/ sde srid rang du dbang bka' rjes gnang sngar khyud ltar rnam grangs mang tsam phul/ slar yang yar yongs/ byang chen sa mtho zhing / dgun dus kyi grang — 115 —

reg che bas 'gro mi thub par byas nas/ rin chen gling du yongs/ byang chen tshogs pa spyi dang yang phrad mdo 'jam dbyangs tshul bzang pa rang re'i slob ma chos dang mthun pa nyams myong bzang ba yin/ na tshod shin tu mtho bas da res min pa phyis mi 'phrad par go bas/ ched gtad khong dang phrad pa'i phyir yin/ yar lam shun zhabs drung gis shog gsung nas rog tsho la 'gro rtsis yin yang / shel dkar gyi ltag tsam de nas ltas log ste/ de 'phral dgongs grol zhu mkhan btang / bre gong gi thad der byin rlabs zhu mkhan 'ga' re byung ba'i bud med cig gi mgo la me tog dmar po phor chen tsam zhig 'dug de nas de gdong mdog mi 'dra ba 'phral 'phral 'gyur zhing 'gro ba zhig phyi mig blta zhing song / zhing gi rnam par zhig yin par 'dug /phyis de mthong ma byung / de nub bal mdar bsnyegs/ zhabs drung o rgyan mtsho mo'i sprul sku'i gsung shog dang /phyag g.yog rab 'byams pa rin chen chos gri khar rkyen lam du 'das pa'i bsngo rten sogs byung / rtag brtan du zhag bzhi bsdad nas dpal gyi jo nang du dus khrid tshugs/ de lo yang 'khrid gsar pa lo snga ma dang 'dra rung mang bar byung zhing / 'khrid lo yang shin tu legs de nas dus khrid grol 'phral glang lo hor zla dang po'i nang du rtag brtan du sleb par byas/ zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gsum nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos btsugs te/ chos bzang gi chos grwar rdo rje gdan gyi khri thog nas/ rang res brtsams pa'i sgrub dkyil gyi bshad pa de kha'i 'dzug khrid dang mtha' gcod don bsdu rgyas pa chos thun shin tu che ba re tshogs pa byings la bshad/ chos thun de grol 'phral sngar sbyor drug gi dam po byed myong —116—

ba bzhi brgya skor la bkod pa mtha' yas su sbyor ba yan lag drug pa 'i 'khrid tshul yongs su rdzogs pa'i dmigs pa'i chos thun zhib po re yang byas/ chos thun gnyis po de tshar rting ma nas dgongs skyog par thub pa sha stag byung / tshul de kas sa ga'i sgrub mchod tshugs kyi bar la/ mngon rtogs kyi bshad pa yongs rdzogs dang / dkyil chog gi phyed cam song / de'i 'phros de sgrub mchod grol nas byas/ de mtshams pha drug spa lung ba'i bla ma ngag dbang pa'i sku skye ba/ rkyen glo bur ba chu la shor nas grongs/ chos kyi mgo sgang la lhun grub sgang pa nyi ma lags dang/ khong tsho'i sa mna' ma drung mo 'das pa'i rjes sgrub kyi rnam grangs la 'di'i dge 'dun rnams la rnyed bkur bzang po rang byung / bo dong spo mthon pa'i bla ma sngags pa chos rje tshe ring ba yang / snga sor yun ring po nas na mo'i rnam 'gyur sna tshogs rang cig bstan/ de skabs khong ma 'tsho ba'i dge 'dun la rnyed bkur sogs kyang byung / de nas chos mtshams zla phyed tsam zhig ka byas nas/ yang sngar gyi rgyun 'du khang du tshogs chen la/ rang res sgrigs pa'i zung 'jug rab gsal gyi 'dzug khrid dang / der ma 'dus pa'i spyi dom mtha' gcod zhib bshad du byas shing / dam po zhu myong ba rnams la rtags tshad dang ngo sprod phyi nang pa'i gegs sel sogs mtha' rgyas rang tshang bar byas/ /wo 'di rang chos 'phel zhing blo skyed che la/ rnam g.yeng chung bas zos bde ba rang re'i nyams myong yang bogs che ba zhig byung / lo 'di nang du zab yangs kyi phyed tsam bde yangs ci rigs dang bcas pa/ g.yu lo dang / sau ra ni skor gyi logs bris 'phags ma sgrol ma'i 'bur sku dang bcas pa bzhengs grub/ gtsug lag khang

chen mo'i par khang steng du lha khang byas te/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma sngo ljang gi gser sku mi tshad che ba/ rgyab yol yang gser zangs sogs las sgrubs/rab gnas dang / rab ston sogs kyang dkyus bzhin gal chung ngu ma song ba byas/ ston kha dpal legs ldan ye shes 'phrin las zung du 'jug pa'i mgon po lcam dral ga bor bcas kyi zab sku/ sku tshad kyang mi chung zhing rgyu tshogs phun sum tshogs pa las bzhengs thub/ lcam dral gnyis la zab sku so sor yod/'di phal cher grub pa'i skabs/ bzo bo tshos thog mthil la bkram nas sgrig tshom 'dra byed pa'i skabs/ nam mkha' nas 'bras bu'i char babs pa/ der 'tshogs thams cad kyi mthong 'dug rab gnas byas pa'i skabs kyang shin tu zil che ba'i rnam 'gyur byung / de dag gi snga phyir mgon po lcam dral gyi gser sku rta ba mda' tshad pa gnyis kyang bzhengs nas u tsa lar bzhugs pa yin/ de lo zar chos 'khor bde chen gyi logs bris kyang grub/ 'di skabs bsam 'grub rtse la 'bod mi gnang byung ba ltar chu byang kha brgyud nas phyin/ rtser sleb pa'i dgongs mo gangs chen po ri klung med khyab pa cig byung / dge ba'i mtshan ma cig yin par ni 'dug lo snga ma byi lo rtser phyin dus/ dpal rab kyi yin 'dug nga/'i sngags thang nyi shu skor cig ston pa'ang gnang / de kha'i 'dra nga zhus rung ba rnam/sa de lugs dang / bsgyur dgos dang de na med pa'i kha bskongs dgos pa rnams la bris yig cig dgos gsung pa ltar zhib por bris/ glang lo de rnams bzhengs pa'i dgongs brtad nges pa rang gnang gin 'dug na'ang /glang lo'i skabs 'dir 'go rtsom tsam cig mdzad/ thugs rtog bskur mkhan — 118—

—pyung ba yin nam ci yin rung / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs tsam bzhag nas/ bka' rgyud pho khrom tshar gnyis bzhengs pa mdzad 'dug tsan dan skye la khad la sred de mar 'gyur gda'/ dang po nor bu khyung rtse ba rnams gnas brtan bcu drug la rnam rtog byed pa dang / nyang stod gzhung na mar yang sngags sku bzhengs na 'a rmya yong zer ba'i kha skad ngan pa cig 'dug /da rna mchog tu khyer ba'i snga sor nas bod gong ba sogs mang po'ang yol thang tshun chod la sngags sku 'di 'tshub grags pas sngags sku med pa rang cig dgos zer gyin 'dug de 'dra'i rigs cig 'di res kyang byung ba 'dra/ spyir gsang sngags nang gi lha bzhengs skabs/ skal med khrom du tshogs pa'i dkyil min pa cig tu dgos/mchod gtor dang tshogs 'khor byung na dgos pa'i yan lag yin/ gzhan ni mi 'phrod pa yin don med/ cis kyang med kyi yong gin yod na/ yang na bzhengs mkhan sbyin bdag rang dam tshig nyams pa yin/ yang na ras chog dang rab gnas byed mkhan gyi bla ma de rang dam nyams cig yin pa yin yod/ sngags sku bkra mi shis zer ba 'di kho rang tsho spyin bdag la dam tshig med/ bla ma la byin rlabs med pa'i wa skad shor ba la nyams chen yin rgyu'i khungs byas pa der 'dugade min sngags sku bzhengs na tshe ring nad med longs spyod 'phel/ dbang thang rgyas gdon gyi gnod pa zhi/ dgra thul/ phugs sangs rgyas thob/ sku gzhan las phan yon brgya 'gyur gyi che ba lags mod/ lar da lta bstan pa shin tu nyams pa'i dus yin/ theg pa gzhan rnams thos bsam gyi go ba dang bag chags 'jog pa tsam yin/ lag len mig ltos dang / sgrigs bkod pa dgos — 119—

———pa tsam dang / blo chos la bskul byed sogs lam gyi yan lag dang spyod rnga ni/ jitshul la gal che mod/ gsang sngags dang ma 'brel na/ de dag gis ce༅ gnad du 'gro ba cig kyang mi yong / gsang sngags mi byed na sgrol ma dang mtshan brjod kyang ma 'don/ ma ṇi yang ma bgrong / gtor ma btang nas kyang ci byed/ tshe dbang yang ma zhu/ mdos gtor rgyag rim gro sogs byas nas kyang ci phan/srung ba srung mdud sogs btags nas kyang gang byed/ khyed tsho la gsang sngags kyi dra dri dgos rgyu min pa la/ de tsho gsang sngags kyi dum bu rkyang pa yin pa/ 'o bla ma'i gsol 'debs bya ba de yang gsang sngags pa kho na la dgos pa yin/yi dam bsgom bzlas dang / chos skyong srung ma bsten zer ba de yang gsang sngags kho na la yod ba yin/ nor lha bsten zer ba de yang gsang sngags pa kho na nas yod ba yin/ tshe sgrub zer ba de yang gsang sngags 'ba' zhig yin/mdo rkyang pa la de 'dra'i sgros mi yong / sbru sbru sbru/ don la 'di ltar yin te/sngags skur rab gnas can byung na/ nag phyogs kyi 'dre rnams skrag cing 'jigs pa skye/ kla klo sogs nag phyogs kyi mtha' dmag kyang bzlog pa yin/glo bo lo tsā bas rje sa skya paṇḍi ta la dri ba phul ba'i dri lan gyi yi ge de la ltos/de ngas brtsams pa min/ de tsa na sngags sku bzhengs kyi dogs nas 'di la 'tshub yong ngo zhes gdug 'dres bsgrags pa'i gtam de/ mi bsod zad rnams kyi snying la 'babs pa der 'dug cha cig tu na sngags sku'i skor 'di tsam 'gangs chung / sngon gyi sgrub rgyud rnams nyams nas/ da bshad rgyud du 'gro ba'i dus yin zer byung la ngo so byed kyin 'dug byung na sgrub rgyud rang dgos te — 120—

bshad rgyud du 'gyur phyin chad la/ gsang sngags kyi nyan bshad du song na grag ste/ sngags pa'i nyan bshad kyi mtha' de sgrub pa la rang shugs kyis reg 'gro ba'i phyir ro theg chen mdo lugs kyi nyan bshad rkyang pa la song na/ sngon dus mdo lugs kyi sgrub grwa ma nyams pa'i dus yin rma ta nyan bshad kyi mtha' sgrub pa ru 'gro bas grag ste/ deng sang de'i sgrub rgyud chad/ yang theg chen gyi sgrub rgyud theg dman gyi nyan bshad du song na ni ji ltar yin rigs pas dpyod/ de tsho'ang chos yin pas re zhig phar zhog la brjod gling bor/ rtog ge sogs phyi'i rig gnas la btsal du bton pa de/ 'di rnams chos rang cig yin rgyu yan med/ de 'dra la bshad rgyu dang lung gi dus kyi tha snyad kyang yi rang mi yong de rnams chos kyi bsam pas zin na chos yin snyam na/ byang chub kyi sems kyis zin na ta/ lto za ba yang chos su 'gro ba cig ta yod de/ lar gyi lto za ba chos yin pa 'dug ge byang chub kyi sems bya ba sgra bo che cig gda' ba de ni/ dus deng sang yul gang na ma su la yod yin/ mthong ni gang na'ang ma mthong yod ni yod yong / dus deng sang byin rlabs sam/ ting nge 'dzin nam/ nus mthu phan yon 'dra chen po ta su la'ang mi 'dug ste/ gang yod tshad ni gsang sngags kho na'i sku drin yin/ gzhan tsho'i drod yal nas da yun rings song / 'ga' zhig na re/ rang re tsho gsang sngags kyi snod yin pa kog de las 'di tsam brling zer te/ de lta kog ste/ de las kyang mdo lugs theg chen dang / rang rgyal dang / nyan thos kyi chos tshun chod kyi snod yin pa yang shin tu dka'/ rgyu mtshan ni deng sang dpe med yin pa'i khungs byas pa tsho yang / nyan thos kyi sdom — 121 —

pa rags rim re la'ang gnas mi thub pa'i phyir ro/ /des na chos de ched du gsungs pa'i gdul bya'i dbang du byas na/ deng sang gi mi rnams phal cher mdo sngags gang gi yang snod ma yin/ theg pa gsum po gang gi yang gdul bya ma yin mod/ thos pa tsam gyis skal ba yod pa'i dbang du byas nas bag chags 'jog pa la thams cad kyi snod du rung tsam yod pas sngags kyi'ang yin/ da lta yod pa'i chos rnams la ltos na/ gsang sngags kyi chos kyis bag chags khyad par can 'jog nus/ chos gzhan rnams deng sang nus pa chung / ting nge 'dzin dang byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan yang / sngags la da lta'ang cung zad tsam yod gzhan tsho la mi gda' ba/ bstan pa'i srog rtsa gsang sngags la thug kyang 'di la gal chung byed pa ni/ bdud rigs kyi 'dre rnams kyis mgo skor chen po rang btang ba zhig ste/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyams pa'i rgyu mthar thug pa yin no/ /de yin pa'i sems can kyi bde skyid tshang ma nyams pa'i rgyu'o/ /yang sgra tshad la bslabs pa'i mthar thug phyag chen la skyel ba yin zer/ phyag chen de chos nas gsungs pa de la zer ba de yin na ni khyod kyi zer rigs 'di khyi lud 'bad pas bsdus nas gser sku bzhengs zer ba dang 'dra/ chos nas gsungs pa de min na gang dga' ci dgar zad/ 'on kyang yong ste mi yong tha snyad 'ba' zhig la rtog dpyod byas pas/ ma bcos so ma yong na/ shar phyogs su bong ba phye mar brdungs pas/ nub phyogs su rdo rdog po yong bar thal bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang gong ma kun legs pa spyo ba'i kha rjes 'brangs te/ phyag chen dang ka ma la shwe la'i lugs gcig zer ba sogs rgyal po dmangs su 'bebs pa mang — 122—

ngo 'dug ste/ kā shi'i lugs dang gcig pa la ha las rgyu ye med/ gcig pa'ang rtags ma grub/ de tsho 'dir bra ga la 'a/nga ngo / /'di skabs gsang phu nas gling stod zhabs drung gis/ nged la thugs gtod pa mdzad pa 'i snye thang bde ba can gyi chos/ sde dang / chos rdzong cha lag dang bcas pa nged la sbyor ba mdzad/'bas/ drung rang sku bzhugs kyi bar khong rang gis mdzad dgos zhus pa ltar mdzad/ sde srid nas rgyab gnon sbyor 'jags kyang gnang / gling stod rin po che 'di/ grwa sa thub bstan rnam rgyal ba yin/ nged dang mjal ma myong yang / ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bzhes su gyur/ rang dang snga sor nas 'brel ba dang / grwa rigs grogs mched mang po zhig ni dri log ste sdod par 'dug ste/ kho rang tsho ma phud na nged rang skad rgyag gin 'gro ba la khyad tsam mi ga da'o / /rang gis smras pa'i lta grub mi 'dzin/ gzhan gyi chos skad rkyang ba kha la 'khyer/ rnyed bkur dang bza' (rgyu 1byung na slob ma yin zer bas ‘sna du zhing rjes la 'brang / khag ngan 'khur dgos dang dka' las yong grabs 'dug na 'khor mi thebs/ chos rang la zhus nas mos gus gzhan la sgom zhen gzhan la mthen pa'i 'byung—dro/dge bshes kyi rigs de ma 'khor ba rang dga' ba 'dug go /bka' brgyud pa snga ma tsho'i gsung las/ lar brgyud pa mi 'dzin pa'i slob ma mi chen rang stong phrag cig las/ brgyud pa 'dzin der shes pa'i slob ma sprang po cig kyang dga'/thun mong ba brgya las/ thun mong min pa cig dga'/ brgyud pa zin nges yod na gcig las mi yong kyang / de'i phyir du tshogs pa skyong rin chog gsung ba cig 'dug pa/ bka' rgyud pa'i sgom chen gong cheg/ 'ji/ tsho thugs lhus thing pa'i gsung — 123 —

bgros gtan tshigs can rang yin pa 'dug ngas dran pa'i dus na ka rje grol mchog la chos kyi bka' drin dpag tu med pa thob pa de 'dra 'ga' re 'dug pa tsho kha nas mos mos 'dra ya nga / snying nas gzhan lugs kho na la zhen 'then/rje btsun rang gi gdan sa'am thun mong ma yin pa'i bu chen grwa rigs bstan pa'i sar rgyu nor lta ci smos kha phan tshig phan tsam yang lar nas mi byed pa de 'dra ka gda'/ 'di la 'u cag gis kyang nges shes rang cig rnyed byung ngo / /'di skabs brag dmar mkhan pom la spyong rgyud kyi skor rnams 'dzug khrid cig bshad/ sde srid du yang sngar 'khyud ltar gyi dbang bka' rjes gnang thor bu pa rnam grangs mang ba dang / khyad par du thar pa'i dge 'dun rnams la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dgos rgyur sde srid nas kyang bka' bkod phebs byung ba/ thog ma/ra sde srid rang gi dbang bskur yongs rdzogs gsan/ de nas thar pa ba thams cad dang / dpon ris 'ga' shas sogs gzhan yang ci rigs bsnan pas nyis brgya skor la dus kyi snyen ra lo'i dbang mo che byas/ brgyad stong pa brgya tshar/ba po' 'gyur tshar gsum tsam/ sku rim thang ga mang rab dang bcas pa la dkyil 'khor de kha'i steng nas rab gnas kyang byas/ 'jag pa sprul sku kun dga' bkra shis pa'i sku skye yang ngos 'dzin byas/ chos sgor zhugs pa'i de dus nas yar rtag brtan du phebs pa yin/ de lo sog po thub pa thal chi lha sar sleb skabs yin pas/ sog po'i rigs sde pa la mjal ma/khan mang po 'dugastod skor chos rje tsho gnyis yod 'dug pa'i/ gcig gi nye gnas dbon po zer ba cig nged la'ang 'phrad du byung / rang re'i grwa rigs sog yul la phyin pa — 124—

bsod nams dbang phyug dang / jo nang pa rang gi grwa rigs khams nga 'dra yang 'byor/ lo 'di'i snga ma dang lo 'di gnyis kar la ser tshogs nyi ma gsum/ pa re mdzad kyin 'dug de skabs ser tshogs 'bi/ ma babs spyi rim yin kyang / ra lung pa'i byang kha bzlog phyir yin pas/ rang res bzlos pa'i nga/migs nga/ byed/ dgos gsung ba ched brtad rab brtan pa sogs gsung skyor mkhan re byung /sems la ni dgos pa ci yin nam snyam pa byung / ra lung ba'i byad kha de tsam rang cang med dam zer ba re zhus// 'di skabs yar yong du nye ba na/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rig pa 'dzin pa rtsen ma'i byin rlabs cig 'bul rgyu'i sgrub mchod 'dzugs grabs la/ rgyu ra'i dkyil 'khor sdib nas nang mchod kyis bkrus pa 'dra ba cig byung / dang po sman thang blo bzang pa la'ang de 'dra cig byung ba 'tshub char mngon tsam 'dug cing / 'di yang cung zad de 'dra yin par sems/yar lam yang byang kha la ka yongs/ bon ngo/ chal thang nas mkha' ru'u bar du rlung 'tshub mi bzad ba rang byung / de nub khams kyang ma bde de'i ltas ni 'phral du shar/ de res rtag brtan du zhag gsur tsam bsdad nas/ bcu gnyis pa'i zla ba dkar ba la ri khrod chen po'i dus chos tshugs pa tsam byas/glang lo'i nang der gro khor dpon drung phyogs nas gzhan bskul ba'i bsam ngan mthu gtad sogs byas pa'i ltas 'ga' re byung bas/ rtser 'gro gong spyin sreg sogs phyir bzlog 'ga' zhig byas/ phar bzlog pa'i rtags skabs 'dir mngon sum du grub/ khong gi bu tsha nyag nyog rnams nyal gyis song lo 'di la'ang khrid gsar sngar khyud ltar mang ba dang / bla ma slob dpon grag pa 'ga' res — 125—

kyang khrid zhus/ de nas stag lo gsar/ de rjes mi ring bar thob rgyal nas lcam gting skyes na bzhugs mkhan de yang glo bur du gshegs/ yin ni brag dkar mgon po'i bka' chad rang yin pa 'dug ma phyogs kyi rgyal zhud yin zer ba cig kyang 'dug sde/ pha ma dang / bu dang / bla rma/'i phyogs nas srog 'phrog ma rdo ba na byung na de ka/ shin tu phung 'dug gang na'ang gting skyes nas nged la 'bod mkhan gnang byung na'ang 'gro ni ma thub/ 'di kha'i dgon yar mar du dgongs rdzogs kyi sku skal sogs phyis skyel ba mdzad byung / skabs 'di dag tu rang re'i dge sbyor 'char chul la bogs kyi cha ni cher 'phel ba zhig byung /de yang 'dir smras pa/ sna tshogs gzu gas dang sna tshogs sgra/ /sna tsho shes dri dang sna tshogs ro/ /sna tshogs reg bya sna tshogs chos/ de dag rang gzugs lhan cig skyes/ 'i de ltar nā gsaX pa nā/ /bstan yod lhan skyes dang por shar/ /rang gzugs lhan skyes gnyis pa yin/ /des mtshon mthong bya kun yang rig /'dir ni gzugs la mtsho'i pa ste/ /gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar gyi ni/ chos rnams thams cad de dang 'dra/ /skyo med gnas na sa rdo med/ /tshul 'di gsal bar rig pa yang / /bar du dge ba'i mtshan ma yin/ /sna tshogs rdo rje ye shes rim/ /sems la dmigs pa'ang 'di yin no/ /zung 'jug thob ces 'ud gog mi 'thag ste/ /rdo rje 'chang ni kun la khyab par bzhugs/ /rdzun med nges can yin na 'dis kyang chog /'dra rung sgro 'dogs tsam la snying po ci/ /ces so/ /— 126—

'di skabs mtshan mo'i ma dus su dmigs pa brtad res kyi rlung a wa ga tir 'gags pa'i rtags kyang 'char zhing / gtum mo'i 'bar snang gis 'khore lo rnams 'khor ba dang / rtsa gnas thams cad g.yo zhing mi shigs pa'i 'od zer kun tu khyab pa'i bde nyams dang bcas pa/ stong pa'i sgra sna tshogs pa'i 'char tshul la/ thog rol mo'am glu dbyangs la sogs par snang ba de/ 'jug tu tshig don can gyi sgra sna tshogs su 'gyur ba zhag re bzhin rtag par 'ong ba zla shas byung / ji zhig ltar nas snang ba de yang gzhan du gyur/ de yang rang bzhin 'pho 'gyur med pa la/ snang cha 'pho 'gyur ltar 'char ba 'di/ sa steng nas zla ba 'phel 'grib la ltas pa dang 'dra'o/ /zhes bshad pa der 'dug rgyud gzhung rnams las rdo brag skud pa'i dpe dang / dngul chu'i dpe dang / ro mchog btung ba sbyar ba yi/ zhes sogs dpe'i ye shes las don gyi ye shes ngo 'phrod cing gsal bar rtog tshul cig gsungs 'dug pa de la/ da lta thams cad la go ba thun mongs su 'char tshul cig 'dug pa/ 'di 'dras phyogs su mi 'gro ba'i go ba 'char tshul dang nges shes cig kyang skyes/ sngar rgya bod 'di na gsang sngags la mang du thos pa'i dpyod ldan rnams/ gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs kyi chos skad dang / sems 'grel skor gsum gyi chos skad 'gal lo snyam pa de phal cher la snang / de'i nang nas la la mi 'dra ba thad sor 'jog zer/ la la cig dgongs pa can dang / cig shos nges don du 'dod/ kha cig bskyed rim sngon du 'gro bar dgongs pa cig zer/ kha cig zab gsal dbyer med la dgongs pa cig zer te/ skabs gzhan tsho la 'gal spong byed rgyu med kyang yod — 127—

ma dag gi zog 'jog byed par 'dug go /bdag gis ni sngar nas kyang 'gal med du go mod kyi/ skabs 'dir nyams cig la/ grol thig gi dmigs pa rnams gsal snang shar ba cig gis rkyen byas nas 'jam dpal zhal lung dang sems 'grel skor gsum dgongs pa gcig pa la blo gros nam langs pa dang nyi ma shar ba 'dra ba cig skyes so/ /sgom pa las byung ba'i shes rab bag tsam yin par byed lags/ kha cob rang song shas che ste/ nga la ni shob 'di yin gtan tshigs can 'di yin bya ba med par thams cad mnyam khad de bud pa 'di byung nas yun ring song ngo / /rdo rje gzhe nu'i dkyil chog 'khyer bde ba brgyud pa kun 'dus zhig dang / gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor rab 'byams kyi sgrub thabs dang / dam tshig gsum bkod kyi dkyil chog rnams brtsams/ rtag brtan du chos than thun 'dra yang bshad/ byang stag lung du rje rin po che ngag dbang rnam rgyal glang lo'i ston tsam na sku ltems/ yin ni chos pa nang gi chags sdang la rten pa'i gsol zas ngan pa'i rigs cig rang yin 'dug sman pa rnams ni gsal bor mi smra ba'i rib se ba byed de/ gnong la phog nas dbang po ches tsar byas dogs su 'dug bar skabs der 'di tshor yang bka' shog gsung 'phrod yang yang gnang byung / sku rim dang brtan bzhugs sogs kyi rten 'brel yang 'ga' re byas mod/ zhag shas re phan pa'i ngo cung zad re ma gtogs phugs phan pa rang ma byung / sku rim rten 'brel gyi khyad par 'ga' zhig ni thugs su ma bde dogs snyan du 'bul yang ma nus/ gang ltar na'ang skyes bu dam pa bstan pa'i rtsa lag khyad par can de/ bsnyung yun rings ba'i — 128—

mthar/ skabs der zhabs pad ma brtan par/ yon mchod zhal bzhugs rnams kyis nged la 'bod mi bka' nan can phebs byung na'ang rang re snga sor rta lug mtshams su na ba nas bzung / lus stobs je ngan je ngan du thal ba'i thag ring 'gro ba'i nus pa mi 'dug pa dang / a ma drung yang 'di phyogs bzhugs pa bgres shing sku gcong ba/ bsnyung gzhi drag po de 'dra'ang yang yang thog babs yong pa cig 'dug pas/ bsam rtse tsam du 'gro ba la yang kha med ma gtogs/blo shin tu 'tshab pa cig yong gin yod/ khong rnams kyang ma phyogs nas thon pa'ang 'gyangs/ lam du'ang 'gor ches/ ci ste nged 'gro bar shar yang / lus ngan pas 'grul thag ring ba shang na ni na yong ba zhig yin pas/ sku tshigs khongs su sleb pa'i re ba mi 'dug ltas cig kyang ma chug nas/ spyir gal che zhing / sgos su bla ma'i phyi yin yang / /rigs pa yis ni mi nus na/ /mi nus de/ ni tshig gis sbyangs/ /zhes gsungs pa de byed dgos par byung / khong tsho log 'gro ba dang lhan du/ ma phyogs su mchod 'bul zhabs tog gang drag 'bul mkhan ched bstan brdzangs/ yar yang thugs dam gsal 'debs kyi rten gnang byung / de nas rtag brtan gyi tshogs par phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po dang / gtum po lha mang gi dbang bskur zhig byas/ 'khor lo chen po'i rgya gzhung bco brgyad sogs kyi lung dang / bskyed rdzogs kyi 'khrid rnying pa srung ba bzhi ldan dang / rnal 'byor bzhi ldan de zugad/ rang re'i theg mchog dbu ma'i gzhung gi le'u lnga pa'i phyed yan tsam gyi zhib khug da byas/ 'di skabs snga phyir lhun grub sgang pa tshor sde pas bka' skyon byung ba dang / de rjes rgong dkar — 129—

zhabs drung sne gdong rtser phebs pa'i skabs sogs yin/ sos ka de dgos phyed gang yin ni mi shes/ bsam 'grub rtse nas 'bod mi zhig kyang gnang byung ste/ spyi babs bde 'gros rang du 'dug cing / bya byed 'di dgos kyang cang mi 'dug lo dus kyi dbang chos ni ma ran/ chos kyi sgang rang du song bas de res dgongs grol zhus/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba tshe dpag med kyi sku brnyan mi tshad mi chung tsam rgyab yol dang bcas pa'i gser sku bzhengs grub cing /gzugs bzhugs 'bul ba'i nyin yang / char cung zad babs/ rab gnas nang ma byas pa'i dgongs char shin tu che ba byung / rab gnas dga' ston sngar 'byud ltar sgrubs pa la yang char chen po babs/ sos char dkon dkon 'dra ba'i dus la de rnams byung bas tshe dpag med bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs su mtshan gsol/ da lta'ang sku khrus phul na char 'bebs pa la bsngags par yod pa 'di yin/ hor zla drug pa'i tshes nyi shu la/ a ma drung shin tu bsnyung pas/ chos 'phro bzhag nas ri khrod du phyin/ mun tshab tshub la sleb/ de'i nyin mo shin tu bsnyung ba la/ da lta rang tshogs mchod cig gyis gsung ba dang gangs ri dkar pos bskor ba'i yul skyid po cig na/ gdan 'dren pa yin zer ba'i mi dkar po gsum byung 'byon pa'i grabs yod pa la/ bzhugs zer mkhan cig byung nas/ gsum po de nas de ring phebs mi thub pa 'dug gnangs bzhes cig gdan 'dren la yong zer ba mnal lam ma yin par gsal snang dgos su byung 'dug ngas sleb dus thog ma rang ngo yang mi mkhyen pa ltar 'dug kyang / de 'phral la thugs rig dwangs su song / ngo mkhyen nas gsung gleng 'dra yang mdzad — 130—

byung / bsnyung ba'i rkyen grib yin pa 'dra bas/ de'i sang nas sku khrus tshe dbang gtor dbang sogs rim can du phul/ sku khams skyed legs po byung / snga sor bsnyung tshabs ches pas zla gcig skor ni 'phros de ka bsnyung / de rjes bde bar byung / de dus sde srid du ja 'dren la sde pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan btang / yang dgong gtad gang yin yang / don lhag po cang med pa la/ dpal de nas 'bod mi la gnang byung ste/ a ma lags bsnyung ba rang dang thug pas 'gro ni ma thub/ 'di skabs kyang chos lung byang rtse la 'gro 'dod cig yod de bshol dgos par byung / dbyar smad ri khrod chen po'i lha khang bde ba can la zhig gsos cung zad dang / dam chos gling du nyi 'od dang rab gsal cig brtsigs/yang 'di skabs snga sor chung chung gi dus su rtag brtan gyi zur rdo che shos te skyel mkhan yin pa 'dug 'dir chos byas nas lo gnyis tsam lon pa zhing gi mkha' 'gro ma yin lā ma rnal 'byor ma'i rigs nges pa'i rtags mtshan can cigagason po'i dus su mi gzhan gyi ngo ma shes/ skabs 'di'i sngon tsam la spyod pa ma legs zer nas dgon pa'i las tshan tshos gnas nas skrod pa'i rtsis dang chad pa 'dra yang byas/ des rten 'brel 'chugs nas/ hong zla bdun pa'i chos bcu gnyis la glo bur du 'das/ mkha' 'gro lha srin rnams 'khrugs pa'i 'tshub shin tu che ba byung / de kha la bzhag na phu mda' gnyis su god chen po 'ong bar 'dug nas/ de'i sel sbyangs la bzlas brjod dang mchod gtor mang po zhag bdun gyi ring la byas pas 'jam nyal gyis song nas/ phyi kyang 'chub cha ci rigs byung ngo / /ston ka'ang bsam 'grub rtse nas 'bod mkhan gnang byung ba — 131 —

ltar ram pas lam du zhugs te phyin/ snar thang gi gdong der shing thog ster mkhan mang du byung / de rjes sde srid du sngar 'byud ltar gyi dbang bka' rjes gnang rkyen sel gyi rigs rnams mang du byas/ sgang chen pa rgan po sogs btson dong du chug pa tsho la phan 'dogs 'dra zhu rtsis snyan du phul te don mthong ris rma na rnga/ri 'dug rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag thung tsam zhig gtang chos su ngag nas spar/ de yi ger 'god pa gnang ba 'dus la legs pa cig byung / de skabs yongs pa'i lag rjes de kha tsam du 'dug nged la ta 'gro don nus pa'i skyes bu'i tha snyad med/ de/ skyes bu dam pa phebs na skya ser ga 'dra cig la yang chos kyi rjes 'jog thub pa cig dgos pa yin/ chos kyi rjes zer ba de ga 'dra cig yod snyam na/ yang na spyin gtong la 'god/ yang na rten gsum bzhengs shing ma/chod pa byed pa la 'god// yang na sdom pa bsrung ba la 'god/ yang na shes rab 'phel ba la 'god/ yang na bzlas bsgom dang mos pa smon lam rjes su yi rang sogs la 'god pa cig dgose pa cig yin/ bla ma byon shul du 'jig rten pa rnams dge la dkar thing gis song / rab byung rnams chos la 'dun pa che thing gis song / skya ser thams cad rgyud 'jam thing gis 'gro/sngar ma go ba 'dra khra gsal gyis go ba 'dug na/ skyes bu dam pa yin pa'i rtags yin/ bla ma byon shul du mi nag pa rnams kyang dad pa chung ngu song / chos pa tsho yang nor la zhe 'dod cher song / tshong dang sbus bsgyur sogs khye phogs kyi dus 'da'/ chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi ngag 'khyal 'phel/ chos kyi skad chag skya se ra thams cad 'dod chags rgyas/ zhe sdang 'phel rung zhing phrag dog tu ka — 132—

song / gang la 'ang rtsi 'jog chung sdig pa la nyams mi nga bar 'gro yin 'dug na/ bdud rang yin pa yin te gcig tu na bdud sdig can pas kyang thu/ bdud kyis chos la bar chad byed kyang / 'jig rten lugs rang la phan ci rigs pa yang 'dogs par 'dug cig shos 'dis ni 'di phyi thams cad du sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig rang sdug gzhan sdug 'dir sdug phyi mar sdug la gtod par 'dug ste/ yang skya ser skal med las zad ma drang ba khyu cig yong gin 'dug pa la de kha mkho yang mkho gtsang pa rgya ras pa'i zhal na re/ las ngan slob ma sdig po che/ mtshan ldan bla ma mi bsten par/ zas nor ster gyi rjes su 'brang / zog po cig dang phrad pa snying re tshims/ zhes gsungs pa de khar 'dug sngon bod kyi rgyal po 'khor bcas sngar sdig shas chen po de/ ma/ban po bo dhi sa twa spyan drangs nas dge ba la dkar sang gis btang ba yin/ dkon mchog gsum la 'jogs che ting gis song ba yin/ rgya nag sogs yul gzhan du bod kyi da rma/ga drangs pa la'ang / lha khang dang dge 'dun la gnod pa dang ci yang med par ma zad/ skyabs bcol ba thams cad thug 'jogs che ba'i drung du 'ong mi nus shing / rgyang nas phyag mchod byed 'bul ba bskur ba yin par 'dug li yul gyi lo rgyus la ltos shig rgyal po khri srong lde btsan 'bangs dang bcas/ pa la sher phyin 'bum la sogs pa bshad pas/ rang rang gi blo gros dang mtshams pa'i shes rab chen po skyes te/ rgyal pos 'bum gyis 'grel pa dang / bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma la sogs bstan bcos ches bzang ba mang po brtsams/ skyes bu dam pa bsten pa'i lag rjes de 'dra gcig dgos pa yin/ mkhan po bo dhi sa — 133—

twas bod kyi rgyal po dang rgya gar rgyal po gnyen āoṃ sgrig pa ma byas/ srid phyogs sgrigs nas dmag byus la phan pa byas pa'i bgros mi gda'/ chos dang gang yang ma 'brel ba la drin che ba tsam gyis skyabs gnas su mi btub/ drin dang pha ma gnyis che ste skyes bu dam pa'i grangs su mi chud/ a pha'i chos lugs skyong ngam/ a ma'i chos lugs skyong yin/ chos med pa la chos lugs gang skyong / snying nye ba ta bza' mi nye ste/ bla ma'i rigs su ga la 'gyur/ don gyi snying po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi gsung las/ mkhas rnams yon tan la gus kyi/ /sangs rgyas dbang phyug sogs la min/ /yon tan med la gang gus pa/ /de blun mi dge'i las las skyes/ zhes gsungs pa la thams cad myongs 'dug pa shes ldan rnams kyis dpyod cig /yang smras pa/ legs lam thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ dam pa'i chos las gzhan du med/ brgyad khri bzhi stong chos rnams gsang sngags la gzhol ba yin/ sngags kyi rtsa ba bla ma'i mos gus yin/ mos gus la g.yo zol med pa cig dgos te dgos nges rang shes pa cig yin kyang / 'jig rten pa tsho la lta ci smos/ deng sang gi chos pa la'ang dka' bar gda'/ 'on kyang rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bka' dang ma 'gal zhing /thugs sun ma phyung ba cig med pa'i thabs med pa yin/ nga rang gis ni bla ma la sdig ma bsags so byas pa cig pos mi chog rtsa ba'i bla ma de la ma dad pa'i mi gzhan gcig dang rang snying nye bar byas na yang rang gi dam tshig nyams 'gro bar bshad/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la phyi mi bcol gzhan la nang mi 'chol ba de ka g.yo zol dam nyams yin no/ /'o na thog mar bla ma ma bcol gong du brtag dgos — 134—

pa la/ bla ma ci 'dra zhig dgos snyam na/ bla ma'i mtshan nyid mdo sngags nas grangs med bshad de 'dir bri bar ga nas lang / dus deng sang rang gi dbang du byas na thams cad la rgyud pa dang ldan pa dgos pa gzhir ba theg so thar gyi rab byung dge slong len na rtsa ba bzhi ma gos/ gzhan sdig pa grags chen ma byas/ 'phral nyin zhag phrug cig gi kun spyod legs pa/ 'dul ba rags rim tsam dang cho ga la mkhas pa cig dgos/ sems bskyed kyi bla ma de/ rgyud 'jam pa theg chen la go ba rags rim yod pa/ sdig pa grags chen ma byas pa/ cho ga la mkhas pa de yin/ sngags chos zhu na bla ma dang mched grogs la dam ma nyams pa/ yi dam lha la dad pa/ bsnyen sogs grub pa'i byin rlabs cung zad yod pa/ sngags kyi go ba rags rim yod cing / cho ga la mkhas pa/ sdig pa chen po min pa cig dgos pa yin/ rigs rus la khyad med mi byings kyi bla ma de kas rung / rgyal po sogs mi chen la ni de tsho'i steng du/ rgyud las/ sa thob ma gtogs khyim pa ni/ /rgyal pos bla mar mi bya ste/ zhes dang / lha khang la sogs rab gnas pa/ /rtags can gyis ni rtag tu bya/ /gnas gcig tu ni gsum gnas na/ khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pas min/ /zhes rtags mngon gyur gyi grub thob yin na ma gtogs/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rigs rab byung yod bzhin du/khyim pas rgyal po'i bla ma dang rab gnas byed du mi rung / bstan pa la gnod/bkra mi shis/ rab byung gi rtags med pa'i a wa dhwa ti yang khyim pa dang 'dra yang / gang zhig khyim pa bsti gnas spyod/ /g.yog spri zhing pa tshong pa dang / /dam chos 'tshong ba'i rmongs pa de/ /sa la rdo rje 'dzin pa min zhes dang / rgyud —135—
