yang sde srid gong ma de skabs/ sngar gtsang pa rang gi dgra phyogs kyi khungs rnams lta ci smos/ nye khul tshos kyang / mtho gnon dang 'gro 'tshams kyis dgra byas pa dang / khong pa'i las shugs dbang thang 'bar ba gnyis thug nas/thams cad stong song pa de ka la/ ngas byas rgyu til 'bu tsam zhig med kyang /de nged la khag bskur na nged tsho la smad ra rgya che gting zab rang yong rgyu'i khungs kyis smras pas yin par 'dug /de'i rgyu mtshan yang / lung bstan yin zer ba'i shob rang tshig re re gnyis gnyis 'don zhing / gzhan tsho chos rgyal yin gtsang pa bdud yin zer ba de la thug skya ser byin dmangs 'di yang de khas mgo 'khor 'gro yi na 'dug gang na'ang / sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rnam 'phrul lkog gyur ni bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i spyod yul yin pas/ ye shes kyi spyan yod pa cig gis gzigs na/ da lta yang dpag tu med pa cig yong ni yod par 'dugangos ni sus kyang mi zin/ de 'dra la ni dus bzang ngan med do/ /mngon 'gyur ba la ni dus bzang ngan yod pa dngos su grub/ da lta mang po med pa de yin spu //skan 'jig rten dkar phyogs kyi lha chen po mi'i lus 'dzin pa lha'i 'jug pa dang / nags phyogs kyi 'dre srin mi'i lus 'dzin pa bong ba ltar na bdud sprul zhes sam/ lha min gyi 'jug pa dngos de ni/ dus deng sang mi yong ba yin/rgyu mtshan ni sngon gyi mi'i lus de rtsa khams dwangs/ rtsa'i nus pa che bas ya mtshan chen po ci yang 'byung la/ phyis kyi rnams de las ldog pa'i phyir ro/ /mtha' na ro langs tshun chad kyang da lta sngon bzhin mi yong ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin/ de'i tshab tu deng sang dkar phyogs kyi lnga'am nag phyogs kyi 'dres/ mi so so'i blo —188—

bsgyur ba dang/ mig gis mi mthong ba'i phyogs nas rgyal pham gyi dpung byed pa kho na yin pa go dgos/ lung bstan mkhan rnams bag yod 'tshal/ rgya gar ba mkhas pa rnams na re/ sngon lha min gyi 'jug pa'i rgyal po byung ste/ mi rnams la gnod pa byed pa'i tshab/ deng sang gi mi la de ltar mi 'byung bas/ da lta kla kle'i chos lugs dar/ de rnams stobs dang ldan 'ing thub par dka' ba yi/na zer/ yang ci ste da ltar yang de ltar yong zhes dbu tshugs smra na/ 'phags pa dang dkar phyogs kyi lha ma yin phyin/ mi/ phal pa gang yang go rig mi yong ba'i zam zom lkug pa sgro zha ba de 'dra las/ gnam the'u dang / 'bal the'u sogs yin kyang brgya 'gyur stong 'gyur gyis grag mod/ 'di tshos rang gzhan gnyis ka'i bya byed stobs chen grub 'ong / cig shos des gang yang mi yong ba lags zhes brjod par bya'o/ /skabs kyi don la/ sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal des gsung phebs la/ nged kyis rgyal srid kyi bya ba rlabs chen 'grub/ da dung skyong ba la dka' las mi 'dug kyang / 'byor pa yod nga/'i tshogs gsog dang / snga phyi'i sgrib sbyongs su gtsug lag khang sogs la brten pa'i dge ba rlabs che ba zhig dgos 'dug pa/ skye bo mi nag pas kha 'jug bkod khyab byas kyang bza' sgo dang tho cho'i spyod pa la song / thams cad du tho wo po 'phog cing / sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i gnad du 'gro ba zhig dka' bar 'dug da lta grwa rigs yon bdag dar rgyas che ba kun la'ang / phyogs med du gus pas zhabs tog byed pa gzhir bcas yin/ dpal jo nang pa'i lugs 'di da lta nub la khad 'dug pa cung zad gso thub na/ dkon pa tsam gyi rin thang che'i dpe phan yon yang che ba — 189—

dang / chos tshul 'di la rang res mos pa'ang yin gsung / snga phyir sa cha dang /yo byad thams cad sbyor 'jags gnang / nged tshos dge 'dun gyi sde 'dzugs rgyu de'i lag len khyed kyis byed dgos tshul don gyi gnad kyi 'dug khong rang bzhugs dus don la'ang de kha rang yin/ de tsam ma gtogs de dus kyang dus zings kyi gros phugs nyi ma gcig kyang byed ma myong / de lta ni khog gros kyi dra dri tsam yang med pa 'di ka yin/ 'di skabs kyang jo bo bdag po'i thugs bsam la/ gros phugs yin pa'i khungs rang gi bka' phebs sku don rnam grangs mang po dang / khyad par gnyen bsgrigs byed dgos tshul sogs 'dug nged rang rtogs ldan la mdzu gu 'dzugs rgyu zhig mi 'dug kyang / ngas dran tsam gyi dus na gtsang phyogs 'di kun na/ dge bzhes kyi ming can gyis gnyen kha byed pa la/kun gyis 'cha' ba'i khrel yod chen po dgos pa'i mig rgyugs kyis/ sngar de 'dra ci yang zer ma myong bas rang res ni ye ma byas/ khong mur gtso/sa ches pa dang / sde srid gzhung rang du'ang / tshong pa'i khra bsdud phran tshegs la rtseg 'dam dang / thugs snyung ba'i tshod byas na/ stod phyogs thams cad 'du ba'i legs lam du yang 'gro ba 'dra bsams par 'dug mdzod pas zhu shog phul yang skyo ma snga btsan gyi dbang las ma byung 'dug de thugs rtsol gyis 'grub na sde pa rang la legs rgyur 'dug ste/ nor rnams kun gyi nang na chog shes pa/ zhes pa'i don thugs la 'khrungs na ni pho skyes rgyab gda'o/ /dbyar smad kyi dus zab chen rgyu gang bzang la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi bkod pa zab dkyil chen mor grags pa 'di yang bzhengs/—190—

rgyu tshogs tshang ma sdoms na/ zab chen yug ring thung sna tshogs pa brgya skor cig song / thog ma'i bgegs sgrod rab gnas la shin tu bkra lod cing 'tshub tu mngon pa ja blugs pa tsam gyi dkar yol don med du sgra dang bcas cha gnyis su gas byung zhing / de nyin ka rtse nas 'bod mkhan zhig kyang sleb byung bas/ rten 'brel mi legs par shes nas/ da res shar phyogs mi 'gro bar thag bcad do/ /hor zla dgu pa'i 'go stod la/ gting skyes nas sde pa yab sras dang / rtse gdong nas lcam drung sogs dpon g.yog mang rab zhig nged dang 'phrad pa dang /'di phyogs kyi rten mjal la phebs/ theg nyi shu skor bzhugs/ tshe dbang brgya tshar dang / dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dbang bskur dang / dpal mgon po'i bka' sogs rjes gnang mang rab dang bcas pa gsan song / bla ma rin po che ka bzhi sprul pa'i sku yang dpal thar pa gling gi 'dzin skyong la phebs pa'ang 'di ka'i dus ka yin/ zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa de nyid/ sku dbyings su thim pa'i dus nges can rdzun med rang cig ni rdzu bag mang grags pas things pa dka' ba 'dug dbyar smad de sku rim yin zer ba mang bskol mang rab mdzad 'dug pa'i/ rtag brtan du yang mang ja 'gyed bcas bsngo rten gyi skal ba gnas byung / zla ba 'di la gsang rtol byung / zla ba bcu pa'i nang du 'di tshor dgongs rdzogs kyi skal ba'ang bzang bar byung / nged kyi bsam mno zhig la/ rtogs ldan 'di kun gyi kha nas bka' brgyud rin po che la thug 'dug yang yang zer ba de yang / 'dra mo ru yang gda'/ mnyam med dpal sgam po pa rang gi dus dang / bde gshegs khams pa dang / 'bri khung rin chen dpal —191—

sogs kyi spyan ltos kyi gzhug de da rung 'dug bla chen bcol na bla chen pher pa de bka' brgyud pa 'di la ka gda'o snyam pa cig byung / 'bru/ga pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i mchog gi sprul sku yang / khro phur phebs 'dug pas gzhi byes la mang ja dang / ja zhal bzab tsam phul/ dgyes pa'i tshu 9 / gyi gsung phebs khral khrol du mdzad kyin yod 'dug cing / gdab lan rtag brtan du mang ja dang /nged la'ang ja 'dren mjad byung 'di na bla chen gyi khungs la la zhig 'brel 'dra byas na/ lci thang thang 'grangs ma/ gtsang po de 'dra min pa'i 'brel 'tshol ba la spro ba skyes yod pa'i rigs yin nga ra der 'dug lags/ de nas ri khrod chen po'i dus khrid yang sngar lugs bzhin btsugs/ khrid gsar pa sngar 'byud bzhin mang ba dang / lo snga ma gsum bshud las 'khrid lo legs tsam gyi 'bring pa cig byung / lo 'di'i nang du jo nang gi lha khang bde ba can du/ ldem/ byang chub sems dang/'a gnyis dang logs bris dang steng gi thigs khang sogs thams cad grub/ rgya gar gyi yul nub phyogs ku dra'i brgyud nas bram ze'i rigs kyi paṇḍi ta gzhon nu sgra la mkhas pa ba la bha dra 'es pa zhig shwe1 snga ma la 'dir byung / lha sa sogs bod yul gyi skor 'os rnams bskor/ slar 'di skabs 'byor byung ba/khong re zhig sdod par byas nas/ swa ra swa sti bya ka ra ṇa/ dbyangs can sgra mdo rtsa 'grel sngar cung zad bsgyur ba'i 'phros nas/ 'gyur byed pa'i 'go brtsams/brel g.yeng stabs nas yun rings 'god/ zhag re'i nang du thun re tsam byas/rtsa 'grel gnyis po gang bsgyur tshar ba de'i rgyu la/ lag len nag po 'gro shes re yang nyin re bzhin bris/ hor zla gnyis pa la rtag brtan du phyin/ chos than — 192—

thun 'dra bshad/ ngam ring mkhan chen klu sgrub sprul pa'i sku yang / yos lo brtag gnyis kyi bshad pa dang / gur sam gnyis la bshad 'doms tsam gsan skabs de nas/ bar skabs der mjal ma thub pas/ cis kyang yong dgos 'dug gsung phebs/ bde mchog nag po lugs kyi rim bzhi lam slong chen mo dang / sbyor drug dang tshi shin rje gshed kyi chos skor thor bu 'ga' dang /rjes gnang ci rigs pa dgos gsung ba ltar phul/ de la spyir bod yul 'di ru chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa' dang / lo paṇa sprul pa'i skyes mchog rnams kyi bka' drin las/ chos kyi sgo mtha' yas pa sna ma 'gags par 'gyur zhing dar ba yin/ dgos su bstan pa phyi dar la/ rgya gar nyi 'og dang / kha che bal po kun dar zhing grags che ba'i gsang sngags kyi chos kyi rkangs phal cher zhig 'gyur ba yin/ rgyud 'ga' shas tsam lus 'dug dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos ni ma 'gyur ba ches mang mod tshad gzung mi nus la/ kha cig med kyang a'u rtsi mod/ yang rgya gar nas brgyud pa'i chos re re tsam la sa bon blangs te/bod yul 'dir rang rang gi blo gros kyis rgya cher spel ba yang mang du byung / kha cig tu zhal mthong dang / lung bstan dang / rmi lam dang / sngar mthong thos med kyang / blo la rang shar ba'i nyams chos sam/ rtogs chos shin tu mang ba dag byung ngo / /rgya bod gnyis kar du rgyud gtsor byed pa dang / gdams ngag gtso bor byed pa so sor byung / rgyud gang yang rung ba cig la brten nas/dbang bskur ba dang / lha sngags kyi rnal 'byor nges can du byed/ de la brten nas bskyed rdzogs la slob pa ni/ rgyud gtso bor byas pa cis zer/ dbang — 193 —

bskur dang lha'i rnal 'byor cig la gzhung srong ba'i nges gzung med par/ rtsa rlung ngam/ sems phyogs sogs rtsal du 'don pa ni/ man ngag gtso bor byed pa zhes grags/ rgya gar gyi dpyod ldan rnams rgyud gtso bor byed pa la rtsis che/bod du ni man ngag gtso bor byed pa kho na dar rgyas che'o/ /rgyud gtso bor ston pa'i chos 'di rnams rgyu dang yi dam la phyogs 'dzin byas pa'i re re tsam min pa bod yul 'di na/ phyis dar rgyas chung bar 'dug kho bo ni rgyud dang 'brel ba'i chos rnam dag 'di rnams la yid ches kyi dad pa brtan po ni yod/ sdug chen ni gang yod yod byed/ dar thub pa'i nus pa ni nga rang la yang mi gda' ste/ de las kyang sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa ma nor ba'i sngags chos zab mo la thos pa dang / sgom pa byed pa'i bsod nams kyi skal ba can de 'dra rgyal khams yongs kyi mi 'di pa'i sa na mang po yod yod mi 'dra bas/ chos zab mo spel thub pa'i thes mi gda'/ ji skad du/ sangs rgyas kyis ni ma gsungs na/ /dka' bsa'abad nas byed pa mtshang/ /zhes pa ltar/ rgyud kyi brten so 'di yin med pa'i rigs tshogs chen cig la'ang / 'bad brtsol gyis thos sgom byed tshul ci rigs ni yong gin gda'/ gzhan phal che ba ni/ snyoms las dang sla chos kho na gtso bor 'don pas/ nya chos sad sud dang 'ad wa shab shob 'dra la/ blo 'gro ba tsam ma gtogs/ chos dbyings che ba la mos pa tsam yang mi skye ba der gda'o/ /'o na rgyud dang 'brel pa'i chos 'gangs che ba da lta rgyun ma 'chad pa ni ji lta bu yin da lta ji tsam yod snyam na de 'dra ni 'di dag yin te/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags skor du grags pa'i dbang bskur ba dang/ sgron gsal la —194—

brten pa'i rgyud kyi bshad pa rim lnga spyod sdus dang 'brel pa'i rdzogs rim dang bcas pa mar 'gos gnyis 'dus kyi dbang lung man ngag cha tshang rnams rkangs tshugs pa'i srol ka gcig yin te dang po'o/ /yang 'dus pa la/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi lugs/ lo tsā ba ye shes rgyal mtshan/ yon tan grags/ dar ma grags rnams nas brgyud pa gtso bor gyur pa dbang bka' rgyud bshad rdzogs rim grol ba'i thig le sogs dbang rgyud man ngag cha tshang ba yod pa 'di ni rkang tshugs pa'i sde tshan gnyis pa yin no/ /dpal gshin rje gshed kyi phyogs la/ rwa lo'i bzhed kyi nag po skor gsum gyi dbang bka'/ gtso bor nag 'jigs kyi rgyud bshad las tshogs mtha' rgyas/ phyis kyi blo bzo'i bsre slad med pa'i rdzogs rim dang bcas pa 'di rkang tshugs pa gsum pa yin no/ /lo tsa ba shes rab bla ma dang / di'od kyi 'byung gnas dang / blo gros grags rnams kyi lugs la'ang dbang bshad man ngag rkang tshugs pa yod kyang phyis dar rgyas chung bas snga ma'i zhor byung du bgrangs so/ /gshin rje gshed dmar po lugs gnyis la lo tsā ba chos kyi dpal bzang po dang / chos rje dpal zang po dang / shes rab rin chen dang / mkhas pa spyin pa tshul khrims rnams nas brgyud pa'i gdams ngag bcas/ so so'i dbang bka'/ shin tu spros med dang / rnal 'byor bzhi'i rdzogs rim/ byin rlabs kyi bka' rgya gzhung gi zin so can mang po dang / gzhung gi bshad pa las tshogs dang bcas pa/ rgyab rten rgyud sogs cha tshang bar yod pa 'di ni rkang tshugs pa 3—195—

bzhi pa'o/ /dgyes pa rdo rje la lo tsā ba shaka ye dang / lo tsā ba bsod nams rtse mo gnyis 'dzoms pa'i rtsa bshad kyi dkyil 'khor dbang bka' mi 'dra ba bcu gnyis tsam dang / rgyud gsum du grags pa'i bshad pa/ zab pa'i tshul dgu/lhan cig skyes grub/ lhan cig skyes pa'i man ngag sogs dang / gzhug 'grel mang po'i lung bka' dang bcas pa 'di ni rkang tshugs pa lnga pa'o/ /yang dgyes rdor la nā ro mi tri nas brgyud pa/ 'gyur byed bla ma lho pa chen po'i lugs la/ rtsa bshad kyi dbang bka' sum rdzogs rim 'khrid tshul rgyas pa gnyis/ byin rlabs kyi bka' cig gur brtag gi bshad pa bzang rgyas su 'dzom pa dang bcas pa 'di ni rkang tshugs pa drug pa yin no/ /dgyes rdor dpyal lugs la dbang rgyud bshad man ngag lhad med khyad par can byung 'dug yig cha bzang ngo/ 'dug na'ang / rgyud pa chad nas ring zhig lon gda'/ yang dpal 'bor lo sdom pa'i phyogs la/ slob dpon rnam gsum gyi bzhed pa'i dbang bskur so so dang / bskyed rim gyi man ngag dang / rdzogs rim rnal 'byor chen po/ rim lnga rim bzhi'i khrid zab rgyas can rnams dang gzhung so so'i bshad pa/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / kun spyod kyi bshad pa/ bshad rgyud gzhan rnams kyi bshad lung sogs yod de/ lo tsā ba shes rab brtsegs dang / blo gros grags dang / rdo rje grags dang / chos dbang dang / grags 'byor rnams kyi man ngag bshad sgros dang bcas pa/ ngo mtshar rmad du gyur pa'i chos skor yod de/ slob dpon rnam gsum lugs rkang tshugs re yin mod kyi 'dir brgyud pa gcig tu gril ba'i dbang du byas nas lam rkang tshugs pa bdun — 196—

pa'o /'khor lo sdom pa la dbang bka' tsam gyi rigs dang / man ngag thor bu'i rigs sogs chos skor rnam dag kha 'thor ba mtha' yas so/ /de yang ji lta bu snyam na/ dkyil 'khor zur bka'i dbang bskur rang yang nyi shu lhag cig yod cing / yum bka'i dbang byin rlabs bskyed rdzogs rigs ji snyed cig dang /khrid tshul yang mang po dang / lhan skyes kyi man ngag rang yang mtha' yas pa yod pa lta bu'o/ /dpal rdo rje gdan bzhi la/ bla ma chen po chos blo ba dang / khug pa dang / dran pa ye shes la sogs pa'i legs bshad du ma yod cing / gang ltar yang dbang bka' gnyis dang / rgyud nyid la 'dzug tshugs su byas pa'i khrid tshul zab la rgyas pa gzhung phran mang po rgyud rgyud 'grel dang bcas pa ste/ lam rkang tshugs pa brgyad pa'o/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po ma hā mā ya la sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba mang yang / ku ku ri pa dang / shānti pa dang / zhi bzang rnams kyi lugs gtso bor gzung nas/ 'gyur byed bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra/ dbang bka' rgyas pa dang / 'khrid tshul zab rgyas dang / gzhung 'grel mang po'i lung rgyud bshad dang bcas pa yod de rang rkang tshugs pa dgu pa'o/ /dpal sangs rgyas thod pa la/ lo tsā ba zla 'od dang / dharma ma ti nas brgyud pa'i dbang bka' dang / rgyud rgyud 'grel/ rgya gzhung gi lung bka' ma chad pa yod/ rdzogs rim zab mo phyis byung ba'ang yod de/ lam rkang tshugs pa bcu pa'o/ /—197—

thams cad kyi mthar thug pa'i zab don/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la 'gyur byin mang yang 'dir gnyal cor shes rab grags dang / rwa lo gnyis pa dang / mi nyag sangs grags dang / mkhas pa bya rog gdong / shākya dpal bzang dang / rnal 'byor zla ba dang / dharma snya mi shrī bha dra la sogs pa'i bka' babs gcig tu gril pa/ dbang bka' rnam grangs mang po dang / khyad par du rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang che chung dang / man ngag mthar thug rdo rje'i rnal 'byor nyams khrid rgyun ma chad pa la mkhas grub mtha' yas pa'i lugs srol rnams kyi yig lung dang / bskyed rdzogs dbang gsum gyi bshad pa/ rgya gzhung mang po'i lung / rtsa rgyud dbang mdor bstan gyi bshad pa/ bsdus rgyud sems 'grel skor gsum mtshan brjod dang bcas pa'i lung bshad rgyun ma chad par yod pa 'di ni/ rang nyid gsang sngags kyi lam rkangs tshugs yin par ma zad/ chos gzhan thams cad kyi yang mthar thug 'di la ltos pa'i phyir chos kyi rgyal po lta bu ste bcu gcig pa'o/ /gzhan yang lo tsā ba shud ke dang / ba na ratna nas brgyud pa'i mi g.yo ba bla med kyi dbang rgyud man ngag dang / lo tsā ba dharma bha dras bsgyur ba'i 'khor lo chen po'i dbang rgyud lung man ngag dang / lo tsa ba brtson 'grus seng ge shes rab rgyal mtshan/ gung thang gi mal rnams pha log bu log byas pa/ nyi ma sbas pa'i sgrol ma'i chos skor rnam grangs shin tu mang ba sogs dang / gzhan yang thor bu ba mang du yod do/ /sgrub thabs thor bu pa la bka' rnam dag gzhung rkyang dang gdams ngag can mtha' yas so/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dkyil —198—

'khor chen po rnams la bka' yod cing lhad med pa'i dbang bka' ni mang du yod/ dus deng sang man ngag gi rgyun dang sgrub bka' yod pa ma thos/ bshad bka' yang than thun tsam min pa/ 'gangs che ba'i rgyun med la/ rgyud 'bum nang gi lung tsam ma gtogs/ lung bka' 'gangs che ba yang dkon por snang ngo / /bod kyi lo tsā ba sprul pa'i skyes mchog rnams kyis/ lus srog thed la bor/ bod yul gyi longs spyod thams cad rgya gar la gril ba'i dgos pa ni/chos 'di rnams bod yul du dar ba'i phyir yin pa 'dug shes ldan rnams gyis 'bad nas mi nub par bya dgos pa'i chos de 'di rnams yin/ 'di rnams zab po min/ bod kyi mi la mi phan na/ chos kyi rgyal po de dag dang lo paṇa de rnams ban rgan 'khrul le cig u yin/ bod rang du blo rdol mar byung ba'i chos tsho ka dga' na dag dang po'i mi de tsho dka' las khyad du bsad nas/ rgya gar la 'gro dgos rgyu ma red ang / yang gdams ngag gtso bor gyur pa ni/ sngon gyi rdzogs chen rnying pa rnams dang / gsar ma'i chos skor gcig la rgyas shos lam 'bras dang / 'gro phan che shos chos drug lugs gnyis la sogs pa rgyud gcig kho na'i gzhung mi srong bar/ rgyud mang po'i don dgongs 'dus su byas nas/ blo rigs ma nges pa rnams kyi nyams len 'byer bde bar byas pa ste/ dam chos sdug bsngal bzhi byed dang / phyag chen brgyud pa snga phyi mang du byung ba sogs ji snyed rnams kyang de dang 'dra'o/ /'di dag gi nang nas 'ga' zhig rgyud gcig kho na'i dbang dang bskyed rim sogs dang sbrel ba ltar yod pa ni/ brgyud pa'i bla ma 'ga' zhig gi thugs bzhed tsam ka yin kyang / bla ma de dag 'phrin las che —199—

bas khyab chen po rang byung bar zad do/ /bod yul 'dir rigs ma nges pa'i skye bo kho na mang bas/ rgyud sde gcig kho na lam brten pa'i man ngag spyi ldog 'di rnams phan khyab che zhes gsung mkhan ni gda'/ khungs ni med/ 'dra rung ba snyam pa cig ni 'dug yang 'dug go /'di skabs mkhan chen drung nas kyang rim bzhi lam slongs chen mo rgyud sde'i nges gsang de la don gnyer mdzad pa mkhas pa'i bgyid 'os su 'dug snyan brgyud tshigs bcad ma'i tshig gis zin ma zin sogs nyams len gyi gnad phra mo tsho la'ang dpyad pa che ba'i nan chags nges tig rang mdzad kyin 'dug pas/ rjes su yi rang chen po skyes/ spyi nged la lam 'bras nai gu phyag chen gcod sogs zhu mkhan mang zhing / grags pa'i rjes 'brang tsam gyis rgyud dang 'brel pa la sbyor drug zhu mkhan mang rab yong bar 'dug nan tan bya mkhan ni nyin mo'i skar ma bzhin no/ khyud dang gtso bor 'brel ba'i chos gzhan de rnams tshur don gnyer byed mkhan ni ye mi yong ba'i rdzo du 'dug rang res phar ni brdal por gang 'gro 'gro bto / thob po thob po zer ba'i tshig rkyang las ma byung kyang / rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa'i mtha' pa gi la phan nam bsam pa ni yin/ gzhan lar mtshan nyid sngon song sngags chos kyang mang rab 'chad mkhan gyi khungs/ dge bshes su sngo ba phyis 'byung gi 'di tsho la yang phyogs zhen gyi skyar yor cig ka man pa sngags chos de dang de rtsa slongs rang shes pa lta ci zhig gting gi chos nyams chen po rang zhig kyang ye mi yong ba'i tshod du sleb 'dug 'di 'dra yi mug chen po'i rgyu cig 'dug ste/bstan pa'i mthar la sleb pa'i rtags yin snyam sems rnal du 'jog pa lags/—200—

deng sang bod yul 'di na dbang rkyang re tsam dang / lung rkyang re tsam ma gtogs/ rgyud sde re re'i chos la'ang cha shas tshang ma rdzogs par bzhugs pa chen po rang mi 'dug pa ni mngon sum gyi grub pa 'di lags pa/ bdag cag 'jig rten pha rol tu chas pa'i tshe gong du smos pa'i chos de dag las mang tshad rang zhig 'bog khris la 'gril ba 'dra lags/ he he/ bdag gis ni thob kyang legs la/ ma thob kyang chog pa'i chos kyang ji snyed cig thob/ thob na phan yon che zhing mi thob tu mi wo ba'i chos gong smos 'di rnams la don gnyer u ru mu ru byas/ 'bad pas brtsal nas thob kyang thob pas nga rang gi mdun ma rtse la phyin pa lags so/ /mi 'di rnams 'khra/ga pa re tsam rgyal ba dang / kha mchu re tsam legs pa dang / sa cha re tsam chod pa la mdun ma legs so zer gyin gda' na/zab mo'i chos tshigs bcad re re la'ang stong gsum ther 'bum khrag khrig gis kyang mi dpogs na/ de 'dra ba'i chos rnams/ bla ma dam pa las thos kyang thos/go yang go shes kyang shes/ myong yang myong ba 'di bsod nams che ba'i mthar thug yin/ 'di las mdun ma legs pa byung ri shi/ yod ri shi yong ri shi'o/ /lar rang ni phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ da ni dkyus la 'jug ste/ 'di skabs bsam rtser bdag mo rtse gdung nas rnam rgyal bu khrid drung bu kha'i rkyen gyis glo bur tu sku gshegs pa'i bsngo'i rten rnams 'byor byung / dang po snga sor bcom ldan 'das ma rig pa 'dzin pa rtsen ma'i dkyil 'khor rdib pa'i ltas kyi 'bras bu de 'di yan chad yin 'dug dpon mo bzhi tsam grul btub ma byung / de kha'i gsang rtol dang / rtse gdong nas lcam drung sku gzhon pa 'bring mtshams nas tshur bsu —201—

ba gnang ba'i bges skrod gu chu rug la yong dgos tshul nan chags gnang ba'i/hor zla lnga pa'i 'go la gzhis ka rtser phyin/ sleb pa'i nyin ka gza' skar bzang gsungs nas/ lcam drung gi bgegs skrod de byas/ de'i gnangs nyin sku tshigs zidrug pa la bsngo rten mtshon tsam yang gnang byung / de kha'i rjes 'thud la/dbyar gung chen dang yang thug zla ba phyed dang gsum tsam sdod dgos byung / 'di skabs kyang col sgrogs sna tshogs byung / spyi babs sa lugs pa ho 'di ba yang dang po nas da lta'i bar du zhal bzan la phyag rgya chung ba cig ka yod/ lar bya mchu skam po dang / mi mchu rlon pa'i dpe yin/ skrag rgyu med do a/ nga ni rdo rje 'dzin pa yin/ ha ha ha ha dgod re bro/ yang 'di na gang dag bstod mi shes kyis bstod pa dang / smad mi shes kyi smad pa zer ba de 'dra cig yong gin gda'/ kho bo la yang smad ra'i khungs kyis mngon spyod kyi las byas so zhes stod smad 'di tsho na yang yang zer ba 'dug de rnams la smras pa/ re zhig ngan song spyod rgyud las/ /glen pas dkon mchog gsum smod dang / /sangs rgyas bstan la gnod byed dang / /bla ma smod la brtson pa rnams/ /mkhas pas bsgrim ste bsad par bya/ /chos min ldan dang sdig spyod dang / /rtag tu sems can gnod brtson dang / /dam tshig sdang rnams snying brtse ba'i/ /sngags mkhan gyis ni sngags kyis bsad/ /ces bsgral bar bya ba'i yul bdun la bsad las bya bar gsungs/ dgyes rdor las kyang / bstan la gnod pa byed pa dang / /bla ma sangs rgyas 'jig pa ni/ /bla ma thub pa la zhus/nas/ /snying rjes ba bad par bya ba nyid/ /ces gsungs/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las kyang / ma dad smra ci —202—

ba'i sems can dang / /rdo rje slob dpon smod pa dang / gdug pa'i sems can g.yin la yang / /rab tu bskul ba 'di bya 'o/ /zhes dang / mgon po de yisabaslu ba yis/ /lus can thams cad 'jig mdzad kyang / /ngan 'gror skye bar mi 'gyur zhing / /byang chub lam ni rnyed mi dka'/ /zhes gsungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dpal rdo rje khro bo'i rgyud las/ e ma ho gsod pa 'di ni bzang / /ji srid sdig pa dag las grol/ /sdig pa stong phrag byas pa yang / /mnar med la sogs mi skye 'o/ /zhes mngon spyod kyi lasani gzhan phan 'gro don mchog tu bshad/ byang chub sems dpa' sngags kyi spyod pa can rnams kyis/ thabs mkhas chen po cig yin/ rgyu sdom gsum pa las kyang / gdug pa rnams la zlog ste bya/ /dngos su'am yang na sngags sam gzhan/ /'khrul 'khor dang ni ting nge 'dzin/ /sman sa kyang ni bya ba ste/ /de ltar mi phyed de yis ni/ /nges par dam tshig nyams par 'gyur/ /gdon dang log 'dren dag gis kyang / /nges par 'chi ste dmyal bar ni/ /yun ring sdug bsngal gyis brdungs te/ /de bsan na tan ldan pa mā /bzod pa mi bskyed snying rje yis/ /sngags kyis nges par gsad par bya/ /zhes ma rungs pa la drag las ma byas na dam tshig nyams 'gro bar bshad/ de bzhin du/ rgyu gzhan las kyang/ rdo rje slob dpon smod pa dang / /theg pa chen po sun 'e byen dang / /mi gang sngags kyi rgyud dag gi /sbyor ba la ni 'cha' byed pa/ /nan tan bskyed de gsad pa'am/ /yang na gnas nas bskrad par bya/ /zhes gsungs/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi'i nang na/ /gdug la rtag tu byams ldan par/ /byed pa de ni bcu par —203—

'dod/ /ces bya ba cig mi gda' 'am/ gdug pa can la snying nye bar byas na rtsa lhung yin par bshad/ de'i shugs la mngon spyod ma byas na nyes pa dang /byas na phan yon 'byung zer ba cig yong ba yin/ mi nag pa chos la sol phye las gnag pa/ dbang 'dra yod pas dkon mchog gi dbu 'phangs smod pa rnams/ mngon spyod kyi yul yin pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ chos pa'am dge bshes su rdzu ba/ bstan pa dang sems can la gnod pa rang byed pa 'di kun kyang / bsgral bar bya ba'i yul yin te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po paṇḍita dharma rakṣi ta༅kyang / bzang po lta bur kun gyis bcos na yang / /log lta'i nags su bdag lta 'khrugs pa yis/ /stag mo bu zan lta bur 'jigs pa de/ /bka' sdod bsrung ma rnams kyis bsgral bya yin/ /pur smrig gos can zhi dul mdzes gyur kyang / /byi la bzhin du bsam pa ma rungs pa'i/ /dam pa'i gzugs brnyan gso ru med pa de/ /ma mo rnams kyi kha ru gdab bya yin/ khri khrag dgu yi gtso bor 'dug gyur kyang / khyab 'jug bzhin du rang rgyud ma thul ba'i/ /chags sdang 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba de/ /gshin rje gshed kyi zhal du gdab bya yin/ khyim nas byung zhing bstan pa'i sgor zhugs kyang / khyim pa bzhin du bya ba mtha' yas shing / /spang blang thams cad khyad du gsod pa ste/ /drang srong rnams kyis smod pas gdab bya yin/ /rtags dang ldan yang tshukha khrims mi srung zhing / /dzad pa'i las la snang ba 'byams gyur nas/ /dam pa rnams la sgro skur 'debs pa de/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis pha rol bsgras bya yin/ /rnyed pa'i ched du dam pa'i gzugs bzung nas/ khyi phag —204—

bzhin du 'dod yon 'jol nyog byed/ /sngags su khas blang thams cad bslu ba de/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i thab tu gzhug bya yin/ /theg chen skad du las 'bras khyad gsod cing / /stong pa'i rbad kyis 'khor tshogs bslu ba yi/ /'gongs po bzhin du sku ru rjub de/ /dam tshig can gyis sngags kyis bsad bya yin/ /'di ltar so so thar pa phar zhog gi /rang nyid ༅ 'gro wo por 'gro dgos kyang / /bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra bgegs mi sgrol ri/ /dam nyams pha rol dgra bgegs bsgral bar bya/ /zhes 'byung / gzhud 'di byang chub sems dang/'i blo sbyong gi gzhung yin/ byang chub sems kyi mnga' bdag bshes gnyen bka' gdams pa rnams kyis rtsis su mdzad pa yin pas/ mngon spyod dang byang chub kyi sems 'gal mi 'gal bsam mno thong / gal te rdo rje slob dpon rnams kyis mngon spyod byar mi rung na/ rgyud sde bzhi po thams cad nas bsad bskrad dbye ba rmongs rengs phur gdab kyi las mtha' yas pa zhig gsungs 'dug pa thams cad dgos med du thal bas ser rgyag gam ci/ kho bo cag ta/ dar ma mdo sde la sogs pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'ang bcu gsum bsgral zer ba de'i mi rgyud yin/ mtshan nyid pa skam po tsho yang mthu sdigs byed gdams ngag thor bu re zhus zhag shas mtshams tsam byas pa tsho yang sngags nus kyi khur 'dra len na/ngas mngon spyod byas rang byas na yang pha tshe bu rabs kyi las ka srid pas bskos bskos pa de ka yin/ yang gcig tu na mngon spyod kyi las cung zad byas pa'ang srid/ byed par 'gyur ba'ang srid/ mig gis bltas/ rna bas nyan/ bsam mno zhig thong dang / mngon spyod kyi las byas pa la rjes kyang mang po zhig byung —205—

byung 'dra/ da rung yod yod 'dra/ lar ga ge mo zhig gis mthu byed kyin 'dugache ge mo cig gis gnan gtad byas/ ci cig cig tu ser ba phab/ ma ge cig tu ltas ngan byung / wa mar zer dgos pa de ka lha dang lha ma mnyam/ mi dang mi ma mnyam pa'i skad cha shor ba de yin/ drag las byas zer na/ nga ni 'dod chos can yin/ nus pa yong na khyed rang tsho yang byas btang ba'i chog mod/ lar chos nas mngon spyod bkag pa yang yod/ ci dgar gnang ba'ang yod/ nges par byed dgos par zugad pa'ang yod/ bkag pa de stong nyid snying rje med par bkag pa yin/ yul ma yin pa la bkag pa yin/ nga ni stong nyid snying rje med zer nas zhum zhus yang dgos pa med/ nga rang gar 'gro'i gdeng med pa la zer ba'i rtsi bcum bcum de 'dra yang shes 'dod la med/ dus ngan deng sang bsgral ba'i zhing bcu ma snyed kyi dogs pa ni gtan nas mi 'da'/ dang po'i dpe de yin/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bshigs pa ni mkhan slob dang / dkon mchog dbu 'phangs smod pa ni sbyin bdag dang / bla ma slob dpon dang pha ma la bdo ba ni skya ser yongs/ dam nyams ni grwa ba tsho rang zer ba'i dpe yin/mngon spyod byas so rang byas so zhes gsung lugs 'dis/ khyed rang tsho la'ang byed dgos pa'i thugs bzhed cig yod pa 'dra/ bzhed na phul ba'i chog lags/ yang khyed ci'i phyir drag po'i las byed ce na/ rang don du ni gtan nas ma byas mi byed/ byed par mi 'gyur/ rgyu mtshan des dang po yun ring por cig ci yang med/ phyis nges pa'i don gyi bstan pa cung zad skyong skabs 'dir 'gal byed mang po byung ba rnams la ngas ched btad las la sbyar ba mi dran te/—206—

rtags du ma re yong gin 'dug pa/ yang snga sor nged kyi dran mi dran gyi skabs dang po zhig bla chen 'ga' re la/ mthu gtad byas so/ /zhes skur pa'i khungs 'debs kyin yod/ nyams med pa rnams de skyon brjod gnad du phog nges shes pa cig yin par 'dug khong pa'i las thabs la gnod yod par 'dug snyam byed/ da 'di ru yang thabs zab po cig byung snyam/ de'i rigs 'gre nged la 'geb par 'dug ste/ deng la bstod ra yin/ mngon spyod kyi las yag po min na/ gshin rje'i cho ga gtong ba skad/ phur chog gtong ba skad/ rnga gog ding ding / zlos rgyag gtor rgyag byed pa skad 'di tsho thams cad phung 'dug da lta ni bzang bzang mo byed kyin 'dug pa/ de tsho drag las min na ci yin/ kla klo blun po tsho bsam mno thong zhig da lta bla ma slob dpon dge 'dun sngags pa rtogs ldan yod tshad mthu rang la smon smon ni byed kyi 'dug pa/ ngor pa tsho ni nged ngor pa rang mthu che/ rdzong pa tsho ni nged rdzong pa rang mthu che/ /zha lce ba tsho ni nged zha lu ba tsho rang mthu che/ de bzhin du sa skya ba/ karma pa/ bo dong ba sogs mtha' na dgon chung sad sud dang / bla chung sad sud thams cad kyang nged tsho rang mthu che/nga cag gi chos skyong rang bka' gnyan zer gyi 'dug pa/ mthu mthu zer ba de kha mngon spyod ka yin las che/ dgra la srog ser cho 'phrul gsum byung ba dang /mi shi god kha yul thon nang 'khrug sogs byung ba la mthu byung zer na ni/ mnan gtad mngon spyod sogs dang don cig ming gi rnam grangs ka yin lags/ de 'dra gang yang mi yong na ni/ mthu che ba'i mtshan gzhi gang la byed/ lar gsung rab rnams nas mthu zhes bya ba mngon par shes pa drug la bshad yod de/ mthu —207—

che che zer ba de rnams de 'dra ni min pa 'dug de 'dra yod pa tshol dgos na ni/lo 'bum tsho gcig gi lam rgyags khyer nas 'tshol du 'gro dgos pa gda' lags/ thams cad mthu chen 'dod pa dang / /mthu chen byung na kha gtod pa/ /'di 'dra 'gal ba ltag sprod yin/ /ra lab cha lab snying re rje/ khyed cag rnams kyi smra ba la/ /ngas kyang lan ni de 'dras btab/ /nga nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor la/ /lar ni de 'dra'i rtsis gdab mod/ /sbyor ba thams cad ye sbyor yin/ /sgrol ba thams cad ye sgrol yin/ /ye sbyor ye sgrol rṣa po'i ngang du oṃ ā hu/ /sbyor sgrol gnyis kyi spyod pa 'di/ /gsang sngags pa yi khyad chos yin/ /mngon spyod cig pur ga la zad/ /sbyor sgrol ma byin len dang rdzun/ /tshig rtsub la sogs rnam pa lnga/ /dbyings su gcod cing dbyings su rol/ /skal med log lta can tsho rang / /zab chos 'di 'dra'i col dogs med/ /lud gseb tu nyal ba de ka dga'/ /gzhan ni gang yang byed rgyu med/ /badzra gu ru padma sirnyi hū/ /ga zos ngan spyod thams cad kyis/ /sgrib pa dag tu yod mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs gdog lags/ yang 'o na sngags chos mang po las sbyor sgrol gnyis byed par gsungs pa de chos min na mi nag phal pa dang / dgon gog gi 'ba' hrang tsho dang / bla brang gog po'i nang bzan tsho dang rta rdzi mdzo rdzi tsho la dgongs pa e yin/ gsang sngags la bkag na/ mtshan nyid pa skam po tsho la dgongs pa e yin/ gsang sngags pa chen po la bkag na/ gsang sngags pa phal pa las dang po pa tshol gnang ba lags sems/ bka' bkod cig gnang bzhu lags/ lar rmongs pa lta zhog mkhas mkhas kun yang gzhan gyi —208—

zer sgra'i rjes su 'brang ba las mi 'dug rjes zlos sna tshogs byas pa dang /lab snga phyi thams cad 'gal/ gsang du tshogs pa la dngos 'gal gyi dpe de ga yong gin 'dug ngas ta snga sor 'thung thor shing ka pa gcig la gshin rje'i sku rang byon cig byung / de rjes skabs cig nas/ bstan pa spyi rim la dmigs pa'i drag po'i spyin sreg 'dra dang gtor 'phen re tsam ma gtogs mngon spyod ta su la'ang ma byas te/ mi shes shes rdzu mkhan tshos gcig mag zer mkhan tsho la de tsam smras pa de yin pa rang bden pa rang yin te ku re bzhad gad kyang lags so/ /'phros don de mangs so/ /da ni sngar gyi 'phros nas pond na/ dus der sde srid yab sras dang lcam drung sogs la rkyen sel gyi rim pa sngar khyud ltar dang / li ma lha khang du bde mchog pū hi pa'i dbang zhig byas/ de nyin khams nyog pa rang byung / de rjes dgongs bzhed ltar gshed dmar bcu gsum ma'i dbang zhig kyang sgrubs/ chos than thun sad sud zhu mkhan 'dra mang du byung / ka bzhi nas sogs rang re'i bu slob bla slob kyi rigs bdun brgyad sogs 'ga' shas la/ dkon mchog ta la dang / sa bcu pa dang / sangs rgyas sa de mdo gsum po de dpe bshad zhib par byas/ dpal 'khor bde chen nas mkhan chen kun dga' lung rig pa'i drung yang phebs/ gzhan mang dag dang bcas pa la zab lam nai gu chos drug dbang dang bcas pa dang / gser mdog can tshogs chen dang / thar pa ba rnams la'ang chos kyi rnam grangs 'ga' re sgrubs/ sde srid nas bal po'i bzo bos shing rkos byas pa'i klu dbang rgyal po dang / sa skya gong ma lnga sogs phyag bzhed gnang ba'i sku 'dra mang rab dang / po ti re mang la —209—

rab gnas byas/ lo 'di babs kyis char pa shin tu chung ba la/ skabs skabs chu thog dang ser drag yong ba'i mi phyugs zhing sogs la gnod pa che ba cig byung /sngar gyi rgyun la dbyangs can byā ka ra ṇi'i 'phros yongs su rdzogs pa'ang sa 'dir bsgyur grub/ yar yong dus/ phyug grong gi 'og tsam der/ bsam gtan sbug pa sogs 'phrad mkhan mang rab byung ba dang / gsang chu mig nas 'gro dus kyang mi 'tshogs re che byung ba'i/ mi 'tshogs de gnyis kar la/ ya mtshan pa'i ltas yod pa re re 'dug sha ba chu rgyas pa la 'dzem pa'i zol gyis/ glang la brgyud lhun rtse'i zam pa skor/ nam zla dbyar smad hor zla bdun pa'i nang yin dbyar ltas mang po shugs byung / lam skor ba rnams yul sna tshogs kyi bdud rtsi bsten pa zar ba de /smung bden par 'dug lo snga ma'i ston ka dang / 'di skabs yan chad la rtag brtan du rnam sras gling gi skor rgya khyon che ba steng 'og thams cad mthar thon pa byung / de nas yar 'ongs nas ston ka dang / dgun stod de ri khrod chen po dang / rtag brtan gnyis la yar 'pho mar 'pho byas/ rje grol mchog gi skye rabs 'phreng ba'i thang ka thog tshad ma bco lnga yang bzhengs grub pa la rab gnas bgyis/ grwa rigs rnams ston gyi brel ba'i skabs yin pas/chos bshad kyi g.yeng ba sogs kyang med/ spyir yang lang tsho yol/ lus stobs zad/ rtag tu nad kyis she mong 'thab pa 'dis/ da ni chos bshad sogs kyi spros pa'i khur yang rim pas 'dor bsam pa yin/ da dgos nus na dge sbyor byed/ ma nus na sos dal snyoms las la sdod pa rang dga' bar 'dug 'jig /ye lke rten gyi bya ba lta zhog chos kyi bya bar ming btags pa thams cad kyang / gsog —210—

gsob ya ma brla snying po med pa'i zlos gar tsam du gda'o/ /da dus mthar sleb/ rang phyogs gzhan phyogs skya ser drag zhan pho mo chos pa 'jig rten pa thams cad/ khyi lud la gser du 'dzin pa 'di ka ya re cha'o/ /de rjes dgun stod rtag brtan gyi tshogs su gsang ba spyi rgyud yongs su rdzogs pa'i bshad pa dang bstan pa la 'jug pa'i rim pa sogs chos sna 'ga' zung byas/ dus tshod 'di tsam na skyes po de bteg thub na nga rang gi don de legs pa rang yong rgyur 'dug na'ang / da ka sngas man phyis man cig yod pa 'dra/ de rjes ri khrod chen por lug lo spre lo'i mtshams kyi khrid mo che yang btsugs/ khrid gsar ba yang mang po byung zhing khrid lo'ang shin tu legs/ dam po'i skabs de la nang cig bud med ga lko nu lus shin tu che zhing sbom pa la sha nyams rgyas pa/ gcer bu skra grol ba zhig gis chos kyi gtam 'dra yang smra zhing / lung bstan rab rib zar zur 'dra byed snyam pa cig byung / de skabs mkha' 'gro'i bskang bshags mchod gtor gsol 'debs gnad bskul rgyas pa nan che ba zhig dgos rgyu yin pa 'dug na'ang / le los khyer nas byed pa ma byung ngo / /snga sor gzhong rma byar sdod mkhan dpon drung blo gros sangs rgyas zer ba khong gi ko cag gi nang na 'chad du grags pa'i sa cha de/ khong rang yod dus nas nged la sbyar yig dang bcas byin pa yin na'ang / sa skya'i mnga' zhabs kyi 'khris na yod pas/ khong pa 'das nas sa skya a mis drung rang nas 'phrog pa mdzad song / de rjes rim pas sa skya rang du yang yang zhug kyang ye ma byung / ngan lan tes 'dzin byed rgyu yin na ta las bla bar 'dug ste ga la byed/ bdag chen drung rang ni ma thus pa 211—

——phran tshegs re la yang pir pir tog tog de 'phral rang sku 'phar 'gro ba 'dra de ka rang mdzad pa cig 'dug pas 'di nas kyang ci gsung ngam bsam thugs zag gsog gsog la/ yang yang ka snyan gcer zhus/ de 'dra re la yang thugs rgyal bzhengs theng re dang bka' bkod ra thon lug thon mdzad thengs re ka yod ba cig byung / 'di skabs sde srid nas ngo chen dang mi sna sgrags pa zhus dus/thugs khog chung ba'i mi sna tshos phyag 'bul byed long yang med par/ thab po'i kha nas gang thon gyi dpe dang / spre'u 'brab 'drab mdzad kyi 'dug zer/ de nas yar 'phen mar 'phen mang po cig la/ 'chad kyi tshab tu gzhug nas pha drug gi sman chu go lung mchod thes su sbyor 'jags gnang ba yin/ sde srid nas bka' shog bka' bkod kun la/ tshab longs nges shes pa gyi gsung pa yod kyang / khrims sa ba rang gi mgron gnyer yig mkhan 'ga' re dang / rtsis sprod mkhan shel dkar gyi bsdud dpon cig gis zar zir gyi dbang las tsha ba ji bzhin thub pa rang ni ma byung / che chung gang byung yang nged kyi sa nas re khang med de/ ma zos grong po che yong nyen yod pas kha gsal nas smras pa yin/ lar gyi yang / chen po rnams la sug zos nas/ 'khor gyis brlag pa shin tu mang zhes pa ltar la zon dgos so/ /'di dag gi dus su sa skya zhabs drung a mi drung gi bka' bkod yin zer/ rin po che rang 'grel ba ngag dbang chos grags kyi drungarang ni ma tshor ba'i khungs kyi bzang rdzu mdzad/ drung chen gyis dmag dpon byas/phu rdzong dgon pa'i bka' bcu rab 'byams dang / dge slong gi khungs tshos kyang go gon mtshon thogs rang byas pa'i ser dmag gis/ cha lung dgon pa sgrub pa —212—

ma'i sde la bcom rgyag byas/ bla ma pa la srog skyob pas sleb pa min pa thal song la gtod rgyu yin zer zhag shas dam 'jur byung 'dug lar ni btsun ma'i sde la go gon mtshon thogs byas nga/ rang gis khyer kha shor ba dang / 'jungs med pa dang / krog shu langs pa gsum kyi rtags thams cad bstan par gda'/ spyir cha lung 'di rje btsun chen po grags rgyal gyi sgrub gnas yin pas sa skya nga/ tshos spyi mchod du dgos rgyu ni yin nga/ 'dra cig 'dug lar phyis kyi sa lugs pa kun bla ma gong ma'i sgrub gnas bza' tsam me/da pa tsho gnas stong par bskyur ba'i srol zhig snga mo nas byung 'dug dgon pa thar pa gling du bton na mi dga' ba gtsug lag khang du khram/sa gcod byed pa la dpa' dpa' mor rtsi bar gda'/'di yang stong par skyur ba la/ cha lung sgrub chen mar grags pa nges/ jo nang du yang yang byon/ rje grol mchog gi skabs sbyor drug gi skor des po zhus/ khong rang yang nyams rtogs bzang zhing sgrub grwa 'di yang btsugs/ da lta'i bar du sbyor drug gi rgyun ma chad pa yin/ 'di skabs khong tsho khrims sar thug cha lung ba rnams la sngar khyud bzhin 'jags nga/sa/ khong tsho de pa rang spyod ngan bstan rang rkang ring gis drangs pa ma gtogs/ grub 'bras ni gang yang ma byung song /phu rdzong ba tsho rang ni kha sing bla ma'i bka' bkod la/ cha lung bla ma gsod shog gsung gin yod tsa na/ de dus en gsod ma nus pas phung byung zer gyin yod par 'dug go /'di skabs smon thang nas/ chos rje dam/ chos rgyal mtshan dpon slob kyang phebs/ phu 'dar mang skol sogs rnyed bkur yang dag mdzad/lha sa skor ba'i yar lam yang byon/ chos bka' ci rigs pa byas/ 'di skabs —213 —

sde srid nas nged la hor zla gnyis pa'i nang du yong dgos tshul nan chags phebs byung na'ang / snga sor sprul lo nas gzung srung 'khor la ni bdag chen rin po che brtan bzhugs rang gnang yod pas thebs chag pa ni mi 'dug de res ltas shin tu ma legs pa shar bas mi 'gro bar thag bcad do/ /'di skabs byang nas lcam drung sa skyar phebs rgyu yin 'dug mi dmangs rnams bar bir du lab pa la/ khong rang dpon g.yog rnams gsang ngam dam mo mdzad kyin 'dug gang ltar rtse la 'byon pa'i zhor la mar lam nged 'phrad par phebs byung / bal po'i skad cha 'dra ba cig gi nag po dgu thog la dkar rtsi gsol rgyu'i khungs yin zer te/ dkar rtsi dang nag yug nor gda'/ hor zla gnyis pa'i 'ju ga gi gnam gang la/ spyi rim la dmigs nas/ skyid phug ltag rir gtor ma rgya che ba zhig btang dus/ bu yug chen po mi bzad pa rang glo bur du byung ba'i gtor chog lugs su mi rgyug la khad tsam la/ thongs tsam ni byung / de nyin ka bla chen ye shes drung sku snyung ba'i 'go brtsams par 'dug gangs de 'tshub 'gyur chen po dug char gyi rnam par 'dug zla ba gsum pa'i 'go la rtag brtan du phyin/ tshogs pa rnams la gshed dmar bcu gsum ma'i dbang zhig dang / dpung bzang gi rgyud la bshad pa zhib pa cig dang / gzhan chos than thun 'dra byas/ yang gzhis ka rtse nas 'bod mi nan chags gnang hor zla bzhi pa'i gung dkyil la sleb dgos tshul 'dug pas/ de kha'i dbang du byas/ dge tsha'i khungs shig yod pa de yang grub/ ri khrod chen por khor tsam phyin/ tshes bcu drug la rtag brtan du sleb/ 'phral du 'gro ma reg yin na'ang / bla chen ye —214—

——shes drung par skabs sku khams lam pa dwangs yod pa yin te/ de nub rang nas sku khams log snyung zug che ba med kyang / shed stobs tshang ma bri ba'i zungs ngan pa rang du song 'dug pas/ shar la 'gro ba then/ de nas kyang khong gi sku khams je lod la song ba'i hor zla lnga pa'i tshes bcu la sku ma 'tsho song chos kyi sgo ris med pa la mkhyen pa rgyas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la shin tu phan pa zhig yong bar yod na'ang / sems can gyi bsod nams la ma shong bar 'duga'on kyang dgung lo nyi shu skar skor nas nyan bshad mang du mdzad pas 'gro don mdzad rgyu yang lo mang po byung song / der dgongs rdzogs sogs kyi brel ba la zla ba'i 'phro de rtag brtan du bsdad/ sku gdung ni lho phyogs la spyan 'dren mdzad song / de rjes dus kyang dbyar gung la thug pa dang / sde bdag rang la'ang sog po'i rjes 'ded kyi khungs/ byang thang la dmag chen mdzad dgos stabs sogs ma phyogs rang na thugs brel langs 'dug pas/ nged cag dbyar kha dgon par bsdad chog pa byung / ri khrod jo nang gi dbu rtser grags pa 'di gnas chen 'di nyid rang gi lha khang gi snga shos chos rje kun spangs chen po'i nang rten bzhugs pa yin kyang / bar skabs shin tu khogs pa dang rdibs choms chang chung mang du byung / lo snga ma rnams la zhib gsos byed 'dod kyang / sa yul gnyan pa zhig yin 'dug pas brtag pa la ma thon/ lo 'di la rung ba'i dbang du byas/ hor zla lnga pa nyis brtsegs yod pa'i rting ma'i zla ba gsar 'phral nas zhig gsos kyi las ka btsugs pa yin/ thog ma rtag brtan nas nyin rgyugs cig 'ong nas a rta'i cho ga byas/ las ka byed sa khul dog cing g.yas g.yon —215—

— thams cad khang pa gzhan gyis bkag nas byed stabs mi bde bar yod pa/sa /rnying pa 'bebs pa dang / sa sel rdo sel la ring du thogs dogs byung yang / nyi ma gnyis kyi ngo la grub/ mchod rten la cung zad tsam yang skyon mi yong ba'i thabs byas/ g.yas g.yon gyi rtsig pa'i 'gram gsar du 'khru dgos stabs/tshes drug la sa chog rgyas par byas/ dus dbyar gung chen yin/ lo 'di la yar gyi char pa yang shin tu che mod/ kun spangs chen po nyid la gsol ba btab pas mkhar las la char bas gnod pa ye ma byung / 'di skabs yol ba mkhan chen byams pa blo gros rgyal mtshan pa'i drung / dpon slob rnams la gcod kyi khrid lag len nges can dang / thams cad rig pa dang / 'chi med rnga sgra'i dbang sogs byas/ mkhan po ba 'di/ nged rang lo nyer lnga 'gro ba'i thog nas slob mar gyur/ chos zhu ba la yang yang byon/ lan gcig lor nye ba tsam yang nged kyi zla la yang bzhugs/ shing pho stag gi lo nas gzung / khong re'i 'dzin bdag yol dgon pas skor dang bcas pa nged la blo gtod mdzad pa yin/rtag brtan tshor yang skabs skabs phebs/ spyir deng sang gi mi 'di rkyen phran bu re la phar 'gyur tshur 'gyur rang byed/ de'i nang nas kyang dbus bka' 'gyur kha yang ba yin na yang / khong pa 'di sngon ma nas g.yas yong g.yon yong rang mi gsung ba la/ dad gus 'gyur med cig byung / yang stag lung rin po che nas bla ma sgro ra zer ba khong 'dir gtong ba gnas ste/ brtag pa byed dgos kyi sku don 'phran bu dang / nā ro pas mdzad pa'i rim lnga bsdus gsal 'di/ rim lnga'i snying po lta bur 'dug cing / rim lnga smar khrid kyi rtsa ba rang yin pa 'dug —216—

gna'ang / sngon chad 'grel pa mi 'dug pas 'di la ṭīka kha gsal cig byed dgos phebs pa ltar 'phral du rtsoms pa byas te phul/ de tsho'i rjes cig la chos rgyal las kyi gshin rje'i man ngag thams cad nag po 'gro shes su byas shing / 'jug tu chos kyi rgyal po'i rtog pa la yang dka' 'grel go bde ba dang bcas pa cig brtsams/ 'di skabs nyin mo zhig rtsoms pa'i tshig spor ba'i sgang la/ gnyid phyogs pa'i gsal snang gcig la/ dam can chos kyi rgyal po da lta rang 'di ka na phebs yod/ chos rgyal yum da lta en phebs bsam byung zer/lcam dral gnyis la ja gra〈pa dang mgron gtong rgyu'i khungs byed kyin 'dug pa gsal po rang zhig byung / yig cha rtsams pa de gnad 'a ni reg pa cig byung ba dang / 'a zheb cha dang bka' gnyan pa'i cha shas ni yin 'dug de dag tu dbu rtse la ka ba ring mo de bcu tsam 'dzugs dbos yod pa'i ka gdung rnams ja sbyor gcig gi ring la tshugs/ nyi ma de ka la thog shing thams cad kyang 'grems thub/ shin tu grub che/ sde brgyad kyis las ka byas par the tshom med pa lags/gzhan yang chos grwa rnying pa'ang rgya bkyed cing / de la'ang zhig gsos mang du dgos pa dang / rung khang yang rnying pa rtsa ba nas phab ste rgya bkyed/ thog kyang 'phral du khel pa dang / mtha' phyi dang lam bar thams cad du/ rdo gcal rdo skras sogs rgya chen po yod de/ 'u lag pa drug cu bdun cu skor cig gis dbyar thog de kha la nyes skyon cung zad kyang med par grub/ lha khang dang khang pa so sor bgegs skrod rab gnas kyang byas/ rtag brtan du padma gling gi khang pa snga sor gyi de brtan por yod kyang / rting la rgya bkyed pa'i skor de rngam po dpon drung —217—

sogs las rgyab pa rnams kyis thad ma ma byas par/ brtan po ma byung 'dug cing / 'di lo char ba ches bas zhig ral yang byung / de mthun dam dum bzhig ste slar zhig gsos byas pa'i 'og thog khel/ snga sor rtse nas zla ba brgyad pa'i nang du shog gsung ba yod re thugs brel stabs shig byung ba yin nam/ brgyad pa'i nang du gleng brjod ma byung / dgu pa'i nang la thog mar sde srid rang rgyal rtser phebs/ nged kyang rgyal rtser yong dgos phebs pa zhig byung / de la khas len kyang byas pa'i rgyal rtser 'gro rtsis yin na'ang / de 'phral 'gyur ba'i nyang stod la phebs pa gsher la 'dug da res 'di la lta 'gangs mi 'dug ste/'gag che sar bka' gros lhus ma things pa 'di 'dra byung na cung yong rgyu min pa 'dug 'di skabs snga ma rgyal rtse la gal che rang yod gsung pa la/ rting ma 'di yin rang med pa de la yi ma rangs pa cig kyang byung / 'on kyang snga sor nan chags yang yang rang gnang ba de la 'gro ma thub/ da res kyang ma phyin na mi yong ba 'dra bsam/ ri khrod chen po nas thog ma mas yong ba'i nyin/ lam bkra thog ma rang la mi rkang lag gong po gnyis dang 'phrad pa dang / rta la zhon dus yob grol ba sogs bkra lod pa rang byung / de rjes rtag brtan du zhag shas cig bsdad nas/ slar yang la nye de bzlog pa'i phyir/ cher btang ri khrod du phyin zhag gcig bsdad/ slar 'ongs pas snod gang ba dang 'phrad pa sogs bkra legs tsam byung / 'di skabs gzhi de rtag brtan du med jo nang du yod pa'i stabs kyis gzhi de jo nang la rtsis pa yin/ de rjes rtag brtan nas dgu pa'i tshes bcu la thon rgyu yin na'ang / thab 'dzin sogs ma sleb pas zhag gcig —218—

'gyangs/ de nas rim pas rtse phyogs su sleb/ lo snga ma yongs dus dang /'di res gnyis kar/ rtse gdung nas bdag chen rin po che khri'i drung yang nged sleb dus bzhugs 'dug cing / theg drug bdun re nas thegs pa mdzad song /snga gong nged gzhon dus gcig tsa na/ bdag chen 'di pa la chos than thun 'dra zhu 'dod yin na'ang / bar skabs nas phyag g.yog sogs 'ga' zhig dang /phyogs gtogs kyi yon bdag tsho yang sdang shugs kyi khungs byed cing / sa thag rings nas nged la bstad yongs pa 'ga' re'ang lam du skyogs shing bsgyur ba 'dra yang byung bas/ che dang chung gi dpe yin/ dgongs par mi bde phyin/ de ka yin pa 'dug bsams ched kyi mjal kha zhu ba ma byung / rtser snga phyi'i res gnyis po 'di la'ang / ja 'dren ja zhus snol ma re ka byas/ spyir sa skya pa'i lugs 'dzin 'di rnams las nged la tshur drag shos mgo 'don dang / mnyam po tshos phan 'dogs/ dma' ba tshos gus zhabs sogs mdor na skyong pa'i rtsis ye med pa la/ nged kyi lus longs spyod yong dkrugs pa'i phar mgo 'bul lo 'bul byed dgos rgyu'i khungs kyi ha ma ha ma thar thar byed pa 'dug don 'a ni nged snga gong phyogs kun tu 'khyams dus/ sa skya pa'i pho rus phran chogs cig yod yang yod/ dbus gtsang gang du'ang sa lugs kyi bstan pa la gang phan byas/ de dus phan yang phan chen po byung ba ni kun la rgyus yod pa de yin/ gong ma lnga sogs bla ma gong ma rnams la ni da lta'i bar du yang mos gus bsgom bzhin pa 'di yin/ de tsho'i chos lugs ni da lta'ang byed bzhin pa de ka yin/bstan pa'ang 'dzin bzhin pa 'di ka yin/ da lta'i sa lugs kyi bla ma che phra/—219—

—————dgon grwa sa sus kyang / dang po dgos dus nged kyi mgo bton pa yang nam yang med/ rang mgo rang gis bton pa cig ka yin/ zas nor blangs pas ma mongs pa yang med/ rang gi rgyu nor gang yod kyis phar zhabs rtog byas pa cig yin/ drin phar cher mnyam pa ma gtogs tshur che snyam pa med/ nga tā ra nā tha skra spar gang ni dpal stag lung pa la bcad/ chos ni phyogs med du zhus/ sems ngo ni rtogs lda na lha dbang pas sprad/ bka' brgyud rtogs ldan 'a gad cig yin pa 'dug zer na ni gzhogs gcig nas 'dra rung yin/ lung bstan ni byams pa mgon pos mdzad/ lta ba ni dol po pa'i lugs skyong / chos skad ni rgya gar grub thob kyi rjes su 'brang / chos lugs su yin dang / su'i grwa pa yin de da shes par gda' 'am/ bla ma'i byin rlabs ni zhugs/ mdo rgyud kyi don ni shes/dam sdom ni dag gnas lugs ni rtogs/ yi dam ni mjal/ mkha' 'gro ni 'du/ bka' bsrung ni bran du 'khol/ skal ldan ni rjes su 'dzin/ rang rgyud ni grol/ gzhan don ni lhun gyis grub pa cig yin/ gzhan mkhas po yin zer ba mi dga' gnas dris na shod rgyu cig kyang med/ btsun po yin zer ba la/tshul khrims kyi dri ma'i tshab la ra thug gi dri ma bro/ bzang po yin zer ba la rang nga rgyal dang pha rol la phrag dog dang ngan smras dang tshig rtsub rgyun mi 'chad pa'i zam zom 'di pa dang cung zhig 'dra de mi yong go yam/ de las kyang shes ldan gyi khungs 'ga' re smad bud dang dam nyams bka' log kun la mthong che che mor byed pa 'di ni 'dam bi ra'i skad kyi dpe der gda'/ de ka 'dras yod na/ spra cal la la/ lkug pa lkug pa lkug pa/ ti thug ti thug zer bar gda'/ he he he —220—

he lags/ yang sngar 'phros las rtser sleb nas rang re'i bu slob 'dra pa la/'khrid lung ci rigs pa'ang bshad/ sde srid du mar rngog gi bzhed gzhung dpal dgyes pa rdo rje yab bka' yum bka'/ rdo rje gur rigs bsdus/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo ma la ste/ dkyil 'khor bzhi po de rnams kyi dbang rnams rdzogs par phul/ bdag med ma'i dngos gzhi'i nub mo rmi lam du/ gzhung spre shing dang /lung chung gnyis kyang rib tsam byung / da lta dben gnas zer rje btsun chos sku rdo rje dbyings su gshegs sa de na/ lha khang 'phra dar ba/ shar na dkar khung yod pa/ thangs mun ne ba cig 'dug dkon gnyer bud med rgan sang ba gos gsar ba gon mdze yam pa byung zer ba cig kyang 'dug lha khang gi nang na sgam cog rtse mang po bsgrigs 'dug pa'i kha thams cad sdig pas nag cag cag gang ba cig byung / dbang bskur zab mo de tsho'i gnyan cha'i ltas su 'dug phyogs 'dir sleb ma thag grib cham na ba zhig byung ba/ thang 'ga' re btungs pas de yang babs pa snyam byed/ rkyen de dag 'dus nga/'i nad tshabs che ba de yong ba'i 'go brtsams/ lar sha khrag gi lus yod phyin/ na tsha yong/ pa chos nyid du 'dugakhyad par du yang tshabs chen thams cad rang gi las ma/thu yin/ gzhan la khag bskur rgyu ye mi gda'/ de res na ba 'di yang las lhongs su nges shes skyes so/ /lo snga ma lug gi lo lhong zla gsum bzhi'i mtshams de 'dra cig la/ bud med smug mo lus shin tu che ba/ sbrul mgo mang po can/ rgyu gser g.yu sogs rin po che sna tshogs las byas pa'i srog chags kyi gzugs sna tshogs pas rgyan byas pa cig glang chen po gcig la zhe ne nas rab tu dga' ba'i tshul gyis/ na —221 —

'dzog chen po zhig la rgyug shar byed pa cig byung / ltas 'di rigs byung dus/sngar nas kyang lo gcig gi khongs su nad tshabs che ba re yong gin yod/ de yang rang re'i skye ba bcu drug bcu bdun gyi sngon rol nas/ skye ba kun tu smon lam log par btab pa'i klu srin mkha' 'gro cho 'phrul gdug tshub che ba cig yod pa khong dga' ba'i ltas yin par gda'/ lug lo dbyar yar 'ongs dus/ sde srid nas myur tu yong dgos tshul phebs kyin 'dug pa la'ang / lo rting ma la nad do'i ltas cig byung / na dogs cig yod/ de min de ka byed zhug/ lo 'di'i dus khrid kyi dam po'i skabs/ cham pa khag po cig byung ba la/ ngo ma shes par zas spyod thams cad log nas/ nyi ma gnyis shin tu na bar byung /nyi ma gsum pa la/ bco rdos gang yang ma byas pa cig la/ bshal khrus bungs che ba lan gsum byung ba/ de kho nas sangs te grag song / sngar gyi cho 'phrul de yang de tsam ka yin nam bsams kyang / cung min pa 'dug gzhan bzlog thabs rten 'brel gyi rigs ni ye ma byas/ de kas yin te grub thob o rgyan pa rin chen dpal na re/ dgra dam sel min pas gnod ma myong / gsung ba ltar/dam sel gyi rkyen cig ni nges par byung bar 'dug rgyu las lhongs rkyen chos kyi gnyan cha dang dam sel 'phran bur gda'/ lar bdag na ba las shi yang 'gangs ci gdog shi thengs lan bco brgyad byung yang sbang zan gyi chang bu gcig kyang gang ri mod/ gang na'ang hor zla dgu pa de'i nyer brgyad dgu nas gzung shin tu na bar byung na'ang / hor zla bcu pa'i nyer gcig bar la/ sde srid du tshe dbang rkyen sel tsho dang / gzhan chos tsho yang ma chag par thub/ de nas lus kyi —222—

shed sto bas bri bas/ dbang chos kyi spros pa rnams ma nus/ de yang brla nas brtsams te rkang pa gdung khad skrangs na zug drag po dang bcas pa dang / lus thams cad chu ser gyi 'bu rus khyab pa sogs nad gzhi rnying pa'i rigs gzhan yang mang po dus gcig tu langs/ 'gro 'dug langs sdod gang yang ma thub/'on kyang lus kyi na tsha ma gtogs/ sems la sdug bsngal ye med/ blo bde zhing sems skyid par byung / nad la dge sbyor thog 'gel min pa gzhan byed 'dod med kyang / zla bo thams cad kyis yang yang bskul ba dang / sde srid nas kyang gsung bas/ sman pa tsho la bstan/ sngar lar nas rang bzhin tshogs gsog ni rgyun du byed pa de yin/ na ḍā rkyen bzlog rim gro de 'dra byed kyin med/ 'di skabs kyang / ka bzhi nas sogs bu slob dam tshig gtsang ma bzhi sde cig gis nyams chags bskang thabs nyi ma gsum mdzad du bcug de min gzhan byed rtsis med de/ mdzod pas nga la gsang nas rim gro'i rigs mang po rang btang 'dug rting ma min pa ma tshor/ spyir dge 'dun la tshogs gsog legs pa yin mod de/ na ba la sman pa bsten/ rim gro btang ba sogs lo 'di la rtogs ldan gyi gdod yod skyal song / da yin na'ang khyad par med/ na ba'i sgang 'di kun la/ dad pa snying rje sogs gzhan pas che ba cig sngar yang yong gin yod de 'dir yang byung / khyad par skabs 'dir dmigs pa gtad res kyis rags pa thim tshul rnams mtshams phyed po rang min pa la/ sa chu me rlung thim tshul rnams de las gsal tsam/ phra ba snang mched thob gsum gyi rim pa rnams shin tu gsal ba rgya che ba re byung nas/ bzhi pa bde stong gi nyams la/—223—

yun ring du gnas pa sha dag byung zhing / na na tsha tsha la brten nas lus rnga /ya' ba'i rnam pa 'byung zhing / des drangs nas lus thams cad bde cham cham 'gro ba de 'dra'ang yang yang byung / 'od gsal dang bde nyams 'thug pa'i skabs/ na ba'i snang ba mi tsher ba yang rgyang tsam rgyang tsam yod/ phal cher cig rtsig pa mthon pa'i steng nas g.yas g.yon la bltas pa bzhin gnyis kar rig par 'dug spyir rlung gi rang bzhin shes pa'i rdor bzlas kyis hro sems dhwa tir thim nas 'od gsal du 'jug pa rgyud kyi dgongs pa yin mod/ man ngag tu bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bzhed pas/ las dang po pa'i rdor bzlas dkyus ma 'dis kyang / 'chi ba 'od gsal 'dzin nus zhes gsung pa yang shin tu los kyang mad te/ 'di skabs dbugs kha mi bsde ba de 'dra byung dus/ rdor bzlas 'jur po yud tsam re byas pa la'ang / snang ba bzhi'i rim pa gsal la brtan pa yong bar myong bas grub/ na ba dang 'chi bar snang ba 'di dag don la med bzhin du snang ba/ rmi lam gyi bde sdug bzhin du myong / de'i phyir na ba la sdug bsngal dang 'chi ba la 'tsher ba med kyang / rnam rtog gi bag chags ma byang pas/ dgon pa'am/ thang stong sogs ga ru shi yang khyad med/ rdzong nang du shi ba mi legs snyam pa skabs re byung / de dus ba la ka kun dga' dpal bzang gis gnyid kyang rtag tu bcag pa'i nyin mtshan kun tu g.yog ma thebs la 'jebs pa gzhan sus kyang mi yong ba rang byas/ nga rang yang yid rang ches/ sngar gom 'dris ches pa'i sel 'dra yong shas che na'ang / thams cad dag los yod/ kho pa'i blo la nged rang da res ma shi pa gcig rang bsams pa dang / na ba 'di 'phral du —224—

rang grag na snyam pa dung dung rang byed kyin 'dug pas/ dgongs gcig bsam pa la/ rje grol mchog de rong ngur smig gi rje btsun ma dang mjal bas bar chad thams cad sel ba yin par 'dug da lta li ma lha khang 'di na bzhugs kyin 'dug pas/ spyan drangs nas gsol ba btang na phan nam snyam pa zhig yong skabs/ rje btsun ma'i bris sku 'bral spang zhig yod pa 'di/ sku dngos dang bzhugs tshul 'dra ba'i lo bcu skor 'gro ba'i gzhon nu ma'i rnam par song ba snyam pa cig la/ de mi phan gnod yong gsung / las ngan shugs ches pas dngos su mi phan pa rang bden shas 'dug ste/ gnod yong ba de 'dra rang ci srid par snyam ca na/ nged ma dga' bas yin/ nga khros pas yin gsung / steng gi phyogs yi nas khyod la byang chub spyod pa yang ma byung na/ bzang po spyod pa ga nas 'ong zhes gsung bkyon pa cig kyang gsal bar byung / de nas ngur smrig gi rje btsun ma nub re bzhin phyag mchod la spyan 'dren zhus/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya dang 'gal ba kun la bsha/gas pa phul/ mchod pa gsol 'debs bzlas pa gang 'a sdo/ba byas/ gdung shugs drag po rang shugs la byung / yang rgya nag lha khang zhu ba de na snga dro re bzhin mchod 'bul la rgya gling re gtong gin 'dug 'di skabs tshes grangs dngos de brjed 'dug zla ba bcu gcig pa'i 'go stod la ni yin/ snga dro cig gling bu 'bud pa'i sgra tshor ba'i sgang de la/ rmi lam ni ma lags/ nyams snang la ri bo gcig gi rtse na rdzong cig 'dug de'i rab gsal cig na rang re 'dug ri'i rtsa ba phyogs na rgya nag gi bzo rtse gos chen gyi ri mo la yod pa'i seng ma 'brug de'i rigs la/ mdog mu men 'dra ba —225—

cig gis rgya gling gi sgra de de'i skad du song ba 'dra ba la/ nga la bslu brid byed gyu ba'i dga' dga' snyan snyan gyi tshul du 'bod pa ltar byed kyin 'dug sngar lo 'di'i 'go la rmi lam du byung ba'i bud med tshon mo de ka de ma thag gang nas byung cha med par byung nas/ phyag gi brdeg pa'i stangs dang / khyi skrod pa lta bu'i skad cig mdzad song ba'i skad cig de la/ srog chags de 'jigs nas/ shar phyogs la bar thag pa chad nas bros/ la cig brgal nas bud song / ral gcig ma lta bu'i byin rlabs yin par sems/ yi dam thams cad thugs rgyud ye shes gcig cing dgyes pa dang mi dgyes pa'i rnam par rtog pa mi mnga' yang /sgrub po'i las kyi sgrib pa sbyang ba'i phyir/ mi dgyes pa ltar ston pa yang / skyon can gyi 'chad yul nas 'don pa'i thugs rjes gzung ba der gda'/ 'di dang 'dra ba bdag dang po bsam sdings su sdod pa'i skabs shig slob dpon pu rna badzra dang gsung gleng la bslab dus kyi nam mkha'i snying po'i bshags pa'i 'phros cig byung / de yod pa la deng sang nam mkha'i snying po la bsnyen pa byed dgos gsung gin 'dug de rjes cig la bcom ldan 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i mtshan brgya'i lugs ltar gyi bsnyen pa cig kyang byas/ mdo las 'byung ba ltar/tho rangs kyi dus skya rengs la gsol ba 'debs pa de nub bdun bstud nas byas pa'i rting ma la/ nam zi ba'i skabs gnyid tshogs pa'i rmi lam na/ bod pa'i dge slong sku sha dkar ba dar yol dus nyams can/ gos chen gyi snam sbyar sngon po gsol ba cig gis/ khyod rang da bshags pa gyis gsung / spyi bshags bla ma rdor 'dzin ma cig byed kyin 'dug pas/ de tsam gyis mi chog —226—

sgos bshags kyis gsung rang re'i blo la byang sdom dang 'gal ba'i rtsa lhung 'di dang 'di byung 'dug snyam pa kha cig 'dug pas/ de rnams kyi ming nas bton bshags pa 'bul gyin 'dug de nas de zhal 'dzarsha/ mdzad nas da dag 'dug ste tsha tsha stong phrag gcig thob gsung / gnas sgo cig nas yar la bzhung song /de nas rgya nag gi ri mo la bris yod pa'i gyad 'dra ba/ chu shing ra nag gi rgyug pa thogs pa cig gdong na 'dug de na re 'di 'dzed la khad khad/ da dung gzobs shig zer ba cig byung / chos nas bshad pa la yid ches byas lag tu blangs na de ltar 'ong ba yin/ da lta de 'dra lar mi 'ong na/ rmi lam 'phags par nam mkha'i snying po'i/ mdun du 'dug ste bshags pa bya/ zhes gsungs pa'i dgos pa gtor ro/ /bdag cag so so skye bo nyon mongs pa'i rang bzhi can yin pas/ nyes lhung char bzhin 'bab pa'i rigs yin mod/ bcom ldan 'das nam mkha'i snying pos bdag gi spyi gcug nas bzung nas nyes ltung thams cad sbyong ba yin snyam pa bdog lags/ snga mo lan cig skyid phug na yod pa'i skabs cig kyang / nam mkha' nas bdag rang yi dam du byed pa'i lha'i rnam pa cig gis/ da dung bzod pa ma thob kyi/ /nga rgyal ma byed rang sems thul/ /phyi gshe/la ma byed bsam gtan la/ /lcag grobs lhan cig skyes pa sgoms/ /zhes byung ste/ yi dam gyis sgrub pa po'i 'tshang nas 'dru ba ni rjes su gzung ba'i rtags yin/ de dag 'phros don tsam lags/ 'di skabs 'tsho byed pa nam mkha' grags don pa sleb/ khong pas phan ngo cung che bar byung / zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu gsum gyi nyin/ me rtsa brdeg pa'i lag len pa 'tsho byed —227—

dge slong bas byas/ khong gso dpyad pa rang yin pa la/ bslab gtsang rang yin 'dug pas/ khong la dad pa'ang 'gro ba cig byung / dus gcig la rnag 'bo gang tsam mngon/ rjes la'ang chu ser shin tu mang bar babs/ snga phyi yo sdoms zangs shu jo tsam yong ba yod/ de rjes rang re'i bu slob grwa rigs tshos kyang / re zhig lus ma sos par sdad na dga' tshul rang byed kyin 'dug gzhan phyi nang bar gsum tshos kyang de dang mthun pa la dang nge ding nge zer mkhan kyang 'dug ste/ de dag la rtsis btab ma byas/ bcad 'dra byed skabs kyang rang re'i zla la sdod mkhan tsho rgyus yod pas nyams snang cam mi byed par 'dug khong tsho gcig pa ba rnams 'jigs rngam sdigs ri 'dra ba dang / bcad tsho mi bzod snyam pa'i tsab cab byed kyin 'dug lar yang nged dang po chung chung nas/ bla ma gong ma'i skye ba yin zer ba'i ming cig byung ba 'dis/ mi gzhan tsho mno ba la bla ma che ba'i khungs kyi sku skye ga(nan rnams skyid chos gtso bor byed kyin 'dug pa de'i rigs 'gre byas/ nged la'ang rgyags tshad zos nas nyal sdod mkhan 'gar rtser mo gyu lang ba cig yin pas/ sdu ga sran med bsams pa cig byed kyin 'dug ngas ni gzhon dus nas skyid skyid mo ma byas/ sdug khur chen po byas pa cib ka yin/ bla ma gong ma'i stabs kyi ming sgra che tsam ma gtogs sa 'dzin ni 'phran tshegs kyang med/ g.yog rigs hur po ni gcig kyang med/ mang po yang med/ grwa rigs yon bdag gis ches kha 'bal 'bol du skyel ba yang med/sde/ nas dgon gnas 'dra la sred pa phran tshegs byas kyang rang lo nyer gsum yan chad/ yon bdag gi sar yal yul phyin pa'i skabs ma ga|skes/ rang gi —228—

dgon par bsdad nas thugs dam ma slob gnyer byed pa'i skabs kun tu/longs spyod ja gnyis gsum re skol/ de min lto rgya ri ma'i rtsol ba'ang byed kyin med/ za tshad 'thungs tshad kyi re ba lta ga la zhig thugs dam byed dus nam gung cung zad ma gtogs srod thor gnyid srung ba'i phyir/ thog stengs sam phyi ru 'thon nas dge sbyor byed/ slob gnyer byed dus kyang mtshan zang dpe cha sa shor ba'ang byas/ dgun ka yang srod thor phyi ru thon pa dang / sos ga nyin gung tshad pas gdungs pa yang khyad du gsod dgos/ zhogs rgyugs 'dzin pa kun yang /ska tshags bcings nam zi nas phyi la 'thon nas 'dzin pa ma gtogs/ mal sar sbug rdir rdir byed ma myong / bla ma slob dpon rnams rang re la brtse ba'i rang bzhin thugs su bcug pa yin kyang / rang re'i skyon sel zhing chos spyod srangs su 'ju ga pa'i phyir/ rtag tu bka' bkyon pa dang / skabs ska bas su phyag 'jug kyang yong ste yong ba de kun kyang bzod cing theg pa tsam du ma zad shin tu thugs mad cing / rang la sku drin che bar shes pa cig de dus nas bdoga'akhrug lo cig bsam sdings su/ mtshams byed pa'i rdzun btang/ gzhan la gsang nas/ chas gos sprang chas su bsgyur/ chu mig dang gnyan khrod mang po 'grim pa la phyin/ zla ba phyed dang gnyis tsam song / gnyan khrod nyi shu tsam 'khor/ bla brang gi nang zan bstan nyi zer ba kho bzhes bcags dgus bcags blta ba dang / tsam pa skyel ba 'dra la byung / gzhan zla bo med/ de 'dra a khu lags sogs zla bo tshang ma'i blor ma chud kyang thams cad la ma nyan pa yin/bla ma dam pa slob dpon rin po che de/ dus rgyun du bkyon pa kho na 'byon kyang /—229—

de res chos pa bya ba 'di 'dra gcig ka dgos rgyu yin pa 'dug ro mtshar che zhes dgyes dgyes dpe med mdzad/ de skabs mthong snang dang / cho 'phrul sogs bsam gyi mi khyab ste yi ger ga la lang / gnyan khrod brgya rtsa cig 'grim 'dod yod kyang / bla tshugs kyi ming 'dis de rjes byed pa ma byung / na tsha byung dus kyang na sran chen po bdog dge sbyor byed dus phal cher mtshan mo lus tshags mi 'jig na tsha drag po mang pos gtses/ las kyi dbang gis rgyun du rlud khams kyis na ba sogs nad kyi she mong 'thabs pas phyis lus stobs shin tu ngan yang / da lta'i bar du phal cher mtshan mo lus tshags mi 'jig tsha grang dang bkres skom gyi thog tu sran che bar bdog bla ma slob dpon tsho'i nang nas/g.yog byed pa dka' shos nged ma yin pa kun la gsal/ bla ma gzhan mang po'i phyag g.yog gi dka' las tsam dgos na/ nged la g.yog 'byor ba'i rigs kyang min pa 'dug des mtshon gzhan rnams kyi blo la kho byis pa nas dkor zos/ dkor chen po yin snyam pa cig 'dug ste/ lar chos nas gsungs pa la ltas na/ sa lam chen po rnams ma thob/ chos bzhin spyod par yang ma song tsa na/ ngas yon 'byongs pa yod ces kha pho ta ka nas thon te/ 'du ba yul lugs dang bstun pa'i dpe/ da lta'i bla chen gyi ming thogs pa'i skya ser che phra rnams kyi nang na/ ngad las dkor yang ba med/ rang sems dpang po yin pa ma zad/mi rgyus yod tsho yang dpang po yin/ dang po rgyal khams pa'i skabs su/ nor 'gangs chen gyi rigs ni lar len ma myong / ja dar ras snam sad sud la ni brje po tsam rgyab pa kho na yin/ lhag po than thun byung ba rnams ni/ lha sa la —230—

sogs pa lha khang gi mchod pa dang / phyogs med kyi dge 'dun la btang ba kho na yin/ phyis sgo tshod la dpags pa'i mnga' thang 'phran bu byung ba'i skabs 'dir grwa rigs kyi skyod dar 'dra dgos pa la ni/ byung song 'thabs na/ phar btang ba lhag pa ma gtogs tshur blangs pa ye med pa'i tshod tsam yin/ re re gnyis gnyis la brje po tsam byas pa srid lhag po byung ba ni mi dran/ lto gos chos gsum gyis bskyangs kyang mi chog par g.yas dgos g.yon dgos/ ha tar hu tar byed mkhan kyang yod gin 'dug yon bdag sogs 'jig rten skye bo'i blo 'dzin dgos pa la ni/ brje po rgyag pa yang srid mtha' tsam/ gzhan phar gtong ba rang ka yin/ sngon nas da lta'i bar du grwa rigs dang yon bdag gi dkor gyis nga la gos pa med/ nga'i dkor grwa rigs sogs rang la ma byung ba gyis/ sde bdag chen po zhal ngo rim can gyis snga phyir gnang ba sogs yo byad che phra thams cad ni dge phyogs kho nar bsgyur ba kun gyis gzigs pas gsal ba de yin/ spyir dkor la lhus ma blangs pa rang dka' ba 'dug ste/ bla ma gzhan mang po la 'dug pa ltar/ phyogs 'dzin rmongs zhen gyis kun nas bslangs pa'i zhen chen po rnams kyi rang ngam rang phyogs rnams kyis lta ci smos/skye bo thams cad la kha brod gtings nas/ gson po dang gzhin po'i nor thams cad bla ma'am dgon gnas der skyel gang thub byed pa de 'dra'i rigs kyi grwa rigs dang / skye bo zhen chen ni cig kyang med/ bla ma phal cher de 'dra'i thugs/ rtsol rang mdzad kyin gda' ste/ ngas ni de 'dra'i thabs mkhos kyang ye ma byas/ rgyu des na dad rdzas dang gzhin rdzas gang gis kyang gos pa med/ phran —231—

tshegs tsam ni byung ba srid de/༄ 'byongs tshod kyi dge sbyor re byas yod/ slob dpon rgya ma rang mo ba'i dpe de yin/ mi sdig can cig pas nyi ma gcig la/brgya brgya stong stong khri khri 'bum ri ba tsho zas kyang / gang gis yang bgros mi yong / sdom ldan tshogs nas nyin rtser gyi chog kha bal bal btang ba la/ tsam bre re re byung tsa na/ btsun pa 'di tsho'i dkor la dkor la zer ba skad/ mi'i kha la skyag rtad gang yod zer bar gda'/ de yang re bden yin/ dang po byis pa'i dus su/ zla bo kun gyis da dung zo zhes zas za ba la nan bskul byed dgos zas la sred po cig de dus nas med/ da lta'i bar du kha zas nyung ngu tsam za/ mang po yog pa'i myong yang min/ zhim lto la dga' shos kyang min/ bza' btung la ru nga po de 'dra'i tshang yang min/ gos kyang rin thang che che mo dang bzang bzang mo ma byas/ che khyad dang snang shas kyi shes 'dod kyang mi yong ba 'duga'adod chung chog shes rang ta ma lags te/ 'dod chen chog mi shes la kha thal ba rang min tsam bdog za mi nus gon mi nus pa'i ser sna rang yang min/ zas gos thams cad gzhan la byin pa kun gyi dgongs mod/ rje rgyal rme'i gsung nas/ de ka ma gtogs kha pho rbad shod byed ma myong zer ba de ka kha pho yin mod gsung ba'i dper 'dug sdug theg po yod byas pas ka sdug bsngal mi bzod pa dang / 'dod chung chog shes yin snyam pa de kha 'dod chen chog mi shes yin pa'i rtags su 'gro nyin ni bdog des mtshon nas cis kyang dgos med blo la shar rang zer ba de ma shar ba'i rtags dang / nga ro snyoms pa yin ro snyoms rang byed zer ba de ro ma snyoms pa'i rtags yin shas che ba 'dug de 'dra'i rigs mtha' —232—

dzis pa yod ste/ spyir rang gi gnas tshul tsam smos pa yin/ lar nas skyon gyis ma gos zer rgyu dang / yon tan mchog dang ldan zhes brjod rgyu ga la yin/mi mang po cig gi bsam tshod dang / nged kyi gnas tshul mi mthun pa ni der zad/rnam thar bris shig khyed rang gi yin lugs brjod cig zer mkhan byung tsa na/rang gi yin tshus byas tshul tsam smras pa yin/ ngas dka' spyad byas/ nga la dkor med/ ngas bzod pa sgoms zhes gzhan la yus 'tshod pa ga la yin/dad can tsho'i mthong lugs kyi/ sangs rgyas sam/ rdo rje 'chang dzom/ kun tu bzang po sogs kyi re ba ta nga la med/ log lta can mang po'i mthong lugs kyi/bdud gyur mo lugs de rang yang en man par 'dug /nga ras ltas na mi gzhung thad chos kyi skal ba can tsam yin par sems/ bag chags bzang po ni sad rgyu mang po cig 'dug kyang 'dug 'gal re zhig sad kyang sad/ dge ba'i 'jug sgo la la rkyen khar lus pa yang byung / phal cher rkyen gzhan gyi dbang du ma btang bar lag tu'ang longs pa lags so/ /rgyun chod dka' thub kyang du ma re du ma re byed myong/ 'dul ba'i spyod lam dam po yang 'gyang tsam byed myong ste/ bla ma tsho'i gsung gis kyang/ res dka' spyod byed dgos gsung / res ma byed lus la gnod gsung / ma bsdams par bsdad na kun spyod btsun dgos pa'i bslab cha mdzad/ btsun po rang byas na tshul 'chos su 'gro de 'dra rang mi dgos gsung / sangs rgyas yin kyang / gsung bzhin 'grub pa dka' bar 'dugathams cad kyi dgongs pa dus gcig la 'grub pa dka' bas rtsa ba'i bla mas ci gsung sgrub par sems lags/ skabs cig mtshan mo dur khrod 'grim pa 'gyang—233—

tsam byas te rgyas bshad mi byed do/ /da ni dkyus la 'jug ste/ de dus lusazungs ngan par yod kyang / rdzong nas yong ba'i snga dro rang nas khams bde zhing /zungs skyes pa snyam pa byung / tshes bcu dgu'i nyin mo snga dro'i cha la rdzong nas myol/ do li 'am byams khri la btegs nas 'ongs/ thar pa'i grwa pa rnams dang /gzhan rtogs ldan grwa btsun sogs mang po dang / khrom gyi mi skya ser pho mo mang pos mtha' bskor bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ bkra shis dge 'phel gyi skyed tshal du phebs tsam byas/ gang shar sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang nas nyams dga' yal le ba byung / de nyin lus nyams kyang bzang bas/ thar pa ba dpon slob sogs la/rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i tshe sgrub kyi 'khrid de rten 'brel legs pa'i phyir bshad/ de nub 'jam mgon sku skye ba'i drung gis/ nged dpon slob kun la tshogs 'khor bzab ma bshams/ khong dpon slob kyi rten mchod la/dpal 'khor lo chen po'i bris thang byin rlabs can cig kyang 'dug de dang tshogs 'khor de yang rten 'brel legs shing rang re'i nyams chags dag pa'i rtags cig kyang shar/ yar lam byams khri'i stabs tshugs thung thung byas 'ongs pas/ zhug dgu tsam 'gor kyang / nyin re bzhin khams dang skyed je che la song /nyer brgyad kyi nyin bsu ba'i bkod pa sogs ba ri bi ri mang po dang bcas nas rtag brtan gyi chos grwar sleb/ mgo rtsa med pa'i ser bsgrengs byed mi shes pa la/ grwa pa tsho la tshig rtsub mang po'ang btang bkra ma legs pa yang yin 'dugami 'tshogs shin tu che ba'i ngang nas chos bzang gi rdo rje gdan bya ba der cung zad bsdad/ de nas so so'i phyag rten tsho blangs nas/ yar lam sgo khri la —234—

btegs nas 'bras sbungs rtser phyin sdod sa khang pa gsar pa khams gsum rnam rgyal zhes ming btags pa der bsdad/ de nas bzung nas hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i gnam gang bar phyi mtshams med pa'i ngang nas/ 'phrod rten 'jug skyong tsho byas/ dge sbyor 'phel zhing rig pa dang la skyid par byung / 'di skabs kyang 'dun pa btang nas/ o rgyan la phyin na skyid po rang gcig yod rgyur 'dug pa la ka khos sdod dgos pa'i nan ches nas 'dun pa bshol ba yin/ bcu gnyis pa'i 'go nas langs sdod thub tsam byung bas/ de'i tshes brgyad tsam nas skor ba cung zad re yang byas/ da nas nga'i sku rim bsam yin zer mdzod pa rang gi dang ltos rang brtsol ba bskyed pa'i tshes drug gza' skar bzang ba'i thog tu/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa snang ba mtha' yas kyi sku brnyan zab sku dang gser sku chen po ba'i dbu btsugs/ dbus nas bstan 'dzin rin po che sprul pa'i sku dang / rang re'i o lo sogs kyang 'phrad par 'byor byung / hor zla dang po'i tshes gcig gi nyin phyi mtshams grol/ bla ma dge ba sogs khams phyogs nas yongs pa rnams kyi mang skor dang brnyed bkur 'bul ba bsngo rten sogs len pa la tshogs su phyin/ rtse zhol bar rkang pas 'gro thub tsam byung / gser zangs dngul gsum las bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad bzhengs pa 'di/lug lo hor zla brgyad pa'i nang du 'go btsugs pa yin/ phra rgyan mang bas yun ring thogs/ skabs 'dir mthar phyin/ mchod rten re re bzhin dpangs su mtho brgyad pa/ phra rgyan g.yu grung gu dkar dmar gtso bor gyur pa'i g.yu 'phra dang rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rigs la/ padma rā ga dang / tsu ni dang / go mu ti —235—

ka dang / pu she ra ka dang / su kan ti dang / la su na dang / int+ra nī la'i rigs dang / mar ka te'i rigs sogs dang / ṣa ṭa ti la ka dang / to ha ri dang / dngas shel dang / ha gi dkar dmar nag gsum dang / brdar shel mu men mu tig sogs mdor na/ mchod rten re re bzhin 'phra bkod stong phrag phyed dang gnyis re'i rtsis yod/ da rnams kyi gzungs bzhugs kyang tshes gcig gnyis de la ka grub/ tshes bzhi gza' skar bzang ba la/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas snga dro rab gnas dngos gzhi legs par grub/gos sku byams chen yang zhal 'byed byas/ cho se sde sgrub sde gzhan wi gzhis byes tshogs shin tu che ba la/ mchod rten brgyad kyi rten mjal btang / bzo bo'i dga' ston gra der rlung pos sa gdan bskyod ja zhal po ba'i ltas ma lags pa cig kyang byung / dga' ston gyi tshul du nged kyi chos bzang gi khri thog tu phyin/tshogs pa rnams kyis nged la brtan bzhugs byas/ spyi dgos gzhi byes so so nas 'bul ba byed pa'ang mang du byung / tshogs 'khor rgya chen po bshams/chos bzang gi bde yangs su tshogs gral la bzhugs mkhan la stong dang bdun brgya tsam byung / skal ba gtong dgos sogs yong sdoms na stong phrag gnyis lhag nges la/ tshogs zan bre do ma'i rgya dang / spel rnam grangs lnga re yod pa'ang chung chung g.yab g.yab min pa'i bag chags pa re byung / der 'tshogs skye po mi nag pa kun dang / tha na sprang po tshun la'ang skal ba mi chad par byas/tshogs 'khor 'di chos sde spyis rang nas btang ba yin no/ /nged rang ni da dung me shul gyi rma kha ma zubs shing / cha shas cha shas kyi nad sna tshogs sdebs pa'i —236—

lus thang thub rang mi 'dug rung / nad 'ol byi sangs pa'i dbang du byas/phyogs phyogs nas chos zhu la 'ongs pa'i grwa rigs rnam grangs mang po dgug sdod la yod pa tshun/ tshes lnga la ri khrod chen po dpal gyi jo nang du phyin/ de'i sang nyin tshes drug la ka rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i dus chos 'go tshugs par byas/ sngar khyud ltar thugs dkyil gyi dbang sogs kyang sla chos kyi dbang du ma btang bar sgrubs/ nang par dbang gong ma bskur rgyu'i de ring de ka rtag brtan pa thams cad kyang yar byon/ gzhi byes grwa slob pho mo yong sdoms pa'i snga sor rtag brtan gyi de las kyang tshogs bzhugs dang gtong dgos gnyis ka mang nges shes pa la/ sngar bzhin tshogs 'khor bag gro ba btang / dbu rtse chen mo'i sku 'bum gyi gdugs bcu gsum char khebs tog bcas te bar skabs cig 'jim bzo nges med sna tshogs cig bcos/ tshad kyang chung ba dang / zhig ral yang byung 'dug pas/ mchod rten nyid dang 'tshams pa cig gser zangs kyi rgyu la rin po che'i 'phra rgyan mang po dang / gdugs la rin po che'i dra phyed dpyangs pa dpangs mi gang lag thogs tsam yod pa 'di/ bar skabs 'dir legs par phul grub pa'i/ de'i rab gnas kha gso nyi ma snga dro'i cha la byas/ tshogs 'khor 'di rang re'i lag nas btang ba yin/ de lhar tshogs 'khor lan gnyis po de la/ sngam 'khor lo sdom pa'i lugs dang / phyi ma dus 'khor lugs su byas/ rang re dang grwa rigs so so'i nyams chags mang po skongs/ tshogs rgya chen po gsogs par nges shes skyes/ 'or gnyis ka rlung nag langs pa'i 'tshub tu mngon pa rang 'dug dus kyi khrid mo che'i skabs 'di la/ mang mkhar —237—

cha lung pa dang / mdog blo ldan pa dang / las stod lho phyogs dang dbus phyogs sogs byes nas yongs pa shin tu mang zhing / phu mda'i gzhi grwa nye skor gyi khye'u bu mo ci rigs dang bcas/ sngar ma thob pa'i khrid gsar ba rang sum brgya skor byung / rnying pa rnams dang kun sdoms pas/ dam po 'debs mkhan drug brgyar longs nges shes pa byung / dus la ltos pa'i khrid grwa rang bzang bar sems/hor zla gnyis pa la dam po dang khrid gtor sogs sngar khyud ltar bsgrubs shing /gsum pa'i tshes gcig la grol ba yin/ 'khrid gtor skabs ngam ring mkhan chen rin po che yang chos zhu thung tsam la phebs byung / glam byams pa kun dga' ba dpon slob shin tu mang ba dang bcas/ snga sor rang re shin tu na ba'i sgang de la bsam rtser 'byor/ der zla gag dang / rtag brtan du zla gshig lto ni phar ster dgos chos dgugs byas/ sbyor drug gi sngon 'gro'i tshogs chos la yang yod/ btsun ma thams cad dang/ rtogs ldan ci rigs pas dam po'i khungs kyang byas/ dus khrid grol nas/ khong rnams la shangs chos cha tsam mgyogs 'khrid byas/ de grol nas 'gro don la thegs song / 'di skabs hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin nas/ rang re'i ba la ka mdzod pa kun dga' dpal bzang bag tsam na/ nyin re bzhin zungs je yin la 'gro ba'i rnam pa 'duga'akhrid gtor gyi skabs nyi ma bzhi po de la/ khrom gyi mgo la yang 'gro thub pa'i dga' tshad yod na'ang / nyer bzhi'i nyin zungs kyis ma thub pa 'dra ba cig la ma 'tsho bar 'das song / deng rang sger gyi skyid res thams cad de kas 'khor song / khyed dmangs 'dis mi go ba 'dug pas brda' 'byor ba'i phyir 'dir —238—

smras pa tsam lags/ yin kyang 'tsho ba'i dus kyi lhag cung zad tsam 'di la skyid sdug la khyad tsam ta mi 'dug bal gu kho ras ni sngar dge ba'i las rgya chen po byas pa dang / nam bzhag rgyun du bzlas brjod dang kha ton la brtson po rang byed kyi 'dug pas yin nam/ na ba nas brtsams de bar la sgom yang rang shugs la yong ba dang mthong snang 'dra dang ya mtshan pa'i ltas thor pa byung song ba zla bo kun la'ang gsal/ dkyus la zug gzer chung ba la/ skabs skabs su glo dang gzer yong ba zhig 'dug 'tsho byed 'dra yod de/ long 'gros de kha ma gtogs nad dngos zin pa rang cig ma byung / de rjes rjes sgrub sogs rang res gang grag gtong ba'i lugs byas kyang blo khengs pa rang ni ma 'grub/ khong rang la zur gsog bre gang yang med/ lar dge ba phyi rjes su byed pa'ang dga' mo yin mod kyi/ gtso cher rang yod dus su byed dgos pa la/ gson po'i dus su dge ba rang ci lcogs byas pa de yin/ rang res sngar bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i dge ba 'grub zer ba thams cad kho ras byas pa yin/ rtag brtan gyi sde 'di tsam kho ra'i lag mi 'dre yin/ gzhan su yang gi yus med/ bla ma'i mnga' thang la brten nas bza' btung 'dra byed/ rngan pa len nom pa 'dra sdud/ nor 'dra gsog nag chang 'dra don gnyer byed mkhan ni 'dug lags/ pha yi pha yi/rang re dge sbyor 'dra byed pa la/ bya byed tshang ma khong ras yong ba rang re'i bsam pa bzhin blos khel nges/ sger g.yog tsho'i dbang du mi gtong ba'i lag g.yog grul btub de 'das pas/ 'phral gyi bya byed la khas 'chad pa rang byung na'ang / 'byor rgud dang bde sdug res 'jog dang / thams cad 'bral ba'i —239
