yang / /ston thog ma zos shi ba mthong ba'i tshe/ /las kun dka' la don re chung bar shes/ /las la ma dgyes ci mdzad chos la bsgyur/ /pha ma sbun zla 'khor g.yog la ltas na/ /'ga' zhig sngar 'das la la da bzod 'gro/ /mi sdod 'bral ba mthong tshe yid re skyo/ /rang yang de ltar yin min bsam pa zhu/ /mdza' ba'i grogs kyang rmi lam mgron po 'dra/ /yod pa'i 'phro la gar song cha med 'gro/ /dpal 'byor 'di yang ston ka'i na bun 'dra/ /yun ring sdod sdod 'dra yang 'phral du 'jig /dbang thang longs spyod sos ka'i 'ja' tshon 'dra//mig sngar mdzes kyang yid brtan rtag mi thub/ /de la g.yo rgyu brdzun zob lhur blangs pa'i/ khe bogs nyes pa che bas rigs ma yin/ /da lta blo gtad 'cha' ba'i grogs po yang / /'phral du dgra yi dang mar 'gyur gyin snang / dgra gnyen mi rtag phyogs zhen mi 'tshal bas/ /gtan gyi dgra bo yin nges nyon mongs thul/ /bskyangs pa'i bu tsha rang stobs rgyas pa'i tshe/ /drin dang ldan pa'i pha mar ma gus shing / /cir yang mi sems mang du mthong bas na/ /dgos dus phan nges rig pa'i khye'u skyongs/ /mir skyes rtsa na sdig pa la dga' ba/ khre nas gshin rje'i skyes bus khrid gyur te/ /bzod thabs med pa'i sdug bsngal bskal par myong / /dmyal bar skyes tshe 'gyod kyang ci la phan/ /nam zhig sha rus phung po 'jig pa dang / /'gyu ba'i dbugs 'chad gnyen gyi gdung sems 'jig/'khor g.yog rjes su mi 'brang yul dang 'bral/ /zas nor kun bor rogs med gcig pur 'gro/ /lang tsho'i me tog rgas pa'i ba mos gdungs/ /mdangs nyams stobs shor yi mug sems mi bde/ /'dod la dga' yang spyod pa'i nus —350—

pa med/ /pha rol 'gro ba mthong tshe yid rab 'byung / /phyi nas dam pa'i chos dang mjal ba'ang dkon/ /mi lus rin chen thob pa dka' bas na/ /da lta dam pa'i chos la ma 'bad na/ /gtan gyi mdun ma shin tu nyams par 'gyur/ /bsags pa'i longs spyod gzhan gyis bgo bshar byed/ /gces pa'i lus srog bzhag nas 'gro ba'i tshe/ /g.yog dang bu rta rjes su mi 'brang zhing / /che ge shi zhes ming rkyang tsam gcig lus/ /slan chad gnyen dang mkhar gzhis mnga' zhabs nor/ /nam yang gzigs pa'i skabs kyang med pa dang / /ngan song gsum gyi brtson rar 'khyams pa'i tshe/ /dkon mchog gsum las skyabs gzhan ma mchis la/ /sbu gri gtams pa'i thang ni rgya re che/ /ral gri'i nags tshal thibs po pha mtha' med/ /ri klung thams cad me lcer 'bar ba'am/ /grang bas nyen nas brgya tshal stong tshal du/ /rang lus gas tshe 'jigs pa cis mi skye/ /thos kyang 'jigs la bsams na tshugs thabs med/ /lo brgya'i bar du zas skom ming yang med/ /zos na me ru 'bar bas khor lus sreg /gnas tshul bsams na skrag pas sha rus 'gyes/ /gcig la gcig za gsod dang 'ching dang brdeg/bkol zhing dbang med dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal yang / /thog tu babs na bzod pa'i thabs mchis sam/ /da lta bcos thabs yod dus 'bad 'bungs 'tshal/ /nam zhig thog tu babs na gzhan dag la/ /gyod kha rdal ba'i khag ngan su la bgo /rang nyes rang gis 'byer las 'os ci yod/ /sdig pa'i grogs po ngan 'gro'i bsu ma sa /ma shes bde skyid dga' ba'i grogs su 'khrul/ /dge la spyor na dgra yang bla ma yin/ /sdig la sbyor na bdud kyi pho nyar dgongs//chos —351—

ma sgoms na mi rtag sdug bsngal gyi/ /yi mug sgoms kyang phan pa mi gda' bas/ /chos la 'jug pa'i gegs kyang 'di ltar gda'/ /mi nus snyam dang da res mi khom snyam/ /gzhan dbang song dang phyi shol ngang la lus/ /rang mthong che ba'am thang chad bgyid lug dang / /mi bden snyam dang long yod byed pa ste/ /de dag spangs nas 'phral du nyams len 'tshal/ /dkar nag las la bslu ba ma mchis pas/ /'di la spang blang nan tan skyed nas 'tshal/ /g.yog dang khyim thab gnyen dang srid kyi phyir/ /sdig las mdzad kyang rnam smin rang nyid las//gzhan gyis cha shas tsam yang nod pa med/ /de bas gzhan phyir sdig la dges mi 'tshal/ /rang la gnod pa chung yang mi bzod par/ /gzhan lus dum bur gtum pa'i phod khams can/ /bza' btung tsam gyi phyir du srog kyang gcod/ /rang 'dod can gyi spyod ga rnam spangs te/ /mdzad pa bzang pos rang gzhan phyogs kun gyi/ /yul khams thams cad bde ba'i thabs sgrub 'tshal/ /'gro drug drin can pha ma lags pas na/ /kun la 'bad nas phan sems bskyed par 'tshal/ /'gro la byams dang snying rje bskyed pa ni/ /chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba lags pas na/ /gal po che 'di nan tan ldan pas sgom/ /gnod sems 'khon 'dzin mi bya 'phral 'phral yang / /phan pa ci thogs don med gnod mi bgyid/ /smon pa lta bur sems la rang dbang med/ /bdag gi las kyis bskul nas dgra zlar song / /rang la brten nas dgra la sdig pas gos/ /pha ma dmyal bar 'gro ba snying re rje/ /de ltar bsam pas gdug sems zhi bar 'gyur/ /lam gyi rtsa ba bla ma'i rnal 'byor te/ /mos gus gdung shugs —352—

drag pos gsol ba gdab/ /bar chad thams cad 'di nyid kho nas sel//dngos grub thams cad 'di nyid kho nas thob/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i dgongs pa kun bsgrub cing / /yid kyi mos gus ngag gi snyan par brjod/ /yon dbul lus kyi bya ba thams cad kyis/ /slob dpon gang dges de la 'bad par bya/ /'jig rten rje bo ji ltar bzang yang 'bral/ /bla ma dam pa'i thugs rjes 'dor mi srid/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs shugs las rtogs pa skye/ /phyag rgya chen po byin rlabs lam byed yin/ /gsal la 'dzin med lhod de shigs se ba/ /gang snang steng du skyong ba'i zhi gnas dang / /rang ngo rjen par mthong ba lhag mthong gnyis/ /sgom gyi 'jug sgo lags pas nan tan 'tshal/ /gang shar de la bcas bcos med par zhog /'gyur ba gang byung so ma de la bskyang / /gnas sam 'gyu yang bzo bcos mi 'tshal bas/ /yengs med kha gang rig pa'i skyong dar zhu/ /zab don nyams len kun gyi snying po ni/ /rang gi sems la lta zhing tshol ba yin/ /skyes tsam nyid nas gdod nas grol grol ba/ /ngo ma shes pa'i brdzun phugs btib par 'tshal/ /rlud sems rtsa thig btsun pa thabs kyi lam/ /lha sku snang stong zhen med sgyu ma'i sku/ /nyin mtshan gcig gis gcig la bogs 'don zhing / /gnyid kyi gti mug gsal stong bde bar gyur/ /gang snang bla ma yi dam dbyer med la/ /ma zhen dag snang 'khor lo phyogs med bsgyur/ /ji tsam dmigs pa sgom pa thams cad kyang / /rang ngo shes pa'i dran pas zin pa gnad/ /sdig pa bshags dang dge ba gsog pa dang / /rjes su yi rang bsngo bas rgyas thebs pa 'di bzhi mtho ris thar pa'i rtsa ba yin/ /sngar byas sdig la shin tu 'gyod pa —353—

dang //phyin chad srog la bab kyang sdom sems dang / /skyabs 'gro byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed dang / /de ltar bshags na sdig pa byang bar 'gyur//glegs bam sku gzugs byed cing gzungs sngags bzlas/ /stong pa nyid bsgom sdig pa thams cad 'dag /pha ma nad pa mang thos ting 'dzin can/ /chos smra ye shes ldan dang dbul po dang / /tshul khrims ldan dang bla ma dam pa ste/ /'di dgu zhing gi dam par gsungs pa yin/ /chos bshad pa dang bsam gtan sgom pa'i grwa/ /gzugs dang lha khang byas na gzhi de las/ /bsod nams mang du 'phel bar 'gyur zhes gsungs/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la mchod pa rgya cher mdzod/ /lha sgom sngags bzlas dag la'ang brtson pa dang / /dge 'dun la yang gus pa rgya cher mdzod/ /bstan pa rin chen 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu/ /dge slong dge 'dun yod der yun ring gnas/ /'phags pa'i gang zag gar yod mi 'tshal bas/ /gang la'ang brnyas sems skur ba gdab mi 'tshal/ /don med tshe 'di'i bya ba la 'das nas/ /don chen shul du lus pa mang bar gda'/ /dam chos bya snyam yod pa mang na yang / /lag tu longs pa'i mi ni rgya lam na/ /de skad kun dga' snying po zhes bya bas/ /nor 'dzin bdag mo ngag dbang don yod mtshan/ /dge legs dpyid kyi dpal mor gdams pa 'di/ / gong dkar zhes bya rgyal po'i khab tu'o/ /rin rṣa gsum gyi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /srid 'dir phun sum tshogs pa nyid gyur nas/ /bla med byang chub rgyal ba'i rgyal srid la/ /rtag par bzhugs pa'i dge mtshan rgyas par shog /rang lo nyer lnga pa la dge/ //ma ṅga la bistu ra ku sa/—354—

༈ kun 'dzom la/ ༈ oṃ snya sti/ ched du phul ba/ nyams snang rmi ltas bzang ngan sogs gang la yang 'dzin zhen mi 'tshal zhing / sems kyi 'khrul snang yin pas spyir gtad pa mi gdog kha sing te dngos grub kyis ltas yin/ kwa ye nam mkha' 'di la rgyu rkyen med/ /'on kyang yod dang med par 'dzin na 'khrul/ /'dzin med ngang du zhog cig skal ldan ma/ /chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ /mkha' la 'ja' tshon mdzes par shar ba na/ /yod yod 'dra zhing legs kyang yod rgyu med/ /ye nas yod ma myong yang 'ja' ru snang //'di ltar ma rtogs gol sa shin tu mang / /'ja' tshon mkha' las byung kyang mkha' la yal/ /gsal bar mthong kyang nam mkha'i rang bzhin yin/ /rgyu rkyen phrad pa tsam las rnam par snang / /'khrul pa'i rang bzhin chos kun de 'drar gda'/ /legs par brtags na 'ja' tsho ni nam mkha' gnyis/ /tha dad dbye ba 'dug gam mig yangs ma/ /rang sems stong gsal 'gag pa med pa'i rtsal/ /snying rje bzod glags med par shar ba na/ /snying rje'i rang ngos ma bcos so mar zhog /snying rje che la zhen chags chung ba yin/ /gting mtha' med cing zab pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /rba rlabs g.yo ba ji snyed byung gyur kyang / /rba rlabs rgya mtsho nyid las byung gyur zhing / /rgya mtsho'i chu de thim yang rgya mtshor thim/ /rlabs dang rgya mtsho rang bzhin / dad med/ /sems kyi rang bzhin 'di yang rgya mtsho 'dra/ /rnam rtog g.yo ba ji snyed 'khrugs gyur kyang / /rnam rtog sems kyi cho 'phrul sems la thim/ /sems dang rnam rtog tha dad ma lta zhig /sems ni gsal stong skye ba med pa'i phyir/ /'gyu ba'i rtog pa'ang gsal stong skye ba med/ /sems kyi rang —355—

bzhin ngo shes tsam gyis grol/ /rnam rtog 'di yang ngo shes tsam gyis grol/ /ngo ma shes na gnyis ka'ang 'khrul pa yin/ gnas dang 'gyur la spang blang mi 'tshal lo/ /me long shin tu dwangs pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /pra sngags btab pa'i khye'u sa pra gzugs mthong / /med kyang rgyu rkyen tsam la gzugs brnyan snang/ /gzugs brnyan byung yang me long zhig pa med/ /thog med dus nas rang ngo ma shes pas/ /'khrul pa'i snang ba ji snyed shar gyur kyang//sems kyi rang bzhin chos sku zhig pa med/ /'on kyang ngo shes med pas phan ma thogs/ /rang ngo shes na nyon mongs ye shes yin/ /ngo ma shes na lam yang 'khor ba'i rgyu/ /dgag sgrub spang blang med pa'i nyams len 'tshal/ /ji ltar brag ri mthon po'i rtsa ba nas/ /lhang lhang snyan pa'i brag cha byung na yang / /sgra de grags tsam nyid nas stong pa yin/ /rnam rtog shar tsam nyid nas skye med yin/ /chos sku rang la yod pa ngo shes 'tshal/ /phu chu drag po ci yang g.yo ba de/ /gsal dwangs mtsho la babs na lhan ner gda'/ /chu klung drag tu 'bab pa'am 'khyil kyang rung / /bsil dang rlan gsher ngo bor khyad par med/ /chu ltar 'khrugs pa'i 'dod chags g.yo ba yang / /rang ngo shes na mtsho bzhin lhan ner gda'/ /'dod chags shar tsam nyid nas rang grol ba/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes 'di la zer/ /'od dpag med mgon gzhan du ma 'tshol zhig /ji ltar nags la me phung 'bar ba na/ /me lce mkha' las byung zhing mkha' la thim/ /me ltar 'bar ba'i zhe sdang drag po yang / /sems las logs su cung zad grub pa med/ /zhe sdang rang bzhin gsal stong ngang la zhog /me long lta bu'i ye shes mi zer ram/ /mi bskyod rgyal po —356—

gzhan du ma 'tshol zhig /sbrul la mdud pa rgyab pa'i dus tsam na/ /mdud par snang yang rang grol nyid du 'dug /char sprin 'thug po ji ltar mtho na yang / /nam mkha' las gzhan grub pa cung zad med//ngo shes tsam na nga rgyal ser sna yang / /rang grol dbyings las logs su med par mthong / /nga rgyal ser sna mnyam nyid ye shes yin/ /rgyal ba rin 'byung gzhan nas ma 'tshol zhig /mkha' la rlung dmar ji ltar 'tshubs gyur kyang //'tshub ma'i thad kyi mkha' la 'gyur zlog med/ /phrag dog rlung dmar 'tshubs kyang sems kyi ngang / /rang grol 'di ni bya grub ye shes yin/ /don yod grub pa gzhan nas ma 'tshol zhig /mtshan mo nam mkha' mun pas khyab gyur zhing / /nam langs pa na sangs shing gsal bar mthong / /mun pa gzhan nas ma byung gar ma song / /nam mkha'i ngo po mun pas khyab pa'i tshe/ /gzhan du ma song mun pa sangs pa na/ /ngo bo 'gyur nas bzang du song ba med/ /sems kyi rang bzhin sgrib bcas sgrib med la/ /rang bzhin ngo bo bzang ngan 'gyur zlog med//mi shes gti mug rang ngo shes pa na/ /mi bcos so mar zhog cig ye shes yin//chos dbyings ye shes de la bcos ma gtong / /rnam par snang mdzad gzhan nas ma 'tshol zhig /'khor ba las gzhan myang 'das yod ma yin/ /nyon mongs las gzhan ye shes yod ma yin/ /rang sems las gzhan sangs rgyas yod ma yin/ /rnam rtog las ga po stong nyid yod ma yin/ /rang ngo ma shes thams cad 'ching ba'i rgyu/ /rang ngo shes na thams cad rang grol yin/ /zhen zhing bzung na thams cad gol sa yin/ /chen med skyangs na thams cad bogs 'don yin/ /bcas bcos byas na —357—

thams cad phyin ci log /ma bcos bzhag na thams cad rang bzhin yin/ /dgag sgrub spang blang med pa'i nyams len 'tshal/ /e ma 'di 'dra'i nyams len shes gyur na/ /da ni sdod dam langs sam 'gro yang rung / /za 'chag nyal sogs spyod lam ci byed kyang / /thams cad dge sbyor rgyal po'i ngang nyid yin/ /dmigs pa'i lta ba tsam gyi dge sbyor ste//sems kyi gzhi rtsa chod par mi gda' bas/ /byams pa sgoms na 'dod chags sred par lhung / /zhen med sgoms na rang don yid byed skye/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal sgoms na yi chad ldang / /rig pas brtags shing bcad kyang rnam rtog yin/ /bsam mno tsam gyis mgo bo 'khor nyen gdog /byang chub thob 'dod skyes kyang re ba yin/ /sdug bsngal bral 'dod skyes kyang dogs par song / /mi sdug ting 'dzin sgoms pas zhe sdang ldang / /rten 'brel gnas lugs bsam pas rnam rtog 'khrug /dmigs pa rtse gcig gtad na gti mug skye/ /lam sogs yon tan bsam na nga rgyal ldang / /bdag gi nyes pa bsam na shin tu zhus/ /lha sgom bzlas pas bdag 'dzin dam du song / /g.yas pa bcos tshe g.yon pa zhig pa dang / /g.yon pa bcos tshe g.yas nas zhig pa'i dpes/ /rang grol gnas lugs phyag chen ma shes par/ /nyams len byed pa 'di dag shin tu brel/ /bya brgya 'ur rdo gcig gis ded pa ltar/ /sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i mthar thug phyag rgya che/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs min pas mi rtogs pas/ /rtag tu gsol ba 'debs la brtson pa zhu/ /nyams len gnad ni de bzhin kho na lags// //༈ rje mtshan ldan gyi bla ma sku drin can/ /pha lha dbang grags pa'i —358—

zhabs la 'dud/ khong rtogs ldan ma yin grub thob yin/ /grub thob ma zer sangs rgyas gyis/ /las ngan ma dag pas mi ngas kyang / /sngon bla ma sangs rgyas sems can du mthong / /dus de tsam ltas na chos skur gda'/ /sku gsum rin po che la gsol ba 'debs/ khyed sgrub pa lhur len gyi tshogs pa la/ /nged grong khrod 'grims pas smra ci yod/ /'on kyang bla ma de'i sku drin gyi/ /gdeng gcig yod pas 'di skad zhu/ /snang ba kun ngo sprod du shar tsa na/ /yig nag gi dgos pa mi gda' 'o/ /dmigs med kyi snying rje shar tsa na/ /phyogs ris kyi dgos pa mi gda' 'o/ /zhen pa gting nas log tsa na/ /snyan grags kyi dgos pa mi gda' 'o/ /ri khrod dben pa bsten tsa na/ /'grogs bshes kyi dgos pa mi gda'o/ /gdams ngag dang bla ma 'dzom dus su/ /blo mang gis khyer ba de spong ba zhu/ /dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung dus su/ /dad log dang 'khrug pa spong ba zhu/ /dam chos kyi dogs pa gcod dus su/ /long gtam gyi chal chol de spong ba zhu/ /sgrub pa'i rang tshugs 'dzin dus su/ /ngo dga'i mthun 'jug de spong ba zhu/ /'od gsal gyi nyams len bral gyur na/ /snang ba kun bar do'i 'khrul bar gda'/ /gdams pa zab mo mang yod kyang / /brtson 'grus kyi lag dang bral gyur na/ /rgya mtsho'i gting gi nor bu 'dra/ /bzang yang phan par mi gda'o/ /blo drang pos thams cad shes na yang / /bden brdzun gyi kha rgyag byas gyur na/ /snyigs dus kyi skye bos sdig pa gsog /ngag smra ba bskyungs la rang so bzung / /za rgyu dang gon rgyu skyid sdug kun/ /re sa bla ma las med pa la/ /dbu skor dang kha g.yogs gtong ba de 'khrul/ /gegs sel dang bogs 'don dngos gzhi'i —359—

skabs/ /gdams ngag gi rgyal po mos gus yin/ /zab don gzhan du 'tshol na 'khrul/ /lar snyigs dus kyi slob ma bla ma la zhabang / /gros ngan gyi 'go dpon la lha ru 'dzin/ /'phral 'phral du 'di phyi gnyis med yong / /de lha dang phung 'gong gnyis nor ba yin/ /sems rang bzhin med pa'i gtad med las/ /nyams dang rtogs pa kun 'char lags kyang / /snyigs dus kyi sgom chen kun yid mi ches/ /blo rtse tshe 'di'i mdun ma la gtod/ /sgom chen grong du 'khyams kyin gda'/ /de dug dang bdud rtsi nor ba yin/ /nye ba ni rdo rje sbun rang nye/ /mi kun ni sdig pa de la gsog /dmyal ba'i sa bon kho na 'debs//mched grogs la dag snang sbyong ba zhu/ /dbang chos zhu ba skad byed na yang / /bla ma la phyi mi 'tshol ba dang / /mi g.yin la nang mi byed pa 'di/ /dam kha la ma nyams don la nyams/ /dmyal ba'i gting rdo zhig lags pas spong bar zhu/ /ja chang dang mar skrog gi lag 'byongs kyis/ /nye gnas kyi ngos 'dzin byed byed nas/ /sgrub pa pa'i rang tshugs bskyal nyen gdog khyu song la phan yon chung ba zhig gda'/ kha bla ma'i zhabs tog sgrub skad pa/ /phugs za rgyus mi chog la byer rgyu dgos/ /lar byas pa la drin gzo cung zad med/ /mos gus stor ba dang a cang che/ /ngan smras kyi brjod pa char ltar 'bab/ /tshig brjod pa mkhas la rtog dang che/ /de 'dra yi bla ma'i nye gnas de/ /dmyal ba rin gyis nyo ba yin/ /drung na gnas pa rnams gzab par zhu/ /tshe mi rtag myur du 'jig pas na/ /zhag gsum tsam kha ni gso ba la/ /gtan gyi mdun ma ma rlag cig /blos byas kyi stong pa dang dmigs bcas kyi lam/ /rang gis rang nyid 'ching ba yin//byar med —360—

ngang du zhog dang sgom rṣa kun/ /byar med kyi bsgom 'di ma byung na/ /dge sbyor gyis rkyen thub mi yong mchis/ /'dod chags dang zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /lam du khyer lugs shig ma shes na/ /dpa' bo lag cha med pa dang 'dra/ /blo bde ba'i dus cig med med 'dra/ /rlung sems tshags su ma tshud na/ /blo chos su song ba skad byas na yang / /nges 'byung ni na bun bzhin du yal//nyams kra kri cung zad shar ba yang / /sos ka'i ldeng ka bzhin du bskams//mthar tha mal du 'gro ba'i dus shig 'dug /rlung sems la 'jur brdar mdzad pa zhu/ /gzhan yang grwa rigs kun gyis dgongs 'tshal ba la//rang gi chos nyams su mi len par gzhan nyams len byed pa la skur ba ma 'debs//chos kyi bar chad ma byed/khe 'dod nor gsog ma byed/ /sdebs dang dkrug la ma dga'/ /rang gis rang mtshang ma ston/ /grogs kyi skyon 'tshang ma 'dru/ /kha mang dgra yangs ma 'gyed/ /klad med ngo 'dzin ma byed/ /dkon mchog gi rdzas la ma rngam/ /bla ma'i nor la ma za/ /g.yin nor la ltog pa ma byed/ /ci byed chos dang mthun par gyis/ /rang gi rang la 'dzur brdar 'tshal//༈ oṃ rdza sti/ longs spyod kyi khe spogs byed pa ste/ /nged rang chos pa la rung ma yin/ /dus nam zhig bla ma sangs rgyas dus/ /ma ngas/ pa'i 'khor du 'ong zhes gsungs/ /da dge sbyor gang yong ma gtogs pa/ /'khru tshong gi 'phel 'gyed mi mdzad pa zhu/ /'phral 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa/ /nam zhig dag pa'i 'khor du 'ong / /de lha dang dag pa yong phyir la/ /dag pa'i 'khor dang mdzad pa zhu/ /dam pa'i chos la gegs byed na/ /pha ma dang mched grogs yone —361—

mchod sogs/ /su yin kyang bdud du 'bab par gda'/ /mi chos kyi 'brel 'di spong bar zhu/ /snying rje dang wo chags ngo bo gcig /'khor 'das kyi lam la nor so yod/ /chos dang ci mthun ma gtogs pa/ /mi yi ngo bsrung la ma dga' mdzod/ /rang chos ldan du sdad nas 'dug tsa na/ /mi kun gyis gus pa byed par 'dug //chos 'gal gyi spyod pa spong bar zhu/ /yang yang skye ba 'di sdug re bsngal/ /skye med mngon sum du ma gyur par/ /rtse gcig tu sgom pa 'di gal re che/ /sems kyi gzhi rtsa chod pa zhig 'tshal/ /dge sbyor gyi sgang la 'bung dus su/ kha he he zer ba'i long gtam mkhan/ /dge sbyor gcog pa'i phung 'dre yin/ /grogs dang 'brel ba mi mdzad zhu/ /rang sgrub pa nyams su len tsa na/ /ja chang gi zas bskor byed pa ste/ /g.yan pa phrug pa'i bde ba 'dra//bdud kyi mgo bskor zhig ma lags sam/ /yong nges shes pa'i 'chi ba la//med thabs med pa dam chos yin/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba don med du 'dug/ phyi ma'i bsod nams gal re che/ /rang sems chos skur ma rtogs na/ /dngos grub chen po brgyad po yang / /spros bcas kyi mgo bskor tsam du gda'/ /dbang sdud dang drag po'i 'phrin las dang / /mig mthong dang rna snyan khrus chog sogs/ /nyams len pa la bdud du 'bab/ /'gro ba la phan nges ma gtogs pa/ /grong chog la dga' ba mi mdzad zhu/ /bde sdug dang sems snang gang byung yang / /nyams la ma zhen sgom par zhu/ /mdza' mdza' 'dus pa'i pho khrom la//chags sdang gi long gtam 'thag pa ste/ /drin can gyi bla ma'i thugs dkrugs shing / /rang g.yin gyi dge spyor gcog pas na/ /mchu bsdur la dga' ba mi mdzad zhu/ /nyams len —362—

—byed pa'i chos pa la/ /dgra gnyen nye ring mi yong bas/ /mthun mthun gra sdebs kyi dpung gzhibs te/ /bstan pa bshig pa'i dad ma yin/ /dben dang sdebs dkrugs mi 'tshal lo/ /bla ma dang dge 'dun gyi skyon gleng ste/ /rang zong rang gis 'tshong ba zhig lags/ /yon bdag gshe skur byed pa ste/ /rgyal khams kun dad pa zlog pa zhig 'ong / /mi nag la kha spyad thal ba ste/ /rang tshugs mi zin gzhan dbang du thal/ /chos tshugs dang ltag tshugs ma shor bar/ /'dzin tshugs 'tsham po mdzad pa zhu/ /dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yin pas na/ /bla ma la mos gus 'bral med 'tshal/ /byin rlabs kyi sna kha rno ba'i phyir/ /yi dam bsgom bzlas la rem par 'tshal/ /bstan pa bsrung dus dgos pas na/ /chos skyong gi bzlas brjod brtson par zhu/ /'phral du spyod pa gtsang ba dang / /phugs su dag snang che ba dang / /mched grogs nang kha gshin pa dang / /mgo yang blo mangs mi byed pa/ /sgom chen kun la gnad du che// //maṅgal//༈ lar snying nas blo sna ma 'gyur zhing / /sems dang dam chos ma 'dres pas/ /rlom sems dang bzang 'dzin ci byas kyang / khul rjes legs par mi gda' 'o/ /mi gzhan la khyad gsod dang rang mthong skye/ /phrag dog dang ngag 'khyal chags sdang 'phel/ /bla ma dang mched grogs la 'khang zhing 'khu/ /nor 'dod dang khengs dregs skyes pa zhig /de yin pa bar chad kyis khyer rtags yin/ /lo ni spyang grung rgod por sno/ /rgyud se rengs ye rengs la song ba des/ /'brangs ma gtsang rdzar ma nar mar 'ong / /sngon gral 'go 'dzin pa'i —363—

———gnas brtan yang / /mtha' skya ser kun gyis 'og tu sdod/ /gnad che dus ring / pa ma sgrims na/ /las lan gcig nyes pa'ang 'chos pa dka'/ /lar i ngang 'gal ba'i ngan spyod 'di/ khre phan ho dmyal ba'i gting rdo yin/ /tshe 'dir yang mi 'cha' khyi rgod pa/ /bla ma dang bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren po/ /da rjes ngan yang yang ma 'jog par/ /snying la rus pa 'jug par mdzod/ /rus pa chos su sgyur ba 'tshal/ /ban btsun phyug po gcig yong srid kyang / /mthong ba tsam gyis skyug re log /thos pa tsam gyis yi re mug /da byung na lta spyod 'dzom pa zhig gyis/ /min na'ang dka' spyad sdug rus kyis/ /nyams len la 'bad 'bung 'don pa dang / /blo chos song chos brgyad 'go snyoms pa'i/ /lta ba dang sgom pa bzang ba zhig dgos/ /yang na spyod pa zhib tig gis/ /rang spyod la skyon 'dogs med pa zhig 'tshal/ /gnyis med seng ge la mi tshe 'di/ /sngar bskyal la da dung skyel skyel 'dra/ /spyir sems can las ngan spyod pa la/ /nga mi gcig gis bya thabs ga la yod/ /dad pa dang dag snang snying rje dang / /nges 'byung dang sdom sems la sogs pa/ /gcig las gcig chung gi chos med po/ /nga rgyal dang 'dod chags zhe sdang dang / /phrag dog dang nor brnag la sogs pa/ /che mnyam du 'bar ba'i rgyud ngan po/ /ngag rdzun dang phra ma'i gter mo che//'phral byed dgu spyod pa gtsog po ste/ /gang la bltas kyang lta nyan med/ /rlom sems su che ste ze la le/ /lar rang mgo rang gis ma thon na/ /snying logs nas 'jug pa ga la srid/ /phyin chad bla ma'i thugs rje yis/ /dam pa'i chos bzhin spyod par shog/ // tā ra nā thas mai tri dharma bhu ti la gdams pa'o// maṅgal//—364—

lho/ o snya sti/ rje rdo rje 'chang chen grub thob tshul/ /mtshan thos pa tsam gyis don chen ldan/ /bdag bu slob kyi blo sna chos la sgyur/ khyed thugs rje'i gter la gsol ba 'debs/ /dus da res mi lus thob pa dang / /mtshan ldan gyi rje dang mjal skabs 'dir/ /nyams len la 'bad 'bung ma bton na/ /mi tshe don med du 'gro nyen gda'/ /nyams len gyi rgyal po mos gus yin/ /mthun rkyen gyi rgyal po nges 'gyung yin/ /bya byed kyi rgyal po byar med yin/ /mnyam bzhag gi rgyal po rang shar yin/ /rgyal po bzhi ldan gyi gdams ngag 'di/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i gsung ngag yin/ /grub thob yongs kyi thugs bcud yin/ /nga tā ra nā tha'i nyams myong yin/ /mtshan bcas kyi nyams len phyogs re ba/ /sdug dus mi phan pa'i skyid chos de/ /thabs mkhas kyi bkri tshul yin mod kyang / /sangs rgyas lag bcangs su gtod mi thub/ /rang zhal rjen par lta ba la/ /mtshan ldan rje la mos gus dgos/ /bla ma sangs rgyas skad pa'i kha snyan dang / /ci mdzad legs par lta dgos kyi sdug zhen can/ /ma byas pas ma byung tsam gyi mos gus de/ kho gzhi nas ltem 'gyang log ge ba/ /chos rang gis byed pa snyam tshugs bzang yang / /de sgra skad tsam las don mi mthong / /sangs rgyas dang sems can gyi 'then phyogs med/ /thugs chos sku skye med nyag gcig la/ /mdzad spyod nyes na'ang nyes go chod/ /phyogs med kyi 'gro don rgya re che/ /byin rlabs zhugs rung ma zhugs rung / /dngos grub thob rung ma thob rung /skyabs gnas gzhan na med do zhes/ /blo thag chod la gsol ba thob/ /thugs yid dbyer med du mnyam par zhog /sgom mi skye ba'i rang dbang ga la yod/ /—365—

zas gos 'dzom pa'i skyid 'dod de/ /dge sbyor 'chag la g.yeng ba che/ /mthun rkyen du ming btags rnam g.yeng de/ /rnal 'byor pa la dgos pa med/ /yid nges 'byung skyo shas drag po de/ /rang gcig pur sdod na skyo rogs yin/ /lus na tsha byung na nad g.yog yin/ /zas gos dran pa'i rnam g.yeng la/ /gdong zlog byed pa'i mthun rkyen yin/ /sngar ma byas pa cig med pa la/ /byas tshad 'khor ba'i g.yos su song / /da byar med kyi ngang du lhod de zhog /gto gyi btsan sa zin te mchis/ /blos byas kyi dge sbyor brtson na yang / /'gyur med kyi gto sa zin pa med/ /dbyings 'pho 'gyur med pa'i gnad ka des/ /rang babs su bzhag na 'gyur med thob/ /rang shar la bzo bcos mi 'tshal te/ /bcos min la ngo shes gal re che/ /sems rnam rtog med par rang gsal na/ /gsal ba gsal zhing stong pa de/ /rang ngo shes na chos skur 'dug /rang gis rang ngo shes dus na/ /rtog pa'i cho 'phrul ci che yang / /bde sdug gi 'char sgo gang mang kyang / /thams cad chos sku'i yo langs yin/ /rtog pa dang mi rtog khyad par med/ /gnas pa dang 'gyu ba'i rang 'tshang zhig /chab rom chu ru zhu ba ltar/ /gang snang rang sems su lhang nge ba/ /snang dus nas rjes med yul yul po/ /stong tsam gyi 'char sgo ma 'gags pa/ /ya gi sangs rgyas kyi sku gsum nas/ /ma/ gi dmyal khams yan chad kun/ /thams cad mi 'char bya ba med/ /ji ltar shar yang spros dang bral/ /ngag brjod pa kun gyi yul las 'das/ /sems rang rig bde ba chen por myong / /slar spros bcas kyi dge ba gong 'phel bya/ /thams cad phyag chen gyi yo langs yin/ /thabs shes rab tshogs gnyis —366—

rdzogs pa las/ /sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa rtogs pa yin/ /de nyams su blangs na bdud rtsi 'dra/ kha ltar shor na stong shob yin/ /rgyud thog tu nyams su yongs ba zhig 'tshal/ /nyams len la rang byan chud pa zhig zhu// //zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas srurya bi dza ya la gdams pa'o// maṅgal//༈ na mo gu ru we/ bla ma rin chen zhabs la 'dud/ /bu khyod mnga' ris stod phyogs su/ /'gro bar bzhed na dam chos kyi/ /rin chen phreng 'di rdzongs su 'bul/ /rnyed dka' dal 'byor mi lus 'di/ /rang yang lo brgya mi 'da' zhing / /do nub rang yang gdengs med pas/ /tshe 'di'i las thabs ma tshar bar/ /'chi'o snyam du skyo shas bskyed/ /ngan song gsum na skyid med cing / /lha mir skyes kyang sdug bsngal dang / /gang du bsdad kyang btson ra 'dra/ /su dang 'grogs kyang btson rdzi 'dra/ /longs spyod thams cad btson chos 'dra/ /'di las nam zhig thar zhes soms/ /mar gyur 'gro ba 'di thams cad/ /'bor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ /rang nyid zhu bdes mi chog pas/ /da lta sangs rgyas thob bya zhes/ /sems bskyed drag po bsgrub par bya/ /dmyal bar bdag nyid 'gro dgos kyang / /gzhan la gnod pa mi bya'o/ /rgyal srid rngan par ster na yang / /byang chub sems mchog mi 'dor zhing / /do gal che ba ci byung yang / /gzhan phan sems mchog rjed mi bya/ /'phen pa mda' 'phangs lta bu dang / /dam bca' brag ri lta bu dang / /seng ge lta bur snying stobs dgos/ /gdung sems chen pos bla ma dang / /yi dam thugs rje byin rlabs can/ /kun la —367—

gus pas gsol ba gdab/ /nad pa rnams la sman pa dang / /lam stor long ba'i dmigs bu dang / /mnyam pa lta bu'i blo bzhug go /skyo shas snying rje mos gus gsum/ /sngon 'gro'i man ngag mthar thug lags/ /gnas lugs nyams su len pa la/ /lung rig gi mtha' rgya chod na yang / /man ngag med na thog mi khel/ /lus ni bsam gtan phyag rgya bca'/ /ngag kyang mi smra rang sor bzhag/sems ni ma bcos rang thad la/ /ma yengs grim lhod ran par bya/ /sa/nga shar dran pa'i so pas bzung / /rnam pa ma 'gags gang du'ang 'char//rang bzhin ma grub ci yang min/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa yang //'di nyid kho na lags par nges/ /rang sems chos sku lam khyer yin/ /stong pa'i snang ba ma 'gags pa/ / phyi ru snod bcud lha ru bsgyur/ /grags tshad sngags su shes par bya/ /nang du rang lus yi dam lha/ /smras tshad sngags su shes pa dang / /dran tshad sgyu ma lta bur bsgom/ /bza' bco bdud rtsi gos lha rdzas/ /ci byed chos su bsgyur bar bya/ / snang ba longs sku'i lam khyer yin/ /skyid na sems can skyid par smon/ /sdug na kun gyi sdug bsngal blang / /dge ba byas tshad gzhan don bsngo/ /byed spyod sprul sku lam khyer yin/ /dngos gzhi sku gsum lam khyer ro/ /de nas sangs rgyas ma thob bar/ /dgos su tshe 'di yang dgos su/ /gnas skabs kun tu dam chos dang / /mi 'bral 'dun pa drag tu sbyang / /spyod lam kun du dran pa yi/ /lcags kyus bzung la nyams len dang / /rtag tu 'bral med bsgrub par bya/ /dge rtsa chos spyod nyams len ni/ /ci byas sangs rgyas rgyur bsngo zhing / /sangs rgyas nas kyang sems can rnams/ /bla med mchog la 'god pa —368—

yi/ /smon lam nan tan chen pos 'debs/ /'phen pa dran pa bsngo ba gsum/ /rjes kyi nyams len mthar thug yin/ /spros bral ngang nas spros bcas kun/ /rtse gcig nyams su len par zhu// gang la'ang 'dzin pa mi byed par// /so ma'i tshul gyis nyams len mdzod/ /sngon chad mang du bshad pa yi/ /snying po 'dis kyang dga' ba skye// //zhes pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// maṅgal/༈ zla ri ba grags bzang la gdams pa'o// ༈ na mo gu ra we/bdag 'chol ba'i rnal 'byor rgyal 'gru/sa nga/sa/ /nyams myong kun smra ru cung ma btub/ /tshig cung zad brjod na ji tsug 'ong / /thugs la mi 'phrod na zhog la thong / /bla mchod du ming btags kyi lto zan 'di/ /rang tshugs 'jig pa'i rgyu gcig gda'/ /dben par bsdad na mi legs sam/ /mtha' rgya ma chod pa'i dge sbyor 'di/ /zom zom gyi bzang rdzu las ma 'das pas/ /brdar sha bcad na mi legs sam/ /brgyud pa khungs med kyi chos thong kyang / /byin rlabs dang dngos grub mi 'byung bas/ /thug sar thug na mi legs sam/ /shes rab chung la dogs par che/ /'di mos gus mi skye ba'i snga ltas lags/ /the tshom spangs na mi legs sam// /gzhog thabs med pa'i bya gzhag 'di/ /tshe stong zad ru gtong ba'i bdud cig lags/ /lings kyis skyur na mi legs sam/ /grong chog rgyug pa'i dgon pa de/ /ming chos par btags pa'i khyim pa yin/ /lung stong 'grims na mi legs sam/ /ri khrod du zang zing gi 'byor pa de/ /dgon par bsdad pa don med du gtong / /rtse gcig tu sgrub na mi legs sam/ /lar dran —369—

tshad lag tu blangs pa la/ /lha 'dre mi gsum zhe khrel 'dod/ /mdun ma rtse gcig dril na mi legs sam/ /tshig brjod pa tsam la zhen pa de/ /don spyir las pa'i bzang 'dzin yin/ /tshig brjod pa spangs na mi legs sam/ /spros bral dang smra bsam brjod med sogs/ /legs legs dang zab zab ci smras kyang / /don gyis thog tu phebs dus med/ /brtags pa'i mtha' la thug dus med/ /sems las che ba kho nar zad/ /ma brtags bar klod na mi legs sam/ /bskyed rim mi gsal ba'i mog mog 'di/ /bogs su mi thon zhe re sun/ /ci gsal byas na mi legs sam/ /nyal bar 'dod dang 'phred snyes 'dod/ /nyi ma la sdod 'dod kyi ngan lang 'di/ /nyams len byed skad byas kyang byed dus med/ /sdug sran skyed na mi legs sam/ /bsam mno gtong dgos kyi gal po che/ /dgos nges kyi nyams len rlung la bskur/ /rtog med la zhe bcad mi legs sam/ /ma nus pa sangs nas byed snyam ste/ /snyom las kyi bdud la 'byams kyin gda'/ /'phral de 'grog 'bungs na mi legs sam/ khyu med la 'bras bu yong la re/ /'phral 'phral du rtags gcig yong la re/ /mkhas btsun dang grub thob kyi snyan grags 'dod/ /lkog mi thub pa'i tshul chos la bsnyen pa skyel/ /brdzun po che spangs na mi legs sam/ /bla ma'i bka' la nges shes shig bskyed/ /grub thob gong ma'i rnam thar zhig soms/ /rang mthong gang skyes de subs la zhog /lar la tshad med pas tsog ge sdod/ /de bden snyam 'dug na thugs la zhog /ma 'thad na rna ba'i gong ga la thong / /nyan kyang nga la dga' zhen med/ /ma nyan kyang nga la zhe sdang med// //ces pa'ang zla ba ri pa grags —370—

pa bzang po la nye bar gdams pa tā ra nā thas so// dge'o/ maṅgal//༈ dad ldan rnam rgyal la'o// ༈ na mo gu ra we/ /bu dad ldan nyi ma rnam rgyal ba/ khyed na sna di bag gcig smin pa la/ /zab don dang mjal ba nyams re dga'/ khong mkhyen rgya can dge bshes su ming btags pa'ang rga shi so thug thug spros pa la 'das/ /'chi khar mtshams spyor 'dra bzang tsam dang / /'phral lam khyer bzang tsam zhig la re/ /rang grol gcig nyams su ma longs na/ /rang dbang 'dus pa zhig mi 'ong ste mchi/ /sems 'phro 'du ma mang rang dga' zhog /'bad rtsol ma byed lhod kyi bshig /'phros song na de la sgom med du ltos/ /'bad med kyi dran pa 'di chu bo ltar/ /ma yengs pa rgyun mi 'chad cig mdzodi/ /thun dang thun mtshams la khyad med 'tshal/ dus nam zhig 'chi ba dang bar do'i tshe/ /spros bcas kyi dge sbyor rgyang du lus/ /spros med nyams len gal re che/ /slar myur du phrad nas nyams rtogs la/ /bogs 'don gang dgos de byed pa lags/ /zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas so// //maṅgal// //༈ cha bka' bcu pa la'o/ / ༈ rab dkar ston ka'i sprin bzhin du/ /rab g.yo lhag bsam dag pa las/ /snyan tshig sbrang char 'bab pa ni/ /ring du yid bde'i gsos su gyur/ /rnam dkar bsil zer can mtshon pa'i/ /gos bzang gru bzhi lham pa ni/ /phyogs kun dkar por byed pa 'di/ /'gro don rgyas par 'gyur ba'i rtags/ /nyid blo chen sde snod shes pa la/ /bdag lta bus ji —371—

ltar smra bar byed/ /gzhung zab cing rgya che dpag dka' ba/ /thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pa kun/ /sems lhag bsam dag pas kun blangs te/ /blo gsal rnams la rgya cher shod/ /chos smra ba'i go sar 'dug nas kyang / /longs spyod 'ba' zhig don gnyer gyis/ /chos kyi bya ba bshol ba de/ /lung gi bstan pa'i chom rkun yin/ /'phral 'chad nyan smra bar snang na yang / /byang chub sems kyis ma zin na/ /chags sdang gi rgyu la mi tshe skyel/ /rang gzhan 'khor ba las mi grol bas/ /g.yin don 'joms pa'i chom rkun lags/ /mdo sde dang rgyud sde mkhas grub kyi gsung / /sngon byon byin rlabs kyi gzi brjid can/ /gzhung 'grel bzang po la na myo/ tan 'tsha'// /phyi rabs kyi gtam la ma dgos shig/sngon byon gyi mkhas pa grub thob pa yin/ /phyi rabs kyi mkhas pa mkhas brdzu ru snyen dug /dus bskal par nor rdzas spyin pa las/ /chos nyin gcig spyin pa lhag ces gsungs/ /grags 'dod dang che 'dod kyi chos bshad la/ /chos zong du btsongs pa'i nyes pa'ang yod/ /rang sems dul ba 'di gal re che/ /bshes sa/nyen pa'i thugs la de ltar zhog/ //maṅgal/ /༈ bdag po sngags 'chang bkras stobs la// ༈ 'dir nges par brjod pa/ sdeb sbyor tha snyad gtsor mdzad mkhas pa'i tshogs/ /kun brtags tshig la nges pa'i don du 'khrul/ /blo chung 'ga' zhig mnyam bzhag bsam gtan la/ /phyir phyogs sgom 'gro bor nas thos bsam byed/ mi shes mun sgom tsam gyis nga rgyal dang / /lag len nor pa'i cho gas 'da' ba'ang yod/ /bzlas —372—

brjod brtson spangs stong nyid snying rje dang / /rab bral byang chub mchog la shin tu ring / /mdo sde gzhung lugs gsang sngags thams cad dang / /man ngag kun yang gzhol zhing 'bab pa'i gnas/ /chos kun rtsa ba rang sems gcig pu ste/ /sems nyid gdod nas ma grub snang stong yin/ /bzang ngan bde sdug snang ba sna tshogs 'di/ /rang snang 'gag pa med pa'i rtsal lags pas/ /re dogs bcas bcos mi 'tshal lhug par bzhag /ngo shes ngang nas dmigs pa phyogs med gtong / /gegs sel bogs 'don kun gyi mthar thug lags/ /dngos grub 'phrin las sgrub la brtson pa yang / /re dogs bral ba'i dbyings nas g.yo med spyad/ /thabs shes zung 'jug ces bya'i gdams ngag lags// //maṅgal/dge'o/ /༈ kam bka' bcu la gdams pa'o/ /༈ sems nges med rig stong sna tshogs 'di/ /nyams 'di 'char med pa'i gnad ka des/ /mi gzhan dang blo sna mthun dka' yang / /chos zab don ci rigs ston zhing mchis/ /drang don dang nges don zhes bya ba/ /gnas lugs kyi steng na tha dad med/ /rtsal nges med 'char ba'i rang sems 'di/ /ming kun rdzob skad du btags pa yin/ /'di brtags na brjod bral gang du'ang med/ /de nges don skad du mkhas rnams 'dogs/ /lar gang yang min pa zhig cir yang snang / /zung 'jug sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor 'di sgom pa zhu/ /snyigs dus kyi skye bo'i ngan smras 'di/ /sngar byas kyi sdig sgrib 'dag la phan/ /'o skol ni sdig sgrib sbyong mkhan zhig lags/ /phan —373—

'dogs la mi dges mi 'tshal lo/ /las 'bras dge sdig gi snang ba yang / /rang sems 'khrul pa'i snang ngo thig lags/ /las sems kyi nang bzhin byar med du/ /brtsis gdab med par sgom par zhu/ /rnam smin kun dbyings su bdag te mchis/ /rang sems ni chos sku skye med kyi ngang / /bla ma ni chos sku'i ngo bo lags/ /rang sems dang dbyer med du shes tsa na/ skyabs gnas la 'bral ba mi gda'o/ kha gang rig pa'i skyong tshul 'di/ /shi gson la khyad par mi gdog pas/ /sgom pa lhongs su 'byur tsa na/ /bar do zer yang grags stong yin/ /yengs med dpen gnas kyi ri khrod du/ /rtsol grub med pa'i dbyings de la/ /le lo med par sgom pa zhu/ /da res lam sna zhig mi zin/ /sems gang shar lhug pa ma lags pa'i/ /gnyen po ma rnyed pa lags mod kyang / /the tsho mi dang bzang 'dzin mi 'tshal lo/ /go chod po'i nyams len shar ba la/ /yid mi ches byed na rang la sdig /bzang 'dzin byed na ni g.yang sar lhung / /lo zlar dkar bas brtsigs pa'i khang pa de/ /nyin gcig la bshig na las ro yin/ /mi tshe hril por bskyal ba'i sgom de yang / /rlom sems kyis khyer na byur du che/ /snang ba dang rnam rtog ci shar la/ /sems yengs med lhug pa bsten dgos na/ /de phyogs re yin gyi mthar thug min/ /da dung yang rang shar la lta ba zhu/ /sems kho rang gnyen po yin snyam ste/ kho gnyen por 'dug na 'khrul pa yin/ /rnam rtog dang snang ba rtog med gsum/ /ming tha dad don la khyad par med/ /spang gnyen dang smra brjod zad 'dug na/ /gdams ngag gi rgyal pos sleb pa yin/ /dka' spyad dang zhe rus 'dzom pa yis/ /yun ring 'bad rtsol ma —374—

byas pas/ /mi kho bos khyed la ji ltar 'dom/ /don nyams len gyis rang rgyud ma grol ba/ /gzhan grol bar 'dod pa 'di a re re/ /rang 'gyur med kyi brtan sa ma zin par/ /gzhan 'dren par byed zer a tsa ma/ /sngon nyams myong dang las rgyus med pa yis/ /skyes gzhan gyi lam sna ji tshug yong / /'on kyang bla ma rje btsun gyi/ /thugs rje dang rang gi mos mthu yis/ /rang sems kyi 'tshang kun bting kha des/ /cung zad smra bar spobs nas bris// //maṅgal/ dge'o/༈ gting skyes su chos mchog la// ༈ gang las sems nyid rin chen 'di ni/ /rtogs na ngo mtshar che ba gcig gda' ste/ /rtogs pa'i don du sgom mkhan gcig kyang nyung ngo / /mi lus rin chen rnyed dka' 'di la/ /chos la 'bungs na grogs gcig gda' ste/ /de la 'jug pa'i mi gcig nyung ngo / /byin rlabs can gyi bla ma mchog la/ /mos gus byas na rtogs pa 'char te/ /snyem 'khrigs med pa shin tu nyung ngo / /'gro drug drin can pha ma 'di la/ /snying rje shar na sgrib pa 'byang kyang / /phyogs med lhun grub tu 'char ba nyung ngo / /de byar med kyi ngang du yengs med 'jog cing / /'bad med kyi brtson 'grus phyogs med du rtsom pa/ /mtshan ldan bla mar mos gus kyi rgyab skyor/ /dag snang ris med phyogs med sbyongs shig /slad nas myur bar mjal mchis //༈ 'dir smras pa/ rnyed pa dka' ba'i mi lus 'di/ /nyams len chos la ma bkol na/ /da res stong log byed de mchis/ /sgom la 'bungs dang —375—

dad ldan gyi bu/ /mtshan ldan bla ma dang mjal ba la/ /zhabs tog dang sgrub pas ma mchod na/ /lag yod kyi dngos grub phyi la gtong / /mos gus la 'bungs dang skal ldan bu/ /'char sgo ma 'gags pa'i rang sems 'di/ /'dzin med kyi dbyings su ma bcun na/ /gzung 'dzin gyi ngang la yar te mchi/ /byar med kyi ngang la las med du zhog /nam 'chi cha med kyi tshe thung 'di/ /gzhan don lhag bsam gyi ma bsgyur na/ /gces 'dzin gyi ngang la don med du lus/ /lhod de klod dang rab 'byams pa/ /slar yang myur du mjal te 'ong / /nged kyis sngar zhal gdams bskur ba la legs so dang thugs la 'phrod tshul 'dug pas de tsam zhig gdams pa lags// //jo nang dbu mdzad rab 'khyams pa byams pa ba la 'o/ /maṅgalaX//༈ gong dkar rdo rje gdan gyi dgon gnyer dpon la'o/ / ༈ yun ring snyen ra bar 'khor gyur kyang / /da tsam nges don dang zhal mjal ba'i/ /dad ldan gyi thugs la 'di zhog dang / /nyams len la blo kha phyogs gsung pa/ /spyir ni rang don rang yin lags pas/ /gzhan la yus su mi gdog ste/ /sems can la yang de rang phan/ /nged gdams ngag 'bogs pa'i bla ma yang / /snying nas rjes su yi rang byed/ /sgrub pa'i kha bkod bskur gsung pa/ /tshig mang kyang snying po mi gda' bas/ /nyams len chig 'dril du byed pa dang / /chos min thams cad spong ba de/ /grags 'dod dang gzhan la brnyas bcos dang / /nga rgyal dang le lor ma song bar 'tshal/ /sang phod dang sang sgom snyam lags kyang/ /mi tshe —376—

yang nges pa med pa dang / /'chi ba la dus btab mi gdog pas/ 'u snam ra thams cad cams kyis zhog /'dun gros thams cad rbad kyis chod/ /lhab lhub thams cad hril gyis brdzes/ /snying gi lung thag yar la bstungs/ /dam chos zer ba'i sgra bo che/ /de ltar byas na lag tu longs/ /gzhan khye nyen gyi 'khor 'das brtsi brtsi nas/ /dgos nges kyi dam chos shul du phul/ /spros pa kun bcad nas tshig 'dril 'tshal// //maṅgal//—377—
